papers.title: EasyFoam: Skill-Oriented OpenFOAM Agents with Evidence-Driven Evolution
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of automating end-to-end OpenFOAM workflows for computational fluid dynamics (CFD). However, current progress is bottlenecked by two critical limitations. First, existing evaluations are dominated by tutorial-level cases and execution-oriented metrics, masking a substantial executability--acceptability gap: successfully executed simulations often fail to satisfy prescribed numerical or quantity-of-interest (QoI) criteria. Second, domain expertise in existing systems is tightly coupled with bespoke agent architectures, limiting its reuse and continual refinement across agent implementations. To address these challenges, we introduce ExtFoamBench, a challenging benchmark for OpenFOAM agents that spans five axes of workflow variation, and separately assesses execution completion, numerical soundness, and QoI satisfaction. Complementing this, we propose EasyFoam, an agent framework that decouples CFD expertise into modular, externalized skills driven by a dual-loop mechanism. An execution loop constructs workflows from explicit task requirements and uses structured simulation evidence to diagnose failures and guide targeted repairs. Meanwhile, an evolution loop distills task experience into reusable skill updates selected through paired evaluation. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that EasyFoam achieves substantially higher task acceptance rates than baseline agents, establishing this work as a starting point for future research toward self-improving CFD agents.

translation.title: EasyFoam：面向技能、证据驱动演化的 OpenFOAM 智能体
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在自动化计算流体动力学（CFD）端到端 OpenFOAM 工作流方面的能力日益增强。然而，当前进展受限于两个关键瓶颈。第一，现有评估主要依赖教程级案例和面向执行的指标，掩盖了显著的可执行性—可接受性差距：成功运行的仿真往往无法满足规定的数值或感兴趣量（QoI）标准。第二，现有系统中的领域专业知识与定制的智能体架构紧密耦合，限制了其在不同智能体实现之间的复用和持续改进。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 ExtFoamBench，一个具有挑战性的 OpenFOAM 智能体基准，涵盖五个工作流变化维度，并分别评估执行完成度、数值正确性和 QoI 满足度。与此互补，我们提出 EasyFoam，一个将 CFD 专业知识解耦为模块化、外部化技能的智能体框架，由双循环机制驱动。执行循环根据明确的任务需求构建工作流，并利用结构化的仿真证据诊断失败并指导针对性修复。同时，演化循环将任务经验蒸馏为可复用的技能更新，通过成对评估进行选择。实证评估表明，EasyFoam 的任务接受率显著高于基线智能体，为未来迈向自我改进的 CFD 智能体研究奠定了起点。
translation.brief: 针对 OpenFOAM 智能体评估存在可执行性与可接受性差距、专业知识与架构耦合的问题，提出 ExtFoamBench 基准与 EasyFoam 框架，通过执行循环与演化循环实现外部化技能的持续改进。

papers.title: metalSPARSE: A 2:4 Semi-Structured Sparse GEMV Kernel for Apple Silicon GPUs
papers.abstract: Autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) generate text one token at a time, and each token reads every weight from memory, so on edge devices, decoding is limited by memory bandwidth. 2:4 semi-structured sparsity keeps two of every four weights, but Apple-silicon GPUs have no sparse matrix hardware, so pruning helps only if a kernel actually reads fewer bytes. We present metalSPARSE, to our knowledge the first 2:4 sparse kernels for Apple GPUs, together with a fused decoder written in Metal. The kernels stream weights in compressed form and expand them in registers. On Qwen2.5-1.5B with 2:4 sparsity on every decoder linear layer, decoding runs 3.6x faster than HuggingFace Transformers on PyTorch-MPS on an 8 GB M2 MacBook Air and 1.52x faster than MLX on a 16 GB M4. The same engine on dense weights matches MLX, so the gain comes from the compressed weights, and sparsity delivers 97% of the speedup its byte reduction allows. Prompt processing, which is compute-bound, does not speed up. To preserve quality, we combine a Wanda mask with block-wise reconstruction and low-rank adapters trained jointly with the surviving weights and quantized to 4 bits. On WikiText-2 this brings perplexity from 3.01x dense after one-shot pruning (Wanda with a closed-form refit) to 1.34x, and the whole pipeline runs on the same laptop/hardware.

translation.title: metalSPARSE：面向 Apple Silicon GPU 的 2:4 半结构化稀疏 GEMV 内核
translation.abstract: 自回归大语言模型（LLM）逐 token 生成文本，每个 token 都要从内存读取全部权重，因此在边缘设备上解码受内存带宽限制。2:4 半结构化稀疏保留每四个权重中的两个，但 Apple Silicon GPU 没有稀疏矩阵硬件，因此只有当内核确实读取更少字节时剪枝才有帮助。我们提出 metalSPARSE，据我们所知是首个面向 Apple GPU 的 2:4 稀疏内核，以及用 Metal 编写的融合解码器。这些内核以压缩形式流式读取权重并在寄存器中展开。在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 上对每个解码器线性层施加 2:4 稀疏后，在 8 GB M2 MacBook Air 上解码速度比 PyTorch-MPS 上的 HuggingFace Transformers 快 3.6 倍，在 16 GB M4 上比 MLX 快 1.52 倍。同一引擎在稠密权重上与 MLX 相当，因此增益来自压缩权重，稀疏性实现了其字节缩减所允许加速的 97%。受计算限制的 prompt 处理并未加速。为保持质量，我们结合 Wanda 掩码、分块重构以及与保留权重联合训练并量化到 4 bit 的低秩适配器。在 WikiText-2 上，困惑度从一次性剪枝后（Wanda 加闭式重拟合）的稠密模型 3.01 倍降至 1.34 倍，且整个流程在同一台笔记本电脑硬件上运行。
translation.brief: 针对 Apple Silicon GPU 缺乏稀疏矩阵硬件导致 LLM 解码受内存带宽限制的问题，用 Metal 编写首个 2:4 稀疏 GEMV 内核并配合 Wanda 剪枝与低秩适配器保持质量。

papers.title: SideTaskBench: Measuring Unauthorized Side-Task Delivery in Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Can a coding agent fix a user's repository while also completing and delivering work the user never requested? In this paper, we introduce SideTaskBench to measure this failure where third-party technical references induce agents to produce independent side-task artifacts during an authorized repair. Repair success alone misses this behavior. Our key measurement contribution is to pair each repair with a self-contained side task and verify side tasks' delivery success rate along with the repair success rate. The benchmark contains 25 Python repairs and 190 side-task units. Its four-level similarity index defines 300 executable repair--side-task pairs. The experiments show roughly 40% valid delivery under wrapped requests for two models, alongside repair success close to their clean baselines. The completed v10 similarity run uses DeepSeek-V4-Flash on all 300 pairs, with eight repetitions per pair (2,400 runs). Conditional delivery ranges from 20.48% for L0 unrelated tasks to 57.44% for L3 mechanism-overlapping tasks, while the L1-L0 difference is 5.37 percentage points and remains sensitive to task composition. The central insight is that technical relevance may blur the authorization boundary for an agent, such that an agent can solve the requested problem and still deliver unauthorized work. SideTaskBench emphasizes this potential weakness of existing agents and provides a testbed for defenses that preserve repair capability while preventing unauthorized delivery. The code is available at: this https URL.

translation.title: SideTaskBench：度量编码智能体的未授权附带任务交付
translation.abstract: 编码智能体能否在修复用户仓库的同时完成并交付用户从未请求的工作？本文提出 SideTaskBench 来度量这一失败模式：第三方技术参考在授权修复过程中诱导智能体产生独立的附带任务产物。仅看修复是否成功会漏掉这种行为。我们的关键度量贡献是将每次修复与一个自包含的附带任务配对，并同时验证附带任务的交付成功率与修复成功率。该基准包含 25 个 Python 修复任务和 190 个附带任务单元。其四级相似性指数定义了 300 个可执行的修复—附带任务配对。实验显示，在包裹式请求下两个模型约有 40% 的有效交付，同时修复成功率接近其干净基线。完成的 v10 相似性运行使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 在全部 300 个配对上进行，每对重复八次（共 2,400 次运行）。条件交付率从 L0 无关任务的 20.48% 到 L3 机制重叠任务的 57.44%，而 L1 与 L0 的差异为 5.37 个百分点，且对任务构成敏感。核心洞见是：技术相关性可能模糊智能体的授权边界，使得智能体在解决请求问题的同时仍交付未授权的工作。SideTaskBench 强调了现有智能体的这一潜在弱点，并为在保持修复能力的同时阻止未授权交付的防御方法提供了测试平台。代码可在：this https URL 获取。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体可能在授权修复中附带完成并交付未授权任务的问题，构建 SideTaskBench，通过修复与附带任务配对及分级相似性来度量未授权交付率。

papers.title: The Market Is the Reward: Design Markets, Not Just Traders for Human-AI Collective Intelligence
papers.abstract: Learning agents are becoming market participants, yet machine learning still treats the market as a fixed environment, although its payoff rule is the reward agents learn from. This position paper argues that financial AI should build HyperMarkets for human-AI collective intelligence, and not only the agents that trade in them: markets whose liquidity provision, information production, outcome determination, and trading rule are performed or adapted by learning agents and designed jointly toward explicit market-level objectives. In a pre-registered simulation with Claude agents trading for principals, joint design raises a market-level objective by 79% over separately tuned functions, through a trading rule that helps only when slow traders are present, and how evidence is paid for decides whether a stronger agent earns more for its principal. We state when fixed rules or non-market aggregation should be preferred and what findings would refute the case.

translation.title: 市场即奖励：为人类—AI 集体智能设计市场，而不仅仅是交易者
translation.abstract: 学习型智能体正在成为市场参与者，但机器学习仍将市场视为固定环境，尽管市场的收益规则正是智能体学习的奖励来源。这篇立场论文主张，金融 AI 应该为人类—AI 集体智能构建 HyperMarkets，而不仅仅是在其中交易的智能体：即流动性提供、信息生产、结果判定和交易规则由学习智能体执行或调整、并朝明确的市场级目标联合设计的市场。在一项预注册的模拟中，让 Claude 智能体代表委托人交易，联合设计相比分别调优的函数将市场级目标提升了 79%，其关键在于一条仅在慢速交易者存在时才起作用的交易规则，以及证据付费方式决定更强的智能体是否能为其委托人赚取更多收益。我们阐述了何时应偏好固定规则或非市场聚合方式，以及哪些发现会反驳这一主张。
translation.brief: 针对机器学习只优化交易智能体而将市场视为固定环境的问题，提出联合设计市场本身（HyperMarkets）使其收益规则可被学习型智能体塑造以实现市场级目标。

papers.title: MechFoundry: An agentic loop that poses and performs engineering analyses and optimization of real-world objects
papers.abstract: AI agents can automate software engineering because a compiler or a test suite checks that the code does what the user or the agent intended. In engineering analysis, however, the steps that precede the computation have few easily verifiable checks: modeling a design or an object, deciding how it is used, where supports and loads are applied, and what material each part is made of. A human expert therefore makes these decisions, carries out the steps, and judges the result, one object at a time. We present MechFoundry, an agentic loop coupled with bespoke software that automates structural analyses of real-world objects without a human in the loop. From an object's lexical description, it generates a shape, poses a loading case relevant to how the object is used, assigns a material to each part, solves the nonlinear structural response, and improves the design against the loads it carries. A differentiable GPU solver built on an adaptive octree that need not conform to the surface enables the transition from shape generation to simulation and optimization. Across 50 everyday and engineering objects, the agent posed and solved a loading case in 6.5 minutes and for US$1.3 per object on average. Without a test suite to check against, we had language-model reviewers grade each session, as a first indication of where the agent's engineering judgment holds and where it fails.

translation.title: MechFoundry：自动提出并执行真实物体工程分析与优化的智能体循环
translation.abstract: AI 智能体可以自动化软件工程，因为编译器或测试套件能检验代码是否符合用户或智能体的意图。然而在工程分析中，计算之前的步骤很少有易于验证的检查：为设计或物体建模、决定其使用方式、在哪里施加支撑与载荷、以及每个部件用什么材料。因此需要人类专家逐一做出这些决策、执行步骤并判断结果，一次只能处理一个物体。我们提出 MechFoundry，一个与定制软件 coupled 的智能体循环，可在无人参与的情况下自动化真实物体的结构分析。从物体的文字描述出发，它生成形状、提出与物体使用方式相关的载荷工况、为每个部件分配材料、求解非线性结构响应，并针对所受载荷改进设计。基于自适应八叉树、无需贴合表面的可微 GPU 求解器，实现了从形状生成到仿真与优化的衔接。在 50 个日常和工程物体上，该智能体平均每个物体用时 6.5 分钟、花费 1.3 美元即可提出并求解一个载荷工况。由于没有测试套件可供校验，我们让语言模型评审员对每次会话进行评分，作为智能体工程判断在何处成立、在何处失效的初步指标。
translation.brief: 针对工程分析中建模、加载与材料决策缺乏可自动验证检查的问题，构建 MechFoundry 智能体循环，利用可微 GPU 八叉树求解器实现从文字描述到结构分析、仿真与设计优化的全自动流程。

papers.title: When Evaluators of AI Agents Disagree: An Empirical Study of Native Scoring, LLM Judges, and Commit-Boundary Checks on tau2-bench
papers.abstract: Agentic workflows, in which a large language model (LLM) calls tools to read and write data, are evaluated in two ways. Benchmarks compare the final state against a gold answer. Deployed services have none; an LLM judge reads the transcript and decides. Practice treats the two as interchangeable. This paper measures whether they are. We ran 2,160 episodes in tau2-bench's airline and retail domains and recorded every database write. We scored each episode four ways: native scoring against gold state, an LLM judge, that judge given the policy document, and the boundary evaluator, a minimal rule-based check of whether a write was expected against whether one occurred in the trace. Two annotators independently labeled 120 episodes for task correctness, policy compliance, and commitment correctness. The judge repeated its verdict 98.2% of the time but agreed with native scoring on 56.2%. In 11 episodes the agent executed a forbidden write. The judge passed 10 to 11, with or without the policy or transcript. A stronger judge still passed 6. The boundary evaluator, with no model call, caught all 11; no judge significantly exceeded it on human labels. Forbidden writes occurred in 11.1% of episodes without gates. Verification, correction, and safe-termination gates did not reduce them significantly. The traces show a candidate cause: the gates' evidence digest dropped the order status and customer authentication, so valid requests were rejected. The choice of evaluator decides the conclusion; the minimal check exposes failures the judges miss. Traces, code, prompts, and labels are released.

translation.title: 当AI智能体评估者不一致时：tau2-bench上原生评分、LLM裁判与提交边界检查的实证研究
translation.abstract: 调用工具读写数据的大语言模型（LLM）智能体工作流有两种评估方式。基准测试将最终状态与金标准答案比较；已部署的服务则没有金标准，由LLM裁判阅读对话记录并作判断。实践中这两种方式被视为可互换，本文则测量它们是否确实如此。我们在tau2-bench的航空和零售领域运行了2,160个回合，并记录了每一次数据库写入。我们用四种方式对每个回合评分：对照金标准状态的原生评分、LLM裁判、给定策略文档的裁判，以及边界评估器——一种最小化的基于规则的检查，判断轨迹中发生的写入是否为预期写入。两名标注者独立对120个回合标注了任务正确性、策略合规性和承诺正确性。该裁判的可重复率为98.2%，但与原生评分的一致率仅为56.2%。在11个回合中，智能体执行了被禁止的写入；裁判（无论是否提供策略或轨迹）通过了其中的10到11个；更强的裁判仍通过6个。无需模型调用的边界评估器捕获了全部11个违规写入；在人工标注上没有裁判显著超越它。在无门控条件下，11.1%的回合出现了被禁止的写入；验证、纠正和安全终止等门控并未显著减少违规。轨迹分析显示一个可能的成因：门控的证据摘要丢失了订单状态和客户认证信息，导致有效请求被拒绝。评估器的选择决定结论；最小化检查暴露了裁判遗漏的失败。轨迹、代码、提示和标注均已公开。
translation.brief: 研究LLM裁判与原生基准评分在智能体评估中的不一致性，并提出无需模型调用的最小化规则边界评估器来捕获LLM裁判遗漏的禁止写入。

papers.title: Multi-Step Underwater Acoustic Channel Prediction via Dual-Domain Structure Preservation and Pretrained Transformer
papers.abstract: Accurate future channel state information (CSI) is essential for underwater acoustic (UWA) communication because delays associated with signal propagation, feedback, scheduling, and transceiver reconfiguration can render currently available CSI outdated. However, most existing predictors estimate only the next channel state and obtain multi-step forecasts through recursive rollout, which causes prediction errors to accumulate as the multipath structure evolves. The scarcity of sea-trial measurements further limits reliable model training. To address these challenges, we propose LLM4UACP, a dual-domain, structure-preserving framework that adapts a pretrained Transformer for few-shot multi-step UWA channel prediction. LLM4UACP extracts complementary features from the channel impulse response (CIR) and channel frequency response (CFR), aligns them through Fourier-consistent fusion, and encodes the fused representation as delay-time tokens. A pretrained Transformer with a frozen backbone is adapted through Butterfly Orthogonal Fine-tuning to jointly predict multiple future CIRs in a single forward pass, thereby avoiding the error accumulation associated with recursive prediction. Experiments on the measured SO-06 and SO-07 channels show that LLM4UACP achieves normalized mean squared error (NMSE) values of 0.0411 and 0.0399, corresponding to reductions of 88.53% and 85.15%, respectively, relative to the most recent baseline. With only 0.11M trainable parameters, LLM4UACP maintains robust performance across varying prediction horizons and observation-window lengths, limited-data settings, and cross-dataset transfer scenarios.

translation.title: 基于双域结构保持与预训练Transformer的多步水声信道预测
translation.abstract: 准确的未来信道状态信息（CSI）对水声（UWA）通信至关重要，因为信号传播、反馈、调度和收发机重配置带来的延迟会使当前可用的CSI过时。然而，现有预测器大多只估计下一个信道状态，并通过递归展开获得多步预测，导致误差随多径结构的演进而累积。海上实测数据的稀缺也进一步限制了可靠模型的训练。为应对这些挑战，我们提出LLM4UACP，一个双域、结构保持的框架，通过适配预训练Transformer实现少样本多步UWA信道预测。LLM4UACP从信道脉冲响应（CIR）和信道频率响应（CFR）中提取互补特征，通过傅里叶一致性融合进行对齐，并将融合表示编码为延迟-时间token。通过Butterfly正交微调（BOFT）适配一个骨干冻结的预训练Transformer，在单次前向传播中联合预测多个未来CIR，从而避免递归预测的误差累积。在实测SO-06和SO-07信道上的实验表明，LLM4UACP分别达到0.0411和0.0399的归一化均方误差（NMSE），相比最新基线分别降低88.53%和85.15%。仅使用0.11M可训练参数，LLM4UACP在不同预测时域和观测窗口长度、数据受限设置以及跨数据集迁移场景下均保持稳健性能。
translation.brief: 针对多步水声信道预测中递归误差累积与海试数据稀缺问题，提出双域结构保持的LLM4UACP框架，用预训练Transformer单次前向联合预测多个CIR。

papers.title: VASTRA: Efficient Agentic Top-K Interactive Video Analysis
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable natural language video retrieval, bypassing traditional hand-engineered pipelines. Integrating agentic reasoning frameworks (e.g., ReAct) further advances this paradigm by allowing models to dynamically inspect video content rather than relying on a single visual pass. Applying this pattern naively to video retrieval inherits problems that video systems cannot afford: results vary from run to run under identical conditions, and cost and latency scale with every reasoning step the agent takes rather than with the work the query actually requires. We present VASTRA, an agentic video retrieval system whose execution is dictated by query complexity rather than an open-ended reasoning loop: cheap, reliably answerable queries are ranked directly from pre-ingested summaries, while harder queries trigger targeted verification only where relevance is genuinely uncertain. This keeps control flow external to the model rather than latent in a growing chain of thought, establishing deterministic control flow by construction and end-to-end rank reproducibility under greedy serving. Across 40 benchmark queries, VASTRA exposes explicit presets: VASTRA-Fast runs 12.2x faster (4.2 s vs. 51.2 s) and 10.4x cheaper ($0.0044 vs. $0.0458) than best performing ReAct agent at a 5.0-point mAP reduction, while VASTRA-Max matches peak ReAct agent accuracy (0.653 vs. 0.649 mAP) at comparable latency, trading higher spend ($0.1022 vs. $0.0458) for zero run-to-run variance.

translation.title: VASTRA：高效的智能体式Top-K交互式视频分析
translation.abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）使自然语言视频检索成为可能，绕过了传统手工设计的流水线。集成智能体推理框架（如ReAct）进一步推进了这一范式，允许模型动态检查视频内容而非依赖单次视觉处理。但将此模式直接应用于视频检索会继承视频系统无法承受的问题：相同条件下每次运行的结果不同，且成本和延迟随智能体的每个推理步骤增长，而非随查询实际所需的工作量增长。我们提出VASTRA，一个由查询复杂度而非开放式推理循环决定执行方式的智能体视频检索系统：简单且可可靠回答的查询直接基于预先摄取的摘要排序，而较难的查询只在相关性真正不确定时触发针对性验证。这将控制流保持在模型外部而非潜藏于不断增长的思维链中，从构造上确立了确定性控制流，并在贪心推理下实现端到端排序可复现性。在40个基准查询上，VASTRA提供明确的预设：VASTRA-Fast比性能最佳的ReAct智能体快12.2倍（4.2秒 vs 51.2秒）、便宜10.4倍（$0.0044 vs $0.0458），代价是mAP降低5.0分；VASTRA-Max在相近延迟下匹配ReAct智能体的峰值精度（0.653 vs 0.649 mAP），以更高花费（$0.1022 vs $0.0458）换取零运行间方差。
translation.brief: 针对智能体视频检索中结果不可复现且成本随推理步骤失控的问题，提出VASTRA，按查询复杂度外置确定性控制流，简单查询直接用预摄取摘要排序、难查询才触发针对性验证。

papers.title: KernelMosaic: An Open Dataset and Agentic Framework for CUDA Kernel Generation
papers.abstract: Training large language models to generate efficient CUDA kernels requires supervision spanning diverse computational requirements and iterative code optimization. Constructing this supervision is challenging because of heterogeneous specifications, and useful implementations emerge through iterative complicated testing and refinement. We introduce KernelMosaic, an open dataset pairing diverse CUDA tasks with verified solutions and trajectories. Human-guided review and diversity-aware selection curate tasks expressed as natural-language descriptions, reference programs, mathematical specifications, and their intersections. To build the solutions and trajectories, our agentic framework guides a strong LLM through implementation, correctness repair, and performance optimization with reusable CUDA guidance and execution feedback. Supervised fine-tuning of a small open-source model on KernelMosaic raises correctness from 4%, 0%, and 0% to 88%, 82%, and 16% on KernelBench L1, L2, and L3, respectively, while increasing the fraction of tasks with kernels faster than PyTorch eager at every level. Further training experiments show that supervision from the curated trajectories substantially outperforms direct responses and promotes sustained testing and revision. These results demonstrate that KernelMosaic enables a general-purpose model to achieve substantial gains in CUDA kernel generation.

translation.title: KernelMosaic：面向CUDA内核生成的开放数据集与智能体框架
translation.abstract: 训练大语言模型生成高效CUDA内核需要跨越多样计算需求和迭代代码优化的监督数据。由于规格说明的异构性，以及有用的实现需要经过复杂的迭代测试与完善，构建这样的监督数据十分困难。我们提出KernelMosaic，一个将多样CUDA任务与经验证的解法及轨迹配对的开放数据集。通过人工引导的审查和多样性感知的选择，任务被整理为自然语言描述、参考程序、数学规格及其交叉形式。为构建解法和轨迹，我们的智能体框架引导一个强大的LLM完成实现、正确性修复和性能优化，并辅以可复用的CUDA指导和执行反馈。在KernelMosaic上对小规模开源模型进行监督微调后，其在KernelBench L1、L2、L3上的正确率分别从4%、0%和0%提升至88%、82%和16%，同时在每一级别上都提高了内核快于PyTorch eager的任务比例。进一步的训练实验表明，来自精选轨迹的监督显著优于直接响应，并促进持续的测试与修订。这些结果表明，KernelMosaic能使通用模型在CUDA内核生成上取得显著提升。
translation.brief: 针对CUDA内核生成训练监督数据难构建的问题，提出KernelMosaic开放数据集与智能体框架，通过智能体迭代实现、修复和优化生成带轨迹的已验证解法。

papers.title: Discovering the Relation Between Architectural Models and Reference Architectures
papers.abstract: Assessing whether concrete software architectures are consistent with their reference architecture (RA) is essential to ensure that architectural decisions scale coherently across projects, preserving the quality attributes the RA was designed to guarantee. In the absence of dedicated techniques, mapping the components of an architectural model onto a predefined RA can be addressed only with general-purpose model-comparison algorithms. Our experiments show that these algorithms are inaccurate when applied to RAs. To address this gap, we propose Reference Architecture Mapping Discovery (RAMD), an LLM-based workflow that combines model analysis with structured prompting, and refines results through an iterative RA compliance-checking mechanism. We evaluate RAMD on 64 open-source architectural models spanning three RAs from the IoT, self-driving, and smart parking domains. With domain knowledge and GPT-4o, RAMD reaches 85.8% mapping accuracy and outperforms the strongest baseline by 44.6 percentage points, while ensuring structural consistency with the RA.

translation.title: 发现架构模型与参考架构之间的关系
translation.abstract: 评估具体软件架构是否与其参考架构（RA）一致，对于确保架构决策在各项目间连贯扩展、保持RA设计所保证的质量属性至关重要。在缺乏专门技术的情况下，将架构模型中的组件映射到预定义RA只能借助通用模型比较算法。我们的实验表明，这些算法应用于RA时并不准确。为填补这一空白，我们提出参考架构映射发现（RAMD），一个结合模型分析与结构化提示的基于LLM的工作流，并通过迭代的RA合规性检查机制来精化结果。我们在64个开源架构模型上评估RAMD，这些模型横跨IoT、自动驾驶和智慧停车领域的三个RA。借助领域知识和GPT-4o，RAMD达到85.8%的映射准确率，比最强基线高出44.6个百分点，同时确保与RA的结构一致性。
translation.brief: 针对架构模型与参考架构映射中通用模型比较算法不准确的问题，提出基于LLM、结合结构化提示和迭代合规性检查的RAMD工作流。

papers.title: Evaluating the Performance of LLMs in Drafting NIH Data Management Plans
papers.abstract: Sharing research data is essential to promote transparency, enable reproducibility, and fuel scientific discoveries. To ensure consistent sharing, the National Institutes of Health (NIH) and other funding agencies require applicants to submit data management plans (DMPs) with their proposals. They aim to encourage researchers to consider their data management and sharing strategies early on. However, researchers often face challenges when developing DMPs due to a lack of knowledge about data-sharing practices. Here, we evaluated the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) in drafting DMPs compliant with the 2023 NIH guidelines. The goal was to investigate whether LLM-supported DMP creation could reduce the burden on researchers and librarians. We compared Llama and GPT performance against NIH-provided DMP samples. We also asked domain experts to evaluate LLM-generated DMPs. Overall, we found that LLMs can accelerate the creation of initial drafts but still require expert review before submission to ensure clarity and completeness. Moreover, open-source LLMs may not be as ready off-the-shelf as commercial ones for drafting funder-compliant DMPs.

translation.title: 评估大语言模型撰写 NIH 数据管理计划的性能
translation.abstract: 共享研究数据对于促进透明度、实现可复现性和推动科学发现至关重要。为确保一致的共享，美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）及其他资助机构要求申请人在提案中提交数据管理计划（DMP），以鼓励研究人员尽早考虑其数据管理与共享策略。然而，由于缺乏对数据共享实践的了解，研究人员在撰写 DMP 时常常面临困难。本文评估了大语言模型（LLM）撰写符合 2023 年 NIH 指南的 DMP 的性能，目的是研究 LLM 支持的 DMP 创建能否减轻研究人员和图书馆员的工作负担。我们将 Llama 和 GPT 的表现与 NIH 提供的 DMP 样例进行了比较，并邀请领域专家评估 LLM 生成的 DMP。总体而言，我们发现 LLM 可以加速初稿的创建，但在提交之前仍需专家审阅以确保清晰性和完整性。此外，开源 LLM 在撰写符合资助机构要求的 DMP 方面可能不如商用 LLM 那样开箱即用。
translation.brief: 该论文研究用大语言模型自动撰写符合 NIH 指南的数据管理计划以减轻研究人员负担的问题，通过将 Llama 和 GPT 生成的计划与 NIH 样例比较并让领域专家评估来检验其效果。

papers.title: Cleaning an Agent's History Hurts When the World Still Holds the Error
papers.abstract: Tool-using language-model agents accumulate histories of their own mistakes, and a system that compacts, repairs or hands off such a history decides what it says about those mistakes while their effects stay in the world. Prior work cleans the history at a fixed world, where showing a corrected step and saying it is done move together. We ask whether the same correct content helps or hurts depending on how the history states it and what the world holds. We freeze an agent mid-task with its exact world state, edit the history or the world, and let a receiver model continue. On AgentCE-Bench, after the agent commits a wrong value, we hold the world fixed and add the correct value by two natural edits: a truthful note beside the preserved error or the agent's own completed action. The note raises recovery, the share of remaining targets the receiver gets right, from 51% under a matched neutral note to 66%. The completed action lowers it below the unedited history, from 50% to 44%, so the value's presence alone does not predict the effect. On AppWorld, after a database write, we vary whether its receipt reports success or failure and whether its effect is present. A success receipt lowers whole-task success from 45% to 28% while the effect is absent and raises it from 38% to 49% once present. The two effects differ by 27 points pooled over two receivers, a difference positive in six of eight receivers at 97.5% and seven at 95%. A history edit's effect thus depends on the world it describes, and a history made to look clean while the world still holds the error can leave an agent worse off than no edit at all.

translation.title: 当世界仍留存错误时，清理智能体的历史反而有害
translation.abstract: 使用工具的语言模型智能体会积累包含自身错误的历史记录，而压缩、修复或移交此类历史的系统需要在错误的影响仍留存于世界之中时决定如何表述这些错误。先前的工作在固定的世界中清理历史，此时展示修正后的步骤与宣称已完成是一致的。我们探讨同样的正确内容，根据历史如何表述它以及世界中实际留存了什么，会有所助益还是有所损害。我们在任务中途冻结智能体及其确切的世界状态，编辑历史或世界，然后让接收方模型继续执行。在 AgentCE-Bench 上，当智能体提交了一个错误值后，我们在保持世界不变的情况下通过两种自然的编辑添加正确值：在保留错误旁边附上一条真实的说明，或让智能体执行一次完成该修正的动作。说明性笔记将恢复率（接收方正确处理剩余目标的比例）从匹配中性说明下的 51% 提高到 66%；而完成动作则使其低于未编辑的历史，从 50% 降至 44%，说明该值的存在本身并不能预测效果。在 AppWorld 上，在一次数据库写入之后，我们改变其回执报告成功还是失败以及其效果是否存在。当效果缺失时，成功回执使整体任务成功率从 45% 降至 28%；当效果存在时，则从 38% 升至 49%。在两个接收方上汇总，两种效应相差 27 个百分点，该差异在八个接收方中有六个以 97.5% 的水平为正、七个以 95% 的水平为正。因此，历史编辑的效果取决于它所描述的世界，当世界仍留存错误时，一个被修饰得看似干净的历史可能使智能体的处境比不做任何编辑更糟。
translation.brief: 该论文研究智能体历史清理在错误影响仍留存于环境中时的作用问题，通过在冻结的世界状态下编辑历史或世界并让接收模型继续任务来检验不同编辑方式的影响。

papers.title: MITRA-Swarm: Injecting Explicit Linguistic Structure into Foundation Models for Classical Machine Translation
papers.abstract: Classical Sanskrit poses three challenges unresolved by single-call monolithic models: morphophonemic fusion Sandhi, dense nominal compounding Samāsa, and discourse-level zero-anaphora forced by poetic meter. We present MITRA-Swarm, a multi-agent architecture injecting explicit linguistic structure into an otherwise monolithic pipeline: a Sandhi-splitting agent, a parallel array of generalist gemma-4-26B-A4B-it and domain-specialized gemma-2-mitra-it translators, and a discourse-aware Ellipsis Restorer that consults corpus-derived register tags to avoid inventing active-voice subjects in impersonal legal and philosophical registers. Two separated judges evaluate quality: a routing judge ($J_{\text{route}}$, same model family as the generators) driving an internal critique loop, and an independent reporting judge ($J_{\text{report}}=$gpt-4o-mini, no shared vendor lineage) scoring every output exactly once. On a stratified benchmark of 1,000 verses across five registers (23,990 scored verdicts, 12-condition pre-registered ablation), the full swarm reaches $85.90$ MQM against a monolithic baseline of $85.27$ ($\Delta=+0.63$, $p_{\text{adj}}=0.0018$, 95% CI $[+0.30,+0.97]$), and isolated discourse restoration alone accounts for $+0.44$ MQM ($p_{\text{adj}}=0.0288$), outperforming a call-count-matched self-refinement baseline by $+0.51$ MQM ($p_{\text{adj}}=0.0288$). Severe per-verse failures (MQM$<80$) fall from $9.0\%$ to $7.6\%$, at roughly $9\times$ the per-verse inference cost of the baseline. Additionally, $J_{\text{route}}$ scores its own family's outputs $2$-$7$ MQM higher than $J_{\text{report}}$ on every one of the 12 conditions, empirically motivating the two-judge split; and a preflight screen of a 192,151-entry retrieval index against all 12 evaluation works verifies 0 reference leaks across 269 runtime checks. These are small gains on a metric saturating near 85-86.

translation.title: MITRA-Swarm：向基础模型注入显式语言结构以实现古典机器翻译
translation.abstract: 古典梵语给单次调用的单体模型带来了三个未解决的挑战：形态音位融合（Sandhi）、密集的名词复合（Samāsa），以及诗歌韵律强制的篇章级零形回指。我们提出 MITRA-Swarm，一种多智能体架构，在原本单体化的流水线中注入显式语言结构：包括一个 Sandhi 拆分智能体、一个由通用 gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 和领域专用 gemma-2-mitra-it 翻译器组成的并行阵列，以及一个篇章感知的省略恢复器，后者参考语料库导出的语域标签，以避免在无人称的法律和哲学语域中生造主动语态主语。两个相互独立的裁判评估质量：一个路由裁判（J_route，与生成器同模型家族）驱动内部批评循环，一个独立的报告裁判（J_report = gpt-4o-mini，无共同供应商渊源）对每个输出仅评分一次。在一个覆盖五种语域、1000 首诗偈的分层基准上（23,990 条评分判定，12 条件的预注册消融），完整 swarm 达到 85.90 MQM，而单体基线为 85.27（Δ=+0.63，p_adj=0.0018，95% CI [+0.30,+0.97]）；单独的篇章恢复贡献了 +0.44 MQM（p_adj=0.0288），比调用次数匹配的自我精炼基线高 +0.51 MQM（p_adj=0.0288）。严重逐诗失败（MQM<80）的比例从 9.0% 降至 7.6%，代价是约为基线 9 倍的逐诗推理成本。此外，J_route 在全部 12 个条件下对自己家族输出的评分都比 J_report 高 2–7 MQM，从经验上支持了双裁判分离的设计；并且，将一个含 192,151 条目的检索索引对所有 12 部评估作品进行预检，在 269 次运行时检查中验证了 0 起参考泄漏。这些是在一个接近 85–86 饱和的指标上的微小增益。
translation.brief: 该论文研究古典梵语翻译中 Sandhi、Samāsa 和零形回指三大难题，通过多智能体架构将显式语言学分析步骤注入翻译流水线来解决。

papers.title: Together Compiler: Continual Compilation for AI Inference
papers.abstract: Today's AI workloads are rapidly changing: new models are released more often, model architectures are increasingly diverse, and traffic distributions change frequently. The challenge we face at Together AI is continual optimization for these changing workloads. Compiling a deployment into an optimized forward pass is a challenge that is well-suited for agent hill-climbing. Existing systems struggle with continual compilation due to a tradeoff between measurement throughput and fidelity. Many systems use agents to optimize individual kernels from the inference forward pass using offline benchmarks, but timings are low-fidelity because of data-dependent behavior in primitives like mixture-of-experts (MoE). On the other hand, systems use agents to directly optimize end-to-end engines but suffer from slow engine launch times. To address these challenges, we build Together Compiler (TKCC), the first truly continual agent loop designed for AI inference optimization. To address the throughput-fidelity tradeoff, we propose: (1) a Tiered Persistent Engine that decouples engine launch overheads from forward pass computation; (2) a cost model to select the parallelism configurations that seed the optimization process. We also conduct extensive ablations on agent context management and present our insights on deploying TKCC in production. TKCC outperforms highly-optimized hand-written Megakernels on the Llama 1B workhorse workload by up to 1.7x and the best open source engines on the latest frontier models (Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, MiniMax M3.1 Flash, DeepSeek v4.1 Flash) across hardware platforms by up to 2.6x higher TPS on the InferenceX benchmark. TKCC also sets the state-of-the-art performance at batch size 1, with 1111 TPS on M3.1 Flash and 1205 TPS on DeepSeek v4.1 Flash. Finally, TKCC generalizes beyond frontier language model inference. TKCC serves trillions of tokens across our production fleet.

translation.title: Together Compiler：面向 AI 推理的持续编译
translation.abstract: 当今的 AI 工作负载正在快速变化：新模型发布更频繁，模型架构日益多样，流量分布也频繁变动。Together AI 面临的挑战是对这些不断变化的工作负载进行持续优化。将一个部署编译为优化的前向传播是一个非常适合智能体爬山搜索的难题。现有系统在持续编译方面因测量吞吐量与保真度之间的权衡而表现不佳。许多系统使用智能体基于离线基准优化推理前向传播中的单个 kernel，但由于 mixture-of-experts（MoE）等原语的数据依赖行为，计时保真度较低。另一方面，一些系统使用智能体直接优化端到端引擎，却受限于缓慢的引擎启动时间。为应对这些挑战，我们构建了 Together Compiler（TKCC），首个真正面向 AI 推理优化的持续智能体循环。为解决吞吐量-保真度权衡，我们提出：（1）分层持久引擎（Tiered Persistent Engine），将引擎启动开销与前向传播计算解耦；（2）一个成本模型，用于选择为优化过程提供种子的并行配置。我们还对智能体上下文管理进行了大量消融实验，并分享了在生产环境中部署 TKCC 的经验。在 Llama 1B 主力工作负载上，TKCC 比高度优化的手工编写 Megakernels 高出最多 1.7 倍；在 InferenceNet 基准的最新前沿模型（Kimi K3、GLM 5.3、MiniMax M3.1 Flash、DeepSeek v4.1 Flash）上，跨硬件平台比最佳开源引擎的 TPS 高出最多 2.6 倍。TKCC 还在 batch size 为 1 时创下最先进性能：M3.1 Flash 上 1111 TPS，DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 上 1205 TPS。最后，TKCC 可推广至前沿语言模型推理之外。TKCC 已在我们的生产集群上服务了数万亿 token。
translation.brief: 该论文研究 AI 推理工作负载持续变化下如何持续优化编译部署的问题，通过分层持久引擎和成本模型构建持续运行的智能体编译循环 TKCC 来解决吞吐量与保真度的权衡。

papers.title: Trait Hitchhiking in LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is now a standard stage of language model post-training, and the compute devoted to it is growing rapidly. While it has been shown to improve capabilities, particularly for tasks with verifiable rewards, it can also change behaviours and internal properties that the reward does not explicitly target. We present a formalism to describe the evolution of "traits" during RL post-training and, in doing so, recover the Price equation from evolutionary biology. We use this to develop a mathematical model for what we call "trait hitchhiking": the amplification or suppression of non-targeted traits as training redistributes probability across completions. We evaluate this Price update expression on language models trained with GRPO and show that the Price estimates closely track the sampled trait dynamics. These results identify trait hitchhiking as a mechanism by which RL post-training can silently amplify undesirable traits.

translation.title: LLM 后训练中的性状搭便车现象
translation.abstract: 强化学习（RL）如今已是语言模型后训练的标准阶段，投入其中的算力正在快速增长。虽然它已被证明能提升能力，尤其是对于具有可验证奖励的任务，但它也会改变奖励未显式针对的行为和内部属性。我们提出一个形式化框架来描述 RL 后训练过程中“性状”的演化，并由此重新推导出进化生物学中的 Price 方程。我们据此建立了一个描述我们称之为“性状搭便车”现象的数学模型：即当训练在多个完成样本之间重新分配概率时，非目标性状被放大或抑制。我们在用 GRPO 训练的语言模型上评估了这一 Price 更新表达式，结果表明 Price 估计与采样的性状动态高度吻合。这些结果将性状搭便车确定为 RL 后训练可能在无形中放大不良性状的一种机制。
translation.brief: 该论文研究 RL 后训练中奖励未显式针对的性状被意外放大或抑制的问题，通过从 Price 方程建立性状演化的数学模型并用 GRPO 训练的模型验证来解决。

papers.title: Terrain-Aware Thompson Sampling for Multi-Drone Search and Rescue
papers.abstract: In this work, we propose a decentralized terrain-aware multi-drone Thompson Sampling algorithm tailored for search and rescue (SAR) applications. A probability distribution of locating a lost person is informed by terrain data, using established SAR models (displacement ring, elevation, watershed, dispersion angle, and track offset) derived from historical SAR case data on lost person behavior. Exploration is conducted by a team of drones using Thompson Sampling, where candidate actions are selected by drawing samples from this probability distribution, represented by a per-cell Gaussian posterior whose mean and variance are updated through Bayesian inference. This approach balances exploration of uncertain regions with exploitation of high-probability areas to locate a lost person. Observation uncertainty is incorporated through fractional forest coverage, which measures the percentage of an observation occluded by tree coverage and accounts for reduced detection performance in densely vegetated areas. Simulations using real SAR case data (YOSAR) evaluate the proposed method against a coverage planner and a probabilistic active search method in search regions of 1.5 and 3.8 square kilometers, with 5, 10, 15, and 20 agents flying at 50 km/hr. We demonstrate that our method achieves a success rate of approximately 87% within 60 to 247 seconds in the 1.5 square kilometer region, and success rates of approximately 75% to 91% within 161 to 466 seconds in the 3.8 square kilometer region, across different agent configurations.

translation.title: 面向多无人机搜救的地形感知 Thompson 采样算法
translation.abstract: 本文提出了一种面向搜救（SAR）应用的分布式地形感知多无人机 Thompson 采样算法。利用基于历史搜救案例中失踪人员行为数据建立的经典 SAR 模型（位移环、高程、分水岭、离散角和轨迹偏移），结合地形数据构建发现失踪人员的概率分布。无人机团队通过 Thompson 采样进行探索，候选动作通过从该概率分布中采样来选择，该分布由逐单元的高斯后验表示，其均值和方差通过贝叶斯推断更新。该方法平衡了对不确定区域的探索与对高概率区域的利用，以定位失踪人员。通过分数森林覆盖率引入观测不确定性，该指标衡量观测被树木覆盖遮挡的百分比，并考虑了茂密植被区域检测性能的下降。基于真实搜救案例数据（YOSAR）的仿真将所提方法与覆盖规划器和概率主动搜索方法进行对比，搜索区域分别为 1.5 和 3.8 平方公里，无人机数量为 5、10、15 和 20 架，飞行速度 50 km/hr。结果表明，在 1.5 平方公里区域内，该方法在 60 至 247 秒内达到约 87% 的成功率；在 3.8 平方公里区域内，不同无人机配置下在 161 至 466 秒内达到约 75% 至 91% 的成功率。
translation.brief: 针对多无人机搜救任务，利用地形与历史失踪人员行为模型构建概率分布，并通过 Thompson 采样引导无人机进行搜索。

papers.title: Risk-Aware Joint Inference and Resource Control for Physical AI in 6G Networks
papers.abstract: Wireless edge inference enables Physical-AI devices to execute edge-inferred actions using transmitted sensory inputs. Since the risk of incorrect actions vary across observations and tasks, the associated uplink transmission of sensory inputs requires different levels of wireless reliability. For instance, applying a fixed signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) requirement can overprovision low-risk tasks while underprovisioning high-risk ones. Therefore, we propose risk-aware control for edge inference (RACE), which maps predicted action-failure probability and task criticality to adaptive SINR targets and combines them with deadline-derived SINR requirements. A slow-timescale large language model (LLM) proposes task requirements for deterministic validation, while a fast hybrid actor selects inference configurations and transmit power levels, complemented by analytical receive beamforming and finite power restoration. Simulations show $11\%$ improvement in the average accuracy-latency-energy objective over fixed-high-SINR control, with near-zero constraint outage.

translation.title: 面向 6G 网络中物理 AI 的风险感知联合推断与资源控制
translation.abstract: 无线边缘推断使物理 AI 设备能够利用传输的感知输入执行边缘推断的动作。由于错误动作的风险因观测和任务而异，感知输入的上行传输需要不同级别的无线可靠性。例如，采用固定的信干噪比（SINR）要求会为低风险任务过度配置资源，而对高风险任务配置不足。因此，我们提出面向边缘推断的风险感知控制（RACE），将预测的动作失败概率和任务关键性映射为自适应 SINR 目标，并与基于截止时间的 SINR 要求相结合。慢时间尺度的大语言模型（LLM）提出任务要求以进行确定性验证，而快速的混合 actor 选择推断配置和发射功率级别，并辅以解析接收波束成形和有限功率恢复。仿真表明，相比固定高 SINR 控制，该方法在平均精度-时延-能耗目标上提升 11%，且约束违约接近零。
translation.brief: 针对边缘推断中不同任务风险差异导致的无线资源配置不当问题，提出将动作失败概率和任务关键性映射为自适应 SINR 目标的 RACE 控制框架。

papers.title: Probe What-If Worlds Before You Ship: Persona Simulation for Real-World Decision Making
papers.abstract: User research and system testing reveal whether products and services meet user needs, yet recruiting specialized participants, designing controlled what-if comparisons, and repeating studies as designs evolve often bottleneck design iteration and data-driven decision-making. We present a framework and execution infrastructure that translates real-world industry inquiries into controlled experiments with simulated users. Our methodology formally defines the target cohort, experimental stimuli, and decision-relevant metrics, while the pipeline supports large-scale concurrent runs over cohort-stimulus-environment combinations (survey, web, chatbot, and OS app), auditable trial-level logging, cohort-level outcome aggregation, and cross-cohort and cross-variant statistical reports. Across twelve industry partner cases spanning five domains, we show how constructing hard-to-reach or what-if persona cohorts supports exploratory studies and distills simulated responses into testable design hypotheses. Cross-model comparisons on selected cases largely preserve primary conclusions, whereas perturbing or ablating persona attributes alters service outcomes, effect sizes, and inter-group differences, indicating that grounding target cohorts in detailed personas materially shapes simulation results. Together, these studies show that persona-enabled agents can test specified cohorts at design speed, diagnose systems under test, and deliver directional evidence that focuses problem definition, steers design and strategic decisions, and guides further study.

translation.title: 在发布前探测假设世界：面向现实决策的人物角色模拟
translation.abstract: 用户研究和系统测试能揭示产品和服务是否满足用户需求，然而招募专业参与者、设计受控的假设对比，以及随设计迭代重复研究，往往成为设计迭代和数据驱动决策的瓶颈。我们提出了一个将现实行业问题转化为带模拟用户的受控实验的框架和执行基础设施。我们的方法论正式定义目标人群、实验刺激和决策相关指标，同时该流水线支持对人群-刺激-环境组合（调查、网页、聊天机器人和操作系统应用）的大规模并发运行、可审计的试验级日志记录、人群级结果聚合，以及跨人群和跨变体的统计报告。在横跨五个领域的十二个行业合作案例中，我们展示了构建难以触达或假设性的人物角色人群如何支持探索性研究，并将模拟响应提炼为可测试的设计假设。对选定案例的跨模型比较基本保持了主要结论，而扰动或消融人物角色属性会改变服务结果、效应量和组间差异，表明基于详细人物角色构建目标人群会实质性地影响模拟结果。这些研究表明，启用人物角色的智能体能够以设计速度测试指定人群、诊断被测系统，并提供方向性证据，以聚焦问题定义、引导设计和战略决策，并指导后续研究。
translation.brief: 针对用户研究招募难、迭代慢的问题，提出用人物角色模拟智能体将行业问题转化为大规模受控实验的框架与基础设施。

papers.title: Code as Explanations: Executable and Verifiable LLM Explanations
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly make consequential decisions and solve problems alongside humans, we must understand how models arrive at their conclusions. Understanding how an LLM behaves requires observing it across multiple inputs, yet free-text explanations such as chain-of-thought (CoT) are generated per instance and cannot be easily verified on new inputs. We propose {code explanations to address the mismatch in how LLM explanations are generated versus how they are evaluated: a program explains LLM behavior across a dataset of inputs, and its execution enables automatic verification. We define Consistency metric that measures the fraction of inputs on which the program reproduces the LLM's outputs, and use it to evaluate and select candidate programs. Across three open-source code-capable LLMs and eight tasks, we find that LLMs can produce highly consistent code explanations in several settings. Code explanations are also 6$\times$ to 100$\times$ shorter than CoT, and better align with model behavior in 9 out of 24 settings. However, consistency is significantly lower on tasks with more complex linguistic components, where generated programs reproduce model outputs no more frequently than an uninformative explanation baseline, and these programs often rely on longer hard-coded patterns. In experiments with Claude Opus 5.5, providing the model with consistency feedback and code execution improves explanation consistency across tasks, but consistency remains significantly lower on more complex tasks. Our findings establish executable code as a novel, verifiable, and compact approach to explaining LLM behavior and highlight verification feedback as a promising direction for improving explanation consistency. The code for this paper is at this https URL.

translation.title: 代码即解释：可执行且可验证的 LLM 解释
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地与人类一起做出重大决策和解决问题，我们必须理解模型如何得出其结论。理解 LLM 的行为需要跨多个输入进行观察，而自由文本解释（如思维链 CoT）是逐实例生成的，无法在新输入上轻松验证。我们提出代码解释以解决 LLM 解释的生成方式与评估方式之间的错配：一个程序解释 LLM 在整个输入数据集上的行为，其执行可支持自动验证。我们定义一致性指标来衡量程序复现 LLM 输出的输入比例，并用它来评估和选择候选程序。在三个开源具备代码能力的 LLM 和八个任务上，我们发现 LLM 在若干设置下能产生高度一致的代码解释。代码解释也比 CoT 短 6 到 100 倍，并在 24 个设置中的 9 个中更好地对齐模型行为。然而，在语言成分更复杂的任务上，一致性显著降低，生成的程序复现模型输出的频率不超过无信息解释基线，且这些程序常依赖较长的硬编码模式。在 Claude Opus 5.5 的实验中，为模型提供一致性反馈和代码执行可提升跨任务解释的一致性，但在更复杂任务上一致性仍显著较低。我们的发现确立了可执行代码作为解释 LLM 行为的一种新颖、可验证且紧凑的方法，并突出了验证反馈作为提升解释一致性的有前景方向。论文代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对自由文本 LLM 解释难以验证的问题，提出用可执行程序跨数据集解释模型行为，并定义一致性指标进行自动评估与选择。

papers.title: Harmony: Bridging Audio Understanding and Editing through Agentic Collaboration
papers.abstract: Natural-language audio editing requires connecting a user's intent to specific sounds and time regions while preserving surrounding content. Complex requests make this connection demanding: an edit may select one occurrence, depend on a temporal relation, or modify a source that overlaps with other sounds. We introduce Harmony, an agentic framework that bridges audio understanding and editing through collaboration among an LLM planner, an audio-language model, and external tools. Harmony combines two mechanisms. Edit-driven collaborative planning uses targeted questions and tool measurements to determine the target, timing, and operation parameters. Evidence-guided execution uses observations of the first separated or generated audio to trigger bounded corrections before final mixing. Together, these mechanisms connect semantic decisions to waveform operations throughout the editing process. Harmony supports addition, removal, replacement, and volume adjustment. On 420 MMAE examples spanning these operations, Harmony achieves an exact match rate of 22.62%, compared with 13.57% for the strongest baseline, and improves aggregate instruction following and context preservation.

translation.title: Harmony：通过智能体协作连接音频理解与编辑
translation.abstract: 自然语言音频编辑需要将用户意图连接到特定的声音和时间区域，同时保留周围内容。复杂请求使这种连接极具挑战性：编辑可能选择某一处出现、依赖时间关系，或修改与其他声音重叠的音源。我们提出 Harmony，一个通过 LLM 规划器、音频语言模型和外部工具之间的协作连接音频理解与编辑的智能体框架。Harmony 结合两种机制：编辑驱动的协作规划使用有针对性的提问和工具测量来确定目标、时序和操作参数；证据引导的执行利用首次分离或生成音频的观察，在最终混音前触发有界的修正。这些机制在整个编辑过程中将语义决策与波形操作相连接。Harmony 支持添加、移除、替换和音量调节。在涵盖这些操作的 420 个 MMAE 示例上，Harmony 达到 22.62% 的精确匹配率，而最强基线为 13.57%，并提升了总体指令遵循和上下文保留。
translation.brief: 针对自然语言音频编辑中复杂请求意图与音频内容对齐困难的问题，提出由 LLM 规划器与音频语言模型协作的智能体框架 Harmony。

papers.title: When Should Semantic Priors Enter Partially-Identified Causal Discovery?
papers.abstract: Observational causal discovery often leaves causal di- rections unresolved or unstable. Large language mod- els (LLMs) can provide semantic information to resolve these directions, but incorrect proposals can exclude the true causal graph and invalidate downstream inference. We study three separate decisions: where to allocate semantic queries, which proposals to admit, and which causal graphs to retain. Our framework distinguishes population non-identifiability from finite-sample insta- bility, evaluates semantic orientation against statistical and random controls, and examines calibrated admis- sion and error-tolerant DAG retention. Experiments across benchmark networks show that semantic infor- mation improves recovery over coin-flip orientations, but targeting unstable edges has no established ad- vantage over matched-random allocation. The tested admission certificate cannot support nontrivial admis- sion with the available calibration tasks. Moreover, downstream retention depends on reference adequacy: learned references contain the true DAG in only three of 80 planned tasks. These findings separate the value of semantic information from the reliability of its alloca- tion, admission, and retention, and identify calibration size and reference adequacy as key limitations.

translation.title: 语义先验应何时进入部分可识别的因果发现？
translation.abstract: 观测性因果发现常常无法确定或难以稳定地确定因果方向。大语言模型（LLM）可以提供语义信息来解决这些方向问题，但错误的提议可能排除真实因果图并使下游推断失效。我们研究三个独立的决策：在何处分配语义查询、接受哪些提议、保留哪些因果图。我们的框架区分总体层面的不可识别性与有限样本的不稳定性，将语义方向判断与统计控制和随机控制进行对比评估，并考察经校准的提议接受机制和容错式DAG保留策略。在多个基准网络上的实验表明，语义信息相比随机翻转方向能改进恢复效果，但针对不稳定边定向相比匹配随机分配并无确证的优势。所测试的接受性证书在现有校准任务下无法支持非平凡的接受决策。此外，下游保留依赖于参考图的充分性：在80个计划任务中，学到的参考图仅在三个任务中包含真实DAG。这些发现将语义信息的价值与其分配、接受和保留的可靠性区分开来，并指出校准规模和参考充分性是关键限制。
translation.brief: 研究在因果发现中何时及如何安全利用LLM语义先验确定因果方向，通过区分不可识别性与样本不稳定性，提出分配、接受与保留三阶段的评估框架。

papers.title: A Sublogarithmic Competitive Algorithm for Online Graph Exploration
papers.abstract: In online graph exploration, an agent must visit every vertex of an unknown weighted graph and return to its start, learning the incident edges at each vertex it visits. On $n$-vertex graphs, the best known competitive ratio has been $O(\log n)$, achieved by several algorithms, among them the hierarchical depth-first search of Megow, Mehlhorn, and Schweitzer. We give an algorithm with competitive ratio ${(2+o(1))}\ln n/\ln\ln n$ for known~$n$. Like hierarchical depth-first search, it groups the edges into geometric weight classes and searches depth-first between components of lighter edges. Unlike it, the agent tours each component along a minimum spanning tree for the original weights, so only crossings between components pay for rounding, and the base $b$ of the weight class can grow with~$n$. The leading constant $2$ is tight for our choice of base. Without knowing $n$, restarts with increasing size guesses give upper bounds with leading constant $4$ for a fixed schedule and $2$ in expectation for a randomly shifted schedule. If the weights lie in a known range $[1,2^k]$ with $k\ge4$, choosing $b=k/\log_2 k$ gives a competitive ratio of $O(k/\log k)$ without knowing $n$.

translation.title: 在线图探索的亚对数竞争算法
translation.abstract: 在在线图探索中，一个智能体必须访问未知带权图中的每个顶点并返回起点，同时在其访问的每个顶点处获知相邻边。在n个顶点的图上，已知的最佳竞争比一直是O(log n)，由包括Megow、Mehlhorn和Schweitzer的层次深度优先搜索在内的多个算法实现。我们给出一个在已知n时竞争比为(2+o(1))ln n/ln ln n的算法。与层次深度优先搜索类似，它将边按几何权重分层，并在较轻边的连通分量之间进行深度优先搜索。不同之处在于，智能体沿原始权重的最小生成树遍历每个分量，因此只有分量之间的跨越需要为舍入付出代价，且权重分层的底数b可以随n增长。对于我们所选的底数，首项常数2是紧的。在不知道n的情况下，以递增的规模猜测进行重启，固定调度可得到首项常数为4的上界，随机移位调度在期望意义下为2。若权重位于已知范围[1,2^k]（k≥4）内，选择b=k/log_2 k可在不知道n的情况下获得O(k/log k)的竞争比。
translation.brief: 改进在线图探索的竞争比，通过按几何权重分层并以最小生成树遍历各分量，将达到(2+o(1))ln n/ln ln n的竞争比。

papers.title: SynthCorp: A Platform for Creating Benchmarks for Data Agents
papers.abstract: Current benchmarks for LLM-driven data agents saturate quickly and cannot target specific capabilities. We present SynthCorp, a platform that creates customizable data estates and benchmarks by simulating how business events produce and modify corporate data over time. Each data estate combines relational databases, a document store, and a data catalog, paired with evaluation tasks and executable gold programs. First, given a scenario and target complexity dimensions, SynthCorp synthesizes reusable event types and compiles each into a program over predefined simulation primitives. Second, SynthCorp schedules event instances on a virtual calendar, interleaving routine and disruption events so that tables, documents, and catalog entries remain consistent. Third, SynthCorp executes the calendar to materialize the data estate and records every operation in a simulation log. Fourth, SynthCorp generates analytical tasks and derives verified gold programs from the log. We use SynthCorp to generate initial evaluation benchmarks comprising seven data estates (up to 1K operational tables) and 256 tasks across five domains. The data estates pass deterministic pipeline checks (such as foreign-key violations, undeclared writes, recurrence violations, and database execution failures) with a near-zero error rate, introduce cross-asset complexities, and cover all requested dimensions. Evaluating three models across four data-context settings shows that the benchmarks separate data contexts and model tiers. Auditing candidate queries against causal provenance in the simulation log verifies gold programs without manual annotation, including on multi-event composite tasks that expose reasoning failures in state-of-the-art agents. We hope the community uses SynthCorp to generate more challenging and useful data estates and benchmarks that foster the development of enterprise data agents.

translation.title: SynthCorp：面向数据智能体基准构建的平台
translation.abstract: 当前面向LLM驱动的数据智能体的基准很快就会饱和，且无法针对特定能力。我们提出SynthCorp，一个通过模拟商业事件如何随时间产生和修改企业数据来创建可定制数据资产与基准的平台。每个数据资产结合关系数据库、文档存储和数据目录，并配有评估任务和可执行的标准程序。首先，给定场景和目标复杂度维度，SynthCorp综合出可复用的事件类型，并将其编译为基于预定义模拟原语的程序。其次，SynthCorp在虚拟日历上调度事件实例，交错安排例行事件与干扰事件，使表、文档和目录条目保持一致。第三，SynthCorp执行日历以物化数据资产，并将每个操作记录在模拟日志中。第四，SynthCorp生成分析任务，并从日志中推导出经验证的标准程序。我们使用SynthCorp生成了初始评估基准，包含七个数据资产（最多1K个业务表）和跨五个领域的256个任务。这些数据资产通过了确定性流水线检查（如外键违规、未声明写入、重复违规和数据库执行失败），错误率接近零，引入了跨资产复杂性，并覆盖所有要求的维度。对三个模型在四种数据上下文设置下的评估表明，这些基准能够区分数据上下文和模型层级。通过将候选查询与模拟日志中的因果溯源进行审计，可在无需人工标注的情况下验证标准程序，包括在暴露最先进智能体推理失败的多事件复合任务上。我们希望社区利用SynthCorp生成更具挑战性和实用性的数据资产与基准，推动企业数据智能体的发展。
translation.brief: 构建SynthCorp平台，通过模拟企业事件随时间生成和修改数据，自动合成带可验证标准程序的数据资产与基准，以克服现有数据智能体基准饱和且无法定向评测的问题。

papers.title: Rational Use of Time for Social Coordination in Humans and AI
papers.abstract: All social interactions are situated in time. Previous studies have shown that humans are able to use implicit temporal cues, such as the duration of a pause, to infer others' mental states. But how do humans use temporal cues for dynamic, fine-grained social coordination? And can AI systems do the same, without ``experiencing'' continuous real-time as humans do? We study these questions using a cooperative card game task called The Mind, which requires players to achieve a shared goal across repeated interactions but forbids explicit communication: the only available signal is the passage of time. We evaluate 150 humans, and two classes of AI models which reflect different ways of operationalizing time in artificial systems: computer-use agents (CUAs), and standard text-prompted LLMs. We find that human behavior is best captured by a Bayesian strategy that infers a partner's belief from their timing---and similarly for frontier models. However, unlike humans, none of the tested models seem to efficiently adapt their behaviors to their partners' over the course of the game. From a cognitive perspective, our findings suggest that humans perform implicit probabilistic reasoning about continuous-time signals in dynamic social settings, and that such reasoning mechanisms may emerge without real-time experience. Practically, our study highlights new challenges for AI systems to coordinate efficiently with other agents by learning to interpret and adapt to their implicit signals in dynamic settings.

translation.title: 人类与AI在社会协调中对时间的理性运用
translation.abstract: 所有社会互动都处于时间之中。以往研究表明，人类能够利用内隐的时间线索（如停顿的时长）来推断他人的心理状态。但人类如何利用时间线索进行动态的、细粒度的社会协调？AI系统能否像人类那样做到这一点，而无需'体验'连续的实时时间？我们通过一个名为The Mind的合作纸牌游戏任务研究这些问题，该任务要求玩家在重复互动中达成共同目标，但禁止显式交流：唯一可用的信号是时间的流逝。我们评估了150名人类，以及两类以不同方式在人工系统中操作化时间的AI模型：计算机使用智能体（CUA）和标准的文本提示LLM。我们发现，人类行为最适宜用一种贝叶斯策略来刻画，即从对方的时机中推断其信念——前沿模型也类似。然而，与人类不同，所有测试的模型似乎都无法在游戏过程中有效地适应其伙伴。从认知角度看，我们的发现表明，人类在动态社会情境中对连续时间信号进行内隐的概率推理，且这类推理机制可以在没有实时体验的情况下涌现。在实践层面，我们的研究突出了AI系统在动态环境中学会解读和适应其他智能体内隐信号以实现高效协调的新挑战。
translation.brief: 用禁止交流的合作纸牌游戏研究时间线索驱动的动态社会协调，发现人类与前沿LLM均能用贝叶斯策略从时机推断伙伴信念，但模型无法随游戏进程适应伙伴行为。

papers.title: An LLM Is All You Need: Data-Efficient Adaptation to Full-Duplex, Word-Level Spoken Dialogue
papers.abstract: Full-duplex spoken dialogue, in which a system listens while it speaks and can backchannel, yield the floor, and be interrupted, is usually obtained by training on hundreds of thousands to millions of hours of speech. This is costly, rewrites the language model that supplies the system's knowledge, and still leaves turn-taking either implicit or decided coarsely rather than word by word. We show that a frozen, general-purpose multimodal LLM can instead be adapted into a word-level full-duplex system with little data. Our system is a thinker-talker cascade on an 80 ms frame clock. The thinker keeps the LLM frozen and trains only lightweight adapters and a few new token embeddings (97M parameters); at every frame it emits one token of agent text, with pauses, yields, and onsets represented as tokens of the same vocabulary and kept legal by a finite-state machine. A four-stage curriculum, each stage anchored to the model's own behavior under the previous format, performs the conversion in about 30 GPU-hours. The talker reads only the thinker's discrete tokens, so the two halves are trained independently. On Full-Duplex-Bench and InteractionBench, the system is competitive with open-source full-duplex systems built through large-scale speech training: among them, it is the least likely to take the floor when the user merely pauses, backchannels most often, and leads in spoken-task accuracy, groundedness, and coherence over long conversations.

translation.title: 一个LLM足矣：面向全双工、词级口语对话的数据高效适配
translation.abstract: 全双工口语对话要求系统在说话的同时进行聆听，并能附和、让出发言权以及被打断，这通常需要用数十万到数百万小时的语音进行训练。这种方式成本高昂，会重写提供系统知识的语言模型，且话轮转换仍是内隐的或粗粒度决定，而非逐词决定。我们证明，一个冻结的通用多模态LLM只需少量数据即可被适配为词级全双工系统。我们的系统是一个在80毫秒帧时钟上运行的thinker-talker级联。thinker保持LLM冻结，仅训练轻量适配器和少量新的token嵌入（97M参数）；在每一帧它输出一个智能体文本token，其中停顿、让权和起声以同一词表中的token表示，并通过有限状态机保持合法。一个四阶段课程体系，每个阶段都锚定模型在前一格式下的自身行为，在大约30 GPU小时内完成转换。talker只读取thinker的离散token，因此两部分可独立训练。在Full-Duplex-Bench和InteractionBench上，该系统与通过大规模语音训练构建的开源全双工系统相比具有竞争力：在它们之中，该系统在用户 merely 停顿时最不容易抢占话轮，附和最频繁，并在口语任务准确率、扎根性和长对话连贯性方面领先。
translation.brief: 通过冻结LLM加轻量适配器和有限状态机约束的thinker-talker级联，仅用约30 GPU小时将通用多模态LLM适配为词级全双工口语对话系统。

papers.title: SlipStream: Enabling HBF for GPU Systems by Mitigating the Latency and SRAM Overheads
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference demands ever more memory capacity for larger models and batch sizes. High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) replaces the DRAM dies of HBM with NAND flash and provides up to 16x the capacity at comparable read bandwidth. However, HBF can incur a read latency of nearly 20$\mu$s, 20x that of HBM, so on-demand HBF accesses slow inference by up to 12.8x. Conventional cache-line prefetchers require 20x more in-flight tracking state to cover this latency. Tensor-streaming designs, such as H3, follow virtual-address order as opposed to kernel-demand order, and therefore need hundreds of megabytes of buffering. We propose SlipStream, a software-hardware co-designed prefetcher that turns prefetching into a demand-paced producer-consumer pipeline. In software, SlipStream profiles the repeatable weight-page demand order of data-independent LLM kernels and inserts a staging warp that replays this order with non-blocking STAGE instructions. In hardware, the staging warp acts as the producer and the work warps as consumers. Our key insight is to retire each STAGE tracking entry only when demand first accesses the page, as opposed to when the page returns from HBF. Demand thus paces staging and bounds how far staging leads consumption. SlipStream tracks 4 KB pages instead of cache lines and allocates buffer slots only when pages return, which decouples the buffer size from outstanding traffic. Across seven dense models spanning 16-800 GB, SlipStream with a 40 MB staging buffer achieves 92.4% of the performance of an ideal HBF with HBM-like latency. H3 achieves only 43.1%, even with a 320 MB buffer. The buffer sizing of SlipStream is independent of HBF latency and workload. SlipStream with 16 MB buffer, 20x smaller than that of H3, performs within 4% of SlipStream-40MB. SlipStream also supports Mixture-of-Experts models and reaches 91.2% of ideal performance (40 MB buffer).

translation.title: SlipStream：通过缓解延迟与 SRAM 开销使 HBF 适用于 GPU 系统
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）推理对更大模型和批量规模需要越来越多的内存容量。High-Bandwidth Flash（HBF）用 NAND 闪存替代 HBM 的 DRAM 层，在读带宽相当的情况下提供高达 16 倍的容量。然而，HBF 的读取延迟接近 20 微秒，是 HBM 的 20 倍，因此按需访问 HBF 会使推理变慢最多 12.8 倍。传统缓存行预取器需要多出 20 倍的在途跟踪状态才能覆盖该延迟。而 H3 等张量流式设计按虚拟地址顺序而非内核需求顺序访问，因此需要数百 MB 的缓冲。我们提出 SlipStream，一个软硬件协同设计的预取器，将预取转变为按需求节奏的生产者-消费者流水线。在软件层面，SlipStream 剖析数据无关 LLM 内核可重复的权重页需求顺序，并插入一个 staging warp，用非阻塞 STAGE 指令重放该顺序。在硬件层面，staging warp 充当生产者，工作 warp 充当消费者。我们的关键洞察是：仅当需求首次访问某页时才退役对应的 STAGE 跟踪项，而非当页面从 HBF 返回时。由此需求为 staging 节奏定速，并限制 staging 领先消费的程度。SlipStream 跟踪 4 KB 页面而非缓存行，且仅在页面返回时分配缓冲槽位，从而将缓冲大小与在途流量解耦。在 16-800 GB 的七个稠密模型上，配备 40 MB staging 缓冲的 SlipStream 达到理想 HBF（HBM 级延迟）性能的 92.4%，而 H3 即便使用 320 MB 缓冲也仅达到 43.1%。SlipStream 的缓冲大小与 HBF 延迟和负载无关；使用 16 MB 缓冲（比 H3 小 20 倍）时性能与 SlipStream-40MB 相差不超过 4%。SlipStream 还支持 Mixture-of-Experts 模型，达到理想性能的 91.2%（40 MB 缓冲）。
translation.brief: 针对 HBF 闪存高读延迟拖慢 LLM 推理的问题，提出软硬件协同的按需求节奏的页级预取器 SlipStream，用 STAGE 指令重放权重页访问顺序并在需求命中时才退役跟踪项，从而大幅降低缓冲与跟踪开销。

papers.title: Mach2: Scientific Discovery Platform with Deterministic Execution Constraints
papers.abstract: Language-model agents can formulate workflows and invoke specialized tools, yet compliance with natural-language operating rules is not guaranteed by prompting alone. Mach2 addresses this limitation by coupling Eigen orchestration to deterministic, lint-like checks of tool requests, source changes, acceptance tests, and artifact contracts. Domain requirements are represented as executable predicates: mandatory failures prevent advancement of the checked operation, while diagnostic findings are retained for correction or review. User-specified test-driven development (TDD), CodeGrapher's abstract-syntax-tree analysis, and history-guided evolutionary search provide complementary verification and optimization mechanisms. Mach2 also generates task-specific agent packages for execution through independently selected endpoints. The originating harness validates returned artifacts against declared interfaces and evidence requirements without assuming continuous supervision of the remote run. Model-internal-knowledge (MIK) dependencies are recorded separately from source-grounded and test-supported findings. This paper formalizes the rule-gated execution model and the agent-package lifecycle, and proposes measurable criteria for evaluating rule compliance, engineering validity, and cross-endpoint task continuity.

translation.title: Mach2：具有确定性执行约束的科学发现平台
translation.abstract: 语言模型智能体能够构建工作流并调用专用工具，但仅靠提示无法保证其遵守自然语言操作规则。Mach2 通过将 Eigen 编排与对工具请求、源码变更、验收测试和工件契约的确定性、类 lint 检查相耦合来解决这一局限。领域需求被表示为可执行谓词：强制性失败会阻止被检查操作继续推进，而诊断发现会被保留以待修正或审查。用户指定的测试驱动开发（TDD）、CodeGrapher 的抽象语法树分析以及基于历史的演化搜索提供了互补的验证与优化机制。Mach2 还生成任务特定的智能体包，通过独立选择的端点执行。发起方 harness 依据声明的接口和证据要求验证返回的工件，而无需假定对远程运行进行持续监督。模型内部知识（MIK）依赖与有源可查和测试支撑的发现分开记录。本文形式化了规则门控的执行模型和智能体包生命周期，并提出了评估规则合规性、工程有效性和跨端点任务连续性的可度量标准。
translation.brief: 为解决语言模型智能体不保证遵守自然语言操作规则的问题，Mach2 将智能体编排与确定性规则检查（可执行谓词）耦合，实现规则门控的执行与跨端点工件验证。

papers.title: RE-PRESENT: Evidence Triangulation across Alternative Candidate-Space Views for Efficient LLM Ensemble Inference
papers.abstract: Heterogeneous large language models (LLMs) exhibit complementary strengths, motivating routing and multi-model inference methods that seek to identify reliable predictions for each input. However, exploiting this complementarity remains challenging even when a correct prediction is available within the ensemble. We investigate this challenge across heterogeneous LLM ensembles and find that a simple single-round aggregation rule is highly competitive with learned routing methods, yet substantial oracle headroom remains. Further analysis shows that the evaluated single-round response signals provide limited discriminative power for identifying reliable predictions. In contrast, controlled re-presentations of the same question elicit complementary evidence about prediction reliability. Motivated by these findings, we introduce RE-PRESENT, a training-free framework that selectively re-presents disputed questions and directly aggregates candidate-level evidence across alternative views. Across seven multiple-choice benchmarks and two heterogeneous model ensembles, RE-PRESENT improves over strong single-round aggregation while offering a favorable accuracy--cost trade-off compared with self-consistency and multi-model debate.

translation.title: RE-PRESENT：跨备选候选空间视图的证据三角互证以实现高效 LLM 集成推理
translation.abstract: 异构大语言模型（LLM）具有互补优势，这催生了试图为每个输入识别可靠预测的路由和多模型推理方法。然而，即使集成中存在正确预测，利用这种互补性仍然具有挑战性。我们在异构 LLM 集成上研究该挑战，发现简单的单轮聚合规则与学习型路由方法相比极具竞争力，但距离 oracle 上限仍有很大空间。进一步分析表明，所评估的单轮响应信号在识别可靠预测方面的判别能力有限。相比之下，对同一问题的受控重述能引出关于预测可靠性的互补证据。受这些发现启发，我们提出 RE-PRESENT，一个免训练框架，它选择性地重述存在争议的问题，并直接聚合来自备选视图的候选级证据。在七个多选基准和两个异构模型集成上，RE-PRESENT 优于强单轮聚合方法，并相比 self-consistency 和多模型辩论提供了更优的精度-成本权衡。
translation.brief: 针对异构 LLM 集成中识别可靠预测困难的问题，提出免训练的 RE-PRESENT 框架，选择性地重述争议问题并跨备选视图聚合候选级证据。

papers.title: Robust Task-Aware State Estimation from Pre-trained Perception
papers.abstract: Agents that perform state estimation using pretrained perception models, e.g., Vision-Language Models (VLMs), face the fundamental challenge that predictions are uncertain. Still, most approaches determinize these predictions into a single best-guess state and make decisions as if it were ground truth. This is brittle because when the guess is wrong, the agent's decisions may be unsafe or infeasible. At the other extreme, maintaining a full probability distribution over symbolic states is often intractable. We propose a middle path, drawing on the underlying probabilities the perception model already produces (e.g., a VLM's output-layer token distributions) to construct a $\theta$-confidence Minimal Belief Set (MBS$_\theta$), a minimal subset of states whose cumulative probability meets a user-specified belief-mass threshold. The minimality of an MBS$_\theta$ ensures that the agent considers only the most likely states, enhancing robustness in downstream decision-making while maintaining computational tractability. Using a novel three-layered belief system, we efficiently approximate individual state probabilities from per-feature predictions and task-level constraints. On this belief construction, we base our MBS$_\theta$ construction, while maintaining only a lean factored representation of the belief. Our algorithm, Probability-Ranked Valid State Search (PRaVaSS), takes advantage of the unique structure of this belief system to construct an MBS$_\theta$ with correctness guarantees and polynomial complexity in the unconstrained case. Using a VLM as the backbone of our state estimator, we validate our method's theoretical properties, scalability with problem size, and improvement of downstream decision-making when used in a task-planning pipeline.

translation.title: 基于预训练感知的鲁棒任务感知状态估计
translation.abstract: 使用预训练感知模型（如视觉-语言模型 VLM）进行状态估计的智能体面临预测不确定这一根本挑战。然而，大多数方法将这些预测确定化为单一最佳猜测状态，并视其为真值进行决策。这种方式很脆弱，因为当猜测错误时，智能体的决策可能不安全或不可行。另一个极端是为符号状态维护完整概率分布往往难以处理。我们提出一条中间路径，利用感知模型已经产生的底层概率（如 VLM 输出层的 token 分布）构建 θ-置信最小信念集（MBS_θ），即累积概率满足用户指定信念质量阈值的最小状态子集。MBS_θ 的最小性确保智能体只考虑最可能的状态，在保持计算可处理性的同时增强下游决策的鲁棒性。借助新颖的三层信念系统，我们从逐特征预测和任务级约束中高效近似单个状态的概率。在此信念构建的基础上构建 MBS_θ，同时只维护信念的精简因子化表示。我们的算法 Probability-Ranked Valid State Search（PRaVaSS）利用该信念系统的独特结构构建 MBS_θ，具有正确性保证，且在无约束情形下具有多项式复杂度。以 VLM 作为状态估计器的骨干，我们验证了方法的理论性质、随问题规模的可扩展性，以及在任务规划流水线中对下游决策的改进。
translation.brief: 针对 VLM 等预训练感知预测不确定导致决策脆弱的问题，提出用 θ-置信最小信念集（MBS_θ）替代单一最佳猜测，通过 PRaVaSS 算法高效构建该信念集以支撑鲁棒的任务规划。

papers.title: When Is Proof-Step Verification Worth Its Cost? Operating Requirements of Certify-or-Decline Verification for Open-Weight Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract: Proof-step verification rewrites a solver's answer into typed steps and uses LLM judges to certify or decline. We evaluate this pipeline on open-weight models across GPQA, AIME-2025, and a MATH-500 subset. Certification raises answer-key-match precision by 31 percentage points on the strong GPQA configuration and 46 on AIME, while answering only 35% and 21% of attempts. On near-ceiling MATH-500, gains are at most 5 points at a loss of 13-27 points of coverage. An output-token-matched self-consistency selector obtains 82.9% precision at 35% coverage, compared with the verifier's pooled 87.6% (paired difference: +4.8 points, 95% interval [-8.2, 18.5]). A diagnostic sample reveals a distinct failure mode: 52 of 88 completed problems end in invalid proof construction without ever reaching a judge. Finally, external-LLM acceptance of rendered certified chains is 61.0-67.6%, compared with 87.6% answer-key match. These audits lack human or formal-kernel ground truth. Open-weight auditor pairs show near-zero chance-corrected agreement, which measures consistency rather than accuracy against proof truth. These results motivate separate reporting of execution failures, selected-answer precision, and independently assessed proof validity. We provide per-configuration results and evaluation details in the supplement.

translation.title: 证明步骤验证何时物有所值？面向开放权重数学推理的认证或拒绝验证的运行要求
translation.abstract: 证明步骤验证将求解器的答案改写为带类型的步骤，并使用 LLM 评审来认证或拒绝。我们在开放权重模型上于 GPQA、AIME-2025 和 MATH-500 子集上评估该流水线。认证将答案键匹配精度在强 GPQA 配置上提升 31 个百分点、在 AIME 上提升 46 个百分点，但仅回答了 35% 和 21% 的尝试。在接近天花板的 MATH-500 上，增益最多 5 个百分点，同时损失 13-27 个百分点的覆盖率。一个输出 token 数匹配的 self-consistency 选择器在 35% 覆盖率下达到 82.9% 精度，而验证器的汇总精度为 87.6%（配对差异：+4.8 个百分点，95% 区间 [-8.2, 18.5]）。诊断样本揭示了一种独特的失败模式：88 道完成的题目中有 52 道以无效证明构造告终，从未到达评审环节。此外，外部 LLM 对渲染后的已认证证明链的接受率为 61.0-67.6%，而答案键匹配为 87.6%。这些审计缺乏人类或形式化内核的真值。开放权重审计者对之间的校正机会一致性接近零，这衡量的是一致性而非相对证明真值的准确性。这些结果促使我们分别报告执行失败、所选答案精度以及独立评估的证明有效性。我们在补充材料中提供各配置的结果和评估细节。
translation.brief: 研究证明步骤验证（LLM 评审认证或拒绝）在开放权重数学推理上的成本收益，通过多基准实验刻画其精度提升与覆盖率损失及审计可靠性局限，给出分项报告的操作要求。

papers.title: Selecting and verifying load-bearing periodic cells for elastic-wave band gaps with numerical acceptance checks
papers.abstract: A lattice mount must be stiff enough to support equipment and block vibration over a specified frequency range. Fast simulations help rank designs, but their errors can lead to a wrong acceptance decision. We present AMM (AgenticMetamaterials), an open-source Python tool that searches repeating cubic cells for targets on stiffness, the fraction of the cell that is solid, and band gaps. A complete band gap is an interval with no elastic-wave propagation in any direction. A separate checker allows for changes as the simulation grid gets finer. For gaps, it also tests for modes at sampled wave directions and wavelengths, so it can miss modes between samples. In 1,500 near-threshold tests of stiffness and solid fraction, the checker accepted 454 of 750 claims supported by the reference and none of the 750 false claims. Using the finest grid estimate alone accepted 42 false claims. In an independent finite-element comparison on ten new cells built from cubes joined by bars, the checker accepted one of two true gap claims and left all 17 false claims undecided. The reference could not classify the remaining claim. The protocol required every reported edge to err on the side of a narrower gap. The checker failed this test when it placed one upper edge too high, even though it left that thin-bar cell's claim undecided. Separating search from acceptance shows which targets the evidence supports and where a calculation needs further refinement.

translation.title: 面向弹性波带隙的承重周期单元的数值验收校验选择与验证
translation.abstract: 晶格支座必须足够刚硬以支撑设备并在指定频率范围内阻断振动。快速仿真有助于对设计排序，但其误差可能导致错误的验收决策。我们提出AMM（AgenticMetamaterials），一个开源Python工具，用于搜索重复的立方单元以满足刚度、单元实体占比和带隙目标。完全带隙是任何方向均无弹性波传播的频率区间。一个独立的校验器允许仿真网格逐步加密时的变化。对于带隙，它还会在采样的波方向和波长处测试模式，因此可能遗漏采样之间的模式。在1500次刚度与实体占比的近阈值测试中，校验器接受了750个有参考支持的断言中的454个，而未接受任何750个虚假断言。仅使用最细网格估计则会接受42个虚假断言。在针对十个由立方体加杆连接构成的新单元的独立有限元对比中，校验器接受了两个真实带隙断言中的一个，并将全部17个虚假断言留为未决。参考方法无法对其余断言分类。协议要求每个报告的边界都偏向更窄的带隙。当校验器将一个上边界设得过高时未能通过该测试，尽管它将该细杆单元的断言留为未决。将搜索与验收分离可以显示证据支持哪些目标，以及哪些计算需要进一步细化。
translation.brief: 针对晶格支座周期单元刚度、实体占比与弹性波带隙目标的自动选型，提出开源搜索工具AMM，并用独立校验器以保守准则验证仿真结果以避免误判。

papers.title: Who (or what) are they prompting? How CS students conceptualize and use LLMs
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by students in computing courses. Yet computing education research has not fully examined how teaching and inclusion of LLMs shape students' conceptualization and understanding of LLMs, and how these factors relate to their subsequent use. Although prior work has examined prompting strategies and AI literacy, the relationships among students' conceptualizations of LLMs, their understanding of LLM mechanisms, and their prompting behavior remain underexplored. We studied these relationships in a post CS1 course that introduces students to the various CS subfields. We adapted the course to teach and allow the usage of LLMs. We administered an end-of-course survey, using open-ended items to elicit students' representations of LLMs and their explanations of how LLMs work, alongside closed-response measures of prompting style and prompt count (N=283 students consented and provided codable responses). Using qualitative coding, we categorized students' understanding of how LLMs work into four ordinal knowledge levels based on the Structure of Observed Learning Outcomes (SOLO) taxonomy and coded their metaphoric conceptualizations along two dimensions: persona type and relational role. Our results show that students most often conceptualized LLMs as human assistants, and context-rich prompting was the preferred style. The study contributes a two-dimensional characterization of students' LLM metaphoric representation and exploratory analyses also identified associations among these constructs showing how understanding these systems relates to their usage.

translation.title: 他们在向谁（或什么）提问？计算机专业学生如何概念化与使用LLM
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在计算机课程中被学生越来越广泛地使用。然而计算机教育研究尚未充分考察教学与LLM的引入如何塑造学生对LLM的概念化理解，以及这些因素与其后续使用的关系。尽管已有工作研究了提示策略和AI素养，但学生对LLM的概念化、对LLM机制的理解与其提示行为之间的关系仍缺乏探索。我们在一门CS1之后的课程中研究了这些关系，该课程向学生介绍各计算机子领域。我们对课程进行调整以教授并允许使用LLM。我们开展了期末问卷调查，使用开放式题目引出学生对LLM的认知表征及其对LLM工作原理的解释，并配合提示风格与提示数量的封闭式测量（N=283名学生同意并提供可编码回答）。通过定性编码，我们基于SOLO（可观察学习成果结构）分类法将学生对LLM工作原理的理解划分为四个序数级知识层次，并沿两个维度（人格类型与关系角色）对其隐喻式概念化进行编码。结果表明，学生最常将LLM概念化为人类助手，情境丰富的提示是首选风格。本研究贡献了学生LLM隐喻表征的二维刻画，探索性分析还识别了这些构念之间的关联，揭示了对这些系统的理解如何与其使用相关。
translation.brief: 研究CS1后课程学生对LLM的概念化理解与提示使用的关系，通过问卷与SOLO定性编码将理解划分层次并从人格与关系两维刻画学生隐喻表征。

papers.title: OverServe: Resource Amplification Attacks on SaaS Agents via Tool--Prompt Co-Design
papers.abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) are enabling software-as-a-service (SaaS) providers to automate longer business workflows with agents. In subscription-based SaaS deployments, model and tool calls consume provider resources without additional customer payments. Because the agent autonomously decides when to stop, a malicious tenant can send a prompt to the agent, exploiting its completion decisions to extend execution and waste provider resources. In this paper, we present OverServe, a multi-agent framework for constructing such attacks against SaaS agents. OverServe co-designs Model Context Protocol (MCP) status tools and completion-confirmation prompts for the attacker. Each tool call returns accurate status and terminates normally, yet the agent may repeatedly check an unfinished condition to satisfy the prompt. This consumes the SaaS provider's resources even after the original business task is completed. OverServe constructs service-specific tool--prompt pairs and uses separate tool and prompt reviews to guide candidate pair selection. Tested tool specifications trigger no alerts in the evaluated MCP scanners. We evaluate Qwen, Nemotron, DeepSeek, and Sonnet on selected tasks from nine benchmarks. All OverServe runs pass the original task checks. OverServe can reach a maximal amplification of API requests by $93.88\times$ while preserving the original task goal and collateral checks.

translation.title: OverServe：通过工具与提示协同设计对SaaS智能体发起资源放大攻击
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的进步使软件即服务（SaaS）提供商能够用智能体自动化更长的业务工作流。在基于订阅的SaaS部署中，模型与工具调用会消耗提供商资源而无需客户额外付费。由于智能体自主决定何时停止，恶意租户可向智能体发送提示，利用其完成决策延长执行并浪费提供商资源。本文提出OverServe，一个用于构建此类针对SaaS智能体攻击的多智能体框架。OverServe为攻击者协同设计Model Context Protocol（MCP）状态工具与完成确认提示。每次工具调用返回准确状态并正常终止，但智能体可能为满足提示而反复检查未完成条件。这在原业务任务完成后仍持续消耗SaaS提供商资源。OverServe构建服务特定的工具—提示对，并用独立的工具与提示审查来指导候选对的选择。经测试的工具规格在所评估的MCP扫描器中均未触发告警。我们在九个基准的选定任务上评估Qwen、Nemotron、DeepSeek和Sonnet。所有OverServe运行均通过原任务检查。OverServe可实现API请求最大93.88倍的放大，同时保持原任务目标与附带检查。
translation.brief: 针对SaaS LLM智能体的资源滥用攻击，通过协同设计看似正常的MCP状态工具与完成确认提示诱导智能体反复调用工具，实现API请求的资源放大。

papers.title: Sublogarithmic Online Graph Exploration
papers.abstract: We study the online graph exploration problem, in which an agent must visit every vertex of an initially unknown weighted graph on $n$ vertices and return to its starting vertex. In this model, a vertex's incident edges and their weights are revealed when it is first visited. Despite extensive research, the best known competitive guarantee for general graphs had remained $\mathcal{O}(\log n)$, a bound already established in 1977 for the greedy TSP heuristic Nearest Neighbor. Subsequent approaches, including hierarchical depth-first search (hDFS) and Blocking, achieve better guarantees on restricted graph classes but have logarithmic or worse competitive ratios on general graphs. This raises the question of whether the logarithmic barrier is inherent and Nearest Neighbor is asymptotically optimal. We answer this question in the negative by giving an $\mathcal{O}(\log n/\log \log n)$-competitive algorithm. Our algorithm is a slight modification of hDFS, and we establish its competitive guarantee with a surprisingly short proof.

translation.title: 次对数的在线图探索
translation.abstract: 我们研究在线图探索问题，其中智能体必须访问初始未知、含n个顶点的加权图的每个顶点并返回起点。在该模型中，顶点的关联边及其权重在首次访问该顶点时被揭示。尽管研究众多，一般图上已知的最佳竞争保证一直停留在O(log n)，该界早在1977年就已针对贪心TSP启发式最近邻算法建立。后续方法包括分层深度优先搜索（hDFS）和Blocking，在受限图类上取得更好保证，但在一般图上竞争比为对数或更差。这引出了对数障碍是否固有、最近邻是否渐近最优的问题。我们给出负面的回答，提出一个O(log n / log log n)竞争的算法。该算法是对hDFS的轻微修改，且我们用一个出奇简短的证明建立了其竞争保证。
translation.brief: 研究在线图探索的一般图竞争比问题，通过对hDFS算法的轻微修改首次突破O(log n)障碍，给出O(log n/log log n)竞争算法。

papers.title: LLMs and the Homogenization of Teaching
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are known to lack diversity in open-ended text generation, a limitation that is especially consequential in education, where homogeneity can narrow the kinds of thinking and disciplinary work students are invited to do. We study diversity in two educational generation tasks: math items and essay feedback. We compare frontier and open-weight models with human-authored reference distributions using lexical, semantic, and domain-grounded measures. For math, we examine the mathematical activities students are asked to perform; for feedback, we examine the revision work requested and the rhetorical strategies used to communicate it. We evaluate direct prompting, two diversity prompting methods, and post-training. Across both tasks, directly prompted model outputs are markedly less diverse than human-authored content--78% higher on lexical (Self-BLEU) and 51% higher on semantic (embedding) similarity--and represent a narrower range of instructional forms. Diversity prompting and post-training increase variation largely through surface features without broadening the instructional repertoire. Models inherit and amplify the most normative routines of human instruction. Overcoming mode collapse in education will require richer instructional data and investment in teachers' creative capacity and professional judgment.

translation.title: LLM与教学的同质化
translation.abstract: 已知大语言模型（LLM）在开放式文本生成中缺乏多样性，这一局限在教育中尤为严重，因为同质化会缩窄学生被引导进行的思考类型和学科实践。我们研究两个教育生成任务中的多样性：数学题目与作文反馈。我们使用词汇、语义和领域接地测量，将前沿模型与开放权重模型同人类创作的参考分布进行比较。对于数学，我们考察要求学生执行的数学活动；对于反馈，我们考察所要求的修改工作以及用于传达修改的修辞策略。我们评估直接提示、两种多样性提示方法以及后训练。在两个任务中，直接提示的模型输出明显不如人类创作内容多样——词汇（Self-BLEU）相似度高78%，语义（嵌入）相似度高51%——且教学形式范围更窄。多样性提示与后训练主要通过表层特征增加变化，而未拓宽教学方式。模型继承并放大了人类教学中最具规范性的套路。克服教育中的模式坍缩需要更丰富的教学数据，以及对教师创造力和专业判断力的投入。
translation.brief: 研究LLM在教育文本生成（数学题目与作文反馈）中的多样性问题，对比人类内容并用词汇、语义等指标评估直接提示、多样性提示与后训练的效果。

papers.title: Do People Trust AI Assistants Even When They Are Consistently Wrong?
papers.abstract: People are increasingly using conversational AI systems to make decisions despite concerns around their reliability. How well do people calibrate to AI systems' accuracy in multi-turn conversations? We measure how people's reliance on LLMs' advice changes across repeated interactions, varying whether the AI assistant is helpful (100% accurate), unhelpful (0% accurate), or mixed (50% accurate). Across 4 experiments, we find people learn to trust helpful models more than unhelpful ones (67% vs 21% of the time), but only when they receive external feedback on the models' accuracy. Without feedback, people continue to be persuaded 48% of the time by a consistently unhelpful model (vs 38% for helpful). Rather than gaining trust in helpful models, participant reliance on LLM advisors tended to be high in early trials and only fell with evidence of inaccuracy. Participants trusted LLM advisors more than they trusted human advisors (83% vs 65%, Experiment 4), and LLMs benefited more from having a helpful track record than humans did. In contrast with previous work, we find limited evidence of an advantage for arguing for the truth (versus a falsehood). Truth advantages emerged only when participants were already very confident in their position, and did not emerge at all for static hints. Collectively, the results suggest that people may be swayed by LLM advice, even when it is consistently false, unless they have access to timely ground-truth feedback. Unfortunately, in many domains such feedback may not be available, leading to overreliance on AI.

translation.title: 即使 AI 助手持续出错，人们仍然信任它们吗？
translation.abstract: 尽管存在可靠性担忧，人们越来越多地使用对话式 AI 系统来做决策。人们在多轮对话中对 AI 系统准确性的校准程度如何？我们测量了人们对 LLM 建议的依赖如何随重复交互而变化，分别设置 AI 助手为有帮助（100% 准确）、无帮助（0% 准确）或混合（50% 准确）。在 4 个实验中，我们发现人们对有帮助模型的信任高于无帮助模型（67% vs 21% 的接受率），但这仅发生在他们获得关于模型准确性的外部反馈时。没有反馈时，人们仍会在 48% 的情况下被持续无帮助的模型说服（有帮助模型为 38%）。参与者并非逐渐信任有帮助的模型，他们对 LLM 建议者的依赖在早期试验中往往很高，只随着不准确证据的出现而下降。参与者对 LLM 建议者的信任高于对人类建议者的信任（83% vs 65%，实验 4），而且 LLM 比人类从有帮助的历史记录中获益更多。与以往工作不同，我们发现支持真理（而非谎言）的论证优势证据有限。真理优势仅在参与者对自身立场已经非常自信时出现，而对静态提示则完全没有出现。总体而言，这些结果表明，人们可能会被 LLM 的建议左右，即使它持续为假，除非他们能获得及时的真值反馈。遗憾的是，在许多领域中这种反馈可能并不存在，从而导致对 AI 的过度依赖。
translation.brief: 研究人们对 LLM 建议的信任校准问题，通过设置不同准确率 AI 助手的多轮重复交互实验测量依赖变化。

papers.title: Sophon: A Procedural Diagnostic for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Open-weight Vision-Language Models (VLMs) score 85-94% on spatial benchmarks (BLINK Spatial, What's Up CLEVR) yet collapse to chance on simple geometric questions when object, scene, and texture priors are stripped away.
