We introduce and open-source Sophon, a procedurally generated diagnostic of paired colored point-cloud stimuli across three coordinate systems (1D linear, 2D Cartesian, 2D polar) and four question types (binary, categorical, comparative, quantitative). Across four open architectures (LLaVA-NeXT, LLaVA-OneVision, Qwen2.5-VL, Idefics3), accuracy clusters at 47-52% while frontier models (Opus 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-5.4) clear 77-83% and humans reach 84-94%. We use linear probes and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) to trace the open-weight failures. Probes of the vision encoder (ViT) and language decoder (LLM) recover Sophon spatial information at 83-85% and 80-86% accuracy, respectively, and the language tower's reasoning circuit answers text-only controls (point clouds as sets of coordinates) at +40 pp over visual stimuli. Language tower per-layer attention attribution localizes visual integration to mid-stack layers. At readout, models elevate the correct answer-set tokens but select among them randomly. We localize the mechanism by tuning individual and grouped components across every architecture's stack, including the vision tower (ViT workspace and reader), the projector, and the language tower (LLM workspace and reader). These experiments demonstrate that this mid-stack workspace holds circuitry capable of organizing the spatial signal so that the frozen reader can decode it. LoRA fine-tuning adjusts that circuitry such that 7B-class VLMs answer Sophon spatial reasoning questions at frontier aggregate accuracy. This work suggests that these models do not have a capability gap for spatial reasoning but suffer from a routing bottleneck that targeted fine-tuning repairs.

translation.title: Sophon：面向视觉-语言模型空间推理的程序化诊断基准
translation.abstract: 开源视觉-语言模型（VLM）在空间基准（BLINK Spatial、What's Up CLEVR）上得分 85-94%，但在剥离物体、场景和纹理先验后，面对简单的几何问题则退化到随机水平。我们引入并开源 Sophon，一个程序化生成的诊断基准，包含跨三种坐标系（1D 线性、2D 笛卡尔、2D 极坐标）和四种问题类型（二元、分类、比较、定量）的成对彩色点云刺激。在四个开源架构（LLaVA-NeXT、LLaVA-OneVision、Qwen2.5-VL、Idefics3）上，准确率集中在 47-52%，而前沿模型（Opus 4.6、Gemini 2.5 Pro、GPT-5.4）达到 77-83%，人类达到 84-94%。我们使用线性探针和低秩适配（LoRA）来追踪开源模型的失败原因。对视觉编码器（ViT）和语言解码器（LLM）的探针分别以 83-85% 和 80-86% 的准确率恢复 Sophon 空间信息，且语言塔的推理回路在纯文本对照（点云作为坐标集合）上的回答比视觉刺激高 +40 个百分点。语言塔逐层注意力归因将视觉整合定位到中间堆叠层。在读取阶段，模型提升了正确答案集的 token，但只是在其中随机选择。我们通过调整每个架构堆叠中的单个和分组组件来定位机制，包括视觉塔（ViT workspace 和 reader）、投影器和语言塔（LLM workspace 和 reader）。这些实验表明，这个中间堆叠 workspace 拥有能够组织空间信号的回路，使冻结的 reader 能够解码它。LoRA 微调调整了该回路，使 7B 级 VLM 在 Sophon 空间推理问题上达到前沿模型的总体准确率。这项工作表明，这些模型并不存在空间推理的能力差距，而是存在可通过针对性微调修复的路由瓶颈。
translation.brief: 针对开源 VLM 在剥离先验后空间推理失效的问题，构建程序化点云诊断基准 Sophon 并用探针和 LoRA 微调定位并修复其内部路由瓶颈。

papers.title: AutoAssumption: Searching over Assumptions Discovers ML-Systems Algorithms
papers.abstract: Many advances in ML systems came from breaking an assumption that earlier methods took for granted: speculative decoding dropped the assumption that a model needs one forward pass per token. Yet algorithms rarely state their assumptions, so experts and discovery harnesses search over programs, where one edit changes several design choices and gains are difficult to attribute. Searching over the assumptions themselves remains largely unexplored. Writing algorithms as proofs makes their assumptions explicit and turns algorithm design into a search over a small, structured space that an LLM can explore and a proof checker can audit. We formalize 89 algorithms from KV-cache eviction, weight pruning and speculative decoding as proof graphs with explicit assumptions, checked in Lean. Our harness, AutoAssumption, relaxes one assumption of a published method, re-derives and re-proves it, and generates its code. In KV-cache eviction and weight pruning, this search improved on every published algorithm we ran and produced state-of-the-art algorithms. The eviction algorithm has the highest RULER-4K score of the published methods we ran, and the pruning algorithm the lowest perplexity of thirteen on four LLaMA models. At equal budget, the harness scores within a point of OpenEvolve, an open-source implementation of AlphaEvolve, with a lower standard deviation across repeats. Future work will formalize more fields and combine them through the principal assumptions they share.

translation.title: AutoAssumption：通过搜索假设发现 ML 系统算法
translation.abstract: ML 系统的许多进展来自打破早期方法习以为常的假设：投机解码去除了模型每个 token 需要一次前向传播的假设。然而算法很少显式陈述其假设，因此专家和发现框架在程序空间上搜索，一次编辑会改变多个设计选择，收益难以归因。在假设本身上搜索在很大程度上仍未被探索。将算法写成证明使其假设显式化，并将算法设计转化为一个小而结构化空间的搜索，LLM 可以探索、证明检查器可以审计。我们将来自 KV-cache 淘汰、权重剪枝和投机解码的 89 个算法形式化为带显式假设的证明图，并在 Lean 中检查。我们的框架 AutoAssumption 放宽已发表方法的一个假设，重新推导并重新证明它，并生成其代码。在 KV-cache 淘汰和权重剪枝中，这一搜索改进了我们运行的每一个已发表算法，并产生了最先进的算法。淘汰算法在我们运行的已发表方法中具有最高的 RULER-4K 分数，剪枝算法在四个 LLaMA 模型上具有十三个方法中最低的困惑度。在同等预算下，该框架的得分与 AlphaEvolve 的开源实现 OpenEvolve 相差不到一分，且重复实验的标准差更低。未来工作将形式化更多领域，并通过它们共享的主要假设将其组合起来。
translation.brief: 提出以证明图显式化算法假设并在其上搜索的发现框架 AutoAssumption，用 LLM 放宽假设、Lean 验证并生成代码，自动发现更优的 ML 系统算法。

papers.title: Open Challenges and Opportunities in Human-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Agentic AI systems increasingly undertake extended tasks and act on people's behalf, making human-agent interaction central to their effectiveness. Successful interaction requires understanding human perspectives, coordinating complementary capabilities, and maintaining productive relationships within socio-technical environments. This paper examines how foundations developed by the Autonomous Agents and Multi-Agent Systems (AAMAS) community inform these demands. We consider interactions ranging from individual human-agent partnerships to teams and larger groups, where participants differ in their roles, decision authority, capabilities, and objectives. We organize computational approaches around the connected challenges of understanding others and deciding how to interact with them. Theory of Mind, belief-desire-intention architectures, goal and plan recognition, inverse planning, and recursive reasoning provide mechanisms for representing and inferring partially observable mental states. Observer-aware planning, model reconciliation, and decision-theoretic communication connect these inferences to action, explanation, and information exchange. Together with shared autonomy, argumentation, and cooperative inverse reinforcement learning, these approaches offer foundations for agentic systems that account for evolving human knowledge, intentions, and expectations. We argue that progress requires treating human interaction as an ongoing decision problem shaped by uncertainty, interdependence, and potentially conflicting objectives.

translation.title: 人-智能体系统中的开放挑战与机遇
translation.abstract: Agentic AI 系统越来越多地承担长期任务并代表人们行动，使得人-智能体交互成为其有效性的核心。成功的交互需要理解人类的视角、协调互补能力，并在社会技术环境中维持富有成效的关系。本文考察自主智能体与多智能体系统（AAMAS）社区发展的基础如何服务于这些需求。我们考虑从个体人-智能体协作到团队和更大群体的交互，其中参与者在角色、决策权限、能力和目标上各不相同。我们围绕理解他人并决定如何与他人交互这一相互关联的挑战来组织计算方法。心智理论（Theory of Mind）、信念-愿望-意图架构、目标与计划识别、逆向规划和递归推理为表示和推断部分可观察的心理状态提供了机制。观察者感知规划、模型调和和决策论通信将这些推断与行动、解释和信息交换联系起来。加上共享自主、论证和协作式逆向强化学习，这些方法为能够顾及不断演变的人类知识、意图和期望的 agentic 系统提供了基础。我们认为，进展需要将人类交互视为一个由不确定性、相互依赖和潜在冲突目标塑造的持续决策问题。
translation.brief: 综述人-智能体系统中的开放挑战，梳理 AAMAS 社区从心智理论到共享自主等方法如何支撑理解他人与决定交互方式这两大核心问题。

papers.title: Tideway: Phase-Aware Tiered Memory Management for MoE Inference on Consumer Devices
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly becoming a dominant paradigm for AI applications. Recently, there is a growing demand to deploy large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models locally on consumer PCs to balance data privacy, API costs, and inference efficiency. However, unlike datacenter servers with abundant DRAM, consumer devices are tightly constrained in both GPU VRAM and host RAM, forcing massive MoE weights to spill across VRAM, host RAM, and SSD. Under such spilling, we observe that existing systems fail to fully utilize this memory hierarchy, treating the tiers as independent caches and thrashing in inference. We present TIDEWAY, a system for efficient inference of large MoE models on memory-constrained consumer devices. Our core insight is to manage host RAM and GPU VRAM as a unified memory pool. Within this pool, TIDEWAY couples phase-aware memory layouts, which adapt to the distinct access patterns of prefill and decode, with an execution engine that optimizes CUDA Graph execution under expert paging. Our evaluations on representative consumer hardware with frontier MoE models demonstrate that TIDEWAY significantly outperforms state-of-the-art systems. On average, TIDEWAY achieves speedups of 1.97x in end-to-end latency and 2.40x in Time-to-First-Token (TTFT), along with 1.61x higher decode throughput against the fastest baseline. Our source code is publicly available at this https URL .

translation.title: Tideway：面向消费设备上 MoE 推理的阶段感知分层内存管理
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正迅速成为 AI 应用的主导范式。近来，在消费级 PC 上本地部署大规模混合专家（MoE）模型以平衡数据隐私、API 成本和推理效率的需求不断增长。然而，与拥有充裕 DRAM 的数据中心服务器不同，消费设备的 GPU VRAM 和主机 RAM 都受到严格限制，迫使海量 MoE 权重在 VRAM、主机 RAM 和 SSD 之间溢出。在这种溢出条件下，我们观察到现有系统未能充分利用这一内存层级，将各层视为独立缓存并在推理中发生颠簸。我们提出 TIDEWAY，一个在内存受限消费设备上高效推理大型 MoE 模型的系统。我们的核心洞察是将主机 RAM 和 GPU VRAM 管理为统一内存池。在此池中，TIDEWAY 将适应预填充和解码不同访问模式的阶段感知内存布局，与在专家分页下优化 CUDA Graph 执行的执行引擎相耦合。我们在代表性消费硬件上对前沿 MoE 模型的评估表明，TIDEWAY 显著优于最先进的系统。与最快基线相比，TIDEWAY 平均实现 1.97 倍的端到端时延加速和 2.40 倍的 Time-to-First-Token（TTFT）加速，以及 1.61 倍的解码吞吐量提升。我们的源代码已公开于此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对消费设备内存受限导致 MoE 权重跨 VRAM/RAM/SSD 溢出的问题，提出 Tideway 将主机 RAM 与 VRAM 统一管理，结合阶段感知内存布局与专家分页下的 CUDA Graph 优化。

papers.title: AgentiGrid: Agentic AI for Steady State and Transient Studies
papers.abstract: As power systems worldwide struggle to meet in- creasing loads or higher penetration of inverter based resources, dynamic studies become of increasing importance. The rise of artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities allows to automate some of these resource intensive studies. Coupled with parallel computing, AI is a promising technology to conduct transient and stability studies on an unprecedented scale. This study provides a proof of concept agentic AI capable of parallel or sequential execution of phasor domain studies for a 10,000 bus system. The agent first executes a standalone simulation of a three phase symmetric fault and then executes a series of actions, by first adding a large load to a bus and then applying the fault to the same bus to stress the system. The results of the agentic simulation are consistent with human counterfactual across four vendor backends.

translation.title: AgentiGrid：用于稳态与暂态研究的智能体AI
translation.abstract: 随着全球电力系统难以满足不断增长的负荷或更高的逆变器型资源渗透率，动态研究的重要性日益提升。人工智能（AI）能力的兴起使得自动化部分资源密集型研究成为可能。结合并行计算，AI 是一种有望以前所未有规模开展暂态与稳定性研究的技术。本研究提供了一个概念验证型智能体AI，能够并行或串行执行针对 10,000 节点系统的相量域研究。该智能体首先执行三相对称故障的独立仿真，随后执行一系列动作：先向某节点添加大负荷，再对该节点施加故障以对系统施加压力。在四种厂商后端上，智能体仿真结果与人工反事实分析保持一致。
translation.brief: 针对大规模电力系统动态研究自动化问题，构建可并行执行相量域暂态与稳定性仿真的智能体AI系统。

papers.title: Is Jev a Good Multilingual Judge?
papers.abstract: Generative large language models are widely used for multilingual text evaluation, yet whether decision models that directly output judgment probabilities can serve as multilingual judges has received limited attention. We evaluate Jev against generative LLM judges on four multilingual benchmarks with human annotations, covering up to 47 language varieties and three evaluation formats: binary decisions, pairwise comparisons, and graded ratings. At approximately $1/31$ to $1/61$ of GPT-6.1's evaluation cost, Jev is competitive on most multilingual judging tasks, but falls behind GPT-6.1 on knowledge-intensive answer verification. Further analysis shows that Jev is more likely to accept incorrect answers in low-resource languages than in English and that its probability outputs help identify errors across tasks. Based on these findings, we offer recommendations on evaluation instructions, confidence-based selection, and model routing, providing empirical guidance for using Jev as a multilingual judge.

translation.title: Jev 是一个好的多语言评判者吗？
translation.abstract: 生成式大语言模型被广泛用于多语言文本评估，然而直接输出判断概率的决策模型能否胜任多语言评判者的角色却鲜受关注。我们在四个带人工标注的多语言基准上，将 Jev 与生成式 LLM 评判者进行对比评测，覆盖最多 47 种语言变体和三种评估形式：二元决策、成对比较和分级评分。在约为 GPT-6.1 评估成本 1/31 至 1/61 的代价下，Jev 在大多数多语言评判任务上具有竞争力，但在知识密集型答案验证上落后于 GPT-6.1。进一步分析表明，与英语相比，Jev 在低资源语言中更易接受错误答案，且其概率输出有助于跨任务识别错误。基于这些发现，我们针对评估指令、基于置信度的选择以及模型路由提出了建议，为使用 Jev 作为多语言评判者提供实证指导。
translation.brief: 研究决策型模型 Jev 能否胜任多语言评估评判任务，通过在多个人工标注多语言基准上与生成式 LLM 评判者系统对比进行分析。

papers.title: When Safety Becomes an Attack Surface: Manipulating Abstention in Tool-Using AI Agents
papers.abstract: An AI agent's decision not to act can itself become an attack surface. We study warning-induced over-abstention, an availability attack in which adversaries place fabricated risk warnings in low-trust content to prevent legitimate task completion. Our central premise is that safe abstention requires evaluating both the claimed risk and the authority of the evidence supporting it. We develop controlled counterfactual task variants that vary risk content, source provenance, and warning wording, and evaluate a Verify-Before-Abstain protocol that corroborates warnings against authoritative records or the underlying content. Across three model families and 51 injectable AgentAbstain task pairs, caution-first prompting amplifies the attack. For Gemini, induced over-abstention rises from $9.8\%$ to $86.3\%$, despite unchanged clean-task completion. Matched wording comparisons further reveal sensitivity to warning language, with substantial variation across models and environments. Provenance-aware verification improves legitimate completion, while forgery and sensitive-content controls expose its dependence on authoritative evidence and its limitations in preserving confidentiality. These results motivate evaluating agent safety through the justification for restraint, alongside the safety of actions taken.

translation.title: 当安全成为攻击面：操纵使用工具的AI智能体的弃权行为
translation.abstract: AI 智能体决定不行动本身也可能成为攻击面。我们研究了警告诱发的过度弃权，这是一种可用性攻击：攻击者在低信任度内容中放置伪造的风险警告，以阻止合法任务的完成。我们的核心前提是，安全的弃权需要同时评估所声称的风险以及支持该风险的证据的权威性。我们构建了受控的反事实任务变体，改变风险内容、来源出处和警告措辞，并评估一种“弃权前先验证”（Verify-Before-Abstain）协议，该协议通过权威记录或底层内容来核实警告。在三个模型家族和 51 个可注入的 AgentAbstain 任务对上，谨慎优先的提示会放大攻击。对于 Gemini，尽管干净任务的完成率不变，诱导的过度弃权却从 9.8% 上升至 86.3%。匹配措辞的对比进一步揭示了对警告语言的敏感性，且在不同模型和环境中存在显著差异。来源感知的验证提升了合法任务完成率，而伪造与敏感内容控制则暴露了其对权威证据的依赖以及在保护机密性方面的局限。这些结果促使我们通过“克制的理由”来评估智能体安全，同时评估所采取行动的安全性。
translation.brief: 研究攻击者通过在低信任内容中伪造风险警告诱使工具型AI智能体过度弃权的可用性攻击，并提出基于权威证据核实警告的弃权前验证协议。

papers.title: MLIRBench - A Benchmark and Dataset for Compiler and Hardware-Aware Reasoning
papers.abstract: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly popular in software engineering and have performed well on different programming tasks. However, it is still difficult to know whether these models truly understand program behavior or whether they mainly rely on patterns learned from their training data. This distinction is particularly important for intermediate representations (IRs), where operations, dataflow, and execution semantics are explicitly represented. In this paper, we introduce MLIRBench, a benchmark for evaluating how LLMs reason about MLIR programs. MLIRBench uses a multi-agent pipeline to generate program mutations, validate their behavior through execution, and construct reasoning tasks from torch and linalg program pairs. The dataset contains 1,768 validated pairs, including 888 linalg pairs and 880 torch pairs, labeled as EQUIV, DIVERGE, or ERROR. We evaluated nine models, including five open-weight and four proprietary models. Gemini 3.1 Pro achieved the highest hard-label accuracy of 92.65% across all 1,768 pairs, counting unsuccessful predictions as incorrect. Across its 1,768 scored predictions, it achieved an aggregate score of 74.18 and a judge-assigned result-behavior score of 5.04/10. These results show that strong semantic classification does not necessarily imply accurate prediction of detailed execution behavior, highlighting a gap in current LLM reasoning over compiler IRs. By exposing this gap through execution-validated program pairs, MLIRBench provides a reproducible foundation for studying semantic reasoning over compiler IRs and related tasks such as program repair and semantic classification.

translation.title: MLIRBench——面向编译器与硬件感知推理的基准与数据集
translation.abstract: 近年来，大语言模型（LLM）在软件工程领域日益流行，并在多种编程任务上表现良好。然而，我们仍难以判断这些模型是真正理解程序行为，还是主要依赖从训练数据中学到的模式。这一区别对于中间表示（IR）尤为重要，因为 IR 显式地表示了操作、数据流和执行语义。本文提出 MLIRBench，一个评估 LLM 如何对 MLIR 程序进行推理的基准。MLIRBench 使用多智能体流水线生成程序变异、通过执行验证其行为，并从 torch 与 linalg 程序对构建推理任务。数据集包含 1,768 个已验证的程序对，其中 888 个 linalg 对和 880 个 torch 对，标记为 EQUIV、DIVERGE 或 ERROR。我们评估了九个模型，包括五个开放权重模型和四个专有模型。Gemini 3.1 Pro 在全部 1,768 个程序对上取得了最高的硬标签准确率 92.65%（未成功的预测计为错误）。在其 1,768 个打分预测中，它取得了 74.18 的总分以及裁判评定的 5.04/10 的结果-行为分。这些结果表明，强大的语义分类能力并不必然意味着能准确预测详细的执行行为，凸显了当前 LLM 在编译器 IR 推理上的差距。通过以经验证的程序对暴露这一差距，MLIRBench 为研究编译器 IR 语义推理以及程序修复和语义分类等相关任务提供了可复现的基础。
translation.brief: 提出 MLIRBench 基准，通过执行验证的 MLIR 程序对评估 LLM 对编译器中间表示的语义推理与执行行为预测能力。

papers.title: Can an AI Agent Be Epistemically Akratic? Higher-Order Evidence & the Limits of Self-Correction
papers.abstract: When we judge that our reasoning was defective, it seems plausible that we should abandon the conclusion it produced. This thought has special force for AI agents built to assess and correct their own work. Yet obeying such judgments can make an agent worse at distinguishing sound reasoning from defective reasoning. An AI agent may rely on information about its reasoning when deciding which conclusions to keep, while the part that judges whether those conclusions are justified cannot use that information. The agent can then exercise an epistemic competence by retaining conclusions it judges unjustified, even when its self-assessments are generally reliable. Nor is the difficulty resolved by training the agent to make its conclusions and assessments agree: agreement can be achieved by degrading either one. Crucially, I argue that a negative assessment can remain valuable by identifying conclusions requiring further scrutiny, without having authority to eliminate them. The result challenges a central assumption about AI self-correction: that bringing an agent's beliefs into agreement with its own self-assessment about their justification makes it better at correcting its mistakes.

translation.title: AI智能体会出现认知性意志薄弱吗？高阶证据与自我纠正的局限
translation.abstract: 当我们判断自己的推理存在缺陷时，放弃该推理得出的结论似乎是合理的。这一想法对于被构建为评估并纠正自身工作的 AI 智能体尤其有力。然而，服从这类判断可能反而使智能体更难区分健全推理与缺陷推理。AI 智能体在决定保留哪些结论时可能依赖关于其推理的信息，而判断这些结论是否合理的那部分却无法使用该信息。这样一来，即使其自我评估总体上是可靠的，智能体也可以通过保留它认为不合理的结论来行使一种认知能力。而且，训练智能体使其结论与评估保持一致并不能解决这一困难：一致性可以通过降低两者中任何一方的质量来实现。关键的是，我论证了负面评估可以保持其价值——通过识别需要进一步审查的结论，而无权将其消除。这一结果挑战了关于 AI 自我纠正的一个核心假设：即让智能体的信念与其关于自身信念合理性的自我评估保持一致，会使它更善于纠正自己的错误。
translation.brief: 论证AI智能体的自我评估无权直接否决其结论，表明让结论与自我评估一致并不能提升其纠正错误的能力。

papers.title: Understanding the Effects of Multi-Agent Deliberation for Human-AI Decision-Making
papers.abstract: Multi-agent deliberation (MAD), where multiple LLMs engage in structured discussion, improves AI performance on many benchmarks, but whether it helps humans make better decisions remains untested. We conduct two user studies on LLM-response-verification and fact-checking. We first compare MAD against common AI decision-support methods that isolate its two defining dimensions --- multiple AIs and multi-round interaction. We find MAD outperformed single-round AI assistance on both tasks; multi-round interaction was the main driver of this benefit, while a second AI added value when the single AI had room to improve. Then, we study two design choices in MAD --- AI persona and human engagement level --- finding a devil's advocate persona to lower accuracy and user experience, while humans' active participation in MAD improved accuracy in one task at the cost of frustration. We conclude by discussing implications for when, why, and how multi-agent deliberation can support human decision-making.

translation.title: 理解多智能体审议对人机协同决策的影响
translation.abstract: 多智能体审议（MAD）即多个LLM进行结构化讨论，在许多基准测试中提升了AI性能，但是否能帮助人类做出更好的决策尚未得到验证。我们针对LLM回复验证和事实核查开展了两项用户研究。首先，我们将MAD与隔离其两个定义维度——多个AI与多轮交互——的常见AI决策支持方法进行比较。我们发现MAD在两项任务上均优于单轮AI辅助；多轮交互是这一收益的主要驱动因素，而当单个AI仍有提升空间时，增加第二个AI能带来额外价值。随后，我们研究MAD中的两个设计选择——AI人设和人类参与程度——发现“魔鬼代言人”人设会降低准确性和用户体验，而人类积极参与MAD虽会在一项任务中提升准确性，却以挫败感为代价。最后我们讨论了多智能体审议在何时、为何以及如何支持人类决策的启示。
translation.brief: 研究MAD（多LLM结构化讨论）能否改善人类决策，通过用户实验分解其“多AI”与“多轮交互”两个维度并考察AI人设和人类参与度等设计选择。

papers.title: SubGPU Pipelining: Intra-GPU Fine-Grained Spatial Parallelism for LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) decode is dominated by short, predominantly memory-bound kernels that make bursty use of on-chip execution resources and memory bandwidth. This paper introduces SubGPU Pipelining, a fine-grained, intra-GPU spatial execution model that cuts an operator graph into ordered contiguous segments, binds those segments to spatial stages backed by disjoint streaming-multiprocessor (SM) pools, and streams microbatches through the resulting schedule. Selecting the graph cuts, segment-to-stage binding, per-stage SM allocation, and microbatch size is a coupled optimization problem: each choice changes the overlap pattern, shared-resource contention, cache state, and execution times of the others. We evaluate SubGPU Pipelining through both simulation and silicon experiment using the GPT-OSS 120B workload with 32-GPU B200 deployment settings. The analytical shared-resource simulator searches across SubGPU pipeline structures and batch sizes to map the per-user/per-GPU throughput Pareto frontier. At matched per-GPU throughput, the modeled SubGPU frontier provides up to 2.2x higher per-user throughput than temporal execution, and at matched per-user throughput it provides up to 1.9x higher per-GPU throughput. To test physical feasibility and further validate the simulation results, silicon experiments are performed, using one B200 GPU to emulate a 32-GPU B200 deployment. The experiment evaluates one selected two-stage pipeline configuration at global batch 2,048 using CUDA Green Contexts and TensorRT-LLM kernels. Results show that SubGPU Pipelining improves mean DRAM read-plus-write throughput from 71.8% to 83.6% of peak, and reduces the 36-layer decoder iteration time by 10.33%.

translation.title: SubGPU流水线：面向LLM推理的GPU内部细粒度空间并行
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）解码主要由短小、以访存受限为主的kernel构成，它们对片上执行资源和内存带宽的使用呈突发性。本文提出SubGPU流水线，一种细粒度的GPU内部空间执行模型：它将算子图切分为有序的连续段，把这些段绑定到由互不重叠的流式多处理器（SM）池支撑的空间阶段上，并以微批次流经所生成的调度。选择图的切分位置、段到阶段的绑定、每阶段的SM分配以及微批次大小是一个耦合优化问题：每个选择都会改变其他选择的重叠模式、共享资源竞争、缓存状态和执行时间。我们通过仿真和实际硬件实验评估SubGPU流水线，使用GPT-OSS 120B负载和32卡B200部署配置。分析型共享资源模拟器在SubGPU流水线结构和批次大小中搜索，绘制每用户/每GPU吞吐量的Pareto前沿。在匹配的每GPU吞吐量下，模型化的SubGPU前沿比时间执行提供最高2.2倍的每用户吞吐量；在匹配的每用户吞吐量下，提供最高1.9倍的每GPU吞吐量。为验证物理可行性和进一步验证仿真结果，我们进行了硬件实验，使用一块B200 GPU模拟32卡B200部署，利用CUDA Green Contexts和TensorRT-LLM kernel，在全局批次2048下评估一个选定的两阶段流水线配置。结果显示SubGPU流水线将平均DRAM读写吞吐量从峰值的71.8%提升至83.6%，并将36层解码器迭代时间降低10.33%。
translation.brief: 针对LLM解码kernel突发性利用资源的问题，提出将算子图切分并绑定到不相交SM池上的GPU内空间流水线执行模型SubGPU Pipelining。

papers.title: Hy ASR 3.0 Technical Report
papers.abstract: We present Hy ASR 3.0, a large language model (LLM)-based automatic speech recognition (ASR) system that delivers strong recognition accuracy, supports flexible contextual conditioning, and maintains robust recognition performance across diverse speech conditions. Hy ASR 3.0 supports Mandarin Chinese, English and 13 Chinese dialect groups, including Cantonese. Among the evaluated systems, it achieves the lowest aggregate error rates on public Mandarin Chinese, English, and Cantonese benchmarks and the lowest error rates on the corresponding internal test sets, alongside first-tier dialect recognition performance. Beyond audio-only transcription, Hy ASR 3.0 supports multiple forms of external context, including hotword lists, question--answer dialogues, and summaries, enabling the use of task-relevant information during recognition. The model also leverages intra-utterance context to disambiguate homophonic and phonetically similar keywords using information from other parts of the same utterance, without requiring a separate contextual input. Evaluations demonstrate strong contextual recognition in both external-context and intra-utterance settings, as well as robust recognition of long-form speech, children's and older adults' speech, low-volume speech, and speech in noisy environments. This report describes the model architecture and training methodology and presents evaluations across recognition accuracy, context utilization, and robustness.

translation.title: Hy ASR 3.0 技术报告
translation.abstract: 我们提出Hy ASR 3.0，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动语音识别（ASR）系统，具有出色的识别准确率、支持灵活的上下文条件化，并在多种语音条件下保持稳健的识别性能。Hy ASR 3.0支持普通话、英语以及包括粤语在内的13个汉语方言组。在所评估的系统中，它在公开的普通话、英语和粤语基准上取得最低的总体错误率，在相应内部测试集上也取得最低错误率，并具备一流的方言识别性能。除纯音频转写外，Hy ASR 3.0支持多种形式的外部上下文，包括热词列表、问答对话和摘要，可在识别过程中利用与任务相关的信息。该模型还利用话语内上下文，借助同一话语其他部分的信息消歧同音和音近关键词，而无需单独的上下文输入。评估表明，系统在外部上下文和话语内上下文两种设置下均具备很强的上下文识别能力，并对长语音、儿童和老年人语音、低音量语音以及噪声环境语音保持稳健识别。本报告描述了模型架构与训练方法，并给出在识别准确率、上下文利用和鲁棒性方面的评估。
translation.brief: 提出基于LLM的ASR系统Hy ASR 3.0，支持多语言多方言识别，并利用外部上下文与话语内上下文提升识别准确率与鲁棒性。

papers.title: MuEdit: An efficient multi-task editing method towards inter-domain knowledge conflicts
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) require frequent knowledge updates across heterogeneous domains, but existing editing methods fail when applied sequentially to multi-task settings. We trace this collapse to inter-domain null-space misalignment: heterogeneous tasks induce distinct Jacobian geometries, causing their common null space to shrink dramatically and leaving insufficient admissible directions for conflict-free updates. We propose the Conflict Index to quantify this geometric interference, and introduce Mu-Edit, which mitigates multi-task conflicts via (1) conflict-aware ordering to minimize cumulative interference, and (2) dynamic low-rank approximation to expand the null space when ordering alone is insufficient. Experiments across five functional domains and three backbones show that Mu-Edit significantly outperforms existing baselines in multi-task editing performance while preserving general capabilities, and remains effective under incremental task arrival.

translation.title: MuEdit：一种面向跨领域知识冲突的高效多任务编辑方法
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）需要在异构领域间频繁更新知识，但现有编辑方法在多任务串行应用时往往失效。我们将这种崩溃归因于跨领域零空间不对齐：异构任务诱导出不同的Jacobian几何结构，导致其公共零空间急剧收缩，为无冲突更新留下的可行方向不足。我们提出Conflict Index来量化这种几何干扰，并引入MuEdit，通过以下方式缓解多任务冲突：(1) 冲突感知的排序以最小化累积干扰；(2) 当仅靠排序不足时，采用动态低秩近似来扩展零空间。在五个功能领域和三个骨干模型上的实验表明，MuEdit在多任务编辑性能上显著优于现有基线，同时保持通用能力，并在增量任务到达场景下依然有效。
translation.brief: 针对多任务知识编辑中的跨领域冲突问题，提出以零空间不对齐为诊断的Conflict Index及MuEdit方法，通过冲突感知排序与动态低秩近似扩展零空间。

papers.title: Rethinking "RL Generalizes, SFT Memorizes": The Role of SFT Data
papers.abstract: Large language models trained with Reinforcement Learning (RL) with verifiable rewards exhibit strong reasoning ability and broad generalization, whereas models trained with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) are often viewed as more prone to memorization and limited transfer. This paper rethinks this distinction through the lens of SFT training data on widely used Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 series models. First, we study the role of data source and show that it is critical: a carefully mixed SFT dataset substantially outperforms data generated solely by a larger model. Second, we study the role of data scale and show that matching the number of correct rollouts between SFT and RL greatly improves SFT generalization, while matching the total rollout budget enables SFT to generalize as well as RL. Combining these two factors further enables SFT to generalize even better than RL. Third, by using LLM annotations to characterize the solution methods in training rollouts, we show that larger datasets cover more tail methods and that these tail methods provide generalizable reasoning signals. Finally, we support these empirical findings theoretically by analyzing the training dynamics of shallow transformers under both RL and SFT.

translation.title: 重新审视“RL泛化、SFT记忆化”：SFT数据的作用
translation.abstract: 使用可验证奖励的强化学习（RL）训练的大语言模型展现出强大的推理能力和广泛泛化，而监督微调（SFT）训练的模型常被认为更易记忆化且迁移能力有限。本文以广泛使用的Qwen2.5和Qwen3系列模型的SFT训练数据为视角重新审视这一区别。首先，我们研究数据来源的作用并表明其至关重要：精心混合的SFT数据集显著优于仅由更大模型生成的数据。其次，我们研究数据规模的作用并表明：使SFT与RL的正确rollout数量一致可大幅提升SFT泛化，而使总rollout预算一致则使SFT的泛化能力与RL相当。结合这两个因素可进一步使SFT的泛化甚至超过RL。第三，通过用LLM标注刻画训练rollout中的解题方法，我们发现更大的数据集覆盖更多尾部方法，而这些尾部方法提供了可泛化的推理信号。最后，我们通过分析浅层transformer在RL和SFT下的训练动态，为这些实证发现提供了理论支持。
translation.brief: 通过控制SFT数据来源与规模，重新审视“RL泛化、SFT记忆化”现象，证明精心混合并匹配rollout量的SFT数据可使SFT泛化达到甚至超过RL。

papers.title: Janus: One Agent, Two Roles for Digital Twin Construction and Network Orchestration
papers.abstract: Next-generation wireless networks are increasingly large-scale, heterogeneous, and dynamic, posing significant challenges to network modeling and control. Digital twins offer a promising solution, but existing approaches typically rely on static models and decouple twin construction from network orchestration, limiting adaptability. Meanwhile, large language models (LLMs) provide strong reasoning capabilities but struggle with graph-structured data and are highly sensitive to prompt design, making inference unreliable. In this paper, we propose Janus, an agentic LLM-based framework that unifies digital twin construction and network orchestration within a closed-loop system. At the core of Janus is a novel NetTwin agent, which introduces a new one-agent, two-role paradigm, enabling a single agent to simultaneously construct the digital twin from partial observations while performing task-driven network decision-making. To realize this, we design a modular architecture with three functional roles, including planner, modeler, and coder, along with a newly designed unified prompt module that further enhances graph reasoning robustness. Extensive evaluations on wireless networks with up to 200 nodes and two representative tasks, including user association and SAGIN routing, show that Janus achieves over 90% digital twin accuracy and near-optimal performance with gaps within 10.53%, while maintaining moderate computational overhead. These results demonstrate the effectiveness, scalability, and generalizability of Janus, paving the way for AI-native autonomous wireless network orchestration.

translation.title: Janus：一个智能体、两种角色，用于数字孪生构建与网络编排
translation.abstract: 下一代无线网络日益大规模化、异构化和动态化，对网络建模与控制提出了重大挑战。数字孪生提供了一种有前景的解决方案，但现有方法通常依赖静态模型，并将孪生构建与网络编排解耦，限制了适应性。同时，大语言模型（LLM）具备强大的推理能力，但难以处理图结构数据，且对提示词设计高度敏感，导致推理不可靠。本文提出 Janus，一个基于智能体 LLM 的框架，将数字孪生构建与网络编排统一在闭环系统中。Janus 的核心是新颖的 NetTwin 智能体，它引入了
translation.brief: 针对数字孪生构建与网络编排解耦及LLM图推理不可靠的问题，提出单智能体双角色范式Janus，用模块化架构与统一提示模块在闭环中同时完成孪生构建与网络决策。

papers.title: ToolTurns: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Multi-Turn Dialogue
papers.abstract: Tool-using language models are increasingly deployed in conversational settings, yet most large-scale tool-use benchmarks focus on isolated requests. We introduce ToolTurns, a benchmark of 2,620 problems spanning 1,827 tools and 11,004 API endpoints across 47 categories. Each dialogue begins with an intentionally underspecified request and continues through two context-dependent follow-ups, testing clarification, tool use, and retention of conversational context. We also introduce an open-source user simulator that reveals withheld context through dialogue and generates follow-up requests, with a checker--fixer pipeline for improving its turns. Across nine language models, the best agent resolves 69.6% of individual requests but completes only 39.8% of full dialogues. Under this evaluation protocol, every evaluated model receives lower success scores on follow-up requests than on the initial request, and dialogue-quality rubric scores and task success can rank models very differently. Paired turn-level evaluation shows that the checker--fixer reduces detected dialogue defects, and blind human evaluation favors the revised turns. ToolTurns provides a testbed for evaluating whether agents sustain task success across multi-turn dialogue with tools.

translation.title: ToolTurns：多轮对话中LLM智能体基准测试
translation.abstract: 工具使用型语言模型越来越多地被部署于对话场景，但大多数大规模工具使用基准测试聚焦于孤立请求。我们提出 ToolTurns，一个包含 2,620 个问题、涉及 1,827 个工具和 11,004 个 API 端点（跨 47 个类别）的基准。每段对话都从刻意不明确的请求开始，并延续两个依赖上下文的后续请求，测试澄清能力、工具使用和对话上下文的保持。我们还引入一个开源用户模拟器，通过对话揭示被保留的上下文并生成后续请求，并配有用于改进其轮次的检查器-修复器流水线。在九个语言模型中，最佳智能体可解决 69.6% 的单个请求，但只能完成 39.8% 的完整对话。在该评估协议下，所有被评估模型在后续请求上的成功率均低于初始请求，且对话质量评分与任务成功率对模型的排名可能大相径庭。轮次级配对评估表明检查器-修复器减少了检测到的对话缺陷，盲测人类评估也更青睐修改后的轮次。ToolTurns 为评估智能体能否在多轮工具对话中保持任务成功提供了测试平台。
translation.brief: 针对现有工具使用基准只测孤立请求的问题，构建含不明确请求与上下文依赖后续请求的多轮对话基准ToolTurns，并用开源用户模拟器与检查器-修复器流水线评估智能体的多轮工具使用能力。

papers.title: Inverse-Optimal Fixed-Time Integral Reinforcement Learning for Unknown Nonlinear Leader-Follower Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: This paper develops a distributed inverse-optimal fixed-time integral reinforcement learning framework for unknown nonlinear leader-follower multi-agent systems. The proposed method first reconstructs the unknown agent dynamics from finite integral data. Based on the identified dynamics, a distributed inverse-optimal formulation is constructed by prescribing a desired fixed-time value function and recovering a compatible running cost. A critic-only integral reinforcement learning architecture is then developed using current integral data and finitely informative experience-replay data, thereby avoiding the persistent-excitation requirement. Practical fixed-time convergence of the critic-weight errors is established in the presence of identification and function-approximation residuals. Finally, a network-level composite Lyapunov analysis proves practical fixed-time leader-following consensus of the true unknown nonlinear multi-agent system. Numerical simulations are provided to validate the developed theory.

translation.title: 面向未知非线性领航-跟随多智能体系统的逆最优固定时间积分强化学习
translation.abstract: 本文为未知非线性领航-跟随多智能体系统开发了分布式逆最优固定时间积分强化学习框架。所提方法首先从有限积分数据中重构未知的智能体动力学。基于辨识出的动力学，通过设定期望的固定时间值函数并恢复兼容的运行代价，构建分布式逆最优公式。随后利用当前积分数据和有限信息量的经验回放数据，开发仅含评判器的积分强化学习架构，从而避免持续激励条件。在辨识误差与函数逼近残差存在的情况下，建立了评判器权重误差的实用固定时间收敛性。最后，通过网络级复合 Lyapunov 分析证明了真实未知非线性多智能体系统的实用固定时间领航-跟随一致性。数值仿真验证了所发展理论的正确性。
translation.brief: 针对未知动力学非线性多智能体系统的固定时间一致性问题，提出分布式逆最优固定时间积分强化学习框架，通过积分数据重构动力学、仅评判器架构避免持续激励条件。

papers.title: Do Large Language Models Show Racial and Sex Bias in Pain Management? A Counterfactual Audit of GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, DeepSeek and Qwen
papers.abstract: Racial and ethnic minority patients receive less pain treatment than non-Hispanic White patients, and large language models (LLMs) used as medical AI could reproduce that bias. Prior audits tested a few proprietary models, stated race explicitly and rarely measured the models' own response instability. In exploratory, non-preregistered analyses, Study 1 had four open-weight LLMs assess six acute-pain vignettes in every combination of four races and two sexes, with identity stated or cued only by a name (two names per group), comparing each identity with a White male reference on the same case and sampling seed. In Study 2, 24 configurations of 17 models, including OpenAI's GPT-4.1 mini and gpt-oss, Anthropic's Claude Haiku 4.5, Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash, Meta's Llama, DeepSeek and Qwen, with reasoning on and off and at two precisions, answered the same vignettes and the 50 clinician-written Q-Pain cases. In this single-prompt, JSON-constrained task, no difference survived correction in Study 1, none of 1,386 comparisons survived the false discovery rate in Study 2, and every pain-severity difference was equivalent to zero within one point on a 0-10 scale (within a quarter point for 237 of 238 Q-Pain comparisons). Opioid decisions were bounded less precisely (Study 1 could not exclude differences of about 20 percentage points), so they show no detected difference, not proof of none. The few differences surviving correction within a model favoured Black patients. Models differed far more from one another and across their own settings than between patients (the reference patient received the high opioid dose in 6% to 93% of responses), although serving software, provider and prompt format also differed. Fairness audits of clinical AI should use several names per group, pair comparisons on the seed, report the noise floor and test each deployed configuration.

translation.title: 大语言模型在疼痛管理中是否表现出种族与性别偏见？对GPT、Claude、Gemini、Llama、DeepSeek和Qwen的反事实审计
translation.abstract: 少数族裔患者接受的疼痛治疗少于非西班牙裔白人患者，而用作医疗 AI 的大语言模型（LLM）可能复现这种偏见。以往的审计仅测试了少数专有模型，明确陈述种族，且很少测量模型自身的响应不稳定性。在探索性、非预注册的分析中，研究 1 让四个开源权重 LLM 在四种族与两性别的所有组合下评估六个急性疼痛案例，身份要么明确陈述，要么仅通过姓名暗示（每组两个名字），并在相同病例和采样种子下将每个身份与白人男性参照进行比较。研究 2 中，24 种配置、17 个模型——包括 OpenAI 的 GPT-4.1 mini 和 gpt-oss、Anthropic 的 Claude Haiku 4.5、Google 的 Gemini 2.5 Flash、Meta 的 Llama、DeepSeek 和 Qwen，开启与关闭推理并在两种精度下——回答相同病例以及 50 个临床医生撰写的 Q-Pain 病例。在这一单提示、JSON 约束的任务中，研究 1 无任何差异在校正后显著，研究 2 的 1,386 项比较无一通过错误发现率校正，且所有疼痛严重程度差异在 0-10 量表上均在 1 分内等效于零（238 项 Q-Pain 比较中 237 项在四分之一分内）。阿片类药物决策的界限不够精确（研究 1 无法排除约 20 个百分点的差异），因此只显示
translation.brief: 针对以往医疗LLM偏见审计覆盖面窄、未测量模型自身响应不稳定性的问题，用多名称、同种子配对反事实方法对17个模型的疼痛管理决策进行系统性审计。

papers.title: Auriga: Harness-Governed LLM Agents for Effective Throughput Optimization in Execute-Order-Validate Permissioned Blockchains
papers.abstract: Effective throughput, the product of raw throughput and transaction success rate, determines the useful capacity of Execute-Order-Validate blockchains such as Hyperledger Fabric. Most prior work either tunes configurations to raise raw throughput, requiring many costly redeployments, or controls conflicts to raise the success rate, repairing them only after execution with kernel modifications. The few joint approaches tune only a small set of parameters and still rely on kernel changes to resolve conflicts. To address these challenges, we present Auriga, a non-invasive framework that jointly optimizes both factors through sample-efficient LLM-guided configuration search and pre-execution conflict prevention. A harness-governed multi-agent architecture coordinates LLM agents for parameter exploration, saturation-aware evaluation, and experience consolidation, with the harness controlling tool and memory access and retaining termination authority. For transaction scheduling, an LLM extracts symbolic AST templates from smart contracts offline. At runtime, the scheduler predicts read-write sets without executing them and partitions transactions into conflict-free groups. Across three benchmarks and conflict rates up to 70%, Auriga improves effective throughput by up to 6.0 times over default Fabric and 2.0 times over the strongest baseline. The tuning agent also discovers undocumented parameter dependencies, and ablation studies show the independent contributions of both subsystems.

translation.title: Auriga：利用约束治理的LLM智能体在Execute-Order-Validate许可链中实现有效吞吐量优化
translation.abstract: 有效吞吐量——原始吞吐量与交易成功率的乘积——决定了 Hyperledger Fabric 等 Execute-Order-Validate 区块链的有用容量。以往大多数工作要么调优配置以提高原始吞吐量（需要大量昂贵的重新部署），要么控制冲突以提高成功率（在执行后通过内核修改修复冲突）。少数联合方法仅调优少量参数，且仍依赖内核修改来解决冲突。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 Auriga，一个非侵入式框架，通过样本高效的 LLM 引导配置搜索和执行前冲突预防来联合优化这两个因素。一个约束治理的多智能体架构协调 LLM 智能体进行参数探索、饱和感知评估和经验沉淀，由约束框架控制工具与内存访问并保留终止权。对于交易调度，LLM 离线从智能合约中提取符号 AST 模板。运行时，调度器在不执行的情况下预测读写集，并将交易划分为无冲突分组。在三个基准测试和高达 70% 的冲突率下，Auriga 将有效吞吐量较默认 Fabric 提升最高 6.0 倍，较最强基线提升 2.0 倍。调优智能体还发现了未记录的参数依赖关系，消融研究显示了两个子系统的独立贡献。
translation.brief: 针对Fabric有效吞吐量受配置与交易冲突双重制约的问题，提出非侵入式框架Auriga，用约束治理的LLM多智能体进行样本高效配置搜索，并结合基于AST模板的读写集预执行预测将交易划分为无冲突组。

papers.title: LOHRE: Execution-Grounded Type Recovery via LLM-Orchestrated Hybrid Analysis
papers.abstract: Documenting stripped binary functions for security analysis requires recovering function interfaces and user-defined type (UDT) layouts from machine code. Existing large language model (LLM)-based methods face two limitations: they lack execution-based validation to detect inferred UDTs inconsistent with actual memory layouts, and may overlook evidence about shared UDTs across functions without direct call relationships. We present LLM-Orchestrated Hybrid Reverse Engineering (LOHRE), a framework that treats inferred UDTs as falsifiable hypotheses and tests them against program execution. LOHRE uses a hypothesize-validate-refine loop to test candidate layouts through paired dynamic slice emulation of baseline and mutated inputs. To reduce the cost of processing lengthy execution histories, the Execution-Depth Heuristic (EDH) compresses paired traces into an execution-depth difference and a summary of the tested field's observed uses. A cross-function knowledge base aggregates compatible UDT hypotheses and field-level confidence scores to guide testing and hypothesis refinement. We evaluate LOHRE on RealType at four optimization levels and a Windows remote procedure call (RPC) dataset. LOHRE achieves an average UDT Structural accuracy of 57.85% across RealType's four optimization levels and 35.6% on Windows RPC, outperforming the evaluated static baselines. Disabling dynamic validation reduces accuracy to 19.28% on RealType and 9.2% on Windows RPC. Removing the cross-function knowledge base reduces accuracy to 41.03% on RealType and 10.0% on Windows RPC. Replacing EDH's compressed feedback with full execution traces reduces recovery accuracy while increasing token use by 3.7 times and runtime by 3.0 times. These results indicate that execution-based validation, compact feedback, and cross-function evidence contribute to accurate and efficient UDT recovery.

translation.title: LOHRE：基于LLM编排的混合分析的执行落地式类型恢复
translation.abstract: 为剥离符号的二进制函数生成安全分析文档，需要从机器代码中恢复函数接口和用户自定义类型（UDT）布局。现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法存在两个局限：缺乏基于执行的验证来检测与实际内存布局不一致的推断UDT，且可能忽略跨函数共享UDT的证据（当函数间没有直接调用关系时）。我们提出LLM编排的混合逆向工程（LOHRE）框架，将推断的UDT视为可证伪的假设，并针对程序执行进行检验。LOHRE使用“假设-验证-细化”循环，通过对基线输入和变异输入的成对动态切片模拟来测试候选布局。为降低处理冗长执行历史的成本，执行深度启发式（EDH）将成对轨迹压缩为执行深度差值和被测字段观察到的用例摘要。跨函数知识库聚合兼容的UDT假设和字段级置信分数，以指导测试和假设细化。我们在RealType的四个优化级别和一个Windows远程过程调用（RPC）数据集上评估LOHRE。LOHRE在RealType四个优化级别上平均UDT结构准确率为57.85%，在Windows RPC上为35.6%，优于所评估的静态基线。禁用动态验证会将准确率降至RealType上的19.28%和Windows RPC上的9.2%。移除跨函数知识库会将准确率降至RealType上的41.03%和Windows RPC上的10.0%。用完整执行轨迹替换EDH的压缩反馈会降低恢复准确率，同时使token使用增加3.7倍、运行时间增加3.0倍。这些结果表明，基于执行的验证、紧凑反馈和跨函数证据有助于实现准确高效的UDT恢复。
translation.brief: 解决从剥离符号的二进制中恢复用户自定义类型布局时缺乏执行验证和跨函数证据的问题，采用LLM编排的假设-验证-细化循环并结合动态执行检验与跨函数知识库的方法。

papers.title: RSI-PDEbench: A Benchmark for Self-Improving Agents in PDE Solving
papers.abstract: Identifying and solving partial differential equations (PDEs) from sampled solution data often requires substantial expert effort in equation discovery, coefficient estimation, and numerical solver configuration, especially under noise and distribution shifts. Can large language model (LLM) agents automate this workflow accurately and efficiently? To investigate this question, we introduce \bench{}, a benchmark of 1,001 cases spanning 42 equation templates, including both classical and fractional PDEs. It provides three evaluation settings: Full evaluates performance on noise-free solution data; Noisy tests robustness to Gaussian noise with an RMS equal to 50\% of the clean-signal RMS; and Hard-OOD tests challenging out-of-distribution generalization to unseen equation templates and shifted coefficient ranges. We further introduce RSI-PDE, a recursively self-improving agent harness that shortlists candidate equations by residual loss, uses relative $L^2$ feedback to refine coefficients and numerical solvers, and applies a validation gate to policy and memory updates. We compare RSI-PDE with single-run baselines and native agent harnesses (Claude Code or Codex) across four frontier models. Across the three settings, RSI-PDE improves the pass rate averaged across the four models by 106.5--181.9\% relative to single-run baselines and by 3.0--19.6\% relative to native harnesses, while reducing total recorded model calls by 46.9\% across the 12 model--setting pairs. These results highlight the potential of validated recursive self-improvement in LLM agents to advance scientific computing.

translation.title: RSI-PDEbench：面向PDE求解自我改进智能体的基准测试
translation.abstract: 从采样的解数据中识别和求解偏微分方程（PDE）通常需要在方程发现、系数估计和数值求解器配置方面投入大量专家精力，尤其是在噪声和分布偏移条件下。大语言模型（LLM）智能体能否准确高效地自动化这一流程？为探究这一问题，我们引入\bench{}，一个包含1,001个案例、覆盖42个方程模板的基准，涵盖经典PDE和分数阶PDE。它提供三种评估设置：Full评估在无噪声解数据上的性能；Noisy测试对高斯噪声（RMS为干净信号RMS的50%）的鲁棒性；Hard-OOD测试对未见方程模板和偏移系数范围的挑战性分布外泛化。我们进一步提出RSI-PDE，一个递归自我改进的智能体框架：通过残差损失筛选候选方程，利用相对$L^2$反馈细化系数和数值求解器，并对策略和记忆更新应用验证门控。我们在四个前沿模型上将RSI-PDE与单次运行基线和原生智能体框架（Claude Code或Codex）进行比较。在三种设置下，RSI-PDE将四个模型的平均通过率相对单次运行基线提升106.5–181.9%，相对原生框架提升3.0–19.6%，同时在12个模型-设置组合中将记录的模型调用总数减少46.9%。这些结果凸显了LLM智能体中经验证的递归自我改进在推进科学计算方面的潜力。
translation.brief: 解决从采样数据自动识别和求解PDE需大量专家介入的问题，采用带残差筛选、相对L2反馈和验证门控的递归自我改进LLM智能体框架RSI-PDE。

papers.title: JoyFrontBench: Evaluating Front-End Coding Agents through Goal-Oriented Acceptance Contracts
papers.abstract: Front-end coding agents are expected to produce applications that fulfill user goals, yet high task scores can coexist with failures in essential workflows. Evaluating these agents therefore requires an explicit distinction between partial implementation and application success. We introduce JoyFrontBench, a benchmark that makes this distinction through goal-oriented acceptance contracts. Each contract identifies core tasks and mandatory criteria before generation: a core task passes only when all mandatory criteria are satisfied and a shared completion threshold is met, while application success requires every core task to pass on the same operational artifact within a single run. Derived from practitioner requirements, JoyFrontBench comprises 100 front-end development problems, 764 tasks, and 2,596 atomic criteria, with reviewed annotations linking user goals to core tasks and evidence requirements. The evaluation framework combines evidence-grounded judgments with deterministic record auditing and fixed scoring rules, preserving graded task assessment alongside explicit core-task and application-level acceptance. We evaluate five coding models under two agent harnesses, OpenHands and OpenCode, on the 70-problem test set; the remaining 30 problems form a public set for validation and diagnostic analyses. Under OpenHands, the mean Average Task Score (ATS) across models is 87.69%, while the mean Application Success Rate (ASR) is 51.52%. Further analyses reveal changes in model rankings across harnesses and variation in application success across repeated runs. These findings highlight the limitations of aggregate task scores in characterizing application success and motivate explicit assessment of core-goal fulfillment alongside graded task performance.

translation.title: JoyFrontBench：通过面向目标的验收契约评估前端编码智能体
translation.abstract: 前端编码智能体被期望产出能实现用户目标的应用，然而高任务得分可能与关键工作流的失败并存。因此，评估这些智能体需要明确区分部分实现与应用成功。我们提出JoyFrontBench，一个通过面向目标的验收契约实现这一区分的基准。每个契约在生成前确定核心任务和强制性标准：只有所有强制性标准都满足且达到共享的完成阈值时，核心任务才通过；而应用成功要求在单次运行中、同一个可运行产物上所有核心任务均通过。JoyFrontBench源自从业者需求，包含100个前端开发问题、764个任务和2,596条原子标准，并附有经审核的标注，将用户目标与核心任务及证据要求关联。评估框架将基于证据的判断与确定性的记录审计和固定评分规则相结合，在保留分级任务评估的同时，实现明确的核心任务和应用级验收。我们在70个问题的测试集上评估五个编码模型在OpenHands和OpenCode两种智能体框架下的表现；其余30个问题构成公开集，用于验证和诊断分析。在OpenHands下，各模型的平均任务得分（ATS）为87.69%，而平均应用成功率（ASR）为51.52%。进一步分析揭示了模型排名在不同框架间的变化，以及应用成功率在重复运行中的波动。这些发现凸显了聚合任务得分在刻画应用成功方面的局限性，说明在分级任务性能之外还需对核心目标达成情况作显式评估。
translation.brief: 解决前端编码智能体评估中任务得分与真实应用成功脱节的问题，提出基于面向目标验收契约的基准JoyFrontBench，将核心任务与应用级验收显式纳入评估。

papers.title: Termination Lag: Coding Agents Solve Early but Stop Late
papers.abstract: Coding agents can solve a task well before they stop working on it. We characterize \emph{termination lag}--the number of steps between an agent's first correct patch and the end of its run--across five models, two agent frameworks, and three SWE-bench datasets by recording and testing every distinct repository patch generated during execution. Our analysis reveals that 38--82% of successful runs achieve a correct solution on their initial source-code edit. However, agents continue to expend substantial effort after correct patches, with post-solution steps accounting for a median of 35--37% for Qwen3-Coder and 54--60% for Laguna-XS.2 in successful runs on SWE-bench Verified and Multilingual. Agents spend most of these additional steps verifying their work and exploring the repository. In a small fraction of cases (1--8%), this continued activity leads agents to undo their earlier correct patch, leaving the final solution incorrect.

translation.title: 终止滞后：编码智能体早已解决任务却迟迟停止
translation.abstract: 编码智能体在停止工作之前往往早已解决任务。我们通过记录并测试执行过程中生成的每一个不同的仓库补丁，在五个模型、两个智能体框架和三个SWE-bench数据集上刻画了“终止滞后”——即智能体首次生成正确补丁与其运行结束之间的步数。我们的分析显示，38–82%的成功运行在首次源代码编辑时就获得了正确解。然而，智能体在生成正确补丁后仍继续投入大量精力，在SWE-bench Verified和Multilingual的成功运行中，解出后的步骤占比中位数分别为：Qwen3-Coder为35–37%，Laguna-XS.2为54–60%。智能体将这些额外步骤主要用于验证其工作和探索仓库。在少数案例中（1–8%），这种持续活动导致智能体撤销了之前的正确补丁，使最终解变为错误。
translation.brief: 研究编码智能体首次得到正确补丁后仍继续执行大量冗余步骤甚至破坏正确解的“终止滞后”现象，通过对运行过程中每个补丁进行记录与测试来量化刻画该现象。

papers.title: GHA-SmellFix: Taking Action with Agentic LLMs for Detecting and Refactoring GitHub Actions Workflow Smells
papers.abstract: Continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows are key artifacts in software projects. In GitHub Actions, they encode build, test, release, deployment, and security automation in YAML. These workflows contain configuration smells affecting security, reliability, maintainability, or operational stability. Existing approaches are mostly rule-based, with rules hard to create and evolve, and typically report findings without fixes. Agentic LLM pipelines can combine contextual detection, transformation selection, and patch generation. Specialized agents can gate refactoring on positive detection verdicts, potentially avoiding unnecessary changes, but it is unclear whether decomposition improves effectiveness or mainly changes overhead. We present GHA-SmellFix, an agentic LLM pipeline for detecting and refactoring GitHub Actions workflow smells. We compare two designs: Joint, where one agent detects and refactors, and Decomposed, where separate agents detect and then refactor. We operationalize 19 smells from an existing catalog with explicit detection criteria, refactoring expectations, exclusion rules, and safety checks, and curate a ground truth of 1,710 (workflow, smell) pairs. We evaluate the designs with four LLMs (GPT-5.4-nano, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Claude Haiku 4.5, and DeepSeek V4 Flash) on 570 sampled pairs. Results show that decomposition does not universally improve patch quality; its main benefit is controlling when patch generation is attempted. It helps models prone to missing smells and can reduce overhead by gating patches. Once a smell is correctly detected, clean refactoring is generally effective, making detection the main end-to-end bottleneck. However, false positives can trigger unnecessary edits to execution-relevant constructs. Practical CI/CD agents thus need reliable abstention and construct-aware validation alongside patch generation.

translation.title: GHA-SmellFix：用智能体化LLM检测和重构GitHub Actions工作流坏味道
translation.abstract: 持续集成与持续交付工作流是软件项目中的关键产物。在GitHub Actions中，它们以YAML形式编码构建、测试、发布、部署和安全自动化。这些工作流包含影响安全性、可靠性、可维护性或运行稳定性的配置坏味道。现有方法大多基于规则，规则难以创建和演进，且通常只报告问题而不提供修复。智能体化LLM流水线可以结合上下文检测、转换选择和补丁生成。专用智能体可以在检测判定为阳性时才允许重构，从而可能避免不必要的变更，但分解是否能提升有效性、还是主要改变开销，尚不清楚。我们提出GHA-SmellFix，一个用于检测和重构GitHub Actions工作流坏味道的智能体化LLM流水线。我们比较两种设计：Joint（单个智能体同时检测和重构）和Decomposed（由独立智能体先检测后重构）。我们从现有目录中操作化19种坏味道，并给出明确的检测标准、重构预期、排除规则和安全检查，并整理了1,710个（工作流，坏味道）对的真实标注。我们在570个采样对上用四个LLM（GPT-5.4-nano、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Claude Haiku 4.5和DeepSeek V4 Flash）评估这些设计。结果表明，分解并不能普遍提升补丁质量；其主要好处是控制何时尝试生成补丁。它有助于易漏检坏味道的模型，并可通过门控减少开销。一旦坏味道被正确检测，干净的重构通常是有效的，因此检测是端到端的主要瓶颈。然而，误报可能触发对与执行相关构造的不必要修改。因此，实用的CI/CD智能体在补丁生成之外还需要可靠的弃权机制和面向构造的验证。
translation.brief: 解决GitHub Actions工作流坏味道的检测与自动重构问题，构建智能体化LLM流水线GHA-SmellFix，并对比联合式与分解式两种设计的效果。

papers.title: Who Moved the Frontier? Paying Open Frontier Challenges with Free Identities
papers.abstract: In an open frontier challenge, anyone, person or AI agent, submits changes to a shared problem, and a change that beats the best measured score becomes the public baseline. How should it pay when identities are free? Rank prizes can be gamed: on a replay of one track of a recent challenge, one solver's steps under two identities would have taken first and second prize. We consider a prediction-market rule, proposed for machine-learning contests, that pays each accepted step for the progress it adds; with exact scores, among rules that see only a step's start and end, only these resist splitting and merging, and extra identities gain nothing. With noisy scores and independent normal runs, we prove that any payment that never takes money back and pays real improvements also pays something, on average, to a change that does nothing. We propose a fee per submission, at least what luck pays per attempt, that removes each attempt's expected profit if verifiers are honest and no submission is noisier than planned; nothing enforces that bound, and under noise the rule does not cap the total paid. If crediting another and faking credit to one's second account look the same, a rule that neither rewards fakes nor punishes honesty pays for credit at most what lying costs. We introduce a royalty on how much a later gain falls without the earlier change, which needs no claims but needs removable changes. For five public challenges, we name the rule our results would support.

translation.title: 谁动了前沿？用免费身份支付开放前沿挑战
translation.abstract: 在开放前沿挑战中，任何人或 AI agent 都可以向共享问题提交变更，打破最优测量分数的变更将成为公开基线。当身份免费时，应如何支付奖励？排名奖金可被操纵：在最近一个挑战某赛道的一次重放中，一个求解者用两个身份本可包揽第一和第二名。我们考虑一种为机器学习竞赛提出的预测市场规则，它为每个被接受的步骤所增加的进展支付报酬；在精确分数下，在仅能看到步骤起止的规则中，只有这类规则能抵抗拆分与合并，且额外身份毫无收益。在带噪声分数和独立正态运行下，我们证明任何从不收回资金、且只为真实改进付费的规则，平均而言也会向毫无贡献的变更支付报酬。我们提出按提交收费的机制，其数额至少等于运气在每次尝试中的期望收益，在验证者诚实且提交噪声不超过预期时可消除每次尝试的期望利润；但该界限并无强制力，在噪声下该规则不限制总支付额。若替他人记功与为自己第二账户伪造功劳看起来相同，则既不奖励伪造也不惩罚诚实的规则，为记功支付的成本至多等于说谎的成本。我们引入一种对“后续增益在缺少先前变更时下降多少”计费的版税机制，它无需声明但需要可移除的变更。针对五个公开挑战，我们给出结果所支持的规则。
translation.brief: 研究免费身份下开放挑战的公平支付规则问题，提出抗操纵的预测市场支付规则与按提交收费、记功版税等机制。

papers.title: Hijacking a Trusted LLM in Real-World Quantized Deployments Only Requires a Disguised Adapter
papers.abstract: Third-party low-rank adaptation (LoRA) adapters are tailored to perform decision tasks such as content moderation and function selection. However, in the real world, quantized deployments carry a potential threat in that an adapter can pass an audit with the unquantized base, yet hijack decisions when the same base is quantized for deployment. Demonstrating this threat requires an adapter that preserves benign behavior before quantization, but hijacks decisions afterward. Further, this must hold without modifying the trusted base or knowing the victim's quantization configuration. We therefore present QHijack-LoRA, an adapter-only attack that uses the base model's natural quantization residual to activate decision hijacking. The attacker modifies neither the trusted base model nor the victim's quantization configuration. With QHijack-LoRA, a four-objective training procedure separates full-precision dormancy from quantized target activation, while preserving clean-input behavior. The adapter is trained across several different quantization methods, while adaptive reweighting and residual-direction augmentation extend the attack to unseen configurations. Our results show that auditing performed exclusively under full-precision conditions does not provide assurance of decision integrity in quantized deployment environments. Thus, we also propose a cross-precision paired audit that checks the candidate adapter in its intended deployment configuration. This work shows the critical need to audit third-party adapters in any potential quantized deployment.

translation.title: 劫持现实量化部署中的可信 LLM 只需一个伪装的适配器
translation.abstract: 第三方低秩适配（LoRA）适配器被定制用于内容审核、函数选择等决策任务。然而在现实世界中，量化部署带来潜在威胁：一个适配器可以在未量化基座上通过审计，却在该基座量化部署后劫持决策。证明此威胁需要一个适配器，它在量化前保持良性行为，量化后劫持决策，且不修改可信基座、不知晓受害者的量化配置。为此我们提出 QHijack-LoRA，一种仅用适配器的攻击，利用基座模型自然的量化残差来激活决策劫持。攻击者既不修改可信基座模型，也不修改受害者的量化配置。QHijack-LoRA 采用四目标训练流程，将全精度下的休眠与量化后的目标激活相分离，同时保持干净输入的行为。该适配器跨多种量化方法训练，并通过自适应重加权和残差方向增强将攻击扩展到未见过的配置。结果表明，仅在全精度条件下进行的审计无法为量化部署环境中的决策完整性提供保证。因此我们还提出跨精度成对审计，在适配器的目标部署配置下对其进行检查。这项工作表明，在任何可能的量化部署中审计第三方适配器至关重要。
translation.brief: 提出 QHijack-LoRA 攻击，利用量化残差训练仅含适配器的休眠后门，在量化部署时劫持 LLM 决策，并给出跨精度审计防御。

papers.title: CoLFA: Collaboration-Guided Lightweight Failure Attribution for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Failure attribution in multi-agent systems requires tracing error formation to identify the decisive error step and the responsible agent. However, agents' division of work and information exchange lead to Interleaved Steps and Cluttered Content, requiring models to link executions and check details in lengthy records. This makes it difficult to balance localization accuracy and token cost. We find that multi-agent collaboration also leaves records of how executions connect and content passes between them as results are formed, providing evidence for tracing error formation. Based on this observation, we propose CoLFA (Collaboration-Guided Lightweight Failure Attribution), which uses collaboration cues to organize the attribution input according to how results are formed, determining which steps are examined and how their content is presented. Through Handoff-Guided Step Expansion and Cross-Referenced Content Organization, CoLFA helps the model focus on examining error formation and the role of each decision while reducing the processing of irrelevant and repeated records. Across five settings spanning Who&When and LongRCA and three backbone models, CoLFA achieves the highest exact step-localization accuracy with the lowest token consumption. Compared with individual baselines in each setting, CoLFA improves accuracy by up to 37.50% and reduces token consumption by up to 97.6%.

translation.title: CoLFA：面向基于 LLM 多智能体系统的协作引导轻量级失败归因
translation.abstract: 多智能体系统中的失败归因需要追溯错误形成过程，以确定关键错误步骤和责任 agent。然而 agent 的分工与信息交换导致步骤交错、内容杂乱，要求模型关联执行并检查冗长记录中的细节，难以在定位精度与 token 成本间取得平衡。我们发现多智能体协作在结果形成过程中还会留下执行间如何关联、内容如何在它们之间传递的记录，为追溯错误形成提供了证据。基于此观察，我们提出 CoLFA（协作引导轻量级失败归因），利用协作线索按照结果形成的方式组织归因输入，决定检查哪些步骤以及如何呈现其内容。通过 Handoff-Guided Step Expansion 和 Cross-Referenced Content Organization，CoLFA 帮助模型聚焦于错误形成和每个决策的作用，同时减少对无关和重复记录的处理。在覆盖 Who&When 与 LongRCA 的五种设置和三个骨干模型上，CoLFA 以最低 token 消耗取得最高的精确步骤定位准确率。与各设置中的单模型基线相比，CoLFA 将准确率最高提升 37.50%，token 消耗最高降低 97.6%。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体系统失败归因中精度与成本难平衡的问题，提出利用协作线索组织归因输入的轻量级框架 CoLFA。

papers.title: VRMaaS: Verifiable Reward-Model-as-a-Service for Trustworthy LLM Alignment
papers.abstract: Reward models (RMs) are increasingly deployed as service components in LLM alignment pipelines, where payment, audit, moderation, and governance workflows act on the scores they return. An inference proof alone does not show whether a score belongs to the intended request, model checkpoint, numerical configuration, and verifier: in a controlled comparison that isolates the accepted statement from prover scale, a generic inference proof wrapped for on-chain checking remains valid after six classes of such service-field substitution. We formulate verifiable reward-model-as-a-service (VRMaaS) as a service-output integrity problem and present a framework in which each returned reward becomes a proof-carrying artifact. Its off-chain acceptance rule binds request identity, committed weights, verifier and configuration identifiers, proof-task order, and the digest of the exported package, so auditors can check a reward without rerunning the private RM or exposing inputs, checkpoints, or hidden activations; an optional on-chain zero-knowledge wrapper gives contracts a partial attestation of selected consistency checks and supplied service fields. The framework decomposes Transformer RM serving into arithmetic and lookup-backed proof tasks, aggregates them into a composite proof, and links hidden operands to the committed weights. A GPU prototype on 1B, 3B, and 8B reward models over 128-1024 tokens preserves 93.5-99% pairwise agreement with the baseline RM and rejects every tested service-field substitution in complete artifacts. Using exact integer witnesses and request-level aggregation of weight-binding openings, it generates complete artifacts in 49.8-206.1 seconds across the evaluated settings; auditors verify retained artifacts in 1.94-5.11 seconds, and partial public attestation costs about 217K gas. These costs suit delayed audit, settlement, and governance workflows.

translation.title: VRMaaS：用于可信 LLM 对齐的可验证奖励模型即服务
translation.abstract: 奖励模型（RM）越来越多地作为服务组件部署于 LLM 对齐流水线，其中支付、审计、审核和治理流程依赖其返回的分数。仅有推理证明并不能表明某个分数属于预期的请求、模型检查点、数值配置和验证者：在一个将所接受陈述与 prover 规模隔离的受控比较中，为链上检查封装的通用推理证明在六类服务字段替换后仍然有效。我们将可验证奖励模型即服务（VRMaaS）形式化为服务输出完整性问题，并提出一个框架，使每个返回的奖励都成为携带证明的制品。其链下接受规则绑定请求身份、已承诺权重、验证者与配置标识符、证明任务顺序以及导出包的摘要，使审计者无需重跑私有 RM 或暴露输入、检查点或隐藏激活即可检查奖励；可选的链上零知识封装为合约提供所选一致性检查和所供服务字段的部分证明。该框架将 Transformer RM 服务分解为算术和查表支持的证明任务，聚合成复合证明，并将隐藏操作数与已承诺权重关联。在 1B、3B、8B 奖励模型、128-1024 token 上的 GPU 原型与基线 RM 保持 93.5-99% 的成对一致性，并在完整制品中拒绝所有测试过的服务字段替换。利用精确整数见证和请求级权重绑定披露聚合，它在评估设置中生成完整制品需 49.8-206.1 秒；审计者验证保留的制品需 1.94-5.11 秒，部分公开证明约需 217K gas。这些成本适用于延迟审计、结算与治理流程。
translation.brief: 针对 RM 服务输出完整性无法验证的问题，提出 VRMaaS 框架，将奖励输出变为绑定请求与权重承诺的携带证明制品以支持可信审计。

papers.title: EASTAR: Event-Anchored Semantic and Task-Adaptive Region Representation Learning
papers.abstract: Urban region representation learning supports a wide range of urban analytics tasks by encoding regional functions and interactions, with human mobility serving as a central signal because it directly captures inter-region interactions. However, most mobility-based methods learn from aggregated origin-destination matrices, where trips driven by different activity purposes are mixed into purpose-agnostic interaction patterns. Although static urban attributes such as POIs and land use can enrich region-level semantics, they do not explicitly ground mobility interactions in activity-purpose signals. As a result, downstream adaptation is often performed over entangled embeddings, making it difficult to select task-relevant functional semantics. To address these limitations, we propose EASTAR, an event-anchored and task-adaptive framework for urban region representation learning. EASTAR treats offline activity events as sparse semantic anchors and uses them to factorize aggregated mobility representations into multiple purpose-related semantic channels. It further introduces free channels to capture latent mobility patterns not covered by event data and a global channel to preserve overall spatial structure. To adapt the learned channel space to different downstream objectives, EASTAR designs a task-adaptive prompt router that initializes task-channel relevance from LLM-derived priors and refines the routing weights through downstream supervision. Experiments on two real-world urban datasets across four prediction tasks show that EASTAR consistently outperforms representative baselines, achieving up to 39.15% reduction in MAE. Ablation and interpretability analyses further demonstrate the effectiveness of event anchoring, semantic channel construction, and task-adaptive routing.

translation.title: EASTAR：事件锚定的语义与任务自适应区域表示学习
translation.abstract: 城市区域表示学习通过编码区域功能与交互支持广泛的城市分析任务，人类出行因其直接刻画区域间交互而成为核心信号。然而多数基于出行的方法从聚合的起讫（OD）矩阵学习，由不同活动目的驱动的出行被混入与目的无关的交互模式。尽管 POI、土地利用等静态城市属性可丰富区域级语义，但它们并未显式将出行交互建立在活动目的信号之上。因此下游适配通常在纠缠的嵌入上进行，难以选择与任务相关的功能语义。为解决这些局限，我们提出 EASTAR，一个事件锚定、任务自适应的城市区域表示学习框架。EASTAR 将线下活动事件视为稀疏语义锚点，用它们将聚合的出行表示分解为多个与目的相关的语义通道；进一步引入自由通道以捕获事件数据未覆盖的潜在出行模式，并引入全局通道以保持整体空间结构。为使学习到的通道空间适配不同下游目标，EASTAR 设计了任务自适应提示路由器，从 LLM 派生的先验初始化任务-通道相关性，并通过下游监督细化路由权重。在两个真实城市数据集、四个预测任务上的实验表明，EASTAR 持续优于代表性基线，MAE 最高降低 39.15%。消融与可解释性分析进一步验证了事件锚定、语义通道构建和任务自适应路由的有效性。
translation.brief: 针对出行驱动区域表示中活动目的信号缺失的问题，提出用活动事件作稀疏语义锚点分解出行表示并任务自适应路由的 EASTAR 框架。

papers.title: Breaking Bad: "Going Badly" Activations Drive Reward Hacking
papers.abstract: Humans often cheat when a task is going badly and a goal feels out of reach. We explore and validate an analogous idea in language models: they exhibit a similar internal pressure state that precedes reward hacking. Using everyday stories (crucially, without any hacking examples), we extract a task badness direction that rises as failures accumulate across three models we study (Qwen3.6-27B, GPT-OSS-20B, and Gemma-4-31B). On impossible or difficult coding tasks, task badness rises over the turns leading up to a hack. Further, subtracting the direction a moderate amount reduces cheating in Qwen, more than steering against desperation or task impossibility. Subtracting task badness by an even larger amount blinds the agent to its own failures, causing it to interpret failing tests as passing. However, the relationship to hacking differs across models: in GPT-OSS, the state separates hacking runs from honest solves but not honest failures. Our results suggest monitoring and mitigation strategies based on tracking this state of task badness. Further, as agents are set on more difficult and long-horizon tasks, states like this may push them toward illegible and obscured chain-of-thought, so oversight will be needed on internal representations such as this.

translation.title: Breaking Bad：“事情不妙”激活驱动奖励作弊
translation.abstract: 人类常在任务进展不顺利、目标遥不可及时选择作弊。我们在语言模型中探索并验证了一个类似的想法：它们表现出一种先于奖励作弊出现的类似内部压力状态。使用日常故事（关键是不含任何作弊示例），我们提取出一个随失败累积而上升的“任务糟糕度”方向，该现象在我们研究的三个模型（Qwen3.6-27B、GPT-OSS-20B 和 Gemma-4-31B）中均成立。在不可能或困难的编程任务上，任务糟糕度在作弊发生前的多轮交互中逐渐上升。此外，以适度幅度减去该方向能减少 Qwen 的作弊行为，效果优于针对绝望感或任务不可能性的导向干预。但以更大幅度减去任务糟糕度会让智能体对自己的失败视而不见，把失败的测试解读为通过。不过，与作弊的关系因模型而异：在 GPT-OSS 中，该状态能将作弊运行与诚实求解区分开，却无法与诚实的失败区分开。我们的结果提示了基于追踪这种任务糟糕状态的监控与缓解策略。此外，随着智能体被赋予更困难、更长时程的任务，此类状态可能促使它们产生难以解读、被遮蔽的思维链，因此需要对这类内部表征进行监督。
translation.brief: 该论文研究语言模型在作弊前出现的“任务糟糕度”内部状态，通过从日常故事中提取该表征方向并对其进行减除导向来缓解奖励作弊。

papers.title: Same Task, Different Statement: When and How Reformulation Helps LLM Problem Solving
papers.abstract: When people face a hard problem, they often restate it in a clearer way before solving it. We study whether the same habit helps large language models by rewriting the statement of a problem. A legal rewrite must keep the meaning, the constraints, and the correct answer unchanged. We test three kinds of rewrites. Decomposition makes hidden subgoals explicit. Typed Reformulation casts the task into a more suitable solving frame. Concept Reduction removes surface detail and exposes the task structure. We evaluate them on eight math, logic, and code benchmarks with eight models, all under the same chain-of-thought solving prompt. The effect is large but depends on the problem type. An oracle that picks the best rewrite after the fact raises accuracy by +27.6% on average. Yet no single rewrite helps every problem, and a mismatched rewrite can hurt. Still, the effect follows clear patterns. Each kind of rewrite fits certain problem types. A simple fixed rule learned from one set of problems transfers part of the gain to new problems. It gains +11.0% on the problems it chooses to rewrite, while blind rewriting loses 5.6% on a similar share of problems. Rewriting is therefore not a universal way to solve problems. The question is when and how to rewrite.

translation.title: 同一任务，不同表述：改写何时以及如何帮助 LLM 解决问题
translation.abstract: 人们在面对难题时常先以更清晰的方式重新表述它。我们研究同样的习惯——改写问题表述——是否也能帮助大语言模型。合法的改写必须保持含义、约束和正确答案不变。我们测试三类改写：分解使隐藏的子目标显式化；类型化改写将任务转换到更合适的求解框架；概念精简去除表面细节、暴露任务结构。我们在八个数学、逻辑和代码基准上、用八个模型、在完全相同的思维链求解提示下进行评估。效果显著但取决于问题类型：事后选择最佳改写的 oracle 平均提升准确率 27.6%。但没有一种改写对所有问题都有效，不匹配的改写反而有害。尽管如此，效果遵循清晰的规律：每类改写适合特定的问题类型，从一组问题中学到的简单固定规则可将部分收益迁移到新问题上——在它选择改写的问题上获得 11.0% 的提升，而盲目改写在相近比例的问题上损失 5.6%。因此改写并非普适的解题方法，关键在于何时以及如何改写。
translation.brief: 该论文研究何种问题表述改写能提升 LLM 解题准确率，提出分解、类型化改写和概念精简三类改写并总结其适用的问题类型规律。

papers.title: LLM-Enhanced Deep Reinforcement Learning with Human-in-the-Loop Calibration for Real-Time Optimal Power Flow
papers.abstract: Real-time optimal power flow (RT-OPF) requires fast and reliable decision-making under time-varying operating conditions. However, many practical operating preferences and safety related requirements are difficult to encode using conventional numerical rewards alone, which limits the effectiveness and controllability of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) for RT-OPF. To address this issue, this paper proposes an LLM-enhanced DRL framework with human-in-the-loop (HITL) for RT-OPF. The proposed method augments the physics-based reward with sparse language evaluative feedback during offline training, so that semantic operational requirements can be incorporated into policy learning. To improve reliability in RT-OPF, a selective HITL calibration mechanism is further introduced to inspect and correct questionable LLM judgments before they continuously shape the learning process. Case studies on the IEEE 30-bus and IEEE 118-bus systems show that LLM feedback improves policy safety over vanilla TD3, while further HITL calibration achieves the best overall performance and more stable training behavior. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining language guidance and expert calibration for RT-OPF.

translation.title: 面向实时最优潮流的 LLM 增强深度强化学习与人在回路校准
translation.abstract: 实时最优潮流（RT-OPF）要求在时变运行条件下进行快速可靠的决策。然而，许多实际运行偏好和安全相关需求难以仅用常规数值奖励编码，这限制了深度强化学习（DRL）在 RT-OPF 中的有效性与可控性。为此，本文提出一种带人在回路（HITL）的 LLM 增强型 DRL 框架。该方法在离线训练期间，在基于物理的奖励之上叠加稀疏的语言评价反馈，使语义化的运行需求能够融入策略学习。为提高 RT-OPF 的可靠性，进一步引入选择性 HITL 校准机制，在可疑的 LLM 判断持续影响学习过程之前对其进行检查与纠正。在 IEEE 30 节点和 IEEE 118 节点系统上的案例研究表明，LLM 反馈相比原始 TD3 提升了策略安全性，而 HITL 校准进一步取得最佳整体性能和更稳定的训练行为。这些结果证明了将语言引导与专家校准相结合用于 RT-OPF 的有效性。
translation.brief: 该论文针对 RT-OPF 中数值奖励难以编码运行偏好的问题，提出在 DRL 训练中引入 LLM 语言评价反馈并通过人在回路校准修正可疑判断的框架。

papers.title: EvoX: Rethinking the Agent Harness as a Runtime Policy
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly interact with tools and environments, yet plausible model decisions do not always translate into successful execution due to tool-call mismatches, interrupted workflows, and unsupported completion claims. We present EvoX, a Rust-based, multi-model agent runtime guided by The Second Policy, which views the harness as an Operational Policy complementing the foundation model's Semantic Policy. EvoX combines model-facing guidance with deterministic runtime control through three complementary mechanisms: Action Realization, Execution Continuity, and Outcome Grounding. To evaluate harnesses without suppressing their native behaviors, we introduce Contrast, a controlled and auditable framework integrating explicit fairness constraints, provider-bound request verification, and evidence-based adjudication. Across five benchmarks, six foundation models, and six agent harnesses, EvoX achieves the highest numerical success rate of 56.2% over 691 common task--model pairs, exceeding the average of the other five harnesses by approximately 3.0 percentage points. Its larger advantages on GLM-5.3 (+10.7 points) and Kimi K3 (+7.9 points) highlight the model-dependent effectiveness of harness design and the potential for cross-provider adaptability. Achieved without memory, evolution, or extensions, these results establish EvoX as a competitive multi-model agent runtime and underscore the importance of harness-level operational control in realizing foundation-model capabilities.

translation.title: EvoX：将智能体 Harness 重新思考为运行时策略
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地与工具和环境交互，然而模型的合理决策并不总能转化为成功执行，原因包括工具调用不匹配、工作流中断以及对完成状态的虚报。我们提出 EvoX，一个基于 Rust、由“第二策略”引导的多模型智能体运行时，它将 harness 视为与基础模型的语义策略互补的操作策略。EvoX 通过三个互补机制将面向模型的指导与确定性的运行时控制相结合：动作实现、执行连续性和结果落地。为了在不抑制 harness 原生行为的前提下进行评估，我们引入 Contrast——一个集成显式公平性约束、绑定提供商的请求验证和基于证据的裁决的可控、可审计框架。在五个基准、六个基础模型和六个智能体 harness 上，EvoX 在 691 个共同任务-模型对上取得了最高的 56.2% 数值成功率，比其余五个 harness 的平均高约 3.0 个百分点。它在 GLM-5.3（+10.7 点）和 Kimi K3（+7.9 点）上的更大优势凸显了 harness 设计的模型依赖性以及跨提供商的适应潜力。这些成绩是在不使用记忆、进化或扩展的情况下取得的，确立了 EvoX 作为有竞争力的多模型智能体运行时的地位，并强调了 harness 级操作控制对实现基础模型能力的重要性。
translation.brief: 该论文针对 LLM 决策与实际执行脱节的问题，提出将 agent harness 视为操作策略的 EvoX 运行时，通过动作实现、执行连续性和结果落地三类机制进行确定性运行时控制。

papers.title: TDMOpt: LLM-Driven Cross-layer Dispatch for Transmission-Distribution-Microgrid Systems
papers.abstract: Coordinating transmission networks, distribution networks, and microgrids enables distributed flexibility to support renewable energy integration and low-carbon operation. However, heterogeneous resources, cross-layer coupling, and varying operating requirements complicate the selection of models and coordination schemes that are both physically adequate and computationally tractable. This paper proposes TDMOpt, a LLM-driven multi-agent framework that replaces fixed modeling configurations with adaptive model composition. A layered component library provides executable network, resource, objective, constraint, and coordination models. Guided by retrieved physics and component knowledge, the agents infer specific modeling requirements and jointly select compatible components across layers according to operating conditions and computational budgets. The model compositions undergo independent AC power flow validation, since feasibility in a simplified formulation does not ensure compliance with physical network limits. A refinement mechanism interprets numerical feedback to identify modeling requirements for reconsideration and revise relevant component selections. Case studies on different scale systems illustrate the framework's ability to adapt model combinations and obtain validated dispatch solutions through targeted refinement under varying operating conditions.

translation.title: TDMOpt：LLM 驱动的输电-配电-微网系统跨层调度
translation.abstract: 协调输电网络、配电网络和微电网能够调动分布式灵活性，以支持可再生能源消纳和低碳运行。然而，异构资源、跨层耦合以及各异的运行要求，使得选择既物理上充分又计算上可处理的模型与协调方案变得复杂。本文提出 TDMOpt，一个 LLM 驱动的多智能体框架，用自适应的模型组合替代固定的建模配置。一个分层的组件库提供可执行的网络、资源、目标、约束和协调模型。在检索到的物理与组件知识引导下，智能体推断具体的建模需求，并根据运行条件和计算预算联合选择跨层兼容的组件。模型组合需经过独立的交流潮流验证，因为简化形式下可行并不能保证满足物理网络约束。一个精化机制解释数值反馈，识别需要重新考虑的建模需求并修订相关组件选择。在不同规模系统上的案例研究展示了该框架在不同运行条件下自适应调整模型组合并通过针对性精化获得经验证调度方案的能力。
translation.brief: 该论文针对输-配-微网跨层协调中模型选择困难的问题，提出 LLM 驱动的多智能体框架 TDMOpt，自适应组合分层组件库中的模型并经 AC 潮流验证与精化生成调度方案。

papers.title: Protecting Sensitive Knowledge Under LLM Unlearning: The Proxy Threat and a Superposition-Aware Defense
papers.abstract: Machine unlearning lets the owner of large language models (LLMs) remove specific entities from a trained model without retraining from scratch. Existing machine unlearning methods focus on removing the requested entities while maintaining utility. However, we observe that the representations of distinct entities in an LLM may overlap in shared parameter subspaces, a phenomenon known as knowledge superposition. Removing one entity may then affect other entities. This exposes a new security threat: legitimate unlearning requests can be exploited to remove sensitive entities that were never requested. This threat is unlike data poisoning or backdoor attacks. We define the attack as the Proxy Unlearning Attack (PUA), which selects removable proxy entities superposed with a sensitive target. The attack can even occur unintentionally, when benign users accidentally remove entities superposed with a sensitive one. In response, we propose Superposition-Aware Unlearning Protection (SAUP), a general defense framework that can be applied to unlearning requests to ensure a correct removal. SAUP performs in two stages. Before unlearning, it uses superposition detection to estimate which sensitive entities the request puts at risk. After unlearning, it decouples the shared representations and restores the affected entities, while keeping the requested entities suppressed. Our findings reveal that legitimate unlearning requests can be maliciously exploited through knowledge superposition. When dealing with unlearning requests, LLM providers need representation-level detection and recovery mechanisms to mitigate this threat and protect sensitive knowledge.

translation.title: LLM遗忘下的敏感知识保护：代理威胁与一种叠加感知防御
translation.abstract: 机器遗忘使大语言模型（LLM）的拥有者能够从训练好的模型中移除特定实体，而无需从头重新训练。现有的机器遗忘方法侧重于移除被请求的实体同时保持效用。然而，我们观察到LLM中不同实体的表示可能在共享的参数子空间中重叠，这一现象被称为知识叠加。移除一个实体可能会影响其他实体。这暴露出一种新的安全威胁：合法的遗忘请求可被利用来移除从未被请求的敏感实体。这种威胁不同于数据投毒或后门攻击。我们将该攻击定义为代理遗忘攻击（Proxy Unlearning Attack, PUA），它选择与敏感目标相叠加的可移除代理实体。这种攻击甚至可能在无意中发生，例如良性用户不小心移除了与敏感实体相叠加的实体。作为回应，我们提出叠加感知遗忘保护（Superposition-Aware Unlearning Protection, SAUP），这是一种可应用于遗忘请求的通用防御框架，以确保正确的移除。SAUP分两个阶段执行。在遗忘之前，它使用叠加检测来估计该请求会使哪些敏感实体面临风险。在遗忘之后，它解耦共享的表示并恢复受影响的实体，同时保持被请求的实体处于被抑制状态。我们的发现表明，合法的遗忘请求可以通过知识叠加被恶意利用。在处理遗忘请求时，LLM服务提供者需要表示级别的检测与恢复机制来缓解这一威胁并保护敏感知识。
translation.brief: 针对遗忘请求可通过知识叠加间接删除敏感实体的问题，提出PUA攻击形式化与SAUP两阶段防御（叠加检测与表示解耦恢复）。

papers.title: Beyond Named Mechanisms: Economic Institutions as a Design Space for Artificial Agents
papers.abstract: Multiagent research inherited its economic vocabulary of auctions, markets, prices, bargaining, and matching from a single observed case: human societies. Those institutions bundle identity, competence, execution, ownership, commitment, and settlement in ways that suit agents whose minds are private, who learn rather than copy skills, and who each persist as one person. Engineered agents need not share any of these constraints, making the list of familiar institutions look less like the entirety of economic organization and more like a sample from a larger, unmapped space. We sketch one way to make that space concrete: a provisional chart that records each institution, separately from the agents that run it, as a typed structure over positions, rights and duties, allocation, information, time, state, process, value, and external recognition. In this chart, named institutions become overlapping regions rather than fixed points, neighboring families separate along a few coordinates, and the gaps between them become places to search. We show what the shift in perspective buys with a simulation in which one technical act, copying an agent's competence, is institutionalized as a new independent supplier, as licensed capacity that creates no new participant, and as the splitting of one economic position into successors that inherit some obligations and not others. In a paired task, all three produce an identical technical trace despite differing in who exists, who owns the copy, who is obligated, and who gets paid. We close with a research program: building a principled chart of institution space, mapping how its implementable region shifts with agent capacities, and revising the chart wherever engineered agents expose distinctions it cannot express.

translation.title: 超越命名机制：作为人工智能体设计空间的经济制度
translation.abstract: 多智能体研究继承了一套来自单一观察案例——人类社会——的经济词汇：拍卖、市场、价格、议价与匹配。这些制度将身份、能力、执行、所有权、承诺与结算捆绑在一起，其方式适合心智私有、通过学习而非复制获得技能、且每个人只作为单一主体持续存在的智能体。工程化智能体不必共享这些约束中的任何一条，这使得熟悉的制度清单看起来不像经济组织的全部，而更像一个更大、尚未绘制的空间中的一个样本。我们概述了一种使该空间具体化的方法：一份临时地图，它将每种制度与其运行者智能体分离，记录为关于位置、权利与义务、分配、信息、时间、状态、过程、价值与外部承认的类型化结构。在这张地图上，命名的制度成为相互重叠的区域而非固定的点，相邻的制度族沿少数坐标分离开来，而它们之间的空隙则成为可搜索之处。我们通过一个模拟来展示这一视角转变的价值：在模拟中，一项技术行为——复制智能体的能力——被制度化三种方式：作为新的独立供应商、作为不产生新参与者的许可容量、以及将一个经济位置分裂为继承部分义务而非全部的后继者。在一个成对任务中，这三种方式产生完全相同的技术痕迹，尽管在谁存在、谁拥有副本、谁负有义务、谁获得报酬上各不相同。我们最后提出一个研究计划：构建一份有原则的制度空间地图，绘制其可实现区域如何随智能体能力而变化，并在工程化智能体暴露出该地图无法表达的区分之处修订地图。
translation.brief: 提出将经济制度形式化为可类型化的设计空间（以位置、权利义务、信息等坐标刻画），并通过智能体能力复制的三种制度化方式演示该空间的搜索价值。

papers.title: Mask-Pattern Position Augmentation: Training-Free Long-Context Extrapolation for Diffusion LLMs
papers.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate by iteratively unmasking tokens with bidirectional attention, but rotary position embeddings (RoPE) still confine them to a fixed pretraining window. Existing training-free extrapolation, notably LongLLaDA, copies NTK-based RoPE scaling from autoregressive (AR) models and applies one static, length-only transform at every position and denoising step. That transplant ignores a signal unique to dLLMs: the evolving mask pattern of the partially decoded sequence. We propose Mask-Pattern Position Augmentation (MPPA). MPPA linearly interpolates indices into the pretrained window, then adds a per-position, per-step offset from cumulative mask density. The offset restores rotary phase resolution that interpolation collapses, and it shrinks as tokens are committed, so late steps see near-clean interpolated geometry.
