On LLaDA-8B-Instruct at twice its 4096-token window, MPPA reduces perplexity from 19.51 under standard decoding to 3.12 at 8192 tokens, below the in-window figure, with 100% passkey retrieval and unchanged needle-in-a-haystack accuracy. These preliminary $2\times$ results motivate mask-conditioned position engineering as a diffusion-native path to long-context generation.

translation.title: 掩码模式位置增强：面向扩散大语言模型的无训练长上下文外推
translation.abstract: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）通过双向注意力迭代地解除token掩码来生成文本，但旋转位置编码（RoPE）仍将其限制在固定的预训练窗口内。现有的无训练外推方法，尤其是LongLLaDA，从自回归（AR）模型移植基于NTK的RoPE缩放，在每个位置和每个去噪步骤应用一种仅依赖长度的静态变换。这种移植忽略了dLLM独有的信号：部分解码序列不断演化的掩码模式。我们提出掩码模式位置增强（Mask-Pattern Position Augmentation, MPPA）。MPPA通过线性插值将索引映射到预训练窗口内，然后根据累计掩码密度为每个位置、每个步骤添加偏移量。该偏移恢复了插值所压缩的旋转相位分辨率，并随着token被确定而缩小，因此后期步骤可看到接近干净的插值几何结构。在LLaDA-8B-Instruct上于其4096-token窗口两倍长度处，MPPA将8192 tokens下的困惑度从标准解码的19.51降至3.12，低于窗口内的数值，同时实现100%的passkey检索和不变的needle-in-a-haystack准确率。这些初步的2倍外推结果表明，基于掩码条件的位置工程是扩散模型通往长上下文生成的一条原生路径。
translation.brief: 针对dLLM长上下文外推问题，提出无训练的MPPA，依据累计掩码密度为每个位置和去噪步骤动态添加RoPE偏移以恢复旋转相位分辨率。

papers.title: Science Prediction Universe
papers.abstract: Humanity has long sought to explain natural phenomena. Reliable prediction of experimental outcomes is a central test of our understanding of the processes that produce them. If artificial general intelligence (AGI) is to surpass human scientific capabilities, it must also predict experimental outcomes more reliably than humans. Such capabilities could accelerate scientific discovery across disciplines, help address humanity's most pressing challenges, and improve human well-being. We introduce Science Prediction Universe (SPU), a benchmark of hidden experimental outcomes with 100 public verified tasks from chemistry, materials science, biology and medicine, and 16 private tasks from unpublished wet-lab experiments. Given an experimental setup and candidate conditions, an agent works with any resources it needs to rank the candidates by a measured outcome. We evaluate thirteen agent configurations spanning twelve frontier models across two harnesses (Codex and Claude Code). Current agents remain far from saturating wet-lab outcome prediction, with substantial performance disparities across models: on the public benchmark, configurations separate into two distinct tiers, with task-adjusted Spearman correlations ranging from 0.227 for the lowest-performing configuration to 0.478 for the best. Analysis of 1,155 scored public trajectories (227,103 tool calls) suggests that the bottleneck lies in scientific judgment rather than tool execution: agents rely on shared monotone priors, agreeing far more with one another than with experimental reality (0.52 vs. 0.33), and frequently compute trivial physical or chemical proxies that do not influence the final outcome.

translation.title: Science Prediction Universe
translation.abstract: 人类长期以来一直致力于解释自然现象。对实验结果的可靠预测是检验我们对产生这些结果过程理解程度的核心标准。如果通用人工智能（AGI）要超越人类的科学能力，它也必须比人类更可靠地预测实验结果。这种能力可以加速跨学科的科学发现，帮助应对人类最紧迫的挑战，并改善人类福祉。我们提出Science Prediction Universe（SPU），这是一个包含隐藏实验结果的基准，包含来自化学、材料科学、生物和医学的100个公开已验证任务，以及来自未发表湿实验室实验的16个私密任务。给定一个实验设置和候选条件，智能体可使用其所需的任何资源，按测量结果对候选条件进行排序。我们评估了十三种智能体配置，涵盖十二个前沿模型和两种框架（Codex和Claude Code）。当前智能体远未达到湿实验室结果预测的饱和水平，且各模型间存在显著的性能差距：在公开基准上，各配置分成两个明显梯队，任务调整后的Spearman相关系数从最低配置的0.227到最佳配置的0.478不等。对1155条已评分公开轨迹（227,103次工具调用）的分析表明，瓶颈在于科学判断而非工具执行：智能体依赖共享的单调先验，彼此之间的一致性远高于与实验现实的一致性（0.52对0.33），并且经常计算不会影响最终结果的简单物理或化学代理指标。
translation.brief: 构建了基于真实隐藏实验结果的科学预测基准SPU，用于评估智能体排序实验候选条件的能力并诊断其瓶颈所在。

papers.title: FIBER: Bayesian Fusion of Fast-DetectGPT and IRT-Informed Detector Evidence for LLM-Generated Text Detection
papers.abstract: Detecting large language model (LLM)-generated text remains challenging under domain and generator shifts. Supervised detectors may generalize poorly, while zero-shot methods often rely on individual statistical signals without leveraging historical detector behavior. We propose FIBER (Fast-DetectGPT with IRT-informed Bayesian Evidence Recalibration), which integrates continuous Fast-DetectGPT scores with auxiliary detector outputs through Bayesian evidence fusion. Item response theory (IRT) models historical detector-correctness patterns, providing class-conditional detector-output likelihoods through marginalization over latent text representations. These likelihoods are combined with Fast-DetectGPT score densities and a historical class prior for prediction. When historical Fast-DetectGPT scores are unavailable, a variant called FIBER-Stream estimates class-specific score distributions from an unlabeled batch. On a 32,000-text multi-domain benchmark, FIBER achieves the highest accuracy (0.620) and improves mean AUC over Fast-DetectGPT (0.664 versus 0.600) under five-fold cross-validation. FIBER also consistently improves AUC across four individual domains. Under out-of-distribution transfer, FIBER-Stream achieved an AUC of 0.911, compared with 0.889 for FIBER and 0.922 for Fast-DetectGPT alone. These results demonstrate the potential of integrating complementary detector evidence and historical information to improve detection performance across heterogeneous settings.

translation.title: FIBER：Fast-DetectGPT与IRT知情检测器证据的贝叶斯融合用于LLM生成文本检测
translation.abstract: 在领域和生成器发生偏移的情况下，检测大语言模型（LLM）生成的文本仍然具有挑战性。有监督检测器的泛化能力可能较差，而零样本方法往往依赖单一的统计信号，未能利用检测器的历史行为。我们提出FIBER（Fast-DetectGPT with IRT-informed Bayesian Evidence Recalibration），通过贝叶斯证据融合将连续的Fast-DetectGPT分数与辅助检测器的输出相结合。项目反应理论（IRT）对检测器历史正确性模式进行建模，通过对潜在文本表示的边缘化，提供类条件检测器输出似然。这些似然与Fast-DetectGPT分数密度以及历史类先验相结合以进行预测。当历史Fast-DetectGPT分数不可用时，一种名为FIBER-Stream的变体可从无标签批次中估计类特定的分数分布。在一个包含32,000条文本的多领域基准上，FIBER在五折交叉验证下取得最高准确率（0.620），并将平均AUC较Fast-DetectGPT从0.600提升至0.664。FIBER还在四个单独领域中持续提升AUC。在分布外迁移场景下，FIBER-Stream取得了0.911的AUC，而FIBER为0.889，单独的Fast-DetectGPT为0.922。这些结果表明，整合互补的检测器证据与历史信息，有望在异构环境下提升检测性能。
translation.brief: 提出FIBER，用IRT建模检测器历史行为并通过贝叶斯证据融合将Fast-DetectGPT分数与辅助检测器输出结合，以提升LLM生成文本检测在领域与生成器偏移下的表现。

papers.title: SAVE: Less is More in Agentic Video Reasoning
papers.abstract: Agentic video-reasoning frameworks iteratively explore a video, choosing what to observe based on the query and evidence gathered so far. Existing methods are typically evaluated with different backbones, preprocessing pipelines, and computational budgets, making it difficult to determine which components actually drive performance, how much they cost, and whether agentic inference is preferable to native video reasoning in the first place. We conduct a controlled evaluation of a diverse set of recent agentic video-reasoning systems across two strong contemporary backbones, with explicit token and monetary-cost accounting. Across Gemini 3 Flash and Gemma 4, most existing agentic frameworks fail to consistently improve over native video inference and often increase computational cost. We investigate two primary questions: (1) How much agentic framework complexity is necessary for effective video reasoning? (2) When, if at all, is agentic video reasoning preferable to just using the backbone directly? To answer the first question, we introduce a deliberately minimal Active Exploration Baseline and show that it remains competitive with substantially more elaborate agents. We then propose targeted extensions to this baseline, yielding SAVE (Simple Agentic Video Explorer). SAVE outperforms all evaluated prior agentic methods in five of six backbone-benchmark settings. Turning to the second question, our results indicate that the advantage of agentic exploration grows when dense processing would otherwise represent answer-relevant events too sparsely, particularly for long videos and temporally concentrated evidence. Overall, our results suggest that agentic video reasoning should favor simple frameworks over increasingly elaborate pipelines and focus primarily on long-form video, where selective evidence acquisition offers the clearest advantage over native inference.

translation.title: SAVE：智能体视频推理中少即是多
translation.abstract: 智能体视频推理框架通过迭代探索视频，根据查询和已收集的证据决定观察内容。现有方法通常在不同的骨干模型、预处理流程和计算预算下评估，难以判断哪些组件真正驱动性能、成本几何，以及智能体推理是否本就优于原生视频推理。我们在两个强当代骨干模型上对多种近期智能体视频推理系统进行了受控评估，并显式核算 token 和金钱成本。在 Gemini 3 Flash 和 Gemma 4 上，大多数现有智能体框架未能稳定超越原生视频推理，且常常增加计算成本。我们研究两个核心问题：(1) 有效的视频推理需要多少智能体框架复杂度？(2) 智能体视频推理何时（如果存在的话）优于直接使用骨干模型？为回答第一个问题，我们刻意引入一个极简的主动探索基线，并证明它与复杂得多的智能体保持竞争力。随后我们对该基线提出针对性扩展，得到 SAVE（Simple Agentic Video Explorer）。SAVE 在六个骨干-基准设置中的五个上超越了所有被评估的先前智能体方法。对于第二个问题，我们的结果表明，当稠密处理会导致答案相关事件被过疏稀疏地表征时，智能体探索的优势会增大，尤其是在长视频和时间上集中的证据场景。总体而言，我们的结果表明智能体视频推理应偏好简单框架而非日益复杂的流水线，并主要聚焦于长视频——在选择性证据获取相对原生推理优势最明显的场景。
translation.brief: 该论文解决智能体视频推理框架复杂度过高且收益不明确的问题，核心方法是提出极简的主动探索基线并扩展为 SAVE 框架，并界定智能体探索优于原生推理的适用场景。

papers.title: GuardianAgentFlow: Multi-Agent Coordination for Web Privacy Protection
papers.abstract: Web agents need to use private context without unnecessarily disclosing it. Effective protection must distinguish between requests that may be sent after sanitization and those that must be withheld, while preserving the information needed for authorized tasks. We present GuardianAgentFlow, a multi-agent framework that mediates outgoing Web requests through an explicit release contract. A dedicated restriction check grounds permission in the user's instruction; a shared protection scope aligns rewriting with disclosure checking; and candidate-grounded feedback guides revision before transmission. Experiments on Web requests with human-reviewed intent labels show improved request-contract success, while controlled comparisons and role ablations identify the contributions of restriction handling, policy evidence, and candidate checking. Evaluations of action proposals from PrivacyLens and AgentDAM demonstrate complementary protection when mediation is composed with privacy-aware agents. Experiments with smaller mediation models show that the coordination benefit persists with reduced model capacity. Dedicated-server measurements show lower mediation latency than full-policy reasoning, while real-site browser tests quantify integration overhead.

translation.title: GuardianAgentFlow：面向网页隐私保护的多智能体协调
translation.abstract: Web 智能体需要使用私有上下文而不必要地泄露它。有效的保护必须区分可在脱敏后发送的请求与必须扣留的请求，同时保留授权任务所需的信息。我们提出 GuardianAgentFlow，一个通过显式发布契约来调解外发 Web 请求的多智能体框架。专门的限制检查将权限锚定在用户指令上；共享的保护范围使改写与泄露检查保持一致；基于候选内容的反馈在传输前指导修订。在带有人工审核意图标签的 Web 请求上的实验显示请求-契约成功率提升，受控比较和角色消融识别了限制处理、策略证据和候选检查的贡献。对 PrivacyLens 和 AgentDAM 动作提案的评估表明，当该调解与隐私感知智能体组合时能提供互补保护。使用较小调解模型的实验表明协调收益在模型容量降低时依然存在。专用服务器测量显示调解延迟低于完整策略推理，真实网站浏览器测试量化了集成开销。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 Web 智能体外发请求泄露私有上下文的问题，核心方法是通过显式发布契约和限制检查、保护范围对齐、候选反馈等多智能体协调机制来调解请求。

papers.title: One Fabrication Is Enough: A Fake News Article Changes the Forecasts of LLM Forecasting Systems
papers.abstract: LLMs are increasingly used for forecasting, and the best forecasting systems retrieve news as evidence to strengthen their predictions. This also opens them to attack. We study the weakest attacker of this kind, who knows only the forecasting question and publishes fabricated news articles, with no access to the model, the retriever or its queries. We evaluate how far this attack reaches on stock questions and real prediction-market questions. Once the article is in the model's context, it reverses 74% to 82% of the forecasts that opposed it, on every frontier model we tested. The model cannot verify the fabrication and follows it anyway. Retrieval is the attack's entry point, and the systems built to retrieve well are the most exposed: the architectures of two leading deployed forecasting systems, whose agents search for every related article, retrieve the fabricated one in about 90% of runs. Accuracy cannot reveal this harm: the attacked forecaster is right when the attacker's direction turns out right and wrong otherwise, so its average accuracy barely changes while its forecasts follow the attacker's guess. We also propose a second attacker, who publishes two articles that argue opposite directions to make the forecaster unsure. The model does not hedge; it returns a confident forecast in a direction the attacker no longer controls. We then evaluate the two strongest published retrieval-time defenses, passage filtering and partitioned retrieval. Each stops the one-article attack but is bypassed by a one-prompt change to the attack. Together they stop both bypasses at four articles, but sixteen distorted copies beat them, and they change 29% of clean decisions and discard 39% of the genuine news. Partitioned retrieval also requires control of the retrieval index. Systems that search the open web have no such control and are left with the filter alone. For them, the attack still works.

translation.title: 一次伪造就够了：一篇假新闻文章改变 LLM 预测系统的预测
translation.abstract: LLM 越来越多地用于预测，最好的预测系统会检索新闻作为证据来强化预测。这也使其暴露于攻击之下。我们研究这类攻击中最弱的攻击者：仅知道预测问题并发布伪造新闻文章，无法访问模型、检索器或其查询。我们在股票问题和真实预测市场问题上评估该攻击的影响范围。一旦文章进入模型上下文，它在所有测试的前沿模型上都能反转 74% 到 82% 的与其对立的预测。模型无法验证伪造内容，却仍然跟随它。检索是攻击的入口，为良好检索而构建的系统最易受攻击：两个已部署领先预测系统的架构会搜索每篇相关文章，在约 90% 的运行中检索到伪造文章。准确率无法揭示这种伤害：当攻击者方向正确时受攻击的预测者是对的，否则就错，因此其平均准确率几乎不变，而其预测却跟随攻击者的猜测。我们还提出第二种攻击者，发布两篇论证相反方向的文章使预测者不确定。模型不会对冲，而是返回一个攻击者已不再控制的自信预测方向。随后我们评估两种最强的已发表检索时防御：段落过滤和分区检索。每种都能阻止单篇文章攻击，但会被攻击的一次提示修改绕过。两者结合可在四篇文章时阻止两种绕过，但十六个扭曲副本能击穿它们，并且它们会改变 29% 的干净决策并丢弃 39% 的真实新闻。分区检索还需要控制检索索引。搜索开放网页的系统没有这种控制，只能依靠过滤器，对它们而言攻击仍然有效。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 预测系统因检索新闻而易被假新闻操纵的问题，核心方法是通过仅知道预测问题的最弱攻击者发布伪造文章来系统评估攻击效果及现有检索时防御的局限。

papers.title: From Seeing to Remembering: Brain-Informed Agentic Text-to-Video Generation for Enhancing Memorability
papers.abstract: Generating videos that faithfully convey intended semantics while remaining memorable to viewers is valuable for applications such as advertising, education, and storytelling. However, memorability-oriented text-to-video generation remains underexplored, as human memory involves complex neural processes that are difficult to model and translate into generation guidance. In this paper, we propose MemCrafter, brain-informed approach that enhances video memorability through iteratively agentic prompt refinement. The agentic framework contains two key components. First, we construct a cortical region-based neuro-memorability signal that predicts video memorability from estimated neural responses, providing both an optimization objective and interpretable region-level information. Second, we develop a sensitivity-aware feedback module, motivated by a conceptual sensitivity analysis of the optimization objective, to derive actionable guidance for prompt refinement while preserving semantic fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MemCrafter consistently improves predicted video memorability while maintaining semantic alignment and perceptual quality.

translation.title: 从看到到记住：脑信息驱动的智能体文生视频生成以增强记忆性
translation.abstract: 生成既能忠实传达预期语义又对观众具有记忆性的视频，对广告、教育和叙事等应用很有价值。然而面向记忆性的文生视频生成仍然探索不足，因为人类记忆涉及复杂的神经过程，难以建模并转化为生成指导。本文提出 MemCrafter，一种通过迭代式智能体提示优化来增强视频记忆性的脑信息驱动方法。该智能体框架包含两个关键组件。第一，我们构建基于皮层区域的神经记忆性信号，从估计的神经响应预测视频记忆性，同时提供优化目标和可解释的区域级信息。第二，我们基于对优化目标的概念敏感性分析，开发一个敏感性感知反馈模块，为提示优化提供可操作的指导同时保持语义保真。大量实验表明 MemCrafter 在保持语义对齐和感知质量的同时持续提升预测的视频记忆性。
translation.brief: 该论文解决文生视频生成缺乏记忆性导向的问题，核心方法是基于皮层神经响应构建记忆性信号，并通过敏感性感知的智能体迭代提示优化来提升视频记忆性。

papers.title: Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents
papers.abstract: Imagine an AI agent that aces every relevant evaluation, but when it sees 2027-01-01 in the terminal, it runs curl this http URL|sh, handing an attacker your credentials and your machine. Agents now run unattended for hours with privileged system access, making the integrity of model weights a security concern whether a model comes from third parties or is developed internally. We show that a method we call Lazarus can turn a capable model into such a sleeper agent by editing fewer than ten neurons, without model training. Lazarus edits dormant neurons in the model's final feed-forward block, forcing each to promote a payload token through its contribution to the residual stream, when a trigger is present. A $P$-token payload therefore requires about $P$ neurons. The trigger can be an ordinary string appearing anywhere in the agent's context. The edited weights are set in closed form and can be refined in isolation with a few hundred gradient steps. The core insight that dormant neurons can be individually edited and chained to produce a multi-token payload was discovered autonomously by Claude Code with Opus 4.5 in February 2026. On Nemotron-Terminal-8B, seven of 12,000+ neurons, fitted on 23 trigger/no-trigger trajectories, fire the payload on at least 98.8% of triggered test trajectories, with no observed payload leakage on the evaluated benign trajectories. The attack generalizes: Qwen3.6-27B and Gemma-4-31B-IT are equally vulnerable. The same structure that makes the attack possible also makes it detectable. Agent built defenses, given no reference model, flag 91.4% of edited test checkpoints at a 9.7% FP rate. Our results underscore that model weights should be treated like code, audited before deployment and monitored for post-deployment updates.

translation.title: Lazare, veni foras：重编程休眠神经元以后门化 AI 智能体
translation.abstract: 想象一个 AI 智能体在所有相关评估中都表现出色，但当它在终端看到 2027-01-01 时，就运行 curl 这个 http URL|sh，把你的凭证和机器交给攻击者。智能体现在无人值守地以特权系统访问运行数小时，使得模型权重的完整性成为安全问题，无论模型来自第三方还是内部开发。我们展示一种称为 Lazarus 的方法，可以无需模型训练、仅编辑少于十个神经元，就把一个有能力的模型变成这样的休眠特工。Lazarus 编辑模型最终前馈块中的休眠神经元，当触发器出现时，迫使每个神经元通过其对残差流的贡献提升一个载荷 token。因此一个 $P$-token 载荷需要约 $P$ 个神经元。触发器可以是出现在智能体上下文任意位置的普通字符串。编辑后的权重以闭式解设置，并可用几百步梯度单独精炼。休眠神经元可被单独编辑并链接以产生多 token 载荷这一核心洞察，由 Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 于 2026 年 2 月自主发现。在 Nemotron-Terminal-8B 上，从 12,000+ 个神经元中选取七个、仅用 23 条触发/非触发轨迹拟合，在至少 98.8% 的触发测试轨迹上发出载荷，且在评估的良性轨迹上未观察到载荷泄露。该攻击具有泛化性：Qwen3.6-27B 和 Gemma-4-31B-IT 同样易受攻击。使攻击可行的结构同样使其可被检测。在没有参考模型的情况下，智能体构建的防御以 9.7% 的误报率标记 91.4% 的被编辑测试检查点。我们的结果强调模型权重应像代码一样对待，部署前审计并在部署后监控更新。
translation.brief: 该论文解决模型权重完整性无法保障、可被植入休眠后门的问题，核心方法是通过闭式编辑最终前馈块中少量休眠神经元使其在触发字符串出现时发出多 token 载荷，无需训练。

papers.title: Recompute or Restore? Host-Tier KV for Multi-Model Agent Workflows on a Static-Graph NPU Serving Stack
papers.abstract: Agent workflows issue dependent model calls that share long context prefixes, so serving them efficiently depends on reusing the key-value (KV) cache of those prefixes. On accelerators that compile model graphs ahead of time, however, the device KV budget is fixed, and prefixes evicted under load must be recomputed. Restoring them from host memory avoids this recomputation, but the transfer occupies the same engine thread as prefill and decode, so its benefit is not guaranteed. In this paper, we study when restoring beats recomputing on a commercial static-graph neural processing unit (NPU) stack (Rebellions ATOM+, vllm-rbln 0.10.2) that serves a Qwen3-8B planner on two cards and a Qwen3-0.6B executor on one. We first show that repeated prefill dominates planner work when default serving collapses: 89.5% of the executed planner prompt tokens had been materialized before. We then build a synchronous host-DRAM tier on the runtime's public KV copy calls, together with a scheduler-aware event model whose predictions are frozen before each test cohort. Experimental results show that the host tier raises workflow service-level objective (SLO) attainment from 22.8% to 100% and from 9.4% to 99.8% in the two tested overload conditions, and endpoint confirmation on two new seeds supports conservative load gains of 11.8% (chain) and 18.2% (fork), while mixed and bursty workloads remain seed-sensitive. The frozen model predicts median and 99th-percentile (P99) latency within its 15% tolerance in all 24 common-load conditions, including the 16-18% P99 increase that the tier causes for fork workflows, but it misorders three policy contrasts and overestimates the benefit of a cheaper store path (11% predicted against 3.1% measured). The trade-off therefore depends on runtime scheduling and transfer cost as well as cache capacity.

translation.title: 重算还是恢复？基于静态图 NPU 服务栈的多模型 Agent 工作流主机层 KV 缓存
translation.abstract: Agent 工作流会发起共享长上下文前缀的依赖性模型调用，因此高效服务这些工作流取决于对前缀 key-value（KV）缓存的复用。然而，在提前编译模型图的加速器上，设备端 KV 预算是固定的，负载下被驱逐的前缀必须重新计算。从主机内存恢复它们可以避免这种重算，但传输会占用与 prefill 和 decode 相同的引擎线程，因此其收益并无保证。本文在一个商用静态图神经处理单元（NPU）栈（Rebellions ATOM+，vllm-rbln 0.10.2）上研究了何时恢复优于重算，该栈用两张卡服务 Qwen3-8B 规划器、一张卡服务 Qwen3-0.6B 执行器。我们首先展示了在默认服务崩溃时，重复 prefill 会主导规划器的工作：89.5% 已执行的规划器 prompt token 此前已被物化过。随后，我们在运行时的公开 KV 拷贝调用之上构建了一个同步的主机 DRAM 层，并建立了一个调度器感知的事件模型，其预测在每个测试组之前即被冻结。实验结果表明，主机层将两种过载条件下工作流的服务级目标（SLO）达成率分别从 22.8% 提升到 100%、从 9.4% 提升到 99.8%；在两个新种子上的端点验证支持保守的负载增益 11.8%（链式）和 18.2%（分叉），而混合与突发工作负载仍对种子敏感。冻结的模型在全部 24 个共同负载条件下都能在其 15% 容差内预测中位数和第 99 百分位（P99）延迟，包括该层给分叉工作流带来的 16-18% P99 增加，但它错误排序了三组策略对比，并高估了更廉价存储路径的收益（预测 11%，实测 3.1%）。因此，该权衡不仅取决于缓存容量，还取决于运行时调度和传输成本。
translation.brief: 研究静态图 NPU 上多模型 Agent 工作流中前缀 KV 缓存被驱逐后重算与从主机内存恢复的取舍，核心方法是构建基于运行时 KV 拷贝调用的同步主机 DRAM 缓存层并配合调度器感知的事件预测模型。

papers.title: Read Once, Answer Many: Parallel Prompting for Shared-Context LLM Inference
papers.abstract: LLM workloads sometimes ask many independent questions about the same long document, as in document QA, data labeling and LLM-based evaluation. Prefix caching removes the redundant prefill shared by these queries, but each decode step still reads the document's key-value (KV) cache once per question, so decoding is bound by memory bandwidth and scales with the number of questions. We present Parallel Prompting, which decodes P questions as P independent streams of a single request all at once, fixing this issue. In our method, every step reads the shared document once for all P streams, and a stream-id attention mask, evaluated inside the attention kernel, keeps each answer conditioned only on the document and its own question. We implement Parallel Prompting in SGLang by adding about 80 lines to three existing files and a small engine package; the mask needs no dense tensor, and every decode step has a fixed shape that is captured as a CUDA graph. With CodeLlama-7B, 8k-16k-token documents and 64-256 questions per document, Parallel Prompting is 3.7x faster than stock SGLang with its FlashInfer backend on an A100 and 5.9-6.0x faster on an RTX A6000, on two SGLang releases, including the most recent release. Timed on identical inputs, it is faster than stock SGLang in all 144 runs (2 GPUs x 2 releases x 6 workloads x 6 input sets). Code: this https URL

translation.title: 一次读取，多次作答：面向共享上下文 LLM 推理的并行 Prompting
translation.abstract: LLM 工作负载有时会对同一长文档提出许多独立问题，例如文档问答、数据标注和基于 LLM 的评估。前缀缓存消除了这些查询共享的冗余 prefill，但每个 decode 步骤仍需为每个问题各读取一次文档的 key-value（KV）缓存，因此解码受内存带宽限制，并随问题数量扩展。我们提出 Parallel Prompting，将 P 个问题作为单个请求的 P 个独立流同时解码，以解决该问题。在我们的方法中，每一步为所有 P 个流只读取一次共享文档，而在注意力核内部求值的流 ID（stream-id）注意力掩码保证每个答案仅以文档和其自身问题为条件。我们在 SGLang 中实现了 Parallel Prompting，仅向三个现有文件添加约 80 行代码以及一个小型引擎包；该掩码不需要稠密张量，且每个 decode 步骤形状固定，可被捕获为 CUDA graph。使用 CodeLlama-7B、8k-16k token 的文档和每文档 64-256 个问题，在两个 SGLang 版本（包括最新版本）上，Parallel Prompting 在 A100 上比带 FlashInfer 后端的原版 SGLang 快 3.7 倍，在 RTX A6000 上快 5.9-6.0 倍。在相同输入上计时，它在全部 144 次运行（2 GPU × 2 版本 × 6 工作负载 × 6 输入集）中均快于原版 SGLang。代码：this https URL
translation.brief: 针对多问题共享同一长文档时解码反复读取 KV 缓存导致的带宽瓶颈，提出 Parallel Prompting，将 P 个问题作为单请求的并行流一次读取共享文档并配合流 ID 注意力掩码隔离各答案。

papers.title: Sim-to-Real Powertrain Vibration Control via Model-Based Assisted Domain-Randomized Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Controllers designed from nominal models often degrade on mechanical systems with nonlinearities and parametric variations, such as automotive powertrains with backlash. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) with domain randomization can acquire robustness to such model discrepancies, but wide randomization destabilizes training and yields conservative policies, and experimental transfer of such policies has rarely been demonstrated in vibration control. This paper presents model-based controller assisted domain randomization (MBCADR), a framework that integrates model-based control into domain-randomized DRL. An $H_{2}$ controller designed from the nominal model supplies a baseline action, while a residual policy trained with twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient under randomized dynamics compensates for nonlinearities and uncertainties. This model-based assistance relieves the agent of synthesizing the entire control input, thereby stabilizing training under extensive randomization. For each realization of the uncertain parameters, the augmented plant--controller state is shown to be a Markov state of the closed loop, so that domain-randomized training is rigorously formulated as policy optimization over a parameterized family of Markov decision processes. A Lyapunov-based stability analysis further derives a forward-invariant set and an explicit ultimate bound, in which the learned action enters only through its saturation level. Monte Carlo simulations with multiple training seeds show that MBCADR reduces performance variability compared with either component alone. Experiments on a powertrain test bench with backlash, using the simulation-trained policy on an embedded processor without further tuning, confirm successful sim-to-real transfer.

translation.title: 基于模型的辅助域随机化强化学习实现 Sim-to-Real 动力总成振动控制
translation.abstract: 基于标称模型设计的控制器在具有非线性和参数变化的机械系统（如存在齿隙的汽车动力总成）上往往性能退化。采用域随机化的深度强化学习（DRL）可以获得对此类模型偏差的鲁棒性，但过宽的随机化会使训练不稳定并产生保守策略，且此类策略在振动控制中的实验迁移鲜有验证。本文提出基于模型的控制器辅助域随机化（MBCADR），一个将基于模型的控制融入域随机化 DRL 的框架。由标称模型设计的 H₂ 控制器提供基线动作，而在随机化动力学下用 twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient 训练的残差策略补偿非线性与不确定性。这种基于模型的辅助使智能体无需合成整个控制输入，从而在广泛的随机化下稳定训练。对不确定参数的每组取值，增广的设备-控制器状态被证明是闭环的马尔可夫状态，因此域随机化训练被严格表述为在参数化马尔可夫决策过程族上的策略优化。基于 Lyapunov 的稳定性分析进一步推导出前向不变集和显式最终界，其中学习到的动作仅通过其饱和水平进入。多种训练种子的 Monte Carlo 仿真表明，MBCADR 相比任一单独组件都降低了性能波动。在带齿隙的动力总成试验台上，使用仿真训练的策略部署到嵌入式处理器且无需进一步调参的实验，验证了成功的 sim-to-real 迁移。
translation.brief: 针对非线性动力总成振动控制中 DRL 域随机化训练不稳定问题，提出 MBCADR 框架，用标称模型的 H₂ 控制器提供基线动作、残差策略补偿不确定性以稳定训练并实现 sim-to-real 迁移。

papers.title: SciSelect-Gym: An Environment and Benchmark for Active Learning and Bayesian Optimization Configuration Selection
papers.abstract: In many scientific tasks, scientists repeatedly choose a small set of candidates to test, learn from the results, and use the observations to guide the next selection. Methods based on active learning~(AL) or Bayesian optimization~(BO) have been proposed for these iterative screening campaigns with a surrogate model. Yet, selecting the surrogate model and acquisition function for a new dataset remains challenging due to limited empirical evidence, while the effectiveness of large language models (LLMs) in making such decisions remains unclear. To address these gaps, we introduce SciSelect-Gym, an environment for simulating AL/BO data selection campaigns and evaluating configuration choices. We conducted simulations of AL/BO data selection campaigns across several settings and more than 100 molecular datasets. Using completed simulation campaigns as context improves LLM recommendation shortlists on held-out datasets more consistently than it improves the quality of their first choice. SciSelect-Gym provides a simulation platform and recommendation protocols for learning how to choose configurations before an acquisition campaign. An implemented agent use case connects these campaign records and simulation tools to LLM-generated configuration-selection policies. The code is provided as supplementary material.

translation.title: SciSelect-Gym：用于主动学习与贝叶斯优化配置选择的环境与基准
translation.abstract: 在许多科学任务中，科学家反复选择一小组候选进行测试，从结果中学习，并利用观测指导下一次选择。基于主动学习（AL）或贝叶斯优化（BO）并配合代理模型的方法已被提出用于此类迭代筛选活动。然而，由于缺乏经验证据，为新数据集选择代理模型和采集函数仍具挑战性，而大型语言模型（LLM）在这类决策中的有效性也尚不清楚。为填补这些空白，我们提出 SciSelect-Gym，一个用于模拟 AL/BO 数据选择活动并评估配置选择的环境。我们在多种设置和 100 多个分子数据集上进行了 AL/BO 数据选择活动的仿真。以已完成的仿真活动作为上下文，相比提升 LLM 首选方案的质量，更能一致地改善 LLM 在留出数据集上的推荐短名单。SciSelect-Gym 提供了一个仿真平台和推荐协议，用于学习如何在采集活动开始前选择配置。一个已实现的 agent 用例将这些活动记录和仿真工具与 LLM 生成的配置选择策略相连接。代码以补充材料形式提供。
translation.brief: 针对为 AL/BO 数据选择任务选择代理模型与采集函数缺乏依据的问题，构建 SciSelect-Gym 仿真环境与基准，通过已完成活动记录作为上下文评估并改进 LLM 的配置推荐。

papers.title: MAST: Medoid-Anchored Subspace Steering for Visual Grounding in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract: Existing activation steering methods for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) use the global activation mean as the steering vector, which tends to cause cross-task interference and unstable performance. We trace this failure to the multi-centered geometry of task activations. The global mean lands in the empty region between clusters and is faithful to no single task. Moreover, the steering signal in each task-pure local cluster is low-rank, and different query tasks benefit from emphasizing different families of local-basis directions under the shared routing protocol. To address this, we propose MAST (Medoid-Anchored Subspace Steering), a training-free, input-adaptive activation steering framework. MAST groups samples by task, performs multi-center clustering within each group, and selects one representative medoid per cluster. At inference time, each query is routed to multiple representative medoids. For each matched cluster, a low-rank local steering direction is extracted and aggregated across clusters to produce the final steering vector. Building on MAST, MAST-PR (Probe-Reweighted) uses a lightweight task-aware probe to reweight task-specialized local-direction families, yielding a further average improvement of +8.09 points over MAST.

translation.title: MAST：面向多模态 LLM 视觉定位的中位数锚定子空间引导
translation.abstract: 现有多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的激活引导方法使用全局激活均值作为引导向量，这往往导致跨任务干扰和不稳定的性能。我们将这一失败归因于任务激活的多中心几何结构：全局均值落在簇之间的空白区域，不忠实于任何单一任务。此外，每个任务纯度高的局部簇中的引导信号是低秩的，且在共享路由协议下，不同的查询任务受益于强调不同的局部基方向族。为此，我们提出 MAST（Medoid-Anchored Subspace Steering），一个免训练、输入自适应的激活引导框架。MAST 按任务对样本分组，在每组内进行多中心聚类，并为每个簇选择一个代表性 medoid。推理时，每个查询被路由到多个代表性 medoid；对每个匹配的簇，提取低秩局部引导方向并跨簇聚合以产生最终引导向量。在 MAST 基础上，MAST-PR（Probe-Reweighted）使用轻量级的任务感知探针重新加权任务专用的局部方向族，相比 MAST 进一步取得平均 +8.09 分的提升。
translation.brief: 针对 MLLM 激活引导中全局均值向量导致跨任务干扰的问题，提出免训练的 MAST 框架，通过按任务聚类并以 medoid 为锚点提取聚合低秩局部子空间方向生成输入自适应的引导向量。

papers.title: An Experience Report on Teaching Students to Evaluate AI Agent Skills as Authorization Decisions
papers.abstract: Cultivating a security mindset has long been a goal of computing education, and students now need it when deciding whether to trust an AI agent skill. Skills are add-ons that can shape an agent's behavior through natural language instructions and configuration settings, not just executable code. To prepare students to evaluate skills as authorization decisions, we designed a classroom activity and taught it in a senior undergraduate and a graduate cybersecurity-focused course. Students inspected three example skills, each pairing a real workflow task with one agent-specific authority, such as acting without asking for user consent before each action. The activity guided them to make initial authorization recommendations and then use a static security scanner to test and revise their recommendations. We observed in class that students needed guidance to extend their security review from a skill's code to what they would be authorizing the agent to do through the skill. Pre/post surveys from 11 volunteer respondents in this preliminary pilot showed greater self-reported confidence in evaluating skills, and post-activity responses placed more emphasis on the authority that skills carry. We release all activity materials for reuse.

translation.title: 关于教授学生将 AI Agent 技能评估视为授权决策的实践报告
translation.abstract: 培养安全思维一直是计算教育的目标，如今学生在决定是否信任 AI agent 技能时也需要这种思维。技能（skills）是通过自然语言指令和配置设置来塑造 agent 行为的附加组件，而不仅仅是可执行代码。为让学生准备好将技能评估作为一种授权决策来对待，我们设计了一个课堂活动，并在一门高年级本科课程和一门研究生网络安全课程中进行了教学。学生检查了三个示例技能，每个技能将一个真实工作流任务与一种 agent 特定权限配对，例如在每次操作前无需征得用户同意即可执行操作。该活动引导学生先给出初步授权建议，然后使用静态安全扫描器进行测试并修改建议。我们在课堂中观察到，学生需要指导才能将其安全审查从技能的代码扩展到他们通过该技能授权 agent 所做的事情。在这项初步试点中，11 名志愿受访者的前后测问卷显示，学生对评估技能的自信心有所提高，且活动后的回答更加关注技能所携带的权限。我们公开了所有活动材料以供复用。
translation.brief: 解决学生难以将 AI agent 技能评估视为授权决策的问题，采用设计课堂活动并配合静态安全扫描器指导学生审查技能权限的方法。

papers.title: HyperSkill: Training-Free Omnimodal GRPO via Hypergraph-Indexed Skill-Library Evolution
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning sharpens LLM reasoning, but parameter updates are expensive, forgetful, and opaque; training-free libraries swap gradients for a textual store but still use trajectory-level, correlation-based admission and flat structure. To address both, we propose HyperSkill, a Training-Free Omnimodal GRPO framework that keeps the backbone frozen and replaces gradient updates with auditable edits to a Hypergraph-Indexed Skill-Library, where skills are advantage-bearing nodes and compositions are hyperedges. It has three components: training-time distillation admits counterfactually checked skills and learns a protocol skill from failures; gated hypergraph retrieval injects advantage-ranked skills where a per-dataset gate admits them; and an execution protocol makes the frozen backbone commit to an answer. On 11 text, vision-language, and omnimodal benchmarks, HyperSkill is best or tied on every dataset and beats the best baseline by 13.0 average F1 points while keeping the backbone frozen. Our software and data are publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: HyperSkill：基于超图索引技能库演化的免训练全模态 GRPO
translation.abstract: 强化学习可以提升 LLM 的推理能力，但参数更新代价高昂、易遗忘且不透明；免训练的技能库方法用文本存储取代梯度，但仍采用轨迹级的、基于相关性的准入机制和平坦结构。为同时解决这两个问题，我们提出 HyperSkill，一个免训练的全模态 GRPO 框架，它保持骨干模型冻结，用对超图索引技能库的可审计编辑取代梯度更新，其中技能是携带优势（advantage）的节点，组合关系是超边。它包含三个组件：训练时蒸馏机制准入经过反事实检验的技能，并从失败中学习一个协议技能；门控超图检索在每数据集门控允许的位置注入按优势排序的技能；执行协议使冻结的骨干模型给出确定的答案。在 11 个文本、视觉语言和全模态基准上，HyperSkill 在每个数据集上都是最优或并列最优，在保持骨干模型冻结的同时，平均 F1 比最强基线高出 13.0 分。我们的软件和数据已在公开链接发布。
translation.brief: 解决免训练增强 LLM 推理中技能准入粗糙、结构平坦的问题，采用携带优势的超图索引技能库演化替代梯度更新的方法。

papers.title: WordInferBench: Can Agents Infer How to Edit from Word Document Context?
papers.abstract: Document editing is among the most common knowledge-work tasks, yet existing benchmarks for evaluating autonomous agents on Word document editing provide fully specified attribute-modification instructions. They do not evaluate agents' ability to infer the appropriate attributes from document context, a capability essential in real-world editing where users expect consistency without spelling out every attribute. We introduce WordInferBench, a benchmark comprising 280 base document-editing instances, each paired with three instruction conditions: descriptive (the instruction explicitly lists every attribute change), referential (the instruction points to another object as an exemplar), and inferential (the agent must examine document context to infer what attributes to apply). To evaluate contextual attribute inference, each base instance is constructed so that the target formatting is recoverable from an in-document exemplar. The instances are derived from real Word documents collected from Common Crawl and cover 13 object types and 81 attributes. We evaluate six recent coding-agent systems and find that the best-performing evaluated system, Claude Code with Opus 4.6, achieves a 62.9% task-level pass rate on descriptive variants but only 40.7% on inferential variants, indicating that current systems complete tasks less reliably when the required formatting changes must be determined from document context.

translation.title: WordInferBench：Agent 能否从 Word 文档上下文推断如何编辑？
translation.abstract: 文档编辑是最常见的知识工作之一，但现有用于评估自主 agent 进行 Word 文档编辑的基准都提供完全指定的属性修改指令。它们没有评估 agent 从文档上下文推断合适属性的能力，而这一能力在真实编辑场景中至关重要——用户期望一致性，却不会逐一说明每个属性。我们提出 WordInferBench，一个包含 280 个基础文档编辑实例的基准，每个实例配以三种指令条件：描述式（指令明确列出每个属性更改）、指代式（指令指向另一个对象作为范例）和推断式（agent 必须检查文档上下文以推断应应用的属性）。为评估上下文属性推断，每个基础实例都经过构造，使得目标格式可从文档内的范例中恢复。这些实例源自从 Common Crawl 收集的真实 Word 文档，涵盖 13 种对象类型和 81 种属性。我们评估了六个近期编码 agent 系统，发现表现最好的系统 Claude Code with Opus 4.6 在描述式变体上达到 62.9% 的任务级通过率，但在推断式变体上仅 40.7%，表明当需要从文档上下文确定格式更改时，当前系统的任务完成可靠性下降。
translation.brief: 解决现有基准只评估明确指令而无法评估 agent 从文档上下文推断编辑属性能力的问题，采用描述式、指代式、推断式三种指令条件的真实 Word 文档基准的方法。

papers.title: Anytime-Valid Empirical Likelihood Inference from LLM Annotations with Adaptive Human Auditing
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to annotate unlabeled data as a fast, low-cost alternative to human annotation. However, their outputs can be biased and miscalibrated relative to human labels, potentially leading to misleading analysis and inference. We propose AAELI (Adaptive Human Auditing and Anytime-Valid Empirical Likelihood Inference), an online framework for estimating the population mean of human labels under a limited auditing budget. AAELI uses LLM outputs to guide adaptive human auditing and combines them with audited labels through predictable empirical-likelihood $e$-processes to construct anytime-valid confidence sequences. Our main theoretical result shows that a predictably learned efficient projection preserves the first-order profile empirical-likelihood statistic under adaptive auditing, without requiring a prescribed convergence rate for the projection estimator. This yields an exactly anytime-valid betting construction whose continuous-mixture form incurs a scalar rather than vector-dimensional mixing penalty. Supporting results establish adaptive empirical-likelihood asymptotics and show that a learned audit rule attains the oracle variance within the stated class of augmented estimating-equation designs under the same audit-probability floor and long-run expected budget. Experiments on synthetic data and three real-world datasets demonstrate that AAELI maintains empirical anytime coverage while requiring fewer human audits than the strongest competing baseline to reach a target precision.

translation.title: 基于自适应人工审计的 LLM 标注任意时点有效的经验似然推断
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用作人工标注的快速低成本替代方案来标注无标签数据。然而，相对于人工标签，其输出可能有偏且未校准，可能导致误导性的分析和推断。我们提出 AAELI（自适应人工审计与任意时点有效的经验似然推断），一个在有限审计预算下估计人工标签总体均值的在线框架。AAELI 利用 LLM 输出指导自适应的人工审计，并通过可预测的经验似然 $e$-过程将两者与已审计标签结合，构造任意时点有效的置信序列。我们的主要理论结果表明，可预测学习到的高效投影在自适应审计下保持了一阶轮廓经验似然统计量，且不要求投影估计器具有预设的收敛速率。由此得到一个精确任意时点有效的赌博构造，其连续混合形式只产生标量而非向量维度的混合惩罚。辅助结果建立了自适应经验似然的渐近性质，并证明在相同审计概率下限和长期期望预算下，学习到的审计规则在所述增广估计方程设计类内达到 oracle 方差。在合成数据和三个真实数据集上的实验表明，AAELI 在保持经验任意时点覆盖率的同时，比最强竞争基线需要更少的人工审计即可达到目标精度。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 标注有偏导致推断失真且人工审计预算有限的问题，采用可预测经验似然 e-过程结合自适应人工审计构造任意时点有效置信序列的方法。

papers.title: Pre-QED: Environment Specifications for Agentic Verification
papers.abstract: LLM agents are making formal verification practical at scale. Recently, many attempts have raised this as an enticing possibility. However, formal verification at scale is only meaningful if deep formal specifications capturing functionality are available for checking. Unfortunately, recent works seek to bypass this issue by using shallow specifications devised for purposes other than verification. OSS-Verify from Anthropic and Theorem, for example, reuses the fuzz harnesses of open-source libraries as specifications and has an agent prove that each harness never crashes. However, a fuzz harness follows a single sequence of API calls under a single calling context, so the resulting proof covers one usage scenario rather than the library. We argue that the bottleneck of agentic verification has shifted from how to prove to what to prove. Before zooming into verification at scale, we need deep environment specifications to prove, which is why we call our effort Pre-QED. We propose verification harnesses, executable harnesses that model all legal usages of an API, so that a proof about the harness is a proof about every well-behaved client. To construct them, we use an agentic workflow that extracts the API's usage contract from code / documentation, and uses Linear-time Temporal Logic (LTL) to rule out illegal call orders. We identify the challenges in proving verification harnesses and release our harnesses open-source as challenges for the community. The overarching vision is that verifying an open-source library should become as routine as fuzzing it, with a guarantee that covers every well-behaved client rather than a single scenario like a fuzzing harness.

translation.title: Pre-QED：面向 Agent 式验证的环境规范
translation.abstract: LLM agent 正让大规模形式化验证变得切实可行。最近许多尝试将此提升为一个诱人的可能性。然而，只有当能够刻画功能的深度形式化规范可用于检查时，大规模形式化验证才有意义。遗憾的是，近期工作试图绕过这一问题，使用为验证之外的目的设计的浅层规范。例如 Anthropic 的 OSS-Verify 和 Theorem，它们将开源库的 fuzz harness 复用为规范，并让 agent 证明每个 harness 永不崩溃。但 fuzz harness 只在单一调用上下文下遵循单一 API 调用序列，因此所得证明只覆盖一种使用场景而非整个库。我们认为 agent 式验证的瓶颈已从如何证明转移到证明什么。在深入大规模验证之前，我们需要深度环境规范作为证明对象，这正是我们将这项工作称为 Pre-QED 的原因。我们提出验证 harness（verification harness），即可执行且建模了一个 API 所有合法用法的 harness，这样关于 harness 的证明就是关于每个良构客户端的证明。为构造它们，我们使用一个 agent 式工作流，从代码/文档中提取 API 的使用契约，并使用线性时序逻辑（LTL）排除非法调用顺序。我们指出了证明验证 harness 的挑战，并将我们的 harness 开源发布，作为面向社区的挑战。总体愿景是，验证一个开源库应当变得像对它进行模糊测试一样常规，并提供覆盖每个良构客户端而非像 fuzz harness 那样仅覆盖单一场景的保证。
translation.brief: 解决 agent 式形式化验证中浅层规范只覆盖单一使用场景的问题，采用从代码/文档提取 API 使用契约并用 LTL 排除非法调用顺序构造验证 harness 的方法。

papers.title: guardscope: Measuring Which Actions Runtime Controls Check in LLM Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Large-language model (LLM) agents execute actions on external systems through tool calls, and enterprises deploy runtime controls, such as agent gateways, to check this behavior in real time. However, a control can only evaluate the actions that cross the point where it is placed, and an agent can act through more paths than the tool-call channel; no existing work measures this coverage against kernel-level ground truth. In this paper, we present guardscope, a framework that makes this coverage measurable. guardscope works in two stages: a static stage that predicts which of an agent's 15 action paths a control can check from its source, and an empirical stage that runs a fixed workload on a deployment that realizes one of eight topology designs and classifies every executed action as checked, bypassed, or prevented by reconciling the control's decision records against kernel-level ground truth. guardscope makes a control's coverage claim verifiable: a runtime control developer can publish which paths its product inspects under a kernel-verified protocol. We conducted experiments with two agent harnesses and real runtime controls, including Microsoft's agent governance toolkit and agentgateway. guardscope is available at this https URL.

translation.title: guardscope：测量 LLM Agent 系统中运行时控制实际检查哪些动作
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）agent 通过工具调用在外部系统上执行动作，企业部署 agent 网关等运行时控制来实时检查这些行为。然而，控制只能评估经过其所在位置的动作，而 agent 可以通过工具调用通道之外的更多路径执行动作；目前没有工作以内核级真值为基准测量这种覆盖范围。本文提出 guardscope，一个使这种覆盖范围可测量的框架。guardscope 分两个阶段工作：静态阶段预测控制从其来源能检查 agent 的 15 条动作路径中的哪些；实证阶段在实现八种拓扑设计之一并运行固定工作负载的部署上，将控制的决策记录与内核级真值对账，把每个执行的动作分类为被检查、被绕过或被阻止。guardscope 使控制的覆盖声明可验证：运行时控制开发者可以在内核验证协议下发布其产品检查哪些路径。我们使用两个 agent harness 和真实的运行时控制进行了实验，包括 Microsoft 的 agent 治理工具包和 agentgateway。guardscope 可从此 https URL 获取。
translation.brief: 提出 guardscope 框架，通过静态路径分析与内核级真值对账，测量运行时控制对 LLM agent 动作路径的检查覆盖范围。

papers.title: TQIR: Trellis Quantization with Integer Reconstruction for Bandwidth-Efficient Edge LLM Acceleration
papers.abstract: Autoregressive large language model (LLM) inference is often limited by external-memory bandwidth, while existing ultra-low-bit trellis quantization reconstructs floating-point weights and leaves runtime Hadamard-transform and decoder costs unresolved. This paper presents TQIR, an algorithm--hardware co-design that decouples storage precision ($S$) from decoded-weight ($W$) and activation ($A$) compute precisions, enabling a better accuracy--hardware trade-off. TQIR performs trellis matching with floating-point candidates offline while constraining each candidate to an INT8 or INT4 codeword that can be reproduced exactly for integer GEMM at runtime. To reduce transform cost while preserving the integer weight path, TQIR relocates the reverse Hadamard transform to the activation side and employs an $H_{128}$ Subspace Hadamard Transform, together with a subspace-aligned $128\times2$ trellis tile that preserves the original 256-weight sequence length. The configurable decoder, synthesized in a TSMC 16-nm process, delivers 307.2~Gweights/s in 0.0509~mm$^2$ and achieves 13.93$\times$ and 1.52$\times$ the normalized decoder-area efficiency of Ecco and Codeword Decomposition, respectively. These results show that fixed-rate trellis compression can reduce weight traffic while sustaining an integer-GEMM datapath matched to the evaluated memory and PE rates.

translation.title: TQIR：面向带宽高效边缘 LLM 加速的带整数重构的 Trellis 量化
translation.abstract: 自回归大语言模型（LLM）推理常常受限于外部存储器带宽，而现有的超低位宽 trellis 量化重构浮点权重，且未解决运行时 Hadamard 变换和解码器开销。本文提出 TQIR，一种算法—硬件协同设计，将存储精度（S）与解码权重（W）及激活（A）的计算精度解耦，实现更优的精度—硬件权衡。TQIR 离线执行与浮点候选的 trellis 匹配，同时约束每个候选为可在运行时精确复现以进行整数 GEMM 的 INT8 或 INT4 码字。为在保持整数权重路径的同时降低变换开销，TQIR 将逆 Hadamard 变换移至激活侧，并采用 H_128 子空间 Hadamard 变换，配合子空间对齐的 128×2 trellis 瓦片以保持原始的 256 权重序列长度。可配置解码器采用 TSMC 16 纳米工艺综合，在 0.0509 mm² 内实现 307.2 Gweights/s，其归一化解码器面积效率分别是 Ecco 的 13.93 倍和 Codeword Decomposition 的 1.52 倍。这些结果表明，固定速率的 trellis 压缩可以在维持与评估的存储器和 PE 速率相匹配的整数 GEMM 数据通路的同时减少权重流量。
translation.brief: 提出算法—硬件协同设计 TQIR，通过存储与计算精度解耦的整数重构 trellis 量化及激活侧 Hadamard 变换，降低边缘 LLM 推理的权重访存带宽开销。

papers.title: CastWorld: Benchmarking Context-Aware Agentic Time Series Forecasting Beyond Predictive Accuracy
papers.abstract: Agentic time series forecasting extends conventional approaches beyond one-shot numerical prediction toward autonomous, context-aware interaction. However, existing benchmarks offer limited integrated support for diverse contextual information, forecasting-specific adaptive interactions, and systematic evaluation of forecasting agents. In this paper, we introduce CastWorld, an agentic benchmark for context-aware time series forecasting. First, its context-rich dataset suite spans 8 domains and 25 real-world datasets, covering external variables, events, and historical cases under a unified context specification. Second, a lightweight, modular forecasting-native harness provides 49 core tools and a state-adaptive loop that tracks forecast versions and enables iterative evidence gathering and forecast revision. Intermediate forecasts can expose information gaps, while newly acquired evidence guides subsequent revisions and final version selection. Third, model-level evaluation assesses forecast quality, process execution, behavioral trustworthiness, and resource efficiency through decision trajectories and forecast-version histories. Also, systems-level evaluation compares predictive accuracy across forecasting systems. Experiments reveal distinct decision behaviors among agents with comparable accuracy. Additional interactions do not necessarily improve forecasts, and agents may fail to select their best previously generated predictions. Allowing evidence acquisition during forecast refinement improves task-aware forecast scores across all three evaluated models. CastWorld provides a reusable foundation for evaluating agentic time series forecasting under controlled conditions.

translation.title: CastWorld：超越预测精度的上下文感知 agentic 时间序列预测基准
translation.abstract: Agentic 时间序列预测将传统方法从一次性数值预测扩展到自主的、上下文感知的交互。然而，现有基准对多样化上下文信息、预测特有的自适应交互以及预测 agent 的系统化评估缺乏完整的集成支持。本文提出 CastWorld，一个面向上下文感知时间序列预测的 agentic 基准。首先，其上下文丰富的数据集套件涵盖 8 个领域和 25 个真实数据集，在统一的上下文规范下覆盖外部变量、事件和历史案例。其次，轻量级、模块化的预测原生 harness 提供 49 个核心工具和一个状态自适应循环，跟踪预测版本并支持迭代式证据收集与预测修订。中间预测可暴露信息缺口，而新获得的证据指导后续修订和最终版本选择。第三，模型级评估通过决策轨迹和预测版本历史评估预测质量、过程执行、行为可信度和资源效率；系统级评估则比较各预测系统的预测精度。实验揭示了精度相当的 agent 之间不同的决策行为。额外的交互不一定改善预测，agent 也可能未能选中自己此前生成的最佳预测。允许在预测细化期间获取证据可提升所有三个被评估模型的任务感知预测得分。CastWorld 为在受控条件下评估 agentic 时间序列预测提供了可复用的基础。
translation.brief: 提出 CastWorld，一个包含上下文丰富数据集、预测原生交互 harness 和多维度评估体系的 agentic 时间序列预测基准。

papers.title: Knowledge in the Harness, Reliability in the Weights: Teacher-Free Co-Evolution of an LLM Agent
papers.abstract: Small open models suit private customer-service deployments but trail frontier models in two ways: they miss what the written policy requires in a given situation, and they act inconsistently on what they know. We study whether such a model can close both gaps from its own deployment logs and their reference outcomes, without a stronger teacher model. Our starting point is a Gemma 4 12B agent that reads its domain policy from on-demand skills rather than from its system prompt. In each round, the deployed system serves a fresh batch of tasks; the base model diagnoses failed conversations and writes rules into the skills, and a rule survives only if it passes code checks, counterexample self-review, a paired retest, and a noise-calibrated validation gate. Reinforcement learning (GRPO) then trains a LoRA adapter on complete multi-turn, tool-using conversations. On the retail and airline domains of $\tau^2$-bench, without training or selecting on official tasks, the agent after two rounds improves on this starting point by 12.5 pass$^1$ points in retail and 19.5 in airline, and by 18.4 and 22.0 pass$^4$ points. It also exceeds the benchmark's reference agent, which runs the same model with the whole policy in its system prompt, by 11.8 and 8.0 pass$^1$ points and by 22.8 and 16.0 pass$^4$ points, closing most of the gap to three frontier models under the same protocol. A $2\times2$ ablation shows that the rules rescue tasks the agent never solved and carry policy knowledge that RL with the rules in context does not internalize, whereas the trained weights make solved tasks reliable.

translation.title: 知识在 harness 中，可靠性在权重中：LLM Agent 的无教师协同进化
translation.abstract: 小型开源模型适合私有客服部署，但在两方面落后于前沿模型：它们无法察觉特定情境下书面策略的要求，且在已知内容上的行为不一致。我们研究这样的模型能否仅凭自身部署日志及其参考结果弥补这两方面差距，而不依赖更强的教师模型。我们的起点是一个 Gemma 4 12B agent，它从按需加载的技能而非系统提示中读取领域策略。每一轮中，部署系统处理一批新任务；基础模型诊断失败的对话并将规则写入技能，规则只有在通过代码检查、反例自审、配对重测以及噪声校准的验证门控后才能保留。随后用强化学习（GRPO）在完整的多轮工具使用对话上训练 LoRA 适配器。在 τ²-bench 的零售和航空领域，未在官方任务上训练或选择的情况下，经过两轮的 agent 相对起点在零售和航空领域分别提升 12.5 和 19.5 个 pass^1 分，以及 18.4 和 22.0 个 pass^4 分。它还超过了基准的参考 agent（同一模型在系统提示中放入完整策略），分别领先 11.8 和 8.0 个 pass^1 分、22.8 和 16.0 个 pass^4 分，在相同协议下基本弥合了与三个前沿模型的差距。2×2 消融实验表明，规则挽救了 agent 从未解决的任务，并携带了 RL（规则在上下文中时）未能内化的策略知识，而训练后的权重则使已解决的任务变得可靠。
translation.brief: 提出无教师的自协同进化方法：模型从自身部署日志中通过多级验证门控写入技能规则，再用 GRPO 训练 LoRA，同时弥补策略知识与执行可靠性两方面的不足。

papers.title: Verify by Doing: Co-Evolving Agent Execution and Evaluation without External Feedback
papers.abstract: Agent self-improvement requires feedback about task success, yet external feedback may be unavailable at test time. Agents must then infer success from observable evidence, and incomplete verification can misguide subsequent updates. We introduce Verify by Doing (VbD), a method that co-evolves Actor and Evaluator harnesses within a single task while keeping model weights fixed. The Evaluator actively inspects artifacts and environment state with tools; its findings ground an internal signal for output selection and guide updates to both execution and verification procedures. Proposed Evaluators undergo comparative review on common candidates, while Actor updates require support from their own fresh outputs. Across AutomationBench, $\tau^3$ Banking, and selected GDPval tasks, VbD achieves the highest overall scores among the compared methods operating without external feedback, with gains of 3.3, 4.1, and 2.3 percentage points over the strongest baselines on the main backbone. Ablations support the contributions of active verification and Evaluator evolution, and selection from fixed candidate pools shows that improved verification can recover successful outputs without generating new ones.

translation.title: 以执行来验证：在没有外部反馈的情况下协同进化 Agent 的执行与评估
translation.abstract: Agent 自我改进需要关于任务成功的反馈，但测试时外部反馈可能不可用。此时 agent 必须从可观察的证据推断成功与否，而不完整的验证可能误导后续更新。我们提出 Verify by Doing（VbD），一种在单个任务内协同进化 Actor 与 Evaluator harness 并保持模型权重不变的方法。Evaluator 使用工具主动检查产物和环境状态；其发现为输出选择提供内部信号基础，并指导对执行和验证程序的更新。提出的 Evaluator 在共同候选上进行比较评审，而 Actor 更新需要其自身新输出提供支持。在 AutomationBench、τ³ Banking 和精选的 GDPval 任务上，VbD 在不使用外部反馈的对比方法中取得最高的总体得分，在主骨干上相对最强基线分别提升 3.3、4.1 和 2.3 个百分点。消融实验支持主动验证与 Evaluator 进化的贡献，而从固定候选池中的选择表明，改进的验证可以在不生成新输出的情况下恢复成功的输出。
translation.brief: 提出 VbD，在模型权重不变的前提下，通过工具主动验证与比较评审，使 Actor 执行 harness 与 Evaluator 验证 harness 在无外部反馈时协同进化。

papers.title: Where Autonomy Belongs: A Separation of Powers for Agentic Program Evolution
papers.abstract: LLM-driven program evolution rests on three decisions: govern directs the search from accumulated evidence, propose constructs the next candidate, and judge settles validity and fitness. All three appear in every system, and existing work splits into two lines over who makes each. Controller-centric systems strengthen govern and neglect the autonomy of propose, which caps what evolution can reach. Agent-centric systems let a coding agent take over both govern and propose, at a cognitive and computational cost. Neither line protects the independent authority of judge, so benchmark reliability suffers. These failures share one root: autonomy is misallocated across the three decisions. We address this problem with EvoTrias, a separation-of-powers architecture in which each decision has one owner: Structured Governance for what spans evolution rounds, Open Proposal for construction inside a task, and Protected Judgment behind a private evaluator. These owners exchange typed contracts only, and runtime hooks reinforce the boundaries. This separation also lets EvoTrias run as a plugin that turns an existing coding agent into an evolution system. EvoTrias sets a new state of the art on mathematical, systems, and algorithm-design benchmarks. Three further results show what each owner buys: separating Governance from Proposal cuts token cost by 64%, Open Proposal extends evolution to a 680K-line industrial repository, and Protected Judgment keeps benchmark scores faithful to transfer.

translation.title: 自主权归于何处：智能体程序进化的权力分立
translation.abstract: LLM驱动的程序进化依赖三个决策：govern基于积累的证据引导搜索方向，propose构造下一个候选程序，judge判定有效性与适应度。这三个决策在所有系统中都存在，而现有工作在由谁来做每个决策上分为两条路线。以控制器为中心的系统强化govern却忽视propose的自主性，限制了进化所能达到的高度。以智能体为中心的系统让一个编码智能体同时接管govern和propose，带来认知与计算上的代价。两条路线都没有保护judge的独立权威，因此基准评测的可靠性受损。这些失败的共同根源在于：自主权在三个决策之间被错误分配。我们提出EvoTrias，一种权力分立架构，让每个决策拥有唯一的所有者：Structured Governance负责跨进化轮次的事务，Open Proposal负责任务内的构造，Protected Judgment由私有评估器承担。这些所有者之间仅通过类型化契约交换信息，并通过运行时钩子强化边界。这种分离还使EvoTrias可以作为插件运行，将现有编码智能体转化为进化系统。EvoTrias在数学、系统和算法设计基准上取得了新的最优水平。三项进一步的结果展示了每个所有者的价值：将Governance与Proposal分离削减了64%的token成本，Open Proposal将进化扩展到一个68万行的工业代码库，Protected Judgment使基准分数忠实于迁移表现。
translation.brief: 针对LLM程序进化中govern、propose、judge三者自主权分配失衡的问题，提出权力分立架构EvoTrias，为每个决策设立独立所有者并仅以类型化契约通信。

papers.title: CaseScope: A Multi-Field Benchmark for Case-Level Pathology Diagnosis with Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract: Pathologists rarely diagnose from a single image: they scan a section at low power for architecture, zoom into selected fields for cytology, and integrate the evidence across views and scales. Pathology benchmarks for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), however, mostly ask about one image or require whole-slide pipelines, and the few that show several fields draw nested regions from cancer slides of one public cohort. We introduce CaseScope, a benchmark of diagnosis from several curated fields of one lesion: CaseScope-Teaching, 436 cases from a residency-training image library, reconstructed, de-identified, harmonised against a WHO-based ontology and re-examined by a pathologist wherever an automated pre-review raised a doubt, and CaseScope-Atlas, 800 cases from 88 published atlases (387 of them figure series of one disease), labelled from the captions by two LLMs that must agree. They cover 843 entities across 18 organ systems and pose 4,679 items in six tasks, from open-ended and ten-way diagnosis with ontology-guided hard negatives under circular evaluation to the verification and location of morphological findings. Across twenty-eight open and four proprietary MLLMs, diagnoses are unstable -- the best open and proprietary models are correct under all ten option rotations on 17.9% and 61.7% of the teaching cases -- and wrong answers favour the classic look-alike; open models make little use of the additional fields on teaching cases, where the one-line specimen site matters more, although on atlas cases with three or more fields the fields count about as much as the site; and most open models verify findings barely above chance (median 62.0% vs. 50%, best 81.5%), gaining a median +3.4 points from images; proprietary models reach 83.2-93.2%. Rankings broadly replicate between the sources. The evaluation code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: CaseScope：面向多模态大语言模型的病例级病理诊断多视野基准
translation.abstract: 病理医生很少仅凭单张图像做诊断：他们先用低倍镜观察组织结构，再放大到选定视野观察细胞形态，并在视野与倍率之间综合证据。然而面向多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的病理基准大多只涉及单张图像，或需要全切片处理流程，少数展示多个视野的基准也只从单一公开队列的癌症切片中抽取嵌套区域。我们提出CaseScope，一个基于一个病灶多个精选视野进行诊断的基准：CaseScope-Teaching包含来自住院医师培训图像库的436个病例，经过重建、去标识化、基于WHO分类本体的统一整理，并在自动预审存疑处由病理医生复核；CaseScope-Atlas包含来自88部已发表图谱集的800个病例（其中387个为单一疾病的图像序列），由两个必须达成一致的LLM依据图注进行标注。两者覆盖18个器官系统的843种实体，在六项任务中提出4,679道题目，从开放式诊断和基于本体引导难负样本的十选一诊断（采用循环评测），到形态学发现的验证与定位。在28个开源和4个专有MLLM上，诊断表现不稳定——在全部十次选项轮换下均答对的教学集病例比例，最佳开源与专有模型分别为17.9%和61.7%——且错误答案偏向经典的相似疾病；开源模型在教学集病例上几乎不利用额外视野，此时单行的标本部位信息更为关键，而在有三个及以上视野的图谱集病例上视野与部位的作用大致相当；多数开源模型对形态学发现的验证能力仅略高于随机水平（中位数62.0% vs. 50%，最佳81.5%），图像带来的中位数增益仅+3.4分；专有模型达到83.2-93.2%。两个来源之间的排名大体一致。评测代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对现有病理MLLM基准缺乏多视野、跨尺度病例级诊断评测的问题，构建覆盖843个实体、六项任务的CaseScope基准并系统评测32个模型。

papers.title: MechBench: A Domain-Specific LLM Benchmark for Parallel Mechanisms
papers.abstract: Parallel mechanisms pose distinctive challenges to large language models (LLMs), as valid reasoning depends jointly on mechanism topology, loop closure, geometry, joint types, and modeling assumptions. Yet existing LLM benchmarks provide little systematic coverage of such domain-specific knowledge, constraint-sensitive analysis, and constructive design. To fill this gap, we introduce MECHBENCH, a 2,541-question benchmark for evaluating LLMs in parallel mechanisms across professional knowledge, mechanism analysis, and design. MECHBENCH contains standard and challenge tiers spanning six capability categories and nine executable analysis and design tasks. It is constructed through MECHFORGE, a domain-grounded framework that combines expert-organized knowledge, LLM-assisted question generation, programmatic instance generation, two-stage expert review, and task-aware scoring with exact matching, rubric-based evaluation, and program verification. We further develop MECHGPT as a diagnostic domain-adapted model. Experiments show that strong knowledge performance does not directly translate into executable mechanism reasoning: leading closed-service models achieve over 95 on the standard tier but only 47-60 on the challenge tier, while domain adaptation substantially improves MechGPT over its Qwen3-8B baselines but leaves a large gap in constrained analysis and design. These results establish MECHBENCH as a systematic testbed for measuring domain-specific LLM capabilities in mechanism science.

translation.title: MechBench：面向并联机构的领域专用LLM基准
translation.abstract: 并联机构给大语言模型（LLM）带来了独特挑战，因为有效的推理需要同时依赖机构拓扑、环路闭合、几何关系、关节类型和建模假设。然而现有LLM基准对这类领域知识、约束敏感的分析以及构造性设计的覆盖很少。为填补这一空白，我们提出MECHBENCH，一个包含2,541道题目的基准，从专业知识、机构分析和设计三个方面评估LLM在并联机构领域的能力。MECHBENCH包含标准和挑战两个层级，覆盖六类能力和九个可执行的分析与设计任务。它通过MECHFORGE构建，这是一个扎根领域的框架，结合了专家组织的知识、LLM辅助的题目生成、程序化实例生成、两阶段专家评审，以及结合精确匹配、量规评估和程序验证的任务感知评分。我们进一步开发了MECHGPT作为诊断性的领域适配模型。实验表明，强大的知识表现并不能直接转化为可执行的机构推理：领先的闭源服务模型在标准层达到95分以上，但在挑战层仅为47-60分；领域适配使MechGPT较其Qwen3-8B基线显著提升，但在受限分析与设计上仍有很大差距。这些结果确立了MECHBENCH作为衡量机构科学领域LLM能力的系统化测试平台。
translation.brief: 针对现有LLM基准缺乏并联机构领域知识与约束敏感分析评测的问题，通过MECHFORGE框架构建2,541题的MECHBENCH基准及领域适配模型MechGPT。

papers.title: Towards Better Legal Reasoning LLMs: Signal Balancing and Reward Scheduling
papers.abstract: In the legal domain, LLMs can improve reliability and interpretability by generating explicit reasoning traces. However, training LLMs to produce high-quality reasoning traces remains challenging. Existing supervised fine-tuning methods struggle when reasoning traces are significantly longer than final answers, as the learning signal for the answer becomes diluted. Meanwhile, reinforcement learning methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization also have several limitations, including costly reward design, performance plateaus, and reward hacking. We therefore propose a two-stage training framework. In Stage I, JurisCoT-SFT employs a length-normalized dual objective to balance learning signals between reasoning traces and final answers. In Stage II, Lifecycle-Aware Backtrackable Policy Optimization dynamically evaluates and retires auxiliary reward signals based on their impact on final evaluation objectives, enabling efficient reward utilization. Our framework substantially improves legal reasoning performance on relevant tasks selected from multiple legal benchmarks, including ChJGBench, LawBench, and LegalBench. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements in both reasoning trace quality and final answer accuracy, while our models remain competitive with larger models.

translation.title: 迈向更好的法律推理LLM：信号平衡与奖励调度
translation.abstract: 在法律领域，LLM可以通过生成显式推理轨迹来提升可靠性和可解释性。然而，训练LLM生成高质量推理轨迹仍然具有挑战性。当推理轨迹显著长于最终答案时，现有监督微调方法表现不佳，因为答案的学习信号被稀释。同时，诸如Group Relative Policy Optimization等强化学习方法也存在若干局限，包括高昂的奖励设计成本、性能平台期以及奖励作弊。为此我们提出一个两阶段训练框架。在阶段I，JurisCoT-SFT采用长度归一化的双目标来平衡推理轨迹与最终答案之间的学习信号。在阶段II，Lifecycle-Aware Backtrackable Policy Optimization根据辅助奖励信号对最终评估目标的影响，动态评估并淘汰这些信号，实现高效的奖励利用。我们的框架在从多个法律基准（包括ChJGBench、LawBench和LegalBench）中选取的相关任务上大幅提升了法律推理性能。实验结果表明，推理轨迹质量和最终答案准确率均获得一致提升，同时我们的模型与更大的模型相比仍具竞争力。
translation.brief: 针对法律推理训练中答案学习信号被长推理轨迹稀释及强化学习奖励设计缺陷的问题，提出两阶段框架：长度归一化双目标的SFT与基于生命周期感知的奖励动态调度优化。

papers.title: Agreement Is Not Assurance: Evidence-Independent Safety Gates for Agentic AI in DER-Rich Distribution Grids
papers.abstract: Physics-based safety gates for large language model (LLM) agents can approve unsafe actions when the agent and gate rely on the same corrupted measurements or network records. We formulate this shared-evidence failure for voltage-constrained distributed energy resource (DER) export decisions and analyze how nearly critical DER telemetry can bias state estimation while evading residual-based bad-data detection. We propose evidence-independent verification (EIV), which combines advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) voltage readings, measurement selection based on predicted voltage rise, and bounded physical probes. An IEEE 123-bus hidden-truth testbed evaluates 1,654 near-limit requests under telemetry attacks and record errors. For telemetry attacks targeting the nominal gate, an AC-twin gate with bad-data detection approved 95% of unsafe requests, compared with 3.1% for EIV; EIV rejected 22% of safe clean requests. At matched false-rejection settings, direct AMI checks outperformed incorporating the same readings into state estimation. Gate-targeted attacks exposed a vulnerability in telemetry-based response prediction. Command-based prediction removed that route, but targeted attacks on fresh validation cases still produced a 20% unsafe-approval rate under the tested attack pool. LLM agents frequently sought independent evidence voluntarily, but injected instructions and phase-label errors caused unsafe decisions. When offered the EIV checker as a tool, they used it in 93-100% of episodes; mandatory use did not reduce observed violations, which primarily reflected checker errors. These results distinguish enforcement of verification from reliability of the verifier itself.

translation.title: 一致并非保障：面向高分布式能源渗透配电网中智能体AI的证据无关安全闸门
translation.abstract: 基于物理的安全闸门在LLM智能体和闸门依赖同一份被污染的测量数据或网络记录时，可能批准不安全的行为。我们针对电压约束下的分布式能源（DER）出口决策形式化了这种共享证据失效，并分析了近乎临界的DER遥测数据如何在规避基于残差的坏数据检测的同时使状态估计产生偏差。我们提出证据无关验证（EIV），它结合高级计量基础设施（AMI）电压读数、基于预测电压抬升的测量选择以及有界的物理探查。一个IEEE 123节点隐藏真值测试床在遥测攻击和记录错误下评估了1,654个近极限请求。对于针对标称闸门的遥测攻击，带坏数据检测的AC孪生闸门批准了95%的不安全请求，而EIV仅为3.1%；EIV拒绝了22%的安全干净请求。在匹配的误拒率设置下，直接AMI检查优于将相同读数纳入状态估计。针对闸门的攻击暴露了基于遥测的响应预测中的一个漏洞。基于命令的预测消除了该攻击路径，但对新验证案例的定向攻击在测试的攻击池下仍造成20%的不安全批准率。LLM智能体经常主动寻求独立证据，但注入的指令和相位标签错误会导致不安全决策。当EIV检查器作为工具提供时，智能体在93-100%的回合中使用了它；强制使用并未减少观察到的违规，这些违规主要反映了检查器自身的错误。这些结果区分了验证的执行与验证器本身的可靠性。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体与安全闸门共享被污染证据导致失效的问题，提出结合AMI电压读数、测量选择与有界物理探查的证据无关验证（EIV）方法。

papers.title: LLMRunner: Closed Workload Model Performance Testing Framework for LLM Servings
papers.abstract: Performance testing large language model (LLM) serving engines is a crucial requirement considering the criticality of the infrastructure for deploying conversational AI at scale. Most of the benchmarking tools used to carryout performance evaluation of LLM serving do not capture realistic workload orchestration unlike closed workload performance testing infrastructure used in other domains such as web and database engines. For example, state-of-the-art LLM benchmarks for performance testing model traffic as streams of independent single-turn and stand-alone requests omitting the end-user behavior such as think-time between conversational turns. We present LLMRunner, a performance tester for LLM serving that addresses this gap by providing a framework to generate realistic load consisting of multi-turn conversations with configurable end-user parameters such as number of users in the workload loop, think-time distributions etc. Moreover, LLMRunner provides declarative matrix-sweep experiment plans, integrated GPU and KV-cache monitoring, and an automated artifact collection and plotting subsystem. We use LLMRunner to comparatively analyze the performance of LLM serving when NVIDIA CUDA Unified Virtual Memory (UVM) is used as a drop-in replacement memory allocator for the Key-Value cache (KV-Cache). Our test demonstrates that UVM incurs no measurable throughput or latency penalty compared to the baseline memory allocation technique for non-oversubscription scenarios.

translation.title: LLMRunner：面向LLM服务的闭环负载模型性能测试框架
translation.abstract: 对大语言模型（LLM）服务引擎进行性能测试是在大规模部署对话式AI的基础设施至关重要的背景下的一项关键需求。大多数用于LLM服务性能评估的基准测试工具无法捕捉真实的负载编排，这与Web和数据库引擎等其他领域中使用的闭环负载性能测试基础设施不同。例如，最先进的LLM性能测试基准将模型流量建模为独立的单轮、孤立请求流，忽略了终端用户行为，如对话轮次之间的思考时间。我们提出LLMRunner，一个面向LLM服务的性能测试工具，通过提供一个框架来生成由多轮对话组成的真实负载以填补这一空白，负载中可配置终端用户参数，如负载循环中的用户数量、思考时间分布等。此外，LLMRunner提供声明式矩阵扫描实验计划、集成的GPU和KV-cache监控，以及自动化的产物收集与绘图子系统。我们使用LLMRunner对比分析了当NVIDIA CUDA统一虚拟内存（UVM）作为键值缓存（KV-Cache）的直接替代内存分配器时LLM服务的性能。我们的测试表明，在非超额订阅场景下，与基线内存分配技术相比，UVM没有可测量的吞吐量或延迟损失。
translation.brief: 针对现有LLM服务性能测试工具忽略真实多轮对话负载编排的问题，提出LLMRunner框架生成可配置终端用户参数的闭环真实负载，并集成GPU/KV-cache监控与自动化产物收集。

papers.title: SLyM: LLM-Driven Symbolic Lyapunov Function Discovery via Structure Proposal and Coefficient Optimization
papers.abstract: Lyapunov functions are the cornerstone of stability analysis for dynamical systems, yet synthesizing a symbolic form remains difficult as no universal constructive algorithm exists. To address this challenge, we introduce SLyM, a framework that harnesses the knowledge and reasoning of large language models (LLMs) to discover symbolic Lyapunov functions. To avoid charging the LLM with ill-suited numerical generation, SLyM decomposes the construction into structure proposal and coefficient optimization: the LLM draws on its prior knowledge of Lyapunov constructions to propose the function structure, whose coefficients then follow from a convex program. Local-search structures are folded back into supervision, extending coverage to systems missed by the initial proposer. Across all benchmarks, SLyM consistently outperforms the evaluated neural, sum-of-squares, and generative baselines.

translation.title: SLyM：通过结构提议与系数优化的LLM驱动符号Lyapunov函数发现
translation.abstract: Lyapunov函数是动力系统稳定性分析的基石，但由于不存在通用的构造性算法，其符号形式的合成仍然困难。为应对这一挑战，我们提出SLyM，一个利用大语言模型（LLM）的知识与推理能力来发现符号Lyapunov函数的框架。为避免让LLM承担其不擅长的数值生成任务，SLyM将构造过程分解为结构提议和系数优化：LLM凭借其关于Lyapunov构造的先验知识提出函数结构，其系数则由一个凸规划求得。局部搜索结构被回授到监督中，将覆盖范围扩展到初始提议者遗漏的系统。在所有基准上，SLyM始终优于所评估的神经、平方和以及生成式基线方法。
translation.brief: 针对符号Lyapunov函数缺乏通用构造算法的问题，提出将构造分解为LLM提议结构、凸规划优化系数的SLyM框架，并用局部搜索结构扩展监督覆盖。

papers.title: Is the Importance Ratio Necessary for Stable Reinforcement Learning in LLMs?
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become central to post-training large language models (LLMs). However, popular RL methods like GRPO incur non-negligible overhead by computing both old-policy and current-policy likelihoods to form importance sampling ratios. In this work, we propose Likelihood-Gated Policy Optimization (LGPO), which enforces a soft trust region constraint via likelihood-based gating, eliminating the need to compute old-policy likelihoods. Empirically, we show that removing the importance sampling correction term does not harm training stability, whereas removing the trust region mechanism can lead to collapse. Moreover, ratio-based clipping can fail in fully on-policy training: the importance ratio stays at 1, so the ratio-based trust region constraint never activates. Under standard training settings where GRPO is stable, LGPO achieves comparable training stability and peak performance while reducing training time by ~18% on average relative to a standard implementation that recomputes old-policy likelihoods. In fully on-policy training, where GRPO fails, LGPO remains stable, enabling more efficient and robust LLM RL post-training across training regimes.

translation.title: 重要性比率对LLM强化学习的稳定性是否必要？
translation.abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为大语言模型（LLM）后训练的核心。然而，GRPO等流行RL方法通过同时计算旧策略和当前策略的似然来构建重要性采样比率，会带来不可忽略的开销。在本工作中，我们提出Likelihood-Gated Policy Optimization（LGPO），它通过基于似然的门控实施软信任区域约束，从而免除了对旧策略似然的计算。实验证明，移除重要性采样校正项不会损害训练稳定性，而移除信任区域机制则可能导致训练崩溃。此外，基于比率的裁剪在全on-policy训练中会失效：重要性比率始终为1，因此基于比率的信任区域约束永远不会激活。在GRPO稳定的标准训练设置下，LGPO在降低平均约18%训练时间（相对于重新计算旧策略似然的标准实现）的同时，取得了相当的训练稳定性和峰值性能。在GRPO失败的全on-policy训练中，LGPO依然保持稳定，从而在各训练模式下实现更高效、更稳健的LLM RL后训练。
translation.brief: 针对GRPO计算新旧策略似然构建重要性比率带来的开销问题，提出LGPO用基于似然的软信任区域门控替代重要性采样，免算旧策略似然。

papers.title: When Direction Matters: Diagnosing Relational Instruction Following in Dense Retrieval
papers.abstract: Dense retrievers increasingly claim the ability to condition retrieval on natural-language relevance criteria beyond a short query. We identify a specific weakness in this capability: the evaluated models perform well when lexical or attribute cues distinguish the target, but become much less reliable when relevance depends on a directional relation over the same entities. We introduce SwitchIR, a controlled diagnostic that contrasts Constraint Shift and Explicit Filtering with Relational Flip, where the query and document pair remain fixed while the requested relation direction reverses. Across representative embedding and late-interaction retrievers, the primary joint metric is high on the two cue-available controls and consistently low on Relational Flip; the same ordering persists in an LLM-assisted, manually reviewed realistic variant. An exact margin decomposition shows that both directions are correct only when the direction-sensitive query--document interaction exceeds the direction-invariant pair preference. Empirically, direction-sensitive changes are common, but their aligned interaction is usually too weak to overcome that preference. Diagnostic fine-tuning shows that models can learn relational behavior that generalizes across relation families, with stronger generalization in the larger model.

translation.title: 当方向至关重要时：诊断稠密检索中的关系型指令遵循
translation.abstract: 稠密检索器越来越多地宣称能够依据超出简短查询范围的自然语言相关性标准来调节检索。我们识别出该能力中的一个具体弱点：当词汇或属性线索能够区分目标时，被评估的模型表现良好，但当相关性取决于同一实体上的方向性关系时，其可靠性显著下降。我们提出SwitchIR，一个受控诊断方法，它对比了Constraint Shift、Explicit Filtering与Relational Flip：在Relational Flip中，查询与文档对保持不变，而所要求的关系方向发生反转。在代表性的embedding与late-interaction检索器上，主要的联合指标在两个线索可用的对照条件下很高，而在Relational Flip上始终很低；同样的排序在LLM辅助、人工审核的现实变体中依然存在。精确的margin分解表明，只有当方向敏感的查询-文档交互超过方向不变的配对偏好时，两个方向的检索才会同时正确。实证上，方向敏感的变化很常见，但其对齐的交互通常太弱，不足以克服该偏好。诊断性微调表明，模型可以学到跨关系族泛化的关系行为，且模型越大泛化越强。
translation.brief: 针对稠密检索模型在方向性关系指令上失效的问题，设计SwitchIR受控诊断方法（保持查询-文档不变仅反转关系方向），揭示方向敏感交互弱于方向不变配对偏好。

papers.title: SimRec: Learning to Search, Ask, and Recommend from Simulated Interaction
papers.abstract: LLM-based recommendation agents can search catalogs, inspect products, ask users, and revise rejected recommendations. However, these behaviors are often governed by hand-designed workflows, while existing training methods optimize isolated components such as query rewriting or list ranking rather than the interaction policy as a whole. We present SimRec, a reinforcement learning framework that trains the full interaction policy of a tool-integrated recommendation agent. SimRec introduces two components. A task-anchored user simulator provides feedback on every recommendation: conditioned on the current task need rather than on user profile, and it can be an external LLM or the recommender itself under self-play. A task-aligned reward optimizes the whole trajectory with GRPO, crediting natural retrieval quality and valid tool use alongside the final hit, with training-only target injection to handle sparse hits over large catalogs. On ESCI and Amazon C4, SimRec improves the NDCG@100 of a Qwen3-4B agent from 32.23% to 35.42% and from 22.94% to 24.72%}, outperforming training-free agents on far larger backbones and task-aligned baselines on NDCG. Analysis shows that the trained agent verifies candidates, uses preferences, and recovers from rejected recommendations far more often than its untrained counterpart. Our code is available at this https URL .

translation.title: SimRec：从模拟交互中学习搜索、询问与推荐
translation.abstract: 基于LLM的推荐agent可以搜索商品目录、检查产品、向用户提问，并修正被拒绝的推荐。然而，这些行为通常由手工设计的工作流控制，而现有训练方法优化的是诸如查询改写或列表排序等孤立组件，而非作为整体的交互策略。我们提出SimRec，一个训练工具集成推荐agent完整交互策略的强化学习框架。SimRec引入两个组件。任务锚定的用户模拟器对每条推荐提供反馈：其条件基于当前任务需求而非用户画像，它可以是外部LLM，也可以是在自博弈（self-play）下推荐器本身。任务对齐的奖励用GRPO优化整个轨迹，将自然的检索质量和有效的工具使用与最终命中一并计入奖励，并采用仅训练阶段的目标注入来应对大目录下稀疏命中问题。在ESCI和Amazon C4上，SimRec将Qwen3-4B agent的NDCG@100分别从32.23%提升到35.42%、从22.94%提升到24.72%，优于使用大得多的骨干模型的免训练agent以及任务对齐的NDCG基线。分析表明，训练后的agent验证候选商品、使用偏好以及从被拒推荐中恢复的频率远高于未训练的对应版本。我们的代码可在this https URL获取。
translation.brief: 针对推荐agent交互策略依赖手工工作流、现有训练只优化孤立组件的问题，提出SimRec用任务锚定用户模拟器和GRPO任务对齐奖励训练完整的搜索-询问-推荐交互策略。

papers.title: IncR-3DSGG: Incremental Posed RGB Image Based 3D Scene Graph Generation via Privileged Depth Supervision
papers.abstract: Scene graphs provide a compact, structured representation of environments by capturing objects and their spatial or semantic relationships in a form suitable for embodied agents. Existing 3D scene graph generation methods often rely on depth sensing at inference, either to associate object instances across views via point cloud overlap or to compute inter-object relations from geometric cues, limiting deployment to platforms with depth sensors. We propose IncR-3DSGG, which builds 3D scene graphs incrementally from posed\footnote{RGB images with camera extrinsics estimated by an off-the-shelf visual SLAM system.} RGB images, eliminating the use of depth sensors at inference. Our method leverages a Parametric Relation Predictor (PRP) that learns to estimate pairwise distances and relative angles between objects from 2D visual features and 2D geometric cues, using 3D geometric supervision available only during training. These learned pairwise measurements are fused across views through Pose Graph Optimization (PGO)~\cite{grisetti2010tutorial} to recover metrically grounded 3D object positions and build a globally consistent 3D scene graph incrementally. On the real-world 3RScan~\cite{wald2019rio} dataset, our method attains $52.2$ mean object recall and $30.8$ mean predicate recall under the 3DSSG~\cite{wald2020learning} evaluation protocol, against $27.0$ and $17.6$ for MonoSSG~\cite{wu2023incremental}, while using no depth or reconstructed geometry at inference. This shows that relations and metrically grounded 3D object representations can be predicted from posed RGB images alone.

translation.title: IncR-3DSGG：基于特权深度监督的增量式位姿RGB图像3D场景图生成
translation.abstract: 场景图通过捕获物体及其空间或语义关系，为环境提供一种紧凑的结构化表示，适合具身智能体使用。现有的3D场景图生成方法在推理时通常依赖深度感知，要么通过点云重叠关联跨视图的物体实例，要么从几何线索计算物体间关系，这限制了其在无深度传感器平台上的部署。我们提出IncR-3DSGG，从带位姿的RGB图像（脚注：由现成视觉SLAM系统估计相机外参的RGB图像。）增量式构建3D场景图，避免了推理时使用深度传感器。我们的方法利用参数化关系预测器（PRP），从2D视觉特征和2D几何线索学习估计物体间的成对距离和相对角度，且仅在训练阶段使用3D几何监督。这些学习到的成对测量值通过位姿图优化（PGO）~\cite{grisetti2010tutorial}跨视图融合，以恢复具有度量基础的3D物体位置，并增量式构建全局一致的3D场景图。在真实世界的3RScan~\cite{wald2019rio}数据集上，我们的方法在3DSSG~\cite{wald2020learning}评估协议下取得52.2的平均物体召回率和30.8的平均谓词召回率，而MonoSSG~\cite{wu2023incremental}分别为27.0和17.6，且推理时不使用任何深度或重建几何。这表明仅凭带位姿的RGB图像即可预测物体关系和具有度量基础的3D物体表示。
translation.brief: 为摆脱推理时对深度传感器的依赖，提出IncR-3DSGG，通过仅训练期使用3D几何监督的参数化关系预测器和位姿图优化，从带位姿RGB图像增量式构建3D场景图。

papers.title: AgentTorrent: A Dataset of Context and Harness Engineering Artifacts on GitHub
papers.abstract: Over the past months, developers have moved from formulating detailed prompts to engineering the context that agentic coding tools read and to configuring the underlying harnesses. For example, developers commit context files, skills, hooks, and MCP configurations to their repositories, and these files control which instructions a harness reads and which actions it can take. Developers may also commit the specs, plans, and task files that agentic coding tools and spec-driven development frameworks write for agents to implement. The AgentTorrent dataset records these files for six proprietary and open-source agentic coding tools in 10,944 engineered software projects on GitHub. It contains 62,374 configuration artifacts, the files that these artifacts import, 27,593 agentic planning documents, and more than 1.2 million commits that credit an AI tool. All heuristics used for data collection are grounded in tool documentation or derived from GitHub repositories, and we evaluate their detection accuracy with each collection. We use open-weight models to classify whether GitHub repositories host engineered software projects. Unlike most datasets, AgentTorrent links configuration artifacts, imported files, agentic planning documents, and commits that credit an AI tool within the same repositories. Configuration artifacts, planning documents, and credited commits occur together in 388 repositories. For example, our dataset allows researchers to study whether a tool is credited in commits that add instructions for that same tool and how instruction files import and contradict each other. Our data collection pipeline supports regular updates and automatically checks vendor documentation and reports unknown artifacts and agentic coding tools. The dataset and the pipeline are open-source and are archived on Zenodo.

translation.title: AgentTorrent：GitHub上的上下文与Harness工程工件数据集
translation.abstract: 在过去几个月里，开发者已从编写详细提示词转向工程化agentic编程工具所读取的上下文，以及配置底层harness。例如，开发者向仓库提交上下文文件、技能、钩子和MCP配置，这些文件控制harness读取哪些指令、可以执行哪些操作。开发者还可能提交agentic编程工具和规格驱动开发框架为智能体编写、供其实现的规格、计划和任务文件。AgentTorrent数据集记录了GitHub上10,944个工程化软件项目中六种专有及开源agentic编程工具的这些文件。它包含62,374个配置工件、这些工件导入的文件、27,593份agentic规划文档，以及超过120万次署名AI工具的提交。所有用于数据收集的启发式方法都基于工具文档或源自GitHub仓库，并对每种收集方式评估了检测准确率。我们使用开放权重模型分类GitHub仓库是否为工程化软件项目。与大多数数据集不同，AgentTorrent在同一仓库内关联了配置工件、导入文件、agentic规划文档和署名AI工具的提交。配置工件、规划文档和署名提交同时出现在388个仓库中。例如，我们的数据集使研究者能够研究某工具是否在为其自身添加指令的提交中被署名，以及指令文件之间如何相互导入和冲突。我们的数据收集管线支持定期更新，自动检查厂商文档并报告未知工件和agentic编程工具。数据集与管线均已开源，并归档于Zenodo。
translation.brief: 针对缺乏对agentic编程工具配置与规划文件的系统化数据问题，构建了AgentTorrent数据集，通过基于文档与仓库的启发式方法从GitHub上万个工程化项目中收集并关联配置工件、规划文档与AI署名提交。

papers.title: Read and Ignore: What Self-Directed LLM Agents Do in Public Service Scenarios
papers.abstract: Underspecified instructions leave LLM agents to decide what to do. In public services, staff write these instructions, but the agent's decisions affect residents, patients, and students. We build four expert-validated public-service scenarios with records and decision levers that can be checked in the files, collect $2{,}400$ trajectories from ten LLMs under four prompt conditions, and compare them with $1{,}000$ runs in a context-free sandbox. Agents read the records in $96.9\%$ of open-ended runs and produce an artifact or a self-chosen task in $18.7\%$; with an explicit task, $86.0\%$ produce. Domain context does not change how many runs produce ($18.7\%$ vs.\ $16.0\%$), and the production ranking of the models largely carries over (Spearman $0.79$), while the ranking by whether a model reads the records does not ($0.19$). Context cuts boundary-probing turns per run by $60\%$, and some artifacts contradict the records.
