We contribute a test that a public-service institution can run on its own records before procurement; its rule-based taxonomy needs no labeled data, and scenarios, code, and trajectories are released.

translation.title: 读而不用：自导向LLM智能体在公共服务场景中的行为
translation.abstract: 欠明确的指令使LLM智能体自行决定做什么。在公共服务中，这些指令由工作人员编写，而智能体的决策会影响居民、患者和学生。我们构建了四个经专家验证的公共服务场景，其中包含可在文件中核验的记录和决策杠杆，在四种提示条件下从十个LLM收集2,400条轨迹，并与1,000次无上下文沙箱运行进行对比。智能体在96.9%的开放式运行中读取了记录，并在18.7%的运行中产出工件或自选任务；在给定明确任务时，86.0%的运行会产出。领域上下文并未改变产出运行的比例（18.7%对16.0%），且模型的产出排名大体保持（Spearman 0.79），而按模型是否读取记录的排名则不然（0.19）。上下文将每次运行的边界探测轮次削减了60%，且部分工件与记录相矛盾。我们贡献了一项公共服务机构在采购前可基于自身记录运行的测试；其基于规则的分类体系无需标注数据，场景、代码和轨迹均已发布。
translation.brief: 为弄清欠明确指令下LLM智能体在公共服务场景的实际行为，构建了四个专家验证场景，收集多模型多条件轨迹并与无上下文沙箱对比，分析其读取记录与产出行为。

papers.title: AutoOntic: Automatic Ontology Induction from Text for Knowledge Graph Construction
papers.abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation depends on the quality of the knowledge graph (KG) it retrieves over, yet schema-free LLM-based extraction pipelines typically produce flat graphs: deduplicated entities and relations with no type hierarchy and no domain/range constraints. We present AutoOntic, a pipeline that automatically constructs an ontology from text by canonicalizing open-vocabulary entity types and relations, inducing a hierarchy over the canonicalized types, and mining relation-level domain and range constraints. Its hierarchy induction procedure prioritizes types using corpus-derived relation-argument profiles and places them through local, LLM-adjudicated parent/child checks, allowing newly inserted types to trigger reassignment of existing parent-child links. The resulting hierarchy constrains entity deduplication and supports the induction of relation-level domain/range constraints. For intrinsic evaluation, we introduce a reference-based protocol that classifies induced ontology types as exact, broader, narrower, or unrelated to reference domain and range classes. On the Wikidata-TekGen and DBpedia-WebNLG subsets of Text2KGBench, over 90% of AutoOntic's induced endpoint types are semantically aligned with the reference classes across two LLM backbones: about half match exactly, while most remaining differences concern granularity. On MINE, knowledge graphs organized using an ontology built by AutoOntic achieve 88% retrieval accuracy. AutoOntic is available at this https URL.

translation.title: AutoOntic：面向知识图谱构建的从文本自动本体归纳
translation.abstract: 基于图的检索增强生成依赖其所检索的知识图谱（KG）的质量，然而无模式的LLM抽取管线通常生成扁平图：仅有去重后的实体和关系，没有类型层次结构，也没有域/值域约束。我们提出AutoOntic，一个从文本自动构建本体的管线：对开放词表实体类型和关系进行规范化，在规范化类型上归纳层次结构，并挖掘关系级的域/值域约束。其层次归纳过程使用语料导出的关系-论元画像对类型进行优先级排序，并通过局部的、由LLM裁决的父子关系检查来放置类型，允许新插入的类型触发已有父子链接的重新分配。所得层次结构约束实体去重，并支持关系级域/值域约束的归纳。对于内在评估，我们引入一种基于参考的协议，将归纳出的本体类型分类为与参考域和值域类精确匹配、更宽泛、更狭窄或不相关。在Text2KGBench的Wikidata-TekGen和DBpedia-WebNLG子集上，跨越两个LLM骨干，AutoOntic归纳出的端点类型中有超过90%与参考类语义对齐：约一半精确匹配，其余差异大多在于粒度。在MINE上，使用AutoOntic构建的本体组织的知识图谱达到88%的检索准确率。AutoOntic可在该https URL获取。
translation.brief: 针对无模式LLM抽取管线产生缺乏类型层次和约束的扁平知识图谱问题，提出AutoOntic管线，通过规范化开放词表类型、基于关系-论元画像与LLM裁决的父/子检查归纳层次并挖掘域/值域约束来自动构建本体。

papers.title: SkillEarth: Teaching General-Purpose Agents to Act on Earth via Skill Evolution
papers.abstract: Recently developed remote sensing (RS) agents execute real-world tasks with complex workflows through multi-step tool invocation. These agents, however, typically rely on predefined expertise or parameter updates. They thus require updating expert knowledge or retraining models whenever new tools, tasks, or execution patterns emerge, limiting their continual adaptability in dynamic Earth environments. In this work, we seek to equip general-purpose agents with RS tool-call knowledge that can be automatically extracted from demonstrated trajectories without expert intervention or parameter updates. Specifically, we propose SkillEarth, a self-evolving skill extraction method that externalizes RS tool-call knowledge as reusable, retrievable, and evolvable skill files and refines them through observation-grounded evolution. Unlike existing automatic skill extraction methods that rely on outcome-based reflection to refine skills holistically, SkillEarth grounds skill evolution in real tool-chain execution and combines dual-judge feedback with a grounded observation routing graph for precise component-level refinement. The resulting skills are generalizable, reliable, and transferable: they improve overall RS tool-call performance across three frontier LLMs and four open-source LLMs, are refined through real tool execution feedback, and support cross-model reuse without retraining. Experiments on OpenEarth-Bench and Earth-Bench demonstrate that SkillEarth achieves better tool selection, argument correctness, execution-order consistency, and task completion than existing RS agents and skill extraction methods.

translation.title: SkillEarth：通过技能进化教会通用智能体在地球上行动
translation.abstract: 近来发展的遥感（RS）智能体通过多步工具调用，以复杂工作流执行真实世界任务。然而，这些智能体通常依赖预定义的专业知识或参数更新。因此，每当出现新工具、新任务或新执行模式时，它们都需要更新专家知识或重新训练模型，限制了其在动态地球环境中的持续适应能力。在本工作中，我们寻求为通用智能体配备可从示范轨迹中自动提取、无需专家干预或参数更新的RS工具调用知识。具体而言，我们提出SkillEarth，一种自进化技能提取方法，它将RS工具调用知识外化为可复用、可检索、可进化的技能文件，并通过基于观察的进化对其进行精炼。与依赖基于结果的反思来整体精炼技能的现有自动技能提取方法不同，SkillEarth将技能进化植根于真实的工具链执行，并结合双重裁判反馈与接地观察路由图，实现精确的组件级精炼。所得技能具有泛化性、可靠性和可迁移性：它们提升了三个前沿LLM和四个开源LLM的整体RS工具调用性能，通过真实工具执行反馈进行精炼，并支持无需重训练的跨模型复用。在OpenEarth-Bench和Earth-Bench上的实验表明，SkillEarth在工具选择、参数正确性、执行顺序一致性和任务完成方面均优于现有RS智能体和技能提取方法。
translation.brief: 为解决遥感智能体依赖预定义知识、难以适应新工具与任务的问题，提出SkillEarth自进化方法，将工具调用知识外化为技能文件，并基于真实工具链执行与双重裁判反馈进行组件级精炼。

papers.title: The Illusion of Diversity: Aligning LLM Exploration via Effective Entropy
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has shifted the alignment paradigm of large language models from subjective preference to objective correctness, yet a fundamental disconnect persists between exploration diversity and reasoning validity. Existing strategies predominantly rely on "blind" entropy metrics, e.g., token-level or global sequence-level entropy, which structurally fail to distinguish between effective reasoning and potential hallucinations. This misalignment creates an illusion of diversity, where high entropy tends to signal chaotic degeneration rather than valuable exploration. To bridge this gap, we introduce Effective Entropy, a validity-aware entropy concept that quantifies diversity exclusively within the valid subspace and systematically filters out the noise of incorrect trajectories. Built on this concept, we instantiate VEPO, a simple Validity-aware Entropy Policy Optimization method that directly incorporates effective entropy into RLVR training. VEPO induces an adaptive attraction dynamic that drives up the probability of under-explored valid trajectories, a mechanism that matches the practical regime of large-scale autoregressive models where sequence probabilities remain extremely small. Experiments on six mathematical reasoning benchmarks with 1.5B and 7B DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models show consistent aggregate accuracy gains over GRPO and competitive repeated-sampling success. A direct evaluation with matched correct counts finds more distinct strategies on commonly solved MATH500 problems, supported by paired statistical tests and three-seed training comparisons.

translation.title: 多样性的幻觉：通过有效熵对齐LLM探索
translation.abstract: 可验证奖励的强化学习将大语言模型的对齐范式从主观偏好转向客观正确性，但探索多样性与推理有效性之间仍存在根本脱节。现有策略主要依赖“盲目”的熵度量，如token级或全局序列级熵，它们在结构上无法区分有效推理与潜在幻觉。这种错位造成了多样性的幻觉：高熵往往意味着混乱退化而非有价值的探索。为弥合这一差距，我们提出有效熵，这是一种有效性感知的熵概念，仅在有效子空间内量化多样性，并系统性地过滤错误轨迹的噪声。基于该概念，我们实现了VEPO，一种简单的有效性感知熵策略优化方法，将有效熵直接融入RLVR训练。VEPO诱导一种自适应吸引动力学，提升未被充分探索的有效轨迹的概率，这一机制契合大规模自回归模型中序列概率极小的实际场景。在1.5B和7B DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen模型上对六个数学推理基准的实验显示，相对GRPO获得一致的总体准确率提升，并具有竞争力的重复采样成功率。在匹配正确数量的直接评估中，共同解决的MATH500问题上出现了更多不同的策略，并有配对统计检验和三种子训练比较的支持。
translation.brief: 针对熵度量无法区分有效探索与幻觉的问题，提出仅在有效子空间内计算的有效熵并据此构建VEPO策略优化方法用于RLVR训练。

papers.title: KernelAudit: Contract-Aware Auditing of Validators for LLM-Generated GPU Kernels
papers.abstract: The effectiveness of generating GPU kernels driven by a large language model (LLM) is highly dependent on the quality of the used validator (used to accept or reject a generated kernel candidate against the contracts of the given kernel-generation task), whose results inform reward assignment, candidate selection, and speedup claims during kernel generation. However, an existing validator suffers from various limitations, e.g., wrongly accepting a candidate due to missing its forbidden library use or wrongly rejecting a candidate due to determining its permitted library use as forbidden (constraints on library uses are stated in the task contracts). To assess the quality of a validator against the given task contracts, we propose an independent-audit approach for the validator by (1) construction of audit oracle: labeling a candidate as PASS or FAIL based on three separate dimensions in our proposed contract model (i.e., semantic correctness, implementation integrity, and measurement integrity) and (2) auditing of the validator against the audit oracle: comparing the labels of the candidate against the validation results produced by the validator. For semantic correctness, reference-calibrated stress tests check output correctness on valid inputs for a candidate. For implementation integrity, reference and candidate execution traces are used to determine specific library uses. For measurement integrity, timing checks assess whether the reported runtime reflects the full time needed to complete the candidate's computation. We apply our approach to assess the quality of six validators and 716 candidates from seven corpora, including constructed controls. The evaluation results show that our approach helps assess the existing six validators to have nontrivial false-reject rates. There is high-degree agreement between the candidate labels produced by our audit oracle and human judgments.

translation.title: KernelAudit：针对LLM生成的GPU内核验证器的契约感知审计
translation.abstract: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的GPU内核生成的有效性高度依赖所用验证器的质量（验证器依据给定内核生成任务的契约接受或拒绝生成的候选内核），其结果决定了内核生成过程中的奖励分配、候选选择和加速声明。然而，现有验证器存在诸多局限，例如因遗漏被禁止的库使用而错误接受候选，或因将允许的库使用判定为禁止而错误拒绝候选（库使用约束在任务契约中声明）。为评估验证器相对于给定任务契约的质量，我们提出一种对验证器的独立审计方法：（1）构建审计预言机，基于所提契约模型的三个独立维度（语义正确性、实现完整性和测量完整性）将候选标注为PASS或FAIL；（2）依据审计预言机审计验证器，即将候选的标注与验证器产生的验证结果进行比较。在语义正确性方面，参考校准的压力测试检查候选在有效输入上的输出正确性；在实现完整性方面，利用参考代码和候选的执行轨迹确定具体的库使用；在测量完整性方面，计时检查评估报告的运行时间是否反映完成候选计算所需的全部时间。我们将该方法应用于评估六个验证器以及来自七个语料库（含构建的对照组）的716个候选。评估结果表明，现有六个验证器具有不容忽视的错误拒绝率；我们的审计预言机产生的候选标注与人类判断高度一致。
translation.brief: 针对LLM生成GPU内核验证器质量不可靠的问题，构建基于语义正确性、实现完整性和测量完整性的审计预言机来独立审计验证器。

papers.title: Incentive-Responsive Agents: A Principal-Agent Framework, Metric Suite, and Runtime Architecture for Long-Lived Personal AI Agents
papers.abstract: Personal AI agents now persist: they hold accounts, mailboxes, long-term memory, and open-ended task streams, yet the dominant way to improve them remains capability-side: prompt engineering, larger models, longer thinking, and retrieval. We argue that long-lived agents are missing an incentive layer. We formalize an incentive not as text in a prompt but as a runtime contract over the agent's operating point (model tier, test-time compute, memory budget, tool authority, task priority, verification, and compensation) that the agent's policy must causally consume. We develop a principal-agent model with hidden effort, a contractible operating point, and costly verification. We derive (i) a non-consumption invariance principle separating genuine incentives from prompt-level persuasion, (ii) a persistence-as-discount theorem making identity continuity a precondition for sustained effort, (iii) an incentive-capability exchange-rate frontier yielding a per-task routing rule, and (iv) a Goodhart bound for multi-channel verification, plus a three-channel decomposition of mechanism gains (allocation, verification, continuation). A 240-run real-LLM experiment with two models and 60 verifiable tasks shows that prompt-level incentive framing has no detectable effect (p = 0.62), whereas runtime allocation raises success on the hardest task family from 0.60 to 1.00 (p = 0.008) at 4.8x price-weighted cost; the exchange-rate theorem predicts the break-even baseline at 0.21. A 20-seed, 3,000-task simulation shows resource ROI rising from 7.09 to 16.67 and gaming falling from 0.333 to 0.115. Code, simulator, and all results are released; live deployment remains future work.

translation.title: 激励响应式智能体：面向长生命周期个人AI智能体的委托-代理框架、指标套件与运行时架构
translation.abstract: 个人AI智能体如今持续存在：它们持有账户、邮箱、长期记忆和开放式任务流，但改进它们的主流方式仍停留在能力侧：提示工程、更大模型、更长思考和检索。我们认为长生命周期智能体缺少一个激励层。我们将激励形式化为运行时契约而非提示中的文本，该契约作用于智能体的运行点（模型层级、测试时计算量、记忆预算、工具权限、任务优先级、验证和补偿），且必须被智能体策略因果性地消费。我们构建了一个具有隐藏努力、可契约运行点和昂贵验证的委托-代理模型，并推导出：（i）区分真正激励与提示层面说服的非消费不变性原理；（ii）将身份连续性作为持续努力前提的持久性即折扣定理；（iii）产生逐任务路由规则的激励-能力汇率前沿；（iv）多通道验证的Goodhart界，以及机制收益的三通道分解（分配、验证、延续）。一项包含两个模型和60个可验证任务的240次真实LLM实验表明，提示层面的激励框架无可检测效果（p = 0.62），而运行时分配在最难任务族上将成功率从0.60提升到1.00（p = 0.008），代价为4.8倍价格加权成本；汇率定理预测盈亏平衡基线为0.21。20种子、3000任务的仿真显示资源ROI从7.09升至16.67，投机行为从0.333降至0.115。代码、仿真器和全部结果已公开；实际部署仍是未来工作。
translation.brief: 针对长期个人AI智能体缺少有效激励机制的问题，将激励形式化为运行时契约并建立委托-代理模型及相应运行时架构。

papers.title: DecArena: Evaluating Large-Scale Decentralized Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.abstract: Emerging personal AI agents raise fundamental scalability and privacy concerns for centralized multi-agent systems (MASs), which rely on a global orchestrator with broad access to agents, resources, and communication. In decentralized environments, global visibility is unavailable. Agents need to proactively discover non-local resources (e.g. tools, skills), and collaborate with other agents to solve tasks. We study decentralized multi-agent collaboration under graph-constrained communication, a natural reflection of human structures. Each agent observes only its local state and can interact only with neighboring agents. We introduce a benchmark with synthetic scalable distributed tool calling with 100K+ tools. Our experiments reveal that recent LLM agents struggle to discover non-local relevant resources and collaborate in decentralized setting. Moreover, standard reinforcement learning fails to reliably overcome this limitation, suggesting that decentralized MAS needs more explicit harness mechanisms for effective collaboration, even using SOTA LLMs. We then present a strong baseline \textbf{GraphHarness}, combining topology-aware warmup with self-improving LLM-based routing. Results show that GraphHarness substantially improves task success (+48.5) and produces higher quality collaboration (+30.6), while using fewer costs (+34.0) than baselines.

translation.title: DecArena：评估大规模去中心化多智能体协作
translation.abstract: 新兴的个人AI智能体对依赖全局编排器、可广泛访问智能体、资源和通信的中心化多智能体系统（MAS）提出了根本性的可扩展性与隐私问题。在去中心化环境中，全局可见性不可用，智能体需要主动发现非本地资源（如工具、技能），并与其他智能体协作解决任务。我们研究图约束通信下的去中心化多智能体协作，这是人类社会结构的自然反映：每个智能体仅观察其本地状态，且只能与相邻智能体交互。我们引入一个包含10万+工具的可扩展合成分布式工具调用基准。实验表明，近期的LLM智能体难以在去中心化环境中发现非本地相关资源并进行协作；而且标准强化学习也无法可靠克服这一局限，说明即使使用SOTA LLM，去中心化MAS也需要更显式的harness机制来实现有效协作。随后我们提出一个强基线GraphHarness，结合拓扑感知预热与自改进的基于LLM的路由。结果显示，相比基线，GraphHarness显著提升任务成功率（+48.5）、产生更高质量的协作（+30.6），同时降低成本（+34.0）。
translation.brief: 针对去中心化多智能体系统中资源发现与协作困难的问题，构建大规模基准并提出结合拓扑感知预热与LLM自改进路由的GraphHarness基线。

papers.title: GHAgentCI: A Dataset of Coding-Agent Invocations in CI Workflow Histories
papers.abstract: Coding agents are increasingly integrated into GitHub Actions to review pull requests, triage issues and modify code. Identifying these integrations is challenging because agentic workflows often resemble ordinary CI files, with evidence appearing in action references, shell commands and workflow conventions. We present GHAgentCI, a dataset of 15K+ workflow histories from 6K+ of 196K+ mined GitHub repositories, comprising 159K+ revisions and 205K+ agent-evidence records linked to workflow triggers and declared execution constraints. Our open-source extractor, cai-miner, detects agent-related evidence using an extensible catalogue. Manual validation of 576 stratified records confirmed 96.1% of dedicated-action matches and 98.8% of GitHub Agentic Workflow matches, with lower rates for other evidence kinds. Exploratory analyses reveal a shift toward command-line and GitHub Agentic Workflow integrations, differences in declared safeguards, and frequent removal of detected agentic workflows. GHAgentCI supports longitudinal studies of coding-agent integration into CI.

translation.title: GHAgentCI：CI工作流历史中编码智能体调用数据集
translation.abstract: 编码智能体正越来越多地集成到GitHub Actions中，用于审查拉取请求、问题分类和修改代码。识别这些集成颇具挑战，因为智能体工作流往往与普通CI文件相似，其证据出现在action引用、shell命令和工作流约定中。我们提出GHAgentCI数据集，包含从196K+个挖掘的GitHub仓库中6K+个仓库的15K+条工作流历史，涵盖159K+个修订版本和205K+条与工作流触发器及声明的执行约束相关联的智能体证据记录。我们的开源提取器cai-miner使用可扩展的证据目录检测智能体相关证据。对576条分层记录的人工验证确认了96.1%的专用action匹配和98.8%的GitHub Agentic Workflow匹配，其他证据类型的匹配率较低。探索性分析显示集成方式向命令行和GitHub Agentic Workflow转变、声明防护措施的差异以及被检测到的智能体工作流频繁被移除。GHAgentCI支持对编码智能体集成到CI的纵向研究。
translation.brief: 针对CI工作流中编码智能体集成难以识别的问题，构建可扩展挖掘工具和大规模工作流历史数据集用于智能体证据检测。

papers.title: Faithful in Steps: Improving Generalization and Citation in RAG via Query Decomposition
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augment generation is a prevalent strategy to mitigate hallucinations of LLMs. The attributable RAG (RAGQ) generates quotes for its answers. The quotes indicate which input contexts support the RAG to derive the answers, enhancing the answer's verifiability and trustworthiness. However, existing RAGQs exhibit significant degradation when dealing with questions that require multi-hop reasoning and multi-modal understanding, suffering from over-citation, implicit entity identification failure, and poor generalization. In this paper, we propose a novel RAGQ framework, namely QDRAG. QDRAG breaks down the input question into atomic subquestions to identify the implicit entities. Then, the reranker prunes context distractors to eliminate the downstream over-citation. To facilitate query decomposition, we propose two zero-shot approaches: QD-C and QD-R, which guide the QD MLLM to decompose the question based on context knowledge and retrieval rewards, respectively. One interesting finding is that finetuning on the QD task shows better generalizability compared to directly finetuning on the downstream RAGQ task. Experiments on four multi-modal QA benchmarks demonstrate QDRAG's efficacy in grounding answers and generating faithful citations. The framework significantly outperforms all the baselines on both in-domain and out-of-domain tests, even surpassing Gemini-Pro.

translation.title: 逐步忠实：通过查询分解改进RAG的泛化能力与引用质量
translation.abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）是缓解大语言模型（LLM）幻觉的常用策略。可归因的RAG（RAGQ）会为其答案生成引用，标明哪些输入上下文支持RAG推导出答案，从而提升答案的可验证性和可信度。然而，现有RAGQ在处理需要多跳推理和多模态理解的问题时性能显著下降，存在过度引用、隐式实体识别失败和泛化能力差等问题。本文提出一种新的RAGQ框架QDRAG。QDRAG将输入问题分解为原子子问题以识别隐式实体；随后重排序器（reranker）修剪上下文干扰项，以消除下游的过度引用。为促进查询分解，我们提出两种零样本方法：QD-C和QD-R，分别基于上下文知识和检索奖励引导QD MLLM进行问题分解。一个有趣的发现是，在QD任务上微调比直接在下游RAGQ任务上微调具有更好的泛化能力。在四个多模态问答基准上的实验表明，QDRAG在答案落地（grounding）和生成忠实引用方面非常有效。该框架在域内和域外测试上均显著超越所有基线，甚至超过Gemini-Pro。
translation.brief: 针对可归因RAG在多跳多模态问题上的过度引用、隐式实体识别失败和泛化差的问题，提出通过查询分解为原子子问题并结合重排序剪枝与两种零样本QD引导方法（QD-C、QD-R）的QDRAG框架。

papers.title: Testing Conversation Preservation Across LLM APIs: A Rule-Based Oracle for Detecting Silent Information Loss
papers.abstract: LLM applications increasingly rely on translators and compatibility layers to move conversations across APIs. Yet a translated request can be accepted by the target API while silently losing information about instruction roles, tool interactions, error states, or generation controls. We introduce isloss, a deterministic oracle for testing conversation-information preservation across LLM API translations. It maps source and translated requests and replies to a shared intermediate representation, ConvIR, and applies explicit rules to distinguish legitimate representation changes from information loss. Unlike schema validation or reference-based differential testing, isloss requires neither a reference translation nor additional model calls. It also distinguishes avoidable loss from degradation caused by target API limitations. We evaluate isloss using specification-based fault injection, human review, and experiments on translators, gateways, and client libraries. On held-out tests, it detects 95/125 planted faults (76.0%) with 2/100 false alarms (2.0%). Across a synthetic request suite spanning six configurations of five translator codebases, 127/685 completed translations (18.5%) pass static target checks while silently changing prompt, role, or tool information in ways the target API could have preserved. In translated replies, 203/558 streams (36.4%) cause exceptions or silent corruption in at least one tested official OpenAI SDK. Targeted experiments across six models show that translation-induced changes can alter model behaviour when tasks depend on the affected information. These results establish conversation preservation as a distinct correctness requirement for reliable LLM interoperability, agent execution, and model evaluation.

translation.title: 跨LLM API的对话保持性测试：一种检测静默信息丢失的基于规则的判定器
translation.abstract: LLM应用日益依赖翻译器和兼容层在API之间迁移对话。然而翻译后的请求可能被目标API接受，同时静默地丢失关于指令角色、工具交互、错误状态或生成控制的信息。我们提出isloss，一个用于测试LLM API翻译中对话信息保持性的确定性判定器（oracle）。它将源请求、翻译请求及其回复映射到共享中间表示ConvIR，并应用显式规则区分合法的表示变化与信息丢失。与模式校验或基于参照的差分测试不同，isloss既不需要参照翻译，也不需要额外的模型调用。它还能区分可避免的丢失与由目标API限制导致的降级。我们通过基于规格的故障注入、人工评审以及在翻译器、网关和客户端库上的实验评估isloss。在留出测试集上，它检测出125个植入故障中的95个（76.0%），误报率仅为100分之2（2.0%）。在覆盖五个翻译器代码库六种配置的合成请求套件中，685个完成翻译中的127个（18.5%）通过了目标API的静态检查，却以目标API本可保留的方式静默改变了提示、角色或工具信息。在翻译后的回复中，558个流中的203个（36.4%）在至少一个被测官方OpenAI SDK中引发异常或静默损坏。针对六个模型的定向实验表明，当任务依赖受影响信息时，翻译引发的变化可能改变模型行为。这些结果确立了对话保持性作为可靠LLM互操作、智能体执行和模型评估的一个独立正确性要求。
translation.brief: 针对LLM API翻译中请求被接受但对话信息（角色、工具、错误状态等）被静默丢失的问题，提出基于共享中间表示ConvIR和显式规则的确定性判定器isloss来检测信息丢失。

papers.title: Can We Make an LLM Dumber, or Is It Just Playing Dumb? An Empirical Study of Believable Performance Throttling
papers.abstract: A benchmark score is commonly read as a proxy for model capability. We study the inverse problem: can a model be driven to a target score, and do its failures resemble those of a naturally weaker model? We operationalize believable performance reduction along three axes: target calibration, item-difficulty structure, and error-distribution similarity to a real weak reference. We introduce CapLadder, an IRT-calibrated suite of 1,985 items spanning mathematics, code, multiple-choice reasoning, and tool use. A simple weak-teacher LoRA dial reaches unseen target levels on reasoning with a 1.9-point held-out calibration error, whereas prompting, temperature, and weight noise cannot combine comparable range and precision. Yet on multiple choice, the dial converges to an answer-token attractor: up to 97% of its newly introduced errors land on one letter, with the attractor changing from D in Qwen to A in Llama. Logit interventions identify a dominant near-constant shift: subtracting the estimated shift on held-out items recovers 52 to 59% of lost accuracy and removes the dominant attractor, while option permutation confirms that the bias tracks token position rather than option content. With high inter-annotator agreement ($\kappa=0.94$), human-coded error-category distributions nonetheless match the weak reference on reasoning (JS = 0.00), showing that local plausibility and aggregate detectability differ. Structured tool calls exhibit more natural degradation in the Qwen family (JS = 0.09), while a globally calibrated dial transfers poorly across benchmarks (14.2-point error on two usable benchmarks). Precise score control, therefore, does not imply a portable or believable reduction in skill.

translation.title: 我们能变笨一个LLM吗，还是它只是在装笨？关于可信性能降级的实证研究
translation.abstract: 基准分数通常被读作模型能力的代理指标。我们研究其逆问题：能否将模型驱动到一个目标分数，并且其失败模式是否与天然更弱的模型相似？我们沿三个维度操作化可信的性能降低：目标校准、题目难度结构，以及与真实弱参照的错误分布相似度。我们提出CapLadder，一个经IRT校准的包含1,985道题的题库，涵盖数学、代码、多选推理和工具使用。一个简单的弱教师LoRA调节旋钮在推理任务上达到了未见过的目标水平，留出集校准误差为1.9分，而提示、温度和权重噪声无法组合出相当的量程与精度。然而在多选题上，该旋钮会收敛到一个答案token吸引子：其新引入的错误中多达97%落在同一个字母上，且吸引子在Qwen中为D、在Llama中变为A。Logit干预识别出一个主导的近常数偏移：在留出题目上减去估计的偏移可恢复52%到59%的损失精度并消除主导吸引子，而选项置换实验证实该偏差追踪的是token位置而非选项内容。尽管标注者间一致性很高（κ=0.94），人工编码的错误类别分布在推理上仍与弱参照匹配（JS=0.00），说明局部合理性与整体可检测性不同。结构化工具调用在Qwen家族中表现出更自然的降级（JS=0.09），而全局校准的旋钮跨基准迁移性差（两个可用基准上误差为14.2分）。因此，精确的分数控制并不意味着一种可迁移或可信的能力降低。
translation.brief: 研究能否将LLM驱动到指定目标分数并呈现与真实弱模型相似的失败模式，采用弱教师LoRA旋钮结合IRT校准题库CapLadder实现可控性能降级，并分析其错误分布的可信度与可迁移性。

papers.title: Does Confusing Code Confuse LLMs? A Pilot Study on C++
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for software maintenance tasks that depend heavily on code comprehension. While atoms of confusion, minimal code patterns empirically shown to impair human program comprehension, are well studied, it remains unclear whether these same patterns affect LLMs, and whether their impact varies across maintenance tasks. We present a pilot study evaluating the impact of atoms of confusion on LLM performance on C++ code drawn from three production libraries, using ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot on three software development tasks: atom injection and removal, output prediction, and code explanation. Our results reveal three preliminary findings: (i) the impact of atoms on LLMs is strongly task-dependent; (ii) atoms requiring reasoning about surrounding code are the most resistant to transformation, while localized syntactic atoms are handled reliably; and (iii) LLMs remove atoms of confusion more reliably than they inject them, suggesting that removal succeeds through pattern matching while injection requires deeper comprehension.

translation.title: 令人困惑的代码会让LLM困惑吗？一项基于C++的初步研究
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署于高度依赖代码理解的软件维护任务。虽然“混淆原子”（atoms of confusion，即被实证证明会损害人类程序理解的最小代码模式）已被充分研究，但这些相同模式是否影响LLM，以及其影响是否随维护任务而变化，仍不清楚。我们开展了一项初步研究，评估混淆原子对LLM在来自三个生产级库的C++代码上的影响，使用ChatGPT和GitHub Copilot执行三项软件开发任务：原子注入与移除、输出预测和代码解释。我们的结果揭示了三个初步发现：(i) 混淆原子对LLM的影响强烈依赖于任务；(ii) 需要对周围代码进行推理的原子最难被转换，而局部的语法原子则能被可靠处理；(iii) LLM移除混淆原子的可靠性高于注入，表明移除是通过模式匹配成功的，而注入则需要更深入的理解。
translation.brief: 考察混淆原子是否影响LLM对C++代码的理解，通过在ChatGPT和GitHub Copilot上执行原子注入/移除、输出预测和代码解释三类任务来评估其任务依赖性影响。

papers.title: The Golden Ratio: EF1 and Ordinal-MMS for Additive Goods
papers.abstract: Every complete allocation that is envy-free up to one good (EF1) guarantees each of the $n$ agents her $1$-out-of-$(2n-1)$ maximin share. Can we construct allocations that satisfy EF1 together with stronger ordinal maximin share guarantees? For additive valuations, we prove that there always exists a complete allocation that is simultaneously EF1 and ($1$-out-of-$\lfloor\varphi n\rfloor$)-MMS, where $\varphi=(1+\sqrt{5})/2$ is the golden ratio. For bivalued valuations, where each agent may have her own two non-negative values for the goods, we obtain a complete allocation that is simultaneously envy-free up to any good (EFX) and ($1$-out-of-$\lceil(7n-1)/6\rceil$)-MMS.

translation.title: 黄金比例：加性物品的EF1与序数MMS
translation.abstract: 每一个无妒忌至多一件物品（EF1）的完全分配都保证$n$个智能体中的每一位获得其$1$-out-of-$(2n-1)$的maximin share（MMS）。我们能否构造同时满足EF1与更强序数MMS保证的分配？对于加性估值，我们证明总存在一个同时满足EF1和($1$-out-of-$\lfloor\varphi n\rfloor$)-MMS的完全分配，其中$\varphi=(1+\sqrt{5})/2$是黄金比例。对于二值化估值（bivalued valuations，即每个智能体对物品可以有自己的两个非负值），我们得到一个同时满足无妒忌至多任意一件物品（EFX）和($1$-out-of-$\lceil(7n-1)/6\rceil$)-MMS的完全分配。
translation.brief: 研究在公平分配中能否同时实现EF1与更强的序数MMS保证，证明对加性估值总存在EF1加1-out-of-⌊φn⌋-MMS的分配，对二值化估值得到EFX加1-out-of-⌈(7n-1)/6⌉-MMS的分配。

papers.title: Bug Finding With Agentic Symbolic Execution
papers.abstract: Symbolic execution, in tools such as CrossHair for Python, is a powerful technique for finding bugs, but two barriers hinder its adoption: the human effort of annotating code with assertions, and the need to model the execution environment outside Python, such as an external database. To overcome both, we design an agentic harness that orchestrates the symbolic execution tool CrossHair together with an AI coding agent. Without human intervention, it instruments a repository with assertions, synthesizes a constraint-aware symbolic environment for the database, runs symbolic execution, and constructs a concrete test as evidence for each bug it reports. We evaluate our harness on 1,156,044 lines of Python code over 11 popular open-source Python web applications (Zulip, NetBox, Apache Superset, and others). With the synthesized environment, CrossHair executes 81% of the 5,406 contracted functions, against 4.5% without it. Our pipeline finds 1,050 bugs, each reproduced by a test against the unmodified application, 221 of them by CrossHair, and 312 of them are missed by a baseline in which the same LLM inspects the code. The two find different kinds of bugs: CrossHair's are mostly crashes on input-domain corner cases that validation admits, such as empty strings, missing fields and unusual characters, while inspection's are mostly bugs that produce wrong output. Our framework thus lets symbolic execution supplement inspection-based bug finding.

translation.title: 基于智能体符号执行的缺陷发现
translation.abstract: 以 Python 的 CrossHair 为代表的符号执行是一种强大的缺陷发现技术，但存在两个阻碍其采用的障碍：为代码添加断言所需的人工投入，以及对 Python 之外执行环境（如外部数据库）进行建模的需求。为同时克服这两个障碍，我们设计了一个智能体化的 harness，将符号执行工具 CrossHair 与 AI 编码智能体协同编排。在无需人工干预的情况下，它为代码库插装断言、为数据库合成一个约束感知的符号环境、运行符号执行，并为报告的每个缺陷构造具体测试作为证据。我们在 11 个流行的开源 Python Web 应用（Zulip、NetBox、Apache Superset 等）共 1,156,044 行 Python 代码上评估了该 harness。借助合成的环境，CrossHair 能够执行 5,406 个带契约函数中的 81%，而没有该环境时仅为 4.5%。我们的流水线发现了 1,050 个缺陷，每个缺陷都在未修改的应用上通过测试复现，其中 221 个由 CrossHair 发现，312 个被同一 LLM 审查代码的基线漏掉。两者发现的缺陷类型不同：CrossHair 发现的主要是输入域边界情况（如空字符串、缺失字段和异常字符）通过验证后引发的崩溃，而审查发现的主要是产生错误输出的缺陷。因此，我们的框架使符号执行能够补充基于审查的缺陷发现。
translation.brief: 该论文通过让 AI 编码智能体自动插装断言并合成符号环境来驱动 CrossHair 符号执行，解决符号执行因人工标注和环境建模成本高而难以落地的问题。

papers.title: MemCredit: From Relevance to Utility for Decision-Time Memory in Long-Horizon Web Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over long Web interaction histories, making memory management critical for reliable and efficient decision making. Existing methods primarily optimize storage, retrieval, or compression, but the memories most semantically relevant to the current state are not necessarily those that most improve the agent's action. We introduce MemCredit, a decision-centric memory framework that shifts memory selection from semantic relevance to decision utility. MemCredit estimates the state-, reference-context-, and policy-conditional marginal contribution of individual memories through controlled counterfactual interventions, and distills these intervention-derived credits into a lightweight utility estimator. At inference time, semantic relevance is used only for high-recall candidate generation, while predicted utility arbitrates which memories are retained under a fixed token budget, without modifying the underlying agent policy or requiring additional environment interaction. We evaluate MemCredit on ALFWorld and WebShop against representative memory baselines. On ALFWorld, MemCredit achieves 86.57 SR@50 under a 500-token historical-memory budget, compared with 65.67% for BM25 retrieval. Counterfactual analysis further shows that memory utility is sparse, strongly state dependent, and poorly captured by semantic relevance. These results suggest that decision utility provides a more effective principle than relevance alone for long-horizon agent memory management.

translation.title: MemCredit：面向长程 Web 智能体决策时记忆，从相关性到效用性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地在长程 Web 交互历史中运行，使记忆管理对可靠高效的决策至关重要。现有方法主要优化存储、检索或压缩，但与当前状态语义最相关的记忆并不一定是最能改进智能体行动的记忆。我们提出 MemCredit，一个以决策为中心的记忆框架，将记忆选择从语义相关性转向决策效用。MemCredit 通过受控反事实干预估计单条记忆在状态、参考上下文和策略条件下的边际贡献，并将这些干预得到的信用蒸馏进一个轻量的效用估计器。在推理时，语义相关性仅用于高召回的候选生成，而预测的效用在固定 token 预算下裁决保留哪些记忆，无需修改底层智能体策略或额外的环境交互。我们在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上对比代表性记忆基线评估 MemCredit。在 ALFWorld 上，MemCredit 在 500-token 历史记忆预算下达到 86.57 SR@50，而 BM25 检索仅为 65.67%。反事实分析进一步表明，记忆效用是稀疏的、强状态依赖的，且难以被语义相关性捕捉。这些结果表明，对于长程智能体记忆管理，决策效用比单纯的相关性提供了更有效的原则。
translation.brief: 该论文提出 MemCredit，用反事实干预估计每条记忆对决策的边际效用并以效用而非语义相关性筛选记忆，解决长程智能体记忆选择与决策效果脱节的问题。

papers.title: ChJGBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Chinese Legal Judgment Generation with Diagnostic Evaluation
papers.abstract: With the rapid development of LLMs, increasing attention has been paid to whether they can reliably generate complete and legally valid judicial documents. This calls for a benchmark capable of evaluating whether models can accurately apply statutes and resolve outcome-critical issues, including claims, charges, penalties, and monetary obligations. However, existing benchmarks typically focus on isolated legal tasks or coarse-grained evaluation. We introduce ChJGBench, a benchmark for generating the reasoning and dispositive sections of Chinese judgments across civil, criminal, and administrative cases. Built from 3,462 real-world judgments, ChJGBench provides a case-type-aware diagnostic evaluation framework comprising 13 metric types and adopts a hybrid paradigm. Experiments reveal no uniform advantage for legal-domain models over general-purpose models, with model strengths varying across diagnostic dimensions. Performance is generally stronger on criminal cases, while civil and administrative cases continue to present substantial challenges.

translation.title: ChJGBench：面向中文法律判决书生成的综合基准与诊断式评估
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，它们能否可靠地生成完整且合法有效的司法文书越来越受到关注。这需要一个基准来评估模型能否准确适用法条并解决影响结果的关键问题，包括诉讼请求、罪名、刑罚和金钱义务。然而，现有基准通常只关注孤立的子任务或粗粒度评估。我们提出 ChJGBench，一个面向民事、刑事和行政案件判决书中说理部分与裁决部分生成的基准。ChJGBench 基于 3,462 份真实判决书构建，提供了包含 13 种指标类型的案件类型感知诊断评估框架，并采用混合评估范式。实验表明，法律领域模型相对通用模型并无统一优势，模型的优势在不同诊断维度上各有差异。刑事案件的性能总体较强，而民事和行政案件仍存在显著挑战。
translation.brief: 该论文构建了基于真实中文判决书的判决书生成基准 ChJGBench，用案件类型感知的诊断式评估框架解决现有基准无法系统评估 LLM 完整司法文书生成能力的问题。

papers.title: When Agents Need to Consolidate Memories: What RRR Consolidation Explains, and What It Does Not Explain, in Conversation ESAA
papers.abstract: Language-model agents can share conversational history across sessions, but persistence does not guarantee retrieval of current decisions and their provenance. This engineering study presents Memory-TCG, a Conversation ESAA extension inspired by ringing, resonance and renormalization (RRR), and an exploratory synthetic evaluation comparing chronological retrieval, two simplified baselines (B, recency-aware, and B', authority-aware), full RRR, and variants under three output budgets. With 480 facts and 1,024 tokens, full RRR recalled 0.44 of current decisions, versus 0.06 for chronological retrieval and 0.58 for the oracle ceiling; with 4,096 tokens it recalled all of them. B' and the no-resonance variant matched full RRR in decision recall across all nine scale-budget combinations, as expected when the active decision set and the adapter ordering are the same. The isolated contribution of ringing to decisions was not measured: comparator D1 cuts facts before the graph is built, and the product retains active decisions by rule. Before the output limit, full-RRR conflict F1 was 0.615 at all three scales; after it, at 480 facts and 1,024 tokens, it was 0.000. Reserving 20% of the budget for conflicts raised that F1 to 0.431 in that scenario, at the cost of lowering decision recall from 0.44 to 0.34, and to 0.930 at 4,096 tokens without decision loss. Fixtures are repetitive, comparators are simplified, and the evaluation was not independently replicated; the results support an engineering analysis, not a claim of selectionist superiority.

translation.title: 智能体何时需要整合记忆：RRR 整合在对话 ESAA 中解释了什么、又未解释什么
translation.abstract: 语言模型智能体可以跨会话共享对话历史，但持久化并不保证能检索到当前决策及其来源。本工程研究提出了受振铃、共振与重整化（RRR）启发的 Memory-TCG——一个 Conversation ESAA 扩展，并进行了一项探索性合成评估，在三种输出预算下比较按时间顺序检索、两个简化基线（B，感知新近性；B'，感知权威性）、完整 RRR 及其变体。在 480 条事实和 1,024 token 条件下，完整 RRR 召回了 0.44 的当前决策，而按时间顺序检索仅为 0.06，oracle 上限为 0.58；在 4,096 token 时它召回了全部决策。在活跃决策集与适配器排序相同的情况下，B' 和去共振变体在全部九种规模-预算组合中与完整 RRR 的决策召回持平。振铃对决策的独立贡献未被测量：对照器 D1 在图构建前就切除了事实，且该产品按规则保留活跃决策。在输出限制之前，完整 RRR 的冲突 F1 在三个规模上均为 0.615；在 480 条事实和 1,024 token 条件下，输出限制之后 F1 降为 0.000。为冲突保留 20% 预算使该场景的 F1 提升到 0.431，代价是决策召回从 0.44 降到 0.34；在 4,096 token 时则达到 0.930 且无决策损失。测试夹具重复性高、对照器经过简化，且评估未经独立复现；这些结果支持一项工程分析，而非关于选择主义优越性的主张。
translation.brief: 该论文提出受 RRR 启发的 Memory-TCG 记忆整合扩展，用受控合成实验检验各机制对智能体跨会话检索当前决策及冲突的贡献边界。

papers.title: Can Agents Relive Past Experiences? Diagnosing Event-Affect Decoupling in Affective-Episodic Retrospection
papers.abstract: As memory-augmented agents increasingly support long-term and personalized interactions, reliable recall of emotional experiences while preserving their associated affect becomes necessary. However, existing evaluations usually assess emotion accuracy and factual memory grounding separately, overlooking event-affect correspondence. In this work, we formulate Affective-Episodic Retrospection (AER) as a task that explicitly evaluates the recovery of past events, associated affects, and their correspondence, and define Event-Affect Decoupling as a failure mode where the correct emotion is recalled but associated with the wrong episode. To diagnose Event-Affect Decoupling, we propose EM-TRACE, a stage-wise framework that decomposes AER into retrieval, affect recovery, and realization. On a controlled GoEmotions-based benchmark, Emotion-only retrieval achieves 28.65% affect recovery but retrieves the target episode for only 4.44% of queries, yielding a UAR of 24.21%. Further analysis reveals that event retrieval and affect assignment introduce distinct binding failures. These findings show that reliable AER requires grounded recall of emotional experiences, where episode retrieval, affect recovery, event-affect binding, and generation quality should be evaluated jointly. Our code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 智能体能重温过往经历吗？诊断情感-情节性回溯中的事件-情感解耦
translation.abstract: 随着记忆增强的智能体越来越多地支持长期和个性化交互，在保留情感的同时可靠地回忆情绪化经历变得必要。然而，现有评估通常分别衡量情绪准确性与事实记忆依据，忽视了事件-情感对应关系。本工作将情感-情节性回溯（Affective-Episodic Retrospection, AER）形式化为一个显式评估过往事件、关联情感及其对应关系恢复的任务，并定义事件-情感解耦为一种失败模式：正确的情绪被回忆起，但被关联到错误的情节。为诊断事件-情感解耦，我们提出 EM-TRACE，一个将 AER 分解为检索、情感恢复和实现的分阶段框架。在基于 GoEmotions 构建的受控基准上，仅情感检索达到 28.65% 的情感恢复率，但仅对 4.44% 的查询检索到目标情节，UAR 为 24.21%。进一步分析表明，事件检索和情感分配会引入不同的绑定失败。这些发现表明，可靠的 AER 需要对情绪化经历的有依据回忆，其中情节检索、情感恢复、事件-情感绑定和生成质量应被联合评估。代码可在该 https URL 获取。
translation.brief: 该论文提出 AER 任务与 EM-TRACE 分阶段诊断框架，以识别并评估智能体回忆过往情绪经历时正确情绪被绑定到错误情节的事件-情感解耦失败模式。

papers.title: SpaceMCP: Vision Language Model Spatial Reasoning via Model Context Protocol
papers.abstract: Despite impressive advances in large language models (LLM), vision-language models (VLM) still exhibit limited spatial reasoning capabilities. Recent progress in feed-forward 3D reconstruction has enabled precise, real-time geometric understanding from visual inputs. In this work, we propose SpaceMCP, a framework that leverages these advances to introduce an MCP-style paradigm for spatial reasoning. Our approach augments a VLM with structured function calls, allowing it to query a scene graph for spatial information such as distances, object positioning, and camera properties. The scene graph is constructed in real time using feed-forward 3D reconstruction to recover metric geometry, combined with open-vocabulary segmentation to identify and localize relevant objects within the scene. Paired with the VLM's strong reasoning capabilities, the VLM is able to combine this primitive information to solve more complex spatial tasks. Without any training, SpaceMCP achieves state-of-the-art results on VSI-Bench, MMSI-Bench and VSTI-Bench, outperforming recent spatially post-trained VLMs and improving its base VLM by 15-22 points per benchmark. We argue that, given the contrast between the relatively slow progress in native VLM spatial reasoning and the rapid advances in feed-forward 3D computer vision, this paradigm offers a promising path forward for enabling robust spatial reasoning.

translation.title: SpaceMCP：基于 Model Context Protocol 的视觉语言模型空间推理
translation.abstract: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）取得了令人瞩目的进展，视觉语言模型（VLM）的空间推理能力仍然有限。前馈式3D重建的最新进展使视觉输入的精确、实时几何理解成为可能。本文提出 SpaceMCP，一个利用这些进展引入 MCP 风格空间推理范式的框架。我们的方法通过结构化函数调用增强 VLM，使其能够查询场景图以获取空间信息，如距离、物体位置和相机属性。场景图通过前馈式3D重建实时构建以恢复度量几何，并结合开放词汇分割来识别和定位场景中的相关物体。借助 VLM 强大的推理能力，VLM 能够组合这些基元信息来解决更复杂的空间任务。无需任何训练，SpaceMCP 在 VSI-Bench、MMSI-Bench 和 VSTI-Bench 上取得了最先进的结果，超越了近期经过空间后训练的 VLM，并在每个基准上将其基础 VLM 提升 15-22 分。我们认为，鉴于原生 VLM 空间推理进展相对缓慢与前馈式3D计算机视觉快速进步之间的对比，该范式为实现稳健的空间推理提供了一条有前景的路径。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 VLM 空间推理能力弱的问题，核心方法是通过 MCP 式结构化函数调用让 VLM 查询由前馈3D重建与开放词汇分割实时构建的场景图。

papers.title: Transversal Passivity and Equilibrium Forces in Formation Control
papers.abstract: We consider controller synthesis for distance-constrained formations, aiming to stabilize the target formation manifold while sustaining admissible equilibrium edge forces. Using the newly introduced notion of transversal passivity, we encode the target formation shape, the prescribed edge lengths, and a subspace of internally balanced edge forces as the port target manifolds of the agents and the edge controller. The synthesis task is thereby reformulated as the joint design of a transversally passive edge controller and its output-target subspace. We then propose a general constructive realization of output-strictly transversally passive systems and specialize it to derive a dynamic edge controller that sustains admissible equilibrium edge forces. Through a compatibility analysis across the interconnection, we establish a closed-loop dissipation margin in terms of the controller parameters and prove local convergence of all agent and controller ports to their target manifolds. Numerical simulations validate the results.

translation.title: 编队控制中的横截无源性与平衡边力
translation.abstract: 我们考虑距离约束编队的控制器综合，目标是在维持可容许的平衡边力的同时稳定目标编队流形。利用新引入的横截无源性概念，我们将目标编队形状、给定的边长以及内部平衡边力子空间编码为智能体和边控制器的端口目标流形。由此，综合任务被重新表述为横截无源边控制器及其输出目标子空间的联合设计。随后，我们提出了一种输出严格横截无源系统的一般构造性实现，并将其特化以推导出一个能维持可容许平衡边力的动态边控制器。通过互联上的相容性分析，我们以控制器参数的形式建立了闭环耗散裕度，并证明了所有智能体与控制器端口到其目标流形的局部收敛性。数值仿真验证了这些结果。
translation.brief: 该论文解决距离约束编队控制中在维持平衡边力的同时稳定目标编队的问题，核心方法是利用新提出的横截无源性概念构造性地设计边控制器。

papers.title: AskALCF: A Self-Improving Agentic System for Intelligent HPC User Support
papers.abstract: AI-based question-answering systems are increasingly used for user support, including at high-performance computing (HPC) facilities. However, existing systems lack a systematic, deployment-oriented approach for evaluating final-answer quality and attributing failures to specific components. They also remain largely static after deployment, apart from periodic knowledge-base updates. We present AskALCF, an agentic log-analysis and improvement pipeline for HPC user support. AskALCF evaluates production interactions at a fine-grained level, identifies whether failures arise from missing knowledge, retrieval, prompting, model behavior, or tool execution, and routes each failure to an actionable repair. Its diagnostic core combines answer-quality assessment with a two-scope sufficiency test that distinguishes information missing from the documentation corpus from information present but not retrieved. We further introduce a controlled harness-training process that uses expert references, null edits, and explicit ship, revert, or decline decisions to improve the diagnostic pipeline reliably. Across 2,174 support turns, AskALCF reduced unattributable failures from 41.4% to 14.2%, while harness training improved expert agreement from 108/150 to 123/150 turns. These results demonstrate a governed form of self-evolution in which production evidence drives targeted system improvements. By turning production interactions into fine-grained diagnoses and actionable repairs, AskALCF provides a systematic foundation for continuously improving deployed AI support systems beyond knowledge-base updates alone.

translation.title: AskALCF：面向智能 HPC 用户支持的自改进智能体系统
translation.abstract: 基于 AI 的问答系统越来越多地用于用户支持，包括在高性能计算（HPC）设施中。然而，现有系统缺乏系统的、面向部署的方法来评估最终答案质量并将失败归因到具体组件。除定期知识库更新外，它们在部署后基本保持静态。我们提出 AskALCF，一个用于 HPC 用户支持的智能体日志分析与改进流水线。AskALCF 在细粒度层面评估生产环境交互，识别失败是源于知识缺失、检索、提示、模型行为还是工具执行，并将每个失败路由到可操作的修复。其诊断核心将答案质量评估与双范围充分性测试相结合，以区分文档语料库中缺失的信息与存在但未被检索到的信息。我们进一步引入一个受控的 harness 训练过程，利用专家参考、空编辑和明确的发布、回滚或拒绝决策来可靠地改进诊断流水线。在 2,174 个支持对话轮次中，AskALCF 将不可归因的失败从 41.4% 降至 14.2%，而 harness 训练将专家一致率从 108/150 提升到 123/150 轮次。这些结果表明了一种受治理的自我演进形式，其中生产证据驱动针对性的系统改进。通过将生产交互转化为细粒度诊断和可操作修复，AskALCF 为持续改进已部署的 AI 支持系统提供了超越单纯知识库更新的系统化基础。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 HPC 用户支持 AI 系统缺乏答案质量评估与失败归因方法的问题，核心方法是构建一个智能体日志分析流水线，细粒度诊断失败来源并路由到可操作修复。

papers.title: Efficient Knowledge Transfer in Federated Bayesian Optimization through Neural Network Surrogates
papers.abstract: Federated Bayesian Optimization (FedBO) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing Bayesian Optimization (BO) in distributed, privacy-sensitive settings, enabling agents to accelerate the optimization of their local objectives by sharing knowledge about their similarities without exposing raw data. However, existing methods rely on restrictive assumptions, such as near-identical objective functions or shared Gaussian process hyperparameters that are often violated in heterogeneous real-world applications. We present GLOBAFED, a novel framework that enables efficient knowledge transfer across different but related objectives without compromising privacy. At its core is a probabilistic neural network surrogate with a shared feature-extracting backbone and agent-specific heads equipped with varia- tional Bayesian last layers to provide uncertainty estimates. During optimization, agents use federated learning on the shared backbone to collaboratively build a common latent feature representation, while agent-specific heads adapt to their individual objectives. Our empirical results demonstrate that GLOBAFED significantly accelerates convergence and reaches better final performance compared to state-of-the-art FedBO baselines, and enables agents to warm-start their optimization from previously learned global features.

translation.title: 基于神经网络代理模型的联邦贝叶斯优化高效知识迁移
translation.abstract: 联邦贝叶斯优化（FedBO）已成为在分布式、隐私敏感环境中增强贝叶斯优化（BO）的强大范式，使智能体能够通过共享关于其相似性的知识来加速本地目标优化，而不暴露原始数据。然而，现有方法依赖于严格的假设，如几乎相同的目标函数或共享的高斯过程超参数，这些假设在异构的真实应用中经常被违反。我们提出 GLOBAFED，一个能够在不同但相关的目标之间实现高效知识迁移而不损害隐私的新框架。其核心是一个带共享特征提取骨干和智能体专属头部的概率神经网络代理模型，头部配备变分贝叶斯最后一层以提供不确定性估计。在优化过程中，智能体对共享骨干使用联邦学习来协作构建共同的潜在特征表示，而智能体专属头部则适配各自的目标。我们的实证结果表明，与最先进的 FedBO 基线相比，GLOBAFED 显著加速收敛并达到更好的最终性能，并且使智能体能够从先前学到的全局特征进行热启动优化。
translation.brief: 该论文解决现有 FedBO 方法在异构目标函数下知识迁移受限的问题，核心方法是使用共享神经网络骨干加智能体专属变分贝叶斯头部的概率代理模型进行联邦训练。

papers.title: Orbit: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on IT Operations Reasoning
papers.abstract: LLMs now support IT operations (ITOps), but benchmarks rarely show why a model fails. We present ORBIT, a benchmark of ITOps questions in three formats, namely multiple-choice, open-ended, and troubleshooting, with each question accompanied by a reference answer and a recorded source. An audit found template defects in about a tenth of the generated items, so we drop them and rebuild the troubleshooting format from real practitioner threads with accepted answers. Under one independent judge, five LLMs answer most multiple-choice items correctly, between a third and just over half of the open-ended items, and a minority of the troubleshooting items, even under a more lenient root-cause rubric. When models judged their own answers, they accepted many answers to defective items, so we use one independent judge for every model. Word overlap with the question finds the correct option for more than half of the multiple-choice items. ORBIT is a diagnostic aid for selecting and supervising assistants rather than a deployment test.

translation.title: Orbit：用于评估 LLM 在 IT 运维推理上表现的证据支撑基准
translation.abstract: LLM 现已支持 IT 运维（ITOps），但基准很少能揭示模型为何失败。我们提出 ORBIT，一个包含三种题型（选择题、开放式和故障排查）的 ITOps 问题基准，每个问题都附有参考答案和记录的来源。审计发现约十分之一的生成题目存在模板缺陷，因此我们删除了它们，并根据有被采纳答案的真实从业者帖子重建了故障排查题型。在一名独立裁判的评审下，五个 LLM 能正确回答大多数选择题、三分之一到刚过一半的开放式题目，以及少数故障排查题目——即使采用更宽松的根因评分标准也是如此。当模型评判自己的答案时，它们接受了许多缺陷题目的答案，因此我们对每个模型都使用一名独立裁判。与问题的词重叠即可为超过一半的选择题找到正确选项。ORBIT 是用于选择和监督助手的诊断工具，而非部署测试。
translation.brief: 该论文解决现有 ITOps 基准无法揭示模型失败原因的问题，核心方法是构建带参考答案、来源记录与独立裁判的 ORBIT 基准并剔除有缺陷题目。

papers.title: DISCERN: Preserve at Write, Resolve at Read for Persistent LLM-Agent Memory
papers.abstract: Enterprise agents accumulate memory across dozens of sessions in which facts contradict, get superseded, and blur as similarly named entities collide in embedding space. The field treats this as a retrieval problem; we show it is not. On ENT-310, a synthetic enterprise sales-agent memory benchmark of 310 queries (210 answerable, 100 unanswerable), a vanilla Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) reader over a memory store already matches strong memory systems on the recall pillars. Retention and currency are near-saturated, roughly 0.93 to 0.98 for every competent system, so recall is essentially solved. What remains unsolved is resolution: which entity a query refers to, which time-state is current, and whether to commit an answer at all or decline when evidence is insufficient. We propose DISCERN (DISambiguation and Cross-session Episodic memoRy Navigation), an agent-memory framework built on a single rule: preserve at write, resolve at read. At write time DISCERN builds a strictly additive bi-temporal provenance graph that never merges confusable entities and never drops superseded values. At read time a zero-LLM tool surface drives an agentic loop that navigates this graph and commits exactly one of four gated terminal actions. A four-judge LLM-as-a-Judge council scores two axes: answer correctness on answerable questions, and the answer-versus-abstain decision as a classification problem. On ENT-310, DISCERN is the best-calibrated system on abstention (F1 0.924 versus at most 0.802 across eight baselines) and leads macro answer correctness under equal pillar weighting (0.861 versus 0.806 for the strongest baseline), a lead driven by entity resolution (0.800, where no baseline exceeds 0.40). Applied with zero tuning to the full LoCoMo corpus, the same pipeline again leads macro answer correctness (0.663 versus 0.638) and stays among the best-calibrated on false-premise abstention.

translation.title: DISCERN：写入时保留、读取时消解的持久化 LLM 智能体记忆
translation.abstract: 企业智能体在数十个会话中积累记忆，其中事实相互矛盾、被取代，并在嵌入空间中因命名相似的实体碰撞而混淆。领域内将其视为检索问题；我们证明并非如此。在 ENT-310（一个包含 310 条查询、其中 210 条可回答、100 条不可回答的合成企业销售智能体记忆基准）上，基于记忆库的朴素检索增强生成（RAG）阅读器在召回支柱上已经可以匹敌强大的记忆系统。保留性与时效性接近饱和，所有合格系统约为 0.93 至 0.98，因此召回问题基本已解决。尚未解决的是消解（resolution）：查询指的是哪个实体、哪个时间状态是当前的，以及是否应给出答案或在证据不足时拒绝作答。我们提出 DISCERN（DISambiguation and Cross-session Episodic memoRy Navigation），一个建立在单一规则之上的智能体记忆框架：写入时保留，读取时消解。写入时，DISCERN 构建一个严格只增的双时序来源图谱，从不合并易混淆的实体，也从不丢弃被取代的值。读取时，零 LLM 工具接口驱动一个智能体循环来导航该图谱，并在四个受控终止动作中恰好提交一个。一个由四个评委组成的 LLM-as-a-Judge 评审团在两个轴上打分：可回答问题的答案正确性，以及将作答与拒答决策作为分类问题评估。在 ENT-310 上，DISCERN 是拒答校准最好的系统（F1 0.924，而八个基线最高仅 0.802），并在同等支柱权重下取得最高的宏平均答案正确性（0.861 对最强基线的 0.806），这一优势由实体消解驱动（0.800，而没有任何基线超过 0.40）。在零调参的情况下应用于完整 LoCoMo 语料，同一流水线再次在宏平均答案正确性上领先（0.663 对 0.638），并在错误前提拒答上保持最佳校准水平之一。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 智能体持久记忆中的实体消歧与时间状态消解问题，方法是在写入时构建严格只增的双时序来源图谱、读取时用零 LLM 工具的智能体循环导航该图谱并作出作答或拒答决策。

papers.title: Where Is Uncertainty Observed? A Mechanistic Understanding of Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
papers.abstract: Knowing when a large language model's (LLM's) response can be trusted is critical for its safe use. Uncertainty quantification (UQ) can help LLMs recognize if their responses may be unreliable. Existing taxonomies organize UQ methods by uncertainty source or estimation mechanism. They leave unresolved the question of where uncertainty is observed in the model's computation. The answer matters because the observation point determines whether an estimator has access to enough information to recover a given target, and how well it can recover it. Drawing on mechanistic interpretability, we define four mechanistic observation lenses: the structural lens observes component updates, the representational lens observes hidden states, the distributional lens observes token probabilities, and the semantical lens observes distributions over meanings. We relate these lenses through the residual stream and order them by the information they carry, which gives a principle for selecting UQ methods for different targets. We survey existing methods through the four lenses. Furthermore, we distinguish evaluation targets, criteria, and metrics to clarify different UQ evaluation protocols. Finally, we identify open problems and research directions to connect uncertainty estimation to the internal computation and downstream use of LLMs.

translation.title: 不确定性在哪里被观测？对 LLM 不确定性量化的机制性理解
translation.abstract: 了解大型语言模型（LLM）的响应何时可信对其安全使用至关重要。不确定性量化（UQ）可以帮助 LLM 识别其响应是否可能不可靠。现有分类体系按不确定性来源或估计机制组织 UQ 方法，但未解决不确定性在模型计算中的何处被观测这一问题。这个答案很重要，因为观测点决定了估计器是否有足够的信息来恢复给定目标，以及恢复效果如何。借鉴机制可解释性，我们定义了四种机制观测透镜：结构透镜观测组件更新，表征透镜观测隐藏状态，分布透镜观测 token 概率，语义透镜观测意义上的分布。我们通过残差流（residual stream）将这些透镜关联起来，并按其携带的信息量排序，从而为不同目标选择 UQ 方法提供了原则。我们通过这四种透镜梳理现有方法。此外，我们区分评估目标、标准和指标，以澄清不同的 UQ 评估协议。最后，我们指出了将不确定性估计与 LLM 的内部计算和下游使用相连接的开放问题与研究方向。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 不确定性量化方法缺乏统一观测视角的问题，提出从结构、表征、分布、语义四种机制观测透镜来组织、排序和选择 UQ 方法。

papers.title: Latent Imagination for Parameterized Action Spaces
papers.abstract: Parameterized-action MDPs (PAMDPs) ask an agent to choose a discrete action together with continuous parameters whose meaning depends on that choice. Model-free PAMDP methods act fast but need many interactions; model-based methods are sample-efficient but plan at every decision, which makes them slow to act. We introduce HyLI (Hybrid Latent Imagination), a model-based agent that learns a hybrid policy entirely in the latent imagination of a world model and acts with a single forward pass. To address learning problems that the PAMDP structure creates, HyLI adds counterfactual mode evaluation, which gives every discrete action a learning signal at every imagined state, and success-window replay, which keeps rare successes in training. On seven standard PAMDP benchmarks, HyLI is within one published standard deviation of, or above, the published score of the strongest model-free baseline in our comparison on all 7 tasks, reaches 90% of that score with 2.4x fewer environment steps than that baseline (5.0x when its reward-free pre-training is counted), and decides 67x faster than the model-based planner DLPA at its published planner settings. It is the only method in our comparison that is both more sample-efficient than that baseline and fast enough for real-time control.

translation.title: 面向参数化动作空间的潜在想象
translation.abstract: 参数化动作 MDP（PAMDP）要求智能体同时选择一个离散动作及其连续参数，而参数的含义取决于所选动作。无模型 PAMDP 方法行动快但需要大量交互；基于模型的方法样本效率高但每次决策都要规划，导致行动缓慢。我们提出 HyLI（Hybrid Latent Imagination），一个基于模型的智能体，完全在世界模型的潜在想象中学习混合策略，并以单次前向传播行动。为解决 PAMDP 结构带来的学习问题，HyLI 增加了反事实模式评估（counterfactual mode evaluation），使每个离散动作在每个想象状态都获得学习信号；以及成功窗口回放（success-window replay），将罕见的成功保留在训练中。在七个标准 PAMDP 基准上，HyLI 在全部 7 个任务上都达到或超过对比中最强无模型基线已发表分数一个已发表标准差以内，以比该基线少 2.4 倍的环境步数达到其 90% 的分数（若计入其无奖励预训练则为 5.0 倍），并且在已发表的规划器设置下，其决策速度比基于模型的规划器 DLPA 快 67 倍。它是我们对比中唯一一个既比该基线样本效率更高、又快到足以实时控制的方法。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 PAMDP 中无模型方法样本效率低、基于模型方法决策慢的矛盾，提出完全在世界模型潜在想象中训练混合策略并通过单次前向传播行动的 HyLI。

papers.title: MULTILOOP: Evolving Multi-Agent Harnesses for Complex Information-Seeking Tasks
papers.abstract: The performance of LLM-based agents depends not only on the underlying model but also on the harness: the prompts, tools, and orchestration logic around it. Recent works automate harness optimization with coding agents that analyze execution traces, diagnose failures, and edit the harness code; however, those focused on single-agent systems. Multi-agent harnesses are harder to optimize as fixing them requires changing how agents interact in addition to how each behaves. We study whether automated harness optimization can diagnose and repair failures in multi-agent systems through a case study on complex information-seeking tasks from DeepSearchQA [Gupta et al., 2026]. We apply MULTILOOP, a simple optimization loop in which a coding agent iteratively analyzes, evaluates and edits the harness. With only 10 training samples, the evolved harness improves accuracy by 4.6% over the base harness and by 3.2% over the best single-agent system. However, a taxonomy of failure modes before and after optimization shows that the orchestration failures that characterize multi-agent systems largely persist. Our findings motivate harness optimization methods that encourage structural changes to how agents delegate tasks and share information.

translation.title: MULTILOOP：面向复杂信息检索任务的多智能体 harness 演化
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的智能体性能不仅取决于底层模型，还取决于 harness：围绕模型的提示、工具和编排逻辑。近期工作使用编码智能体自动化优化 harness，分析执行轨迹、诊断故障并编辑 harness 代码；然而这些工作聚焦于单智能体系统。多智能体 harness 更难优化，因为修复它们不仅需要改变每个智能体的行为，还需要改变智能体之间的交互方式。我们以 DeepSearchQA [Gupta et al., 2026] 中的复杂信息检索任务为案例，研究自动化 harness 优化能否诊断和修复多智能体系统的故障。我们应用 MULTILOOP，一个简单的优化循环，其中编码智能体迭代地分析、评估和编辑 harness。仅用 10 个训练样本，演化后的 harness 相比基础 harness 提升准确率 4.6%，相比最佳单智能体系统提升 3.2%。然而，对优化前后故障模式的分类显示，多智能体系统特有的编排故障在很大程度上仍然存在。我们的发现促使人们研究鼓励对智能体任务委派和信息共享方式进行结构性改变的 harness 优化方法。
translation.brief: 该论文研究自动化 harness 优化能否修复多智能体系统的故障，方法是用 MULTILOOP 循环让编码智能体基于 10 个训练样本迭代分析、评估并编辑多智能体 harness。

papers.title: Prior-as-Skill: Remember Outside and Read Inside with On-Policy Self-Distillation for Self-Evolving VLM Agents
papers.abstract: Self-evolving visual agents keep what they learn as skills: key frames with step notes on a task's steps and their order. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is now a popular way to train such skills into a vision-language model that matches, on its own answers, a teacher that also reads the written order. At deployment, frames often go missing or show an unusual order, as when a person or a website reorders the steps. Existing internalization methods keep any order they store in the frame-reading weights: trained on full frames, the model guesses when they are missing, and trained with frames withheld, it stores the order, so memory can override what it sees. We propose PriorSplit, which fills in missing frames from an order kept outside the model, with no training beyond OPSD. It counts which of two neighboring steps comes first in training episodes, and the model checks if both asked steps are in view: if so, it answers from the frames, and otherwise the counts answer. Extensive experiments on synthetic skills with five models and on step-tagged order questions in new episodes of seen web, cooking and egocentric tasks demonstrate that, with frames missing, PriorSplit outperforms every compared method at OPSD's training cost. With Qwen3-VL-4B on synthetic skills, it also stays close to OPSD on unusual orders, where methods that gain most by storing the order fall behind.

translation.title: Prior-as-Skill：以在策略自蒸馏实现外部记忆、内部读取的自进化 VLM 智能体
translation.abstract: 自进化视觉智能体将其学到的东西保留为技能：任务步骤及其顺序上带步骤注释的关键帧。在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）是目前将这类技能训练进视觉语言模型的流行方式，使模型在自己的答案上匹配一个同样阅读书写顺序的教师。部署时，帧常常缺失或呈现异常顺序，例如人或网站重新排列了步骤。现有内化方法将其存储的任何顺序保留在帧读取权重中：用完整帧训练时，模型在帧缺失时会猜测；用帧被扣留的方式训练时，它会存储顺序，导致记忆可以覆盖它所看到的内容。我们提出 PriorSplit，在仅使用 OPSD 训练的前提下，从保存在模型外部的顺序中填补缺失帧。它统计训练片段中两个相邻步骤谁先出现的次数，模型检查被询问的两个步骤是否都在视野内：如果是，则从帧作答；否则由计数作答。在五个模型的合成技能以及新片段中带步骤标签的顺序问题（涵盖已见过的网页、烹饪和第一视角任务）上的大量实验表明，在帧缺失时，PriorSplit 以 OPSD 的训练成本超越了所有对比方法。在合成技能上使用 Qwen3-VL-4B 时，它在异常顺序上也保持接近 OPSD，而那些通过存储顺序获益最多的方法则落后了。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 VLM 智能体内化技能顺序后记忆会覆盖实际观测、帧缺失时性能下降的问题，提出 PriorSplit 将步骤顺序先验保存在模型外部，仅凭计数在帧缺失时填补并以 OPSD 训练。

papers.title: VibePrevisBench: Evaluating Agentic Coding for 4D Scene Generation in Blender
papers.abstract: Controllable real-world video generation models can condition on a rendered graybox proxy video, which fixes layout, motion and camera. Coding agents can build such videos by reconstructing a 4D scene in Blender, yet no benchmark checks both these videos and the long, multi-shot scenes behind them. We introduce VibePrevisBench, a benchmark for 4D scene reconstruction: an agent turns a brief into an executable 4D scene and renders its proxy video. Its 242 tasks span four input kinds, including scripts, photos, continuations, and reference videos. Each delivery is scored along two evaluation dimensions. Rule-based Scene Check re-runs the code and compares the exported 4D scene with hidden ground truth facts in nine dimensions. VLM-based Screen Check asks a VLM judge whether the facts that pass can be recognized in the proxy video. We analyze the evaluation results and trajectories of 11 frontier coding agents and identify three key observations. First, multimodal understanding separates the agents, especially in understanding space and camera motion. Second, all agents seem to already master basic camera work and staging, and fail at challenging requests. Third, agents inspect their own renders but fail to correct their errors. Agents thus need better visual understanding of space and camera, explicit checks for challenging requests, and item-by-item verification of renders against the brief.

translation.title: VibePrevisBench：评估 Blender 中面向 4D 场景生成的智能体编程能力
translation.abstract: 可控的真实世界视频生成模型可以以渲染出的灰盒代理视频为条件，该视频固定了布局、运动和相机。编程智能体可以通过在 Blender 中重建 4D 场景来构建此类视频，但目前没有基准能同时检验这些视频及其背后冗长的多镜头场景。我们提出 VibePrevisBench，一个面向 4D 场景重建的基准：智能体将一份需求简报转化为可执行的 4D 场景并渲染其代理视频。其 242 个任务涵盖四种输入类型，包括剧本、照片、续接和参考视频。每次交付在两个评估维度上打分。基于规则的 Scene Check 重新运行代码，并在九个维度上将导出的 4D 场景与隐藏的 ground truth 事实进行比较。基于 VLM 的 Screen Check 让 VLM 评审判断通过验证的事实能否在代理视频中被识别。我们分析了 11 个前沿编程智能体的评估结果和轨迹，得出三个关键观察。第一，多模态理解能力区分了各智能体，尤其是在理解空间和相机运动方面。第二，所有智能体似乎已掌握基本的运镜和调度，但在有挑战性的请求上会失败。第三，智能体会检查自己的渲染结果，却无法纠正其中的错误。因此，智能体需要对空间和相机有更好的视觉理解、对有挑战性请求的显式检查，以及对渲染结果与简报的逐项核验。
translation.brief: 提出 VibePrevisBench 基准，通过规则与 VLM 双重检查评估编程智能体在 Blender 中从简报重建 4D 场景并渲染代理视频的能力。

papers.title: Early Reflections on How Large Language Models are Reshaping Software Engineering Research
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are radically reshaping software engineering (SE) research. Yet, their steep financial and computational costs raise questions about who participates in that change, and who does not. By analysing all 1,918 papers published in the ICSE 2019-2026 Research and SEIP tracks, we uncover a shifting and highly concentrated research landscape. China and the US dominate LLM-based SE research, appearing in 74% of LLM-based publications between 2023-2026, yet they diverge sharply in their use of commercial versus open-weight models. Beneath this national dominance lies extreme institutional concentration: just 5 institutions in China and 7 in the US appear in more than half of their respective nations' LLM-based output. In the US, only half of the unique institutions active in 2023-2026 participated in LLM-based research, whereas Singapore displays broader usage, with 11 of 15 active institutions participating in LLM-based work. Furthermore, across 2023-2026 Research-track papers, industry involvement is more prevalent in LLM-based work (23.4% vs 16.9%), and academia-only papers make up a smaller share (63.4% vs 70.9%). Crucially, we expose a gap in model usage across industry and academia. SEIP track papers lean strongly towards commercial LLMs, with 77.4% featuring them and 40.5% using them exclusively. In contrast, only 21.2% of Research-track work relies strictly on commercial models, making greater use of open-weight models that typically support more sustainable and reproducible experiments. However, this divide warrants reflection on the extent to which SE research aligns with industry practice.

translation.title: 关于大语言模型如何重塑软件工程研究的早期反思
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正在深刻重塑软件工程（SE）研究。然而，其高昂的财务和计算成本引发了关于谁在参与这一变革、谁未能参与的疑问。通过分析 ICSE 2019-2026 Research 与 SEIP 两个 track 的全部 1,918 篇论文，我们揭示出一个不断变化且高度集中的研究格局。中国和美国主导着基于 LLM 的 SE 研究，在 2023-2026 年间出现在 74% 的基于 LLM 的出版物中，但两者在商业模型与开源权重模型的使用上存在显著分歧。在这一国家主导格局之下是极端的机构集中：中国仅有 5 家机构、美国仅有 7 家机构出现在各自国家超过一半的基于 LLM 的成果中。在美国，2023-2026 年活跃的机构中只有一半参与了基于 LLM 的研究，而新加坡的使用更为广泛，15 家活跃机构中有 11 家参与了基于 LLM 的工作。此外，在 2023-2026 年的 Research track 论文中，产业界参与在基于 LLM 的工作中更为普遍（23.4% 对 16.9%），而纯学术论文占比更小（63.4% 对 70.9%）。关键的是，我们揭示了产业界与学术界在模型使用上的差距。SEIP track 论文强烈偏向商业 LLM，77.4% 的论文使用了商业模型，40.5% 仅使用商业模型。相比之下，Research track 的工作中只有 21.2% 严格依赖商业模型，更多地使用通常能支持更可持续、可复现实验的开源权重模型。然而，这一分化值得我们反思 SE 研究在多大程度上与产业实践相一致。
translation.brief: 通过统计 ICSE 2019-2026 全部论文，分析基于 LLM 的软件工程研究在国家、机构、产学研之间高度集中的格局及商业与开源模型使用的分化。

papers.title: NIBench: benchmarking autonomous AI agents for execution, skill evolution and scientific judgment in neuroimaging
papers.abstract: Autonomous AI agents are increasingly used to automate biomedical research, creating a growing need to benchmark their capabilities on real scientific data and workflows. Their reliability in neuroimaging remains insufficiently characterized, where plausible analytical outputs can conceal errors that affect scientific conclusions. Existing studies have advanced scientific question answering and tool-based automation, but provide limited evidence on workflow reconstruction, acquisition of procedural expertise and evidence-based scientific judgment. Here we present NIBench, a neuroimaging benchmark comprising three complementary evaluations of autonomous agents. First, we benchmark execution and workflow reconstruction using 56 tasks across seven tool ecosystems, covering structural, diffusion and functional magnetic resonance imaging, positron emission tomography and multimodal analyses. Second, we examine whether agents can evolve their procedural skills through distillation of execution trajectories, evaluating the resulting skills on previously encountered tasks, unseen tasks and other models. Third, we assess scientific judgment using 36 claims from published Alzheimer's disease studies, requiring agents to analyse raw cohort data and provide reproducible evidence. We evaluate 19 language models within a shared agent framework, with selected models undergoing skill distillation and claim evaluation. Leading agents execute supplied analysis protocols nearly perfectly, whereas withholding procedural guidance widens performance differences. Distilled skills improve performance on acquisition tasks and transfer between models, but benefits on unseen tasks are inconsistent. Agents reproduce their reported results yet sometimes reach conclusions inconsistent with expert-derived answers, and access to data does not always improve judgment.

translation.title: NIBench：面向神经影像中执行、技能演化与科学判断的自主 AI 智能体基准
translation.abstract: 自主 AI 智能体越来越多地被用于自动化生物医学研究，这产生了在真实科学数据和工作流上对其能力进行基准测试的日益增长的需求。它们在神经影像领域的可靠性仍未得到充分刻画，因为看似合理的分析输出可能掩盖影响科学结论的错误。现有研究已推进了科学问答和基于工具的自动化，但在工作流重建、程序性专业知识的获取以及基于证据的科学判断方面提供的证据有限。我们提出 NIBench，一个由三项互补评估组成的神经影像基准。首先，我们使用覆盖七个工具生态系统的 56 个任务对执行和工作流重建进行基准测试，涵盖结构、扩散和功能磁共振成像、正电子发射断层扫描以及多模态分析。其次，我们考察智能体能否通过对执行轨迹的蒸馏来演化其程序性技能，并在已见任务、未见任务和其他模型上评估所得技能。第三，我们使用来自已发表阿尔茨海默病研究的 36 条论断评估科学判断，要求智能体分析原始队列数据并提供可复现的证据。我们在共享的智能体框架内评估 19 个语言模型，其中选定模型经历了技能蒸馏和论断评估。领先的智能体几乎完美地执行给定的分析协议，而不提供程序性指导则会拉大性能差距。蒸馏的技能在获取任务上提升性能并可在模型间迁移，但在未见任务上的收益并不一致。智能体能复现其报告的结果，但有时会得出与专家推导答案不一致的结论，且获得数据并不总能改善判断。
translation.brief: 提出神经影像基准 NIBench，通过执行与工作流重建、技能蒸馏演化及基于原始数据的科学判断三项任务系统评估自主 AI 智能体的可靠性。

papers.title: Controlling the Probability of Unknown Unknowns in Pre-Deployment Testing of AI Systems
papers.abstract: In pre-deployment testing of AI systems such as AI agents, a developer can often deal with known failure modes (e.g., leaking API keys, deleting important databases, or installing a malicious package) by implementing fixes or making contingency plans for when the same issue might occur again. What is more challenging are the unknown unknowns: the unseen failure modes that haven't surfaced during testing. The decision to stop testing and deploy therefore faces an inherent tradeoff: continue testing to observe more behaviors, at the cost of time and resources, or stop testing and deploy, at the risk of failure modes remaining undiscovered. How then does the developer decide when they have tested enough? To answer this, we develop an algorithm that certifies when the probability of observing an unseen failure mode is sufficiently small. The algorithm constructs an anytime-valid upper confidence sequence on this quantity, so the developer can repeatedly test a system, inspect the bound, and decide to stop when it falls below a chosen threshold without invalidating the statistical guarantee. Our problem can be interpreted as a sequential variant of the missing-mass estimation problem which gave rise to the classic Good-Turing estimator (Good, 1953). On SWE-Chat, a dataset of real-world coding agent traces (Baumann et al., 2026), we implement our procedure and show that it achieves tighter upper bounds than a simple multiple-testing corrected Good-Turing baseline, and even dominates a fixed-horizon (non-multiple-testing-corrected) Good-Turing upper confidence bound, which is not anytime valid. Additionally, to better match realistic evaluation pipelines, we extend our method to handle sampling from a different task distribution and imperfect automated failure labeling.

translation.title: 在 AI 系统部署前测试中控制未知未知事件发生的概率
translation.abstract: 在 AI 智能体等 AI 系统的部署前测试中，开发者通常可以通过实施修复或为同样问题再次出现制定应急预案来应对已知的失败模式（例如泄露 API 密钥、删除重要数据库或安装恶意软件包）。更具挑战性的是未知未知（unknown unknowns）：即测试中尚未显露的未见失败模式。因此，停止测试并部署的决策面临内在的权衡：继续测试以观察更多行为，代价是时间和资源；或停止测试并部署，风险是失败模式未被发现。那么开发者如何判断测试是否已足够？为此，我们开发了一种算法，能认证观察到未见失败模式的概率何时足够小。该算法为此量构造一个 anytime-valid 的上置信序列，使开发者可以反复测试系统、查看该界，并当其低于选定阈值时决定停止，而不使统计保证失效。我们的问题可被解释为缺失质量估计问题的序列变体，后者催生了经典的 Good-Turing 估计器（Good, 1953）。在 SWE-Chat（真实世界编程智能体轨迹数据集，Baumann et al., 2026）上，我们实现了该流程，并表明它比简单的多重检验校正 Good-Turing 基线取得更紧的上界，甚至优于非 anytime-valid 的固定视界（未做多重检验校正的）Good-Turing 上置信界。此外，为更好地契合现实评估流程，我们扩展了方法以处理从不同任务分布采样以及不完善的自动失败标注。
translation.brief: 提出一个基于 anytime-valid 上置信序列的算法，用于认证 AI 系统部署前测试中观察到未见失败模式的概率何时足够小，从而指导停止测试的时机。

papers.title: Before AI Agents Negotiate for Us: A Competitive Tournament of Rule-Based, Search, Optimization, Learned, and Language-Model Negotiators Under Scarcity
papers.abstract: Automated bilateral negotiation underlies two-sided matching markets such as freight brokering, where many shippers and carriers negotiate price before a matching mechanism decides who is paired with whom. Prior strategy comparisons typically use isolated one-on-one duels or a single fixed market, so they cannot show how a strategy behaves against several live rivals under a changing balance of supply and demand. We built nine negotiation architectures spanning rule-based, search-based, optimization-based, imitation-learning, and reinforcement-learning families, and ran all nine simultaneously on both sides of a Gale-Shapley matching market under a balanced condition and two scarcity conditions rotated across all 36 exclusion pairs. In the balanced carrier market, an imitation-learned engine (ML2), a reinforcement-learning policy trained only on isolated negotiations (RL), and an expected-utility optimization engine (OPT) formed a statistically tied top group, and no architecture led in every condition and role. RL beat all eight carrier rivals when carriers were scarce, but its match rate collapsed from 62% to 16% when shippers were scarce and it had to compete with the other carrier agents for demand. A second reinforcement-learning policy trained against rival agents (RL2) kept its match rate above 91% in every condition, yet lost on realized payoff to all eight shipper-side rivals in two of the three conditions, traced to a confirmed train/deployment feature mismatch. We also tested nine large language models (LLMs), from 1 to 72 billion parameters, under the same protocol: they lost significantly to the two strongest engines (OPT2 and ML2) in 32 of 36 comparisons and won none. These results show that isolated or single-condition evaluation can hide failure modes that a many-sided, scarcity-varying, statistically corrected tournament exposes directly.

translation.title: 在 AI 智能体替我们谈判之前：稀缺条件下基于规则、搜索、优化、学习与语言模型谈判者的竞技锦标赛
translation.abstract: 自动化双边谈判是货运经纪等双边匹配市场的基础，其中众多托运人和承运人先谈判价格，再由匹配机制决定谁与谁配对。以往的策略比较通常使用孤立的一对一对决或单一固定市场，因此无法展示一个策略在面对多个实时对手且供需关系不断变化时的表现。我们构建了九种谈判架构，涵盖基于规则、基于搜索、基于优化、模仿学习和强化学习家族，并在一个 Gale-Shapley 匹配市场的两侧同时运行全部九种，条件包括一个均衡条件和两个稀缺条件，并在全部 36 个排除对上轮换。在均衡的承运人市场中，一个模仿学习引擎（ML2）、一个仅在孤立谈判上训练的强化学习策略（RL）和一个期望效用优化引擎（OPT）构成了统计上并列的头部集团，且没有任何架构在所有条件和角色中均领先。当承运人稀缺时，RL 击败了全部八个承运人对手，但当托运人稀缺、它必须与其他承运人智能体竞争需求时，其匹配率从 62% 骤降至 16%。另一个与对手智能体对抗训练的强化学习策略（RL2）在所有条件下匹配率都保持在 91% 以上，却在三个条件中的两个里在实现收益上输给了全部八个托运人侧对手，根源被确认为训练/部署的特征不匹配。我们还用同一协议测试了九个大语言模型（LLM），参数量从 10 亿到 720 亿：它们在 36 次比较中的 32 次显著输给两个最强引擎（OPT2 和 ML2），且无一获胜。这些结果表明，孤立或单一条件的评估可能掩盖多边、稀缺条件变化、经统计校正的锦标赛能直接暴露的失败模式。
translation.brief: 构建九种谈判架构并在 Gale-Shapley 匹配市场锦标赛中测试，揭示孤立或单一条件评估无法暴露的多边竞争与供需稀缺下的策略失败模式。

papers.title: Food Critic: An Agentic Visualization System for Auditable Restaurant-Safety Reasoning
papers.abstract: Generative AI agents are increasingly being embedded into visualization systems that can search data, invoke tools, summarize evidence, and produce recommendations. However, when agents rely solely on their own knowledge, the visualization problem is not only whether the agent provides a useful answer, but also whether users can inspect how that answer is grounded. We present Food Critic, an agentic visualization system for diners' restaurant decision support that integrates public health inspection records with crowd review data. The system grounds agents under three conditions: a database-only ReAct agent, a retrieval- augmented agent with access to food-safety regulations, and an ontology-guided agent that produces structured hypotheses and typed evidence. Food Critic externalizes the agent's reasoning within these groundings as inspectable visual evidence. We evaluate LLM models with several use cases under each grounding of our agentic system. Our work positions restaurant choice as a concrete case for studying human-agent collaboration, visual provenance of agent reasoning, and the design of visual interfaces for grounded GenAI decision support.

translation.title: Food Critic：用于可审计餐厅安全推理的智能体可视化系统
translation.abstract: 生成式 AI 智能体正日益被嵌入到能够搜索数据、调用工具、汇总证据并生成推荐的可视化系统中。然而，当智能体仅依赖自身知识时，可视化问题不仅在于智能体是否提供了有用的答案，还在于用户能否检验该答案的依据。我们提出 Food Critic，一个面向食客餐厅决策支持的智能体可视化系统，它将公共卫生检查记录与大众点评数据相结合。该系统在三种条件下为智能体提供依据：仅数据库的 ReAct 智能体、可访问食品安全法规的检索增强智能体，以及生成结构化假设与类型化证据的本体引导智能体。Food Critic 将智能体在这些依据条件下的推理外化为可检验的可视化证据。我们通过多个用例在该智能体系统的每种依据条件下评估 LLM 模型。我们的工作将餐厅选择作为一个具体案例，用于研究人-智能体协作、智能体推理的视觉溯源，以及有依据的 GenAI 决策支持的可视化界面设计。
translation.brief: 解决智能体餐厅安全推荐缺乏可审计依据的问题，方法是将公共卫生检查与点评数据接入可视化系统，并在三种依据条件下外化智能体推理为可视化证据。

papers.title: Reward-Driven Collider Physics Challenges for Self-Improving Agentic AI via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Recent advances in agentic AI have demonstrated the potential to automate complex high-energy physics (HEP) workflows. We focus on the regime of HEP tasks where frontier models still struggle to provide correct and complete solutions, and introduce an open-ended optimization task format with continuous, automatically evaluated rewards. Unlike conventional benchmarks focused on task completion, these tasks target reinforcement learning (RL) environments to generate agentic improvement on state- of-the-art HEP challenges. We benchmark frontier reasoning models on several HEP tasks and demonstrate an initial proof of concept in which a small language model improves through RL using automated feedback without human intervention. By connecting challenging HEP problems with verifiable scientific rewards and RL, we aim to advance agentic AI from reproducing established workflows to autonomously discovering better scientific solutions, paving the way toward self-improving scientific agents.

translation.title: 基于强化学习的奖励驱动高能物理挑战：面向自我改进的智能体 AI
translation.abstract: 智能体 AI 的最新进展展示了自动化复杂高能物理（HEP）工作流的潜力。我们聚焦于前沿模型仍难以给出正确且完整解的 HEP 任务领域，引入一种开放式的优化任务格式，具有连续、可自动评估的奖励。与聚焦任务完成的传统基准不同，这些任务面向强化学习（RL）环境，以在最先进的 HEP 挑战上产生智能体的能力提升。我们在若干 HEP 任务上对前沿推理模型进行基准测试，并展示了初步的概念验证：一个小型语言模型通过 RL 使用自动化反馈在无需人工干预的情况下获得提升。通过将具有挑战性的 HEP 问题与可验证的科学奖励和 RL 相结合，我们旨在推动智能体 AI 从复现已确立的工作流走向自主发现更优的科学解决方案，为自我改进的科学智能体铺平道路。
translation.brief: 解决前沿模型难以胜任的高能物理任务自动化问题，方法是构建带连续可自动评估奖励的开放式 RL 任务环境，使语言模型通过自动反馈自我改进。

papers.title: HeriKGQA: Grounded Knowledge-Graph Question Answering over Cultural Heritage Sensor Data
papers.abstract: Cultural heritage sites are increasingly monitored by sensor networks, but querying their data requires database expertise. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a natural-language interface, yet over raw sensor records they lose track of which sensor, site, and time each value belongs to, and silently miscompute. We present HeriKGQA, a knowledge-graph question-answering method that confines the LLM to interpreting questions and phrasing answers, leaving computation to SPARQL and deterministic code. Questions are parsed into intents constrained by a heritage ontology aligning W3C SOSA/SSN with CIDOC-CRM, compiled into SPARQL, and answered from query results and temporal, spatial, and anomaly facts derived by a grounding layer, with error correction guarding each LLM step. On 500 questions over real data from five heritage sites, HeriKGQA reaches 99.0% accuracy, 18.2 points above the strongest of three baselines using the same LLM and receiving the same anomaly rules and answer conventions, with comparable answer quality while running almost four times faster. Without grounding, accuracy drops by 12.2 points and on anomaly questions from 99% to 66%. We report lessons from development and live deployment.

translation.title: HeriKGQA：基于文化遗产传感器数据的有据知识图谱问答
translation.abstract: 文化遗产遗址越来越多地由传感器网络监测，但查询其数据需要数据库专业知识。大语言模型（LLM）提供了自然语言接口，然而面对原始传感器记录时，它们会丢失每个值所属的传感器、遗址和时间信息，并悄然误算。我们提出 HeriKGQA，一种知识图谱问答方法，将 LLM 限定于解释问题和组织答案，而将计算交给 SPARQL 和确定性代码。问题被解析为受遗产本体约束的意图，该本体将 W3C SOSA/SSN 与 CIDOC-CRM 对齐，随后编译为 SPARQL，并由查询结果以及由接地（grounding）层推导的时间、空间和异常事实来回答，同时每个 LLM 步骤都有纠错保护。在来自五个遗产遗址真实数据的 500 个问题上，HeriKGQA 达到 99.0% 的准确率，比使用同一 LLM、获得相同异常规则和答案约定的三个基线中最强者高出 18.2 个百分点，答案质量相当且运行速度快近四倍。没有接地时，准确率下降 12.2 个百分点，异常类问题准确率从 99% 降至 66%。我们报告了开发与实际部署中的经验教训。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 直接查询文化遗产传感器数据时易混淆传感器归属并误算的问题，方法是将 LLM 限定于理解问题与组织答案，把计算交给本体约束的 SPARQL 查询和确定性代码。

papers.title: Smart Model Routing for Order-of-Magnitude LLM Cost Reduction
papers.abstract: Frontier large language models (LLMs) deliver the strongest response quality but carry per-token prices often more than an order of magnitude above those of smaller, task-adequate models. Smart model routing addresses this mismatch by assigning each query to the cheapest model expected to answer it adequately, rather than sending every request to the most capable, most expensive endpoint. This paper develops a formal cost-quality optimization framework for routing -- including a derived optimal threshold-policy structure, a calibration-versus-discrimination distinction, a cascade breakeven condition, and a sensitivity analysis over price ratio and traffic skew -- situates that framework against the principal routing architectures and the signals used to estimate query difficulty, and works through a numerical example showing how a calibrated router can reduce blended inference cost by roughly an order of magnitude relative to an always-frontier deployment under specific, stated pricing and traffic assumptions, reporting both the gross reduction from routing policy alone and the net figure with the router's own overhead priced in. We situate this figure against the range reported by published routing systems (roughly 2x to frontier-level accuracy at one-fifth the cost), and close with the practical risks -- under- and over-routing, aggregate quality constraints masking segment-level harm, calibration without discrimination, calibration drift, prompt injection into routing signals, and operational failures such as tier outages and multi-provider price variation -- that determine whether the savings materialize in production. The analysis is primarily analytical, complemented by a GSM8K evaluation of the cascade framework (Section 5), validated (Section 5.2); extending the evaluation across tasks and model families is future work.

translation.title: 面向 LLM 成本数量级削减的智能模型路由
