translation.abstract: 前沿大语言模型（LLM）提供最强的响应质量，但其每 token 价格往往比任务够用的小模型高出一个数量级以上。智能模型路由通过将每个查询分配给预期足以胜任的最便宜模型来解决这一错配，而不是把每个请求都发给最强、最昂贵的端点。本文为路由构建了一个形式化的成本-质量优化框架——包括推导出的最优阈值策略结构、校准与区分能力的区分、级联盈亏平衡条件，以及对价格比和流量偏斜的敏感性分析——将该框架与主要路由架构及用于估计查询难度的信号相对照，并通过一个数值示例展示：在明确给出的定价与流量假设下，校准过的路由器相对始终使用前沿模型的部署可将混合推理成本降低约一个数量级，同时报告仅路由策略带来的毛削减以及计入路由器自身开销的净数字。我们将该数字与已发表路由系统报告的范围（约 2 倍到以五分之一成本达到前沿精度）相对照，并最后讨论实际风险——路由不足与过度路由、总体质量约束掩盖细分场景损害、有校准无区分能力、校准漂移、向路由信号注入提示以及运营故障（如层级中断和多供应商价格波动）——这些决定了节省能否在生产中实现。本分析以解析为主，辅以对级联框架的 GSM8K 评估（第 5 节）并加以验证（第 5.2 节）；跨任务和模型家族扩展评估是未来工作。
translation.brief: 解决一律使用前沿 LLM 导致成本过高的问题，方法是建立形式化成本-质量路由优化框架，将每个查询分配给预期够用的最便宜模型。

papers.title: Spec-Driven PBT: Deriving Semantic Invariants from Code Specifications for Agentic Property-based Testing
papers.abstract: Software is increasingly written by AI agents that produce an implementation from a natural language specification, a practice known as agentic coding. Code is now produced faster than it can be reviewed, and has been shown to exhibit its own characteristic failure patterns. Property-based testing (PBT), a long-standing technique in which invariant properties of a program are checked against many generated inputs, has recently been revisited with LLM agents authoring the properties, thereby removing the high-effort derivation of invariants that has long hindered its adoption. Existing methods, however, derive these properties from the implementation alone (Code-driven PBT). At the same time, a thorough specification such as a product requirements document has become routine within agentic coding, yet its role in testing the resulting code remains underexplored. We study the value of the specification as a source of properties for testing agent-written code. Our key insight is that the specification, unlike the implementation, records what the code was meant to do, and invariants derived from it are not biased by particular implementation choices. We propose Spec-Driven PBT, an agent that first expresses invariants in natural language from the specification and only then inspects the implementation to translate them into concrete tests. Across 25 applications from ViBench, Spec-Driven PBT finds a novel set of bugs that Code-driven PBT misses, while writing 2.4x fewer property tests. Though the two approaches surface a roughly equivalent number of bugs, there is little overlap: nearly 60% of the 169 total bugs are found by only one. Qualitatively, we find that the bugs unique to Spec-Driven PBT tend to violate documented product workflows whereas those to Code-driven PBT instead concentrate on implementation robustness, offering complementary value for bug discovery in agent-written code.

translation.title: Spec-Driven PBT：从代码规约中推导语义不变量以实现智能体性质测试
translation.abstract: 软件越来越多地由 AI 智能体依据自然语言规约生成实现，这种实践称为 agentic coding。代码的产出速度已超过其可被审查的速度，并被证明表现出自身特有的失败模式。性质测试（PBT）是一种长期存在的技术，它将程序的不变性质对照大量生成的输入进行检验；近来 LLM 智能体被用于撰写性质，消除了阻碍其采用的高成本不变量推导。然而，现有方法仅从实现本身推导这些性质（Code-driven PBT）。与此同时，详尽的规约（如产品需求文档）在 agentic coding 中已成为常规产物，但其在测试所得代码中的作用仍未被充分探索。我们研究规约作为测试智能体所写代码的性质来源的价值。我们的关键洞察是：与实现不同，规约记录了代码本应做什么，由其推导的不变量不会受特定实现选择的偏置。我们提出 Spec-Driven PBT，一个先用自然语言从规约表达不变量、然后才查看实现以将其转化为具体测试的智能体。在来自 ViBench 的 25 个应用上，Spec-Driven PBT 发现了 Code-driven PBT 遗漏的一组新 bug，同时所写的性质测试少 2.4 倍。尽管两种方法发现的 bug 数量大致相当，但重叠很小：169 个 bug 中近 60% 只被其中一种方法发现。定性分析表明，Spec-Driven PBT 独有的 bug 往往违反文档化的产品工作流，而 Code-driven PBT 独有的 bug 则集中于实现健壮性，为智能体所写代码的 bug 发现提供了互补价值。
translation.brief: 解决现有性质测试仅从实现推导不变量而遗漏产品需求层面 bug 的问题，方法是从规约先用自然语言表达不变量、再对照实现转化为具体测试。

papers.title: ShadowBench: Exposing Lexical Anchoring and the Illusion of Forgetting in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as primary interfaces for factual retrieval, yet current evaluation paradigms rely almost exclusively on explicit entity names. In this work, we demonstrate that LLM knowledge is fundamentally lexically anchored: models possess extensive factual information but find it significantly difficult to retrieve without explicit name tokens. To quantify this limitation, we introduce ShadowBench, a rigorously hardened, shortcut-resistant benchmark designed to evaluate Latent Entity Association via a novel Dual-Trait Association (DTA) task. Our evaluation reveals a pervasive "Shadow Gap" across all model scales$\unicode{x2013}$up to the frontier models GPT-5.4 and Claude-Sonnet-4.6$\unicode{x2013}$where removing lexical anchors causes performance drops of over 20%. Furthermore, we demonstrate that this lexical dependency exposes a critical vulnerability in AI safety. Applying ShadowBench to Machine Unlearning, we find that state-of-the-art algorithms (e.g., Gradient Difference, NPO) achieve only superficial lexical erasure. While unlearned models fail on direct queries, our novel Latent Entity Leakage Rate (LELR) metric reveals that for popular entities, models explicitly reconstruct the "forgotten" entity in their internal reasoning traces in over 74% of cases, utilizing residual shadow knowledge to solve associative tasks. Conversely, for niche entities, models retain high shadow accuracy (60-90%) via implicit attribute correlation despite 0% LELR. Ultimately, ShadowBench indicates that current unlearning paradigms create an "Illusion of Forgetting," demonstrating that existing methods act as superficial output filters and are not yet reliable for achieving true parametric erasure.

translation.title: ShadowBench：揭示大语言模型的词汇锚定与遗忘幻觉
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已成为事实检索的主要接口，但当前评估范式几乎完全依赖显式实体名称。在本工作中，我们证明LLM知识在根本上是词汇锚定的：模型拥有大量事实信息，但在缺少显式名称token时检索会显著困难。为量化这一局限，我们提出ShadowBench，一个经过严格加固、抗捷径的基准，通过新颖的双特征关联（Dual-Trait Association, DTA）任务评估潜在实体关联。我们的评估揭示了跨越所有模型规模的普遍"Shadow Gap"（阴影差距）——直至前沿模型GPT-5.4和Claude-Sonnet-4.6——移除词汇锚定会导致性能下降超过20%。此外，我们证明这种词汇依赖暴露了AI安全中的关键漏洞。将ShadowBench应用于机器遗忘（Machine Unlearning），我们发现最先进的算法（如Gradient Difference、NPO）仅实现了表面的词汇擦除。虽然遗忘后的模型在直接查询上失败，但我们新颖的潜在实体泄露率（Latent Entity Leakage Rate, LELR）指标显示，对于热门实体，模型在超过74%的情况下会在内部推理轨迹中显式重建"被遗忘"的实体，利用残留的阴影知识解决关联任务。相反，对于冷门实体，模型通过隐式属性关联保持较高的阴影准确率（60-90%），尽管LELR为0%。最终，ShadowBench表明当前遗忘范式制造了一种"遗忘幻觉"，证明现有方法只是表面的输出过滤器，尚未能可靠实现真正的参数擦除。
translation.brief: 针对LLM知识依赖显式实体名称、机器遗忘仅擦除表面词汇痕迹的问题，提出ShadowBench基准和潜在实体泄露率（LELR）指标，通过双特征关联任务评估无名称条件下的潜在实体关联与遗忘真实性。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Inventory Control under Regime-Switching Demand: A Controlled Comparison of LSTM, MLP, and (s,S) Policies
papers.abstract: Classical inventory policies such as (s,S) are provably optimal under stationary demand but cannot adapt when demand switches between hidden regimes, and memoryless deep reinforcement learning policies, confined to a fixed observation window, cannot maintain a belief over latent demand structure. We ask whether a recurrent policy offers a measurable advantage over both a memoryless policy and a classical baseline under regime-switching demand, and how that advantage scales with supply-chain lead time. We build a custom Gymnasium environment in which daily demand is generated by a two-state hidden Markov process with Poisson emissions, so that the regime is known at evaluation time but hidden from the agent. An optimised (s,S) heuristic, an MLP PPO agent, and an LSTM Recurrent PPO agent are trained under matched compute and evaluated at lead times of 0, 3, 6, and 10 days over 30 deterministic episodes each. The recurrent policy outperforms both alternatives at every lead time, and its margin over the MLP widens monotonically with lead time, from parity at lead time 0 to 2.17$\times$ at lead time 10. Principal component analysis of the LSTM hidden state explains the widening gap: the representation shifts from encoding a binary regime indicator at short lead times to encoding multi-step pipeline state at long lead times. Recurrent memory becomes the decisive architectural factor as the credit-assignment horizon lengthens.

translation.title: 需求状态切换下库存控制的强化学习：LSTM、MLP与(s,S)策略的受控比较
translation.abstract: 经典库存策略如(s,S)在平稳需求下可证明最优，但当需求在隐藏状态间切换时无法适应；而局限于固定观测窗口的无记忆深度强化学习策略，无法对潜在需求结构维持信念。我们探究在状态切换需求下，循环策略相比无记忆策略和经典基线是否具有可度量的优势，以及该优势如何随供应链提前期扩展。我们构建了一个自定义Gymnasium环境，其中每日需求由具有泊松发射的两状态隐马尔可夫过程生成，状态在评估时已知但对智能体隐藏。在相同计算资源下训练优化过的(s,S)启发式、MLP PPO智能体和LSTM循环PPO智能体，并在0、3、6和10天的提前期下各进行30个确定性回合评估。循环策略在每个提前期下都优于另两种方案，且相对MLP的优势随提前期单调扩大，从提前期0时的持平到提前期10时的2.17倍。对LSTM隐状态的主成分分析解释了这一差距的扩大：表示从短提前期下编码二元状态指示器，转变为长提前期下编码多步管道状态。随着信用分配时间跨度的延长，循环记忆成为决定性的架构因素。
translation.brief: 针对需求在隐藏状态间切换时经典(s,S)策略与无记忆RL策略均失效的问题，通过隐马尔可夫需求环境的受控实验，比较LSTM循环PPO、MLP PPO与优化(s,S)策略在不同提前期下的表现。

papers.title: Starscream: Reimagining LLM Sharding on AMD Instinct GPUs with GPU Partitioning
papers.abstract: As GPU accelerators grow larger to meet rising compute demands, they exhibit increasingly pronounced non-uniform memory access (NUMA) characteristics that challenge existing LLM frameworks. Chiplet-based architectures provide a practical path to larger GPUs while mitigating manufacturing yield constraints. Modern GPUs such as AMD Instinct MI300X employs such a multi-die design, and further offer GPU partitioning capabilities, partitioning a single physical GPU into multiple logical devices with NUMA-aware memory domains, promising faster kernel launches, and reduced memory access latencies with improved locality. However, current parallelization strategies, designed for homogeneous GPU topologies, when applied under partitioning, extend its unidimensional sharding causing significant performance degradation. Three bottlenecks emerge: (1) memory redundancy; (2) arithmetic intensity collapse; (3) communication overhead from flat collectives. We present Starscream, a rethinking of LLM sharding for the chiplet era. Rather than stretching inter-GPU sharding thinner, Starscream adds intra-GPU sharding along an orthogonal dimension, grounded in three foundational principles: kernel shape preservation, memory redundancy elimination, and communication overhead minimization. These principles form the basis for extending any sharding strategy into the partitioning regime. We demonstrate their effectiveness using tensor parallelism as a case study. On AMD MI300X and MI355X, exploiting partitioning capabilities yields up to 4x speedup for attention and 1.43x for fused GEMMs compared to chiplet-oblivious baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of chiplet-aware designs. Starscream's principles generalize across sharding strategies and future architectures.

translation.title: Starscream：利用GPU分区在AMD Instinct GPU上重塑LLM分片
translation.abstract: 随着GPU加速器为满足不断增长的计算需求而变得越来越大，它们呈现出日益显著的非一致性内存访问（NUMA）特征，这对现有LLM框架构成挑战。基于Chiplet的架构在缓解制造良率约束的同时，提供了构建更大GPU的实用途径。AMD Instinct MI300X等现代GPU采用这种多die设计，并进一步提供GPU分区能力，将单个物理GPU划分为多个具有NUMA感知内存域的逻辑设备，有望实现更快的内核启动，并通过改善局部性降低内存访问延迟。然而，当前为同构GPU拓扑设计的并行化策略，在分区环境下应用时会扩展其单维度分片，导致显著的性能退化。三个瓶颈随之出现：（1）内存冗余；（2）算术强度坍塌；（3）扁平集合通信带来的通信开销。我们提出Starscream，对chiplet时代的LLM分片进行重新思考。Starscream不是将跨GPU分片进一步摊薄，而是沿正交维度增加GPU内分片，基于三项基本原则：内核形状保持、内存冗余消除和通信开销最小化。这些原则构成将任何分片策略扩展到分区环境的基础。我们以张量并行作为案例研究证明其有效性。在AMD MI300X和MI355X上，相比不感知chiplet的基线，利用分区能力使注意力获得高达4倍加速，融合GEMM获得1.43倍加速，证明了chiplet感知设计的有效性。Starscream的原则可推广至其他分片策略和未来架构。
translation.brief: 针对GPU分区（NUMA化）下传统跨GPU分片策略导致的内存冗余、算术强度坍塌和通信开销问题，提出Starscream沿正交维度引入GPU内分片，以内核形状保持、消除内存冗余和最小化通信为原则优化张量并行。

papers.title: Cooperative Learning of Shared Latent Dynamics for Distributed Online Optimization
papers.abstract: We study networked agents that must agree on a decision minimizing the sum of their local costs, where each cost contains unmeasurable stochastic parameters that evolve with linear but unknown dynamics shared by all agents. Each agent receives only finitely many noisy gradient measurements and must then keep tracking the moving minimizer. Our scheme reconstructs the parameters from windows of gradients, learns the shared dynamics cooperatively by averaging instrumental-variable moment matrices over the network, and tracks the minimizer by gradient tracking on forecast gradients. We bound the error of every agent in learning the dynamics and in tracking the minimizer, and show that the learning error, and through it the tracking error, decreases with the number of agents. We demonstrate the approach on two case studies.

translation.title: 面向分布式在线优化的共享潜在动力学协同学习
translation.abstract: 我们研究网络化智能体需就一个最小化其局部成本之和的决策达成一致的问题，其中每个成本包含不可测量的随机参数，这些参数以所有智能体共享的线性但未知的动力学演化。每个智能体仅接收有限数量的带噪梯度测量，随后必须持续跟踪移动的最小化点。我们的方案从梯度窗口重建参数，通过网络对工具变量矩矩阵取平均来协同学习共享动力学，并通过对预测梯度进行梯度跟踪来跟踪最小化点。我们为每个智能体在学习动力学和跟踪最小化点方面的误差给出上界，并证明学习误差——以及通过它传导的跟踪误差——随智能体数量的增加而降低。我们通过两个案例研究展示了该方法。
translation.brief: 针对各智能体局部成本中随机参数遵循共享未知线性动力学的分布式在线优化问题，提出从带噪梯度窗口重建参数、通过网络平均工具变量矩矩阵协同学习动力学，并结合梯度跟踪预测最小化点。

papers.title: COMBS: Concealed Object Multi-modal Bayesian Search
papers.abstract: This work addresses the problem of finding a concealed object in an environment by unifying formalisms for partially observable environments with multi-modal priors drawn from a mix of ontologies, semantic networks, LLMs, and VLMs. We propose a concealment-adaptive mixed-observability MDP (CA-MOMDP), a Bayes-adaptive setting where uncertainty is over both object locations and which nodes can conceal them, held as a hypothesis with a bounded ontology prior and resolved only by interaction. We define a hierarchical transition system (HTS) to abstract the environment into room and object nodes that can be planned over via our CA-MOMDP. We further propose a COMBS-score: a multi-modal fusion of a human informed semantic network, LLM, and VLM, to initialize the belief over object locations, which grounds our abstractions and reduces reliance on a single model. Belief is maintained via Bayes' rule, which never lets a look rule out a closed container. We prove a present target is found in a bounded number of searches under exact perception and that its location is never ruled out given missed detection under noisy perception. We ablate each component to demonstrate their significance. Across five simulator configurations, from a gridworld to Matterport3D with a real detector, COMBS finds 92-100% of in-distribution and 92-100% of out-of-distribution targets, matches or beats the baselines in processing speed, significantly outperforms a per-step LLM policy at lower cost on the larger scenes, recovers more out-of-distribution placements than a TidyBot ranking, and matches an LLM-only prior at a fraction of its per-decision latency. COMBS is the only standalone method that can declare a target absent at a stated error level, and the per-step LLM policy offered a termination action abandons 12-22% of targets that were present, against 1.6-3.2% for COMBS on the same episodes.

translation.title: COMBS：隐蔽物体重模态贝叶斯搜索
translation.abstract: 本工作通过统一部分可观测环境的 formalism 与来自本体、语义网络、LLM和VLM混合的重模态先验，解决在环境中寻找隐蔽物体的问题。我们提出隐蔽自适应混合可观测性MDP（CA-MOMDP），一个贝叶斯自适应设定，其不确定性同时涉及物体位置和哪些节点可以隐藏它们，作为带有有界本体先验的假设保持，仅通过交互来解决。我们定义分层转移系统（HTS）将环境抽象为可通过CA-MOMDP规划的房间和物体节点。我们进一步提出COMBS-score：融合人类知情语义网络、LLM和VLM的重模态融合，用于初始化物体位置信念，为我们的抽象提供基础并减少对单一模型的依赖。信念通过贝叶斯规则维护，使得一次查看永远不会排除一个封闭容器。我们证明在精确感知下，一个存在的目标可在有界搜索次数内被找到，且在有噪感知下漏检时其位置永远不会被排除。我们对每个组件进行消融实验以证明其重要性。在五种模拟器配置（从gridworld到使用真实检测器的Matterport3D）中，COMBS找到92-100%的分布内目标和92-100%的分布外目标，处理速度持平或超过基线，在较大场景中以更低成本显著优于逐步LLM策略，比TidyBot排序恢复更多分布外放置，并以极低的每决策延迟匹配LLM-only先验。COMBS是唯一能以给定错误水平宣告目标不存在的独立方法，而提供终止动作的逐步LLM策略在同一回合中放弃了12-22%的实际存在目标，而COMBS仅为1.6-3.2%。
translation.brief: 针对在部分可观测环境中用多模态先验（语义网络、LLM、VLM）搜索隐蔽物体的问题，提出隐蔽自适应混合可观测性MDP（CA-MOMDP）与COMBS-score多模态信念融合方法，以贝叶斯搜索定位目标并支持判定目标不存在。

papers.title: What Roles Do System Prompts Really Assign? Validating and Steering Occupational Role Vectors in LLMs
papers.abstract: Applications built on large language models assign the model a role through its system prompt, intending to shape how it responds for their use case. We introduce a validation framework for extracting and injecting occupational role vectors, activation-level directions that capture how someone in a given occupational role would distinctively respond to a task or question. We validate these vectors through two complementary lenses, on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The interpretability lens asks whether each vector is a stable, separable, domain-consistent representation of its role: extracted vectors are highly reproducible across repeated runs and sampling temperatures, remain separable even for very similar roles, and agree more with themselves across in-domain and out-of-domain questions than with other roles' signal. The control lens asks whether injecting a role vector during generation makes the model express the role, and sustain it over a conversation, as well as a role prompt does. On Qwen, injecting the vector alone makes the model express the intended role substantially more often than unsteered, but at best matches a role prompt; on both models, adding the vector to the prompt strengthens the role in single answers but did not slow the role's decline over 30 turns. Together, the two lenses show why both are needed: out of domain the role is expressed only subtly, yet the activations still encode it; and a vector that is stable and separable can still barely steer the model's behavior.

translation.title: 系统提示词究竟赋予了什么角色？验证与引导大语言模型中的职业角色向量
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型构建的应用通过系统提示词为模型赋予角色，意图塑造模型对其用例的响应方式。我们提出了一个验证框架，用于提取和注入职业角色向量——即在激活层面捕捉特定职业角色的人如何独特地响应任务或问题的方向。我们在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上通过两个互补视角验证这些向量。可解释性视角考察每个向量是否是其角色的稳定、可分离、领域一致的表达：提取的向量在重复运行和不同采样温度下高度可复现，即使对非常相似的角色仍保持可分离，且在同一领域与跨领域问题上与自身的一致性高于与其他角色信号的一致性。控制视角考察在生成过程中注入角色向量能否使模型表达该角色并在对话中持续维持，效果是否与角色提示词相当。在 Qwen 上，仅注入向量就使模型明显比未引导时更频繁地表达目标角色，但至多与角色提示词持平；在两个模型上，将向量加到提示词上能强化单次回答中的角色，但并未减缓角色在30轮对话中的衰减。两个视角结合揭示了为何二者缺一不可：跨领域时角色表达仅隐约可见，但激活仍然编码了它；而一个稳定且可分离的向量仍可能几乎无法引导模型的行为。
translation.brief: 研究系统提示词赋予的职业角色能否被激活向量表示，提出提取-注入框架，从可解释性与控制两个视角验证角色向量的稳定性与引导效果。

papers.title: Imitating the Imperfect: Offline-to-Online Robust Imitation Learning from Heterogeneous Demonstrators
papers.abstract: Imitation learning (IL) typically relies on large-scale offline demonstrations collected from multiple human or algorithmic demonstrators. However, most existing approaches assume these demonstrators are homogeneous or near-optimal experts, a convenient but unrealistic assumption in real-world applications. In practice, demonstrations are often collected from heterogeneous demonstrators with unknown and varying levels of expertise, resulting in highly mixed-quality data. In this work, we study a challenging yet practical setting of imitation learning from such heterogeneous imperfect demonstrators. We propose Latent Expertise and Optimality Scoring based Imitation Learning (LEOS-IL), a principled framework that jointly learns (i) a state-action optimality scoring model and (ii) latent expertise levels for each demonstrator from unlabeled suboptimal offline demonstrations. The learned scoring model is then integrated into an online policy optimization procedure, where the agent is trained to maximize estimated optimality scores while its online rollouts are iteratively leveraged to refine the scoring model, thereby mitigating distributional shift during online adaptation. We further provide theoretical guarantees for optimality score identification and conditional optimal occupancy and policy recovery under explicit sufficient conditions. Experiments on continuous control benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing baselines across highly heterogeneous and low-quality demonstration regimes.

translation.title: 模仿不完美者：来自异质示范者的离线到在线鲁棒模仿学习
translation.abstract: 模仿学习（IL）通常依赖于从多个人类或算法示范者收集的大规模离线示范。然而，现有方法大多假设这些示范者是同质的或接近最优的专家，这一假设虽然方便但在现实应用中并不现实。实践中，示范往往来自专业水平未知且参差不齐的异质示范者，导致数据质量高度混杂。本文研究从这类异质不完美示范者学习这一具有挑战性又切合实际的模仿学习设定。我们提出基于潜在专业水平与最优性打分的模仿学习（LEOS-IL），这是一个原则性框架，从无标注的次优离线示范中联合学习：（i）状态-动作最优性打分模型，以及（ii）每个示范者的潜在专业水平。学习到的打分模型随后被集成到在线策略优化过程中，智能体在最大化估计最优性得分的同时训练，而其在线 rollout 又被迭代地用于精化打分模型，从而在在线适应中缓解分布偏移。我们还在明确的充分条件下为最优性得分识别和条件最优占据测度与策略恢复提供了理论保证。在连续控制基准上的实验表明，我们的方法在高度异质和低质量示范情形下始终优于现有基线。
translation.brief: 针对示范者专业水平参差不齐的模仿学习问题，提出 LEOS-IL 框架，联合学习最优性打分模型与示范者潜在专业水平，并将其融入在线策略优化以缓解分布偏移。

papers.title: Scaling public input on AI policy with pluralistic agents
papers.abstract: AI is being deployed across a vast range of application domains, cultural environments, and human stakeholders. Safe and responsible AI development requires continuously accounting for diverse perspectives. We develop and test pluralistic agents, AI agent representatives that deliberate on behalf of individuals to align AI systems with diverse human perspectives. Pluralistic agents could help people contribute to many more discussions than they could directly participate in, on technical topics that would require training, and on policy choices that rely on private information that corporations and governments cannot readily share. Our experiments identify opportunities, risks, and perceptions of pluralistic agents. Agents were able to reliably shift policies in the direction of their represented persona's preferences, but the extent of each agent's influence was sensitive to the instructions from its persona, such as having more influence when instructed to be more verbose or less cooperative. This suggests that influence in AI-assisted deliberation could vary based on how participants prompt their agents and how the system is designed. In a preregistered study, 746 humans participated in the pluralistic agents process. Participants viewed pluralistic agents as useful and fair, preferring agents over the baseline of providing input to a single AI reasoning model. Most participants preferred participating themselves over either pluralistic agents or the baseline, but pluralistic agents recovered 68% of the baseline-direct gap in reported satisfaction and 82% in fairness. Because pluralistic agents can be used in many real-world contexts where direct discussion is not, they could be a promising tool to scale AI safety policy development. We encourage cautious exploration of this method, playing to its strengths as an amplifier of human input rather than a replacement.

translation.title: 用多元代理扩大公众对AI政策的参与
translation.abstract: AI 正被部署到广泛的应用领域、文化环境和人类利益相关者中。安全且负责任的 AI 开发需要持续纳入多元视角。我们开发并测试了多元代理——代表个人进行商议的 AI 代理代表，以使 AI 系统与多元人类视角对齐。多元代理可以帮助人们参与远超其直接参与能力的讨论，涉及需要专业训练的技术话题，以及依赖企业和政府难以共享的私人信息的政策选择。我们的实验识别了多元代理的机会、风险与感知。代理能够可靠地将其所代表人物的偏好方向反映到政策中，但每个代理的影响力大小对其人物给出的指令敏感，例如被指示更啰嗦或更不合作时影响力更大。这表明 AI 辅助商议中的影响力可能取决于参与者如何提示其代理以及系统如何设计。在一项预注册研究中，746 人参与了多元代理流程。参与者认为多元代理有用且公平，相比向单一 AI 推理模型提供意见的基线更偏好代理。大多数参与者仍更愿意亲自参与而非使用多元代理或基线，但多元代理在报告满意度上弥补了基线与直接参与之间差距的68%，在公平性上弥补了82%。由于多元代理可应用于许多无法直接讨论的现实场景，它们有望成为扩展 AI 安全政策制定的工具。我们鼓励对这一方法进行谨慎探索，发挥其作为人类意见放大器而非替代品的优势。
translation.brief: 提出多元代理方法，让AI代表个人参与AI政策商议以纳入多元视角，并通过人类实验评估其效果、风险与用户感知。

papers.title: Plurality Consensus for $h$-Majority via First-Repetition Rules
papers.abstract: In the h-Majority dynamics, each of n agents holds one of k opinions and, in every synchronous round, observes the opinions of h agents chosen independently and uniformly at random and adopts a most frequent one among them, breaking ties uniformly at random. Let M_0 be the initial number of agents holding the most frequent opinion, and Delta_0 its bias, its lead over the second most frequent opinion. We show that, for every sample size h >= 3, if Delta_0 >= L sqrt(M_0 log n) max{1, n/(h^2 M_0)} for a sufficiently large constant L, then h-Majority reaches consensus on the initially most frequent opinion within O((1 + n/(h^2 M_0)) log n) rounds with high probability. This is the time bound proved for the DejaVu dynamics with h samples (arXiv:2604.03648); our bias condition is that of DejaVu when h >= sqrt(n/M_0), and larger by a factor sqrt(n/(h^2 M_0)) otherwise. Our main contribution, the analysis of one round, rests on a comparison principle: among all rules that read the same observations and treat opinions symmetrically, plurality maximizes the difference between the probability of outputting the most frequent opinion and that of outputting any fixed competitor. We apply it to the rule that adopts the first opinion repeated among h-1 observations, and otherwise the h-th observation: its output law is the law of the new opinion of a random agent after one round of DejaVu with h-1 samples. Hence, in expectation, one round of h-Majority widens the gap between the most frequent opinion and each competitor at least as much as that round of DejaVu, whose analysis we use as a black box. Independently and concurrently, d'Amore, Rybicki, Shimizu, Shiraga and Vacus (arXiv:2610.40562) obtained, among other results, the same time bound under the weaker bias condition of DejaVu, with a different analysis of one round and a martingale analysis over many rounds.

translation.title: 基于首次重复规则的 h-多数多样性共识
translation.abstract: 在 h-Majority 动力学中，n 个智能体各持有 k 种意见之一，在每个同步轮次中观察独立均匀随机选取的 h 个智能体的意见，并采纳其中最频繁的一种，平票时均匀随机打破。设 M_0 为初始持有最频繁意见的智能体数量，Delta_0 为其偏置，即领先于第二频繁意见的幅度。我们证明，对每个样本量 h >= 3，若 Delta_0 >= L sqrt(M_0 log n) max{1, n/(h^2 M_0)}（L 为足够大的常数），则 h-Majority 会以高概率在 O((1 + n/(h^2 M_0)) log n) 轮内就初始最频繁意见达成共识。这是针对 h 样本 DejaVu 动力学证明的时间界（arXiv:2604.03648）；当 h >= sqrt(n/M_0) 时我们的偏置条件即 DejaVu 的条件，否则要大一个因子 sqrt(n/(h^2 M_0))。我们的主要贡献是单轮分析，其基础是一个比较原理：在所有读取相同观察并平等对待各意见的规则中，多样性规则最大化输出最频繁意见的概率与输出任一固定竞争意见的概率之差。我们将其应用于一个规则：采纳 h-1 个观察中首个重复出现的意见，否则采纳第 h 个观察：其输出分布等于 h-1 样本 DejaVu 一轮之后随机智能体新意见的分布。因此，在期望意义上，一轮 h-Majority 至少与该轮 DejaVu 一样多地扩大最频繁意见与各竞争意见之间的差距，而我们将 DejaVu 的分析作为黑盒使用。独立且并行地，d'Amore、Rybicki、Shimizu、Shiraga 和 Vacus（arXiv:2610.40562）在其他结果之外，在更弱的 DejaVu 偏置条件下得到了相同的时间界，采用不同的单轮分析和基于鞅的多轮分析。
translation.brief: 研究 h-Majority 投票动力学的多样性共识问题，通过比较原理证明单轮等价于 DejaVu 规则，从而给出共识时间上界及偏置条件。

papers.title: Privacy Leakage from Recurrent State in LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Personalized LLM services place private facts and application instructions into a prompt, then retain representations of that context for later inference. Latent-state LLMs compress part of this history into fixed-size recurrent state. The information preserved by its learned updates is implicit, and later computation can expose it even when an observer receives neither the private text nor the responses. We investigate privacy leakage from recurrent state through partial-state probing and physical observation of its use. Our methodology separates recoverable information, persistence through public dialogue, causal influence on later decisions, and leakage through power. Experiments with released hybrid implementations show that a small state observation supports multiple predictions about private facts and response rules, and that personal attributes generalize to unseen authors. The information remains inferable after public dialogue and changes later decision margins. Complete-read power recovers private facts under a fixed execution schedule. On a partitioned GPU, an unprivileged account infers age from whole-device power during public requests; a separate state-isolation experiment establishes the recurrent contribution to this channel. These findings extend context confidentiality to the lifetime and execution of retained state. They identify access-control responsibilities for serving systems, telemetry restrictions for GPU operators, and data-dependent power leakage for accelerator designers.

translation.title: LLM 推理中循环状态导致的隐私泄露
translation.abstract: 个性化 LLM 服务将私人事实与应用指令放入提示词，然后保留该上下文的表示以供后续推理。潜在状态型 LLM 将部分历史压缩为固定大小的循环状态。其学习到的更新所保留的信息是隐式的，即使观察者既未收到私人文本也未收到响应，后续计算也可能将其暴露。我们通过对循环状态的部分状态探测及其使用的物理观察，研究循环状态的隐私泄露问题。我们的方法论区分了可恢复信息、经公开对话的持久性、对后续决策的因果影响以及通过功耗的泄露。在已发布的混合实现上的实验表明，对状态的小规模观察即可支持对私人事实和响应规则的多种预测，且个人属性可泛化到未见过的作者。这些信息在公开对话后仍可推断，并会改变后续决策边界。在固定执行调度下，完整读取功耗即可恢复私人事实。在分区 GPU 上，非特权账户可在公开请求期间从整机功耗推断年龄；一个独立的状态隔离实验确立了循环状态对这一信道的贡献。这些发现将上下文机密性扩展到保留状态的生命周期与执行过程。它们为服务系统指出了访问控制责任，为 GPU 运营者指出了遥测限制，为加速器设计者指出了数据依赖的功耗泄露问题。
translation.brief: 研究个性化 LLM 循环状态的隐私泄露问题，通过状态探测与功耗侧信道等方法揭示私人信息可被恢复、持久并影响后续决策。

papers.title: Human-Likeness and Conversational Preference Diverge for Synthesized Agent Speech in Customer-Service Calls
papers.abstract: Listeners can judge an agent's speech on how human it sounds (human-likeness) and on how much they would want to talk to it (conversational preference). Listening tests rarely ask about conversational preference, so the relation between the two judgments is unclear. We compared them in paired-choice tests on 120 turns that actors improvised as customer-service representatives. On each trial, two agents spoke the same turn. In Study 1, both agents came from six commercial text-to-speech systems, each with eight voices. In Study 2, one was the actor's original recording and the other a system. Some systems ranked higher on human-likeness, and others on conversational preference. Listeners chose systems over actors in 19% of human-likeness trials but 36% of conversational preference trials (and 49% for the most preferred system). On both judgments, variation among a system's voices was about three-quarters of that between systems. Of three automatic naturalness scores, two predicted lower human-likeness, and none predicted conversational preference. In this setting, listeners tended to favor faster speech and fewer pauses between clauses on both judgments, and more pitch variation for conversational preference. Thus, measuring only human-likeness or testing one voice per system can misjudge which agents listeners would rather talk to.

translation.title: 客服通话中合成语音的人性化程度与会话偏好出现分歧
translation.abstract: 听者可以从语音听起来有多像人（人性化程度）以及他们有多愿意与其交谈（会话偏好）两方面评价智能体的语音。听觉测试很少询问会话偏好，因此这两种评判之间的关系尚不明确。我们在演员即兴扮演客服代表的120个话轮上，通过成对选择测试对二者进行比较。每次试验中，两个智能体朗读同一话轮。研究1中，两个智能体均来自六个商用文本转语音系统，每个系统有八个音色；研究2中，一个是演员的原始录音，另一个是系统。部分系统在人性化程度上排名更高，另一些则在会话偏好上排名更高。在人性化程度测试中，听者在19%的试验中选择了系统而非演员，而在会话偏好测试中这一比例为36%（最受偏好系统达49%）。在两项评判上，同一系统内部不同音色之间的差异约为不同系统之间差异的四分之三。在三个自动自然度评分中，有两个能预测较低的人性化程度，但无一能预测会话偏好。在该场景中，无论哪种评判，听者都倾向于更快的语速和子句间更少的停顿，而在会话偏好上还偏好更丰富的音高变化。因此，仅测量人性化程度或每个系统只测试一个音色，可能会误判听者更愿意与哪些智能体交谈。
translation.brief: 研究合成客服语音中'像人程度'与'愿意交谈偏好'两种评价的分歧，通过成对选择听测比较商用TTS系统与演员录音并分析语音特征影响。

papers.title: Wayfinder: Adaptive Resource Routing from Agent Citations
papers.abstract: To act effectively, agents must gather contextual information across resources such as chats, issue trackers, email and knowledge bases, to answer questions like "what was decided in the last project meeting?" or "where is the FAQ for our internal tooling?" Where this information lives in a user's environment is unknown to the agent, so it re-explores the same resources across consecutive interactions. Common routing approaches represent each resource as a tool and rely on high-level descriptions to generalize to unseen environments. Such descriptions often fail to separate similar or overlapping resources and cannot improve from the agent's subsequent interactions. We introduce Wayfinder, an adaptive router that uses the documents cited by the downstream agent as feedback about where relevant information resides. These citations update Wayfinder's internal resource representations, which subsequent interactions use to prioritize the resources likely to contain relevant information. We also introduce resource augmentation during offline reinforcement learning, which anonymizes and permutes resource identities to discourage training-time overfitting of which resource holds which topic; our ablations suggest it helps most when few training environments are available. Because no openly available professional environments pair realistic queries with resource-access patterns, we construct and release three controlled testbeds derived from existing datasets: NFCorpus, FEVER and Tech Startup. Compared with supervised, tool-retrieval and contextual bandit baselines under a shared closed-loop protocol, Wayfinder gives the best routing when resources contain semantically overlapping content that static descriptions cannot distinguish, while description-based tool retrieval suffices when resources are drawn from distinct corpora.

translation.title: Wayfinder：基于智能体引用的自适应资源路由
translation.abstract: 为有效行动，智能体必须跨聊天、问题跟踪器、邮件和知识库等资源收集上下文信息，以回答诸如'上次项目会议决定了什么？'或'我们内部工具的FAQ在哪里？'等问题。这些信息在用户环境中的位置对智能体是未知的，因此它在连续交互中会重复探索相同的资源。常见的路由方法将每个资源表示为一个工具，并依赖高层描述来泛化到未见过的环境。这类描述往往无法区分相似或重叠的资源，也无法从智能体的后续交互中改进。我们提出Wayfinder，一种自适应路由器，它将下游智能体引用的文档作为相关信息所在位置的反馈。这些引用会更新Wayfinder的内部资源表示，后续交互据此优先考虑可能包含相关信息的资源。我们还引入了离线强化学习中的资源增强，通过匿名化和置换资源身份来防止训练时对'哪个资源属于哪个主题'的过拟合；消融实验表明，在训练环境很少时它最有帮助。由于没有公开可用的、将真实查询与资源访问模式配对的专业环境，我们基于现有数据集NFCorpus、FEVER和Tech Startup构建并发布了三个受控测试平台。在共享闭环协议下与监督式、工具检索和上下文赌臂基线相比，当资源包含静态描述无法区分的语义重叠内容时，Wayfinder的路由效果最佳，而当资源来自不同语料库时，基于描述的工具检索已足够。
translation.brief: 提出Wayfinder自适应路由器，利用下游智能体引用的文档作为反馈更新资源表示，以解决跨资源信息路由中相似资源难以区分、无法从交互中学习的问题。

papers.title: Sub-actions in Action: Text-Guided Hand-Role Alignment for Sub-Action Recognition
papers.abstract: Our objective is to enhance VLMs ability to distinguish the roles of the left and right hands in egocentric actions. We introduce sub-action detection, a task that requires models to explicitly recognise the left- and right-hand roles and their manipulated objects within an ongoing high-level action. To address this challenge, we propose BiScopeNet, a framework that augments existing video-LLMs without modifying their vision encoders or language models. BiScopeNet incorporates two components: FocusAlign, a gated text-guided attention-based module that selectively aligns video features with textual context to emphasise action-relevant cues, and MetaLoss, a masked, object-weighted loss that prioritises visually grounded terms. To supervise sub-action detection, we introduce BiScopeCap-100K, a large-scale video-level dataset curated from existing egocentric datasets, providing dense captions that jointly describe high-level actions, left/right-hand roles, and manipulated objects, enriched with spatial metadata for grounding. Across the evaluated Video-LLM backbones, BiScopeNet improves action, hand-role, and object recognition over the corresponding supervised baselines, achieving the strongest aggregate performance among the evaluated configurations on BiScopeCap.

translation.title: 行动中的子动作：面向子动作识别的文本引导手部角色对齐
translation.abstract: 我们的目标是增强VLMs区分自我中心动作中左右手角色的能力。我们提出子动作检测任务，要求模型在正在进行的高层动作中显式识别左右手角色及其操作的物体。为应对这一挑战，我们提出BiScopeNet，一个在不修改现有video-LLM的视觉编码器或语言模型的前提下对其进行增强的框架。BiScopeNet包含两个组件：FocusAlign，一个门控的文本引导注意力模块，选择性地将视频特征与文本上下文对齐以突出与动作相关的线索；以及MetaLoss，一个掩码的、物体加权损失，优先考虑视觉有据的词项。为监督子动作检测，我们构建了BiScopeCap-100K，一个从现有自我中心数据集整理而成的大规模视频级数据集，提供联合描述高层动作、左右手角色和被操作物体的密集字幕，并配有用于定位的空间元数据。在所评估的各Video-LLM骨干上，BiScopeNet在动作、手部角色和物体识别上均优于相应的监督基线，并在BiScopeCap上取得所评估配置中最强的综合性能。
translation.brief: 提出BiScopeNet，通过文本引导注意力对齐（FocusAlign）和物体加权损失（MetaLoss）增强video-LLM识别自我中心动作中左右手角色及操作物体的能力，并构建BiScopeCap-100K数据集。

papers.title: "It's Just a Small Weapon": What Rewarding Misbehavior During RL Does to Character-Trained Models
papers.abstract: Developers train models to follow a consistent character using methods like Model Spec Midtraining (Li et al., 2026), which have been hypothesized to make alignment more robust and generalize broadly. However, it is possible for subsequent RL with misspecified rewards to work against character training. In this work, we apply character training to teach gpt-oss-20b a semi-realistic constitution and study how it interacts with two types of RL that reward breaking the constitution's rules (opposing RL): answering harmful requests rewritten as math problems, and reward hacking in agentic coding environments. The character-trained models learn both behaviors easily, though they are slightly slower than gpt-oss-20b to answer harmful requests. Character-trained models also display more motivated reasoning on harmful answers than gpt-oss-20b, and hack on some tasks which monitors find harder to catch. Finally, since explaining the reasons behind rules can improve how alignment generalizes (Kutasov et al., 2026), we compare constitutions that justify the same rules by grounding them in a value or not, and find little difference between motivations on misalignment, honesty, and capability evaluations.

translation.title: “这只是件小武器”：RL中奖励不当行为对角色训练模型的影响
translation.abstract: 开发者使用Model Spec Midtraining（Li et al., 2026）等方法训练模型遵循一致的角色，这类方法被假设能使对齐更鲁棒并广泛泛化。然而，后续使用错误指定奖励的RL可能抵消角色训练的效果。在这项工作中，我们对gpt-oss-20b应用角色训练以教会其一个半现实的宪法，并研究它与两类奖励违反宪法规则（对抗性RL）的RL的相互作用：回答被改写为数学问题的有害请求，以及在agentic编程环境中的reward hacking。角色训练后的模型都能轻松学会这两种行为，尽管它们比gpt-oss-20b回答有害请求稍慢。角色训练后的模型在有害回答上还表现出比gpt-oss-20b更多的动机性推理，并在一些监控器更难发现的任务上进行hack。最后，由于解释规则背后的理由可以改善对齐的泛化（Kutasov et al., 2026），我们比较了通过诉诸价值来论证相同规则与否的宪法，发现不同动机在错位、诚实和能力评估上几乎没有差别。
translation.brief: 研究角色训练后的模型在后续奖励违反规则的RL（有害问答与reward hacking）下是否更易错位，并比较有无价值论证的宪法的影响。

papers.title: Agentic Computational Algebra
papers.abstract: We explore the use of AI agents for solving computational problems in algebra. For the problems we consider, the main challenge is not correctness but \emph{time}: general-purpose algorithms are guaranteed to provide correct solutions but can be prohibitively slow, while reformulations that exploit special structure often allow solving a problem much faster. We propose to use this setting to evaluate how effectively agents discover and exploit structure within and across tasks to reduce computational costs. More broadly, computational algebra supplies infinitely many problems with independently verifiable answers and systematically controllable structure and difficulty. To illustrate these possibilities, we use benchmark families of systems with controlled shared structure and evaluate agents in three settings: solving independent instances, solving online streams of related instances using persistent memory, and compiling a fast reusable solver for a known problem family. Our experiments show that (i) agents can extend the range of systems solvable within a fixed budget, although reasoning overhead can sometimes outweigh computational savings; (ii) memory can reduce the cost of repeated solving but may preserve suboptimal strategies; (iii) compilation produces faster reusable solvers but at substantial upfront cost. Overall, computational algebra offers concrete, measurable targets for improving how agents discover and reuse structure.

translation.title: 智能体化计算代数
translation.abstract: 我们探索使用AI智能体求解代数中的计算问题。对于我们所考虑的问题，主要挑战不是正确性而是时间：通用算法保证给出正确解但可能慢得难以接受，而利用特殊结构的重新表述往往能快得多地求解。我们提议用这一场景来评估智能体在任务内和跨任务中发现并利用结构以降低计算成本的能力。更广泛地说，计算代数提供了无穷多的、答案可独立验证且结构和难度可系统控制的问题。为展示这些可能性，我们使用具有受控共享结构的基准问题族，并在三种设置下评估智能体：求解独立实例、使用持久记忆求解相关实例的在线流，以及为已知问题族编译快速可复用的求解器。我们的实验表明：(i) 智能体能扩展在固定预算内可求解系统的范围，尽管推理开销有时会超过计算节省；(ii) 记忆能降低重复求解的成本，但可能保留次优策略；(iii) 编译能产出更快的可复用求解器，但前期成本高昂。总体而言，计算代数为改进智能体发现和复用结构的方式提供了具体、可度量的目标。
translation.brief: 提出用计算代数问题族评测AI智能体发现与复用数学结构以降低计算成本的能力，评估独立求解、带记忆流式求解和编译求解器三种设置。

papers.title: Trained on What Screen Readers Cannot Read: Accessibility Debt in the GUI Corpora Behind Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract: Computer-use agents learn to operate mobile interfaces from corpora of captured screens and accessibility trees. The same trees are what a screen reader consumes, so an agent trained on them inherits whatever labelling gaps the underlying applications carry. This paper measures one of those gaps, content-description coverage, in two Android corpora: Rico, collected in 2017, and AndroidControl, collected in 2024. Across 17,373,614 interface elements, 17.74% of the Rico elements that need a content description under our coding rule carry one, against 57.27% in AndroidControl. The difference of 39.5 percentage points holds under five alternative coding rules and when whole apps are resampled. It describes two datasets that also differ in app selection, capture method and platform version; it does not measure change over time. Input controls are the least labelled role in both corpora (2.20% and 27.21%, or 30.99% in AndroidControl if hint text counts as a name). Descriptions in the older corpus are also five times more likely to be placeholders (10.25% against 1.95%), so the difference is not an artefact of developers typing filler. Resolving 26,205 task actions to the elements they touched shows that, among tappable graphics with no text, demonstrations operate elements described 9.0 points more often than the others on the screens they visit, about 3.5 points of it from the choice of element within a screen. That is a selection effect inside the benchmark. A two-coder reliability check (kappa = 0.91 and 0.96) and the full pipeline accompany the paper.

translation.title: 训练于屏幕阅读器无法读取之物：计算机使用智能体背后 GUI 语料库中的无障碍债务
translation.abstract: 计算机使用智能体从捕获的屏幕截图和 accessibility tree 语料库中学习操作移动界面。这些树正是屏幕阅读器所消费的内容，因此在它们之上训练的智能体会继承底层应用所带有的标注缺口。本文在两个 Android 语料库中测量了其中一个缺口——content description 覆盖率：2017 年收集的 Rico 和 2024 年收集的 AndroidControl。在 17,373,614 个界面元素中，按我们的编码规则，Rico 中需要 content description 的元素只有 17.74% 带有描述，而 AndroidControl 为 57.27%。这一 39.5 个百分点的差距在五种替代编码规则和整应用重采样的情况下依然成立。它描述的是两个在应用选择、捕获方式和平台版本上也有差异的数据集；它并未测量随时间的变化。输入控件在两个语料库中都是标注最少的角色（2.20% 和 27.21%，若将 hint text 算作名称，AndroidControl 为 30.99%）。较老语料库中的描述也更可能是占位符（10.25% 对 1.95%，相差五倍），因此这一差异并非开发者随意填写占位文本造成的假象。将 26,205 个任务动作解析到它们所触碰的元素后可以看到，在无文字的可点击图形中，示范操作在其访问的屏幕上更频繁地操作了有描述的元素（比其他元素高 9.0 个百分点），其中约 3.5 个百分点来自屏幕内对元素的选择。这是基准测试内部的选择效应。论文还附带了双人编码者可靠性检验（kappa = 0.91 和 0.96）以及完整流程。
translation.brief: 该论文测量两个 Android GUI 语料库中界面元素的 content description 覆盖缺口，采用统一的编码规则、多种编码规则敏感性分析和任务动作解析来量化无障碍标注债务及其对基准测试的影响。

papers.title: How Do People Debug Complex SQL Queries With LLMs? A Qualitative Study
papers.abstract: While LLMs are increasingly used in various contexts, we lack a fundamental understanding of how they impact SQL query debugging. In response, we conducted a user study with 16 participants of varying SQL expertise, examining how they debug complex SQL queries with and without LLM support. Initial benchmarking indicated that our selected models are already capable SQL debuggers. Qualitative analyses of our study data revealed that while participants trusted the LLM, they varied widely in how and whether they delegated debugging tasks to the LLMs, which we characterized through a new three-state model of participants' SQL reasoning processes. Additionally, participants enforced specific collaborative roles for the LLM such as TA or sounding board, which participants controlled by withholding context from the LLM. These findings suggest that LLM-based tools could enable preset role selection, broader context management, and flexible automation features, including low automation options, to support SQL debugging moving forward.

translation.title: 人们如何使用 LLM 调试复杂 SQL 查询？一项定性研究
translation.abstract: 尽管 LLM 在各种场景中的使用日益增多，我们对它们如何影响 SQL 查询调试仍缺乏基本理解。为此，我们开展了一项有 16 名不同 SQL 水平参与者参加的用户研究，考察他们在有和没有 LLM 支持的情况下如何调试复杂 SQL 查询。初步基准测试表明，我们选用的模型已经具备相当的 SQL 调试能力。对研究数据的定性分析显示，虽然参与者信任 LLM，但他们在是否以及如何将调试任务委托给 LLM 上差异很大，我们通过一个新的参与者 SQL 推理过程三态模型对此进行了刻画。此外，参与者为 LLM 设定了特定的协作角色，如助教（TA）或讨论伙伴，并通过向 LLM 隐瞒上下文来控制这些角色。这些发现表明，未来的 LLM 工具可以提供预设角色选择、更广泛的上下文管理以及灵活的自动化功能（包括低自动化选项），以支持 SQL 调试。
translation.brief: 该论文通过 16 人用户研究考察人在有/无 LLM 支持下调试复杂 SQL 的行为，采用定性分析提出 SQL 推理三态模型和 LLM 协作角色刻画。

papers.title: ADAPT: Agentic Diff-Aware Patch Testing for Pull Requests
papers.abstract: Modern software development relies on pull requests (PRs) that introduce small, targeted code changes. Once merged, these changes should be protected by focused tests that exercise the behavior the PR introduces, yet developers often submit PRs without such tests, leaving the new behavior unguarded against future regressions. Most test generation techniques target entire software units and optimize objectives such as code coverage rather than the behavior a change introduces, and prior diff-aware approaches have had limited success in capturing it. We propose ADAPT (Agentic Diff-Aware Patch Testing), a regression test generation approach that uses an autonomous coding agent to produce change-focused tests for PRs. Given a PR, the agent analyzes the diff between the base and head versions to identify the modified functions and their context, then plans and generates candidate unit tests. A dedicated fail-to-pass (F2P) verification tool runs each candidate on both versions and, after F2P success, reports which executable changed lines remain uncovered; guided by this feedback, the agent iteratively refines its tests. We evaluate ADAPT on the same 426 real-world PRs used by the prior state-of-the-art baseline, with GPT-4o and GPT-5-mini. ADAPT+GPT-4o reaches an F2P rate of 62.0% (264/426), compared with BLAST's reported 35.4% (151/426), while ADAPT+GPT-5-mini reaches 89.9% (383/426). On 137 PRs shared with Change And Cover (ChaCo), ADAPT achieves full patch coverage on 83.9% of PRs, compared with 79.6% for ChaCo, at considerably lower time and cost. A manual evaluation confirms that the F2P-valid tests target each PR's intended change, with mean scores of up to 4.54/5 for importance, 4.35/5 for assertion strength, and 4.49/5 for readability, often covering behavior beyond the developer-written tests.

translation.title: ADAPT：面向 Pull Request 的智能体式 Diff 感知补丁测试
translation.abstract: 现代软件开发依赖引入小而针对性代码变更的 pull request（PR）。合并后，这些变更应由聚焦测试保护，以验证 PR 引入的行为，但开发者常常提交不带此类测试的 PR，使新行为缺乏对未来回归的防护。大多数测试生成技术面向整个软件单元，优化代码覆盖率等目标而非变更引入的行为，此前的 diff 感知方法在捕捉变更行为方面收效有限。我们提出 ADAPT（Agentic Diff-Aware Patch Testing），一种利用自主编码智能体为 PR 生成以变更为中心的回归测试的方法。给定一个 PR，智能体分析基线版本与头版本之间的 diff，识别被修改的函数及其上下文，然后规划并生成候选单元测试。专门的 fail-to-pass（F2P）验证工具在两个版本上运行每个候选测试，在 F2P 成功后报告哪些可执行变更行仍未被覆盖；智能体在该反馈引导下迭代改进测试。我们在与先前最先进基线相同的 426 个真实 PR 上，使用 GPT-4o 和 GPT-5-mini 评估 ADAPT。ADAPT+GPT-4o 的 F2P 率达到 62.0%（264/426），而 BLAST 报告的为 35.4%（151/426）；ADAPT+GPT-5-mini 达到 89.9%（383/426）。在与 Change And Cover（ChaCo）共享的 137 个 PR 上，ADAPT 在 83.9% 的 PR 上实现完整补丁覆盖，而 ChaCo 为 79.6%，且时间和成本显著更低。人工评估证实 F2P 有效测试确实针对每个 PR 的目标变更，重要性、断言强度和可读性的平均得分最高达 4.54/5、4.35/5 和 4.49/5，且常覆盖超出开发者自写测试的行为。
translation.brief: 该论文针对 PR 缺少针对变更行为的测试问题，提出用自主编码智能体分析 diff 并结合 fail-to-pass 验证反馈迭代生成聚焦回归测试的 ADAPT 方法。

papers.title: Intent-Aware Protection for AI Agents
papers.abstract: AI agents increasingly access enterprise data, invoke powerful tools, and act with limited human oversight. Existing security defenses primarily detect prompt injection, harmful outputs, or suspicious behavior, but do not determine whether an agent remains faithful to the purpose for which it was deployed. An action may contain no attack pattern and stay within granted permissions while still violating the agent's role, organizational constraints, or purpose. We introduce Intent- Aware Security, a framework that treats trusted agent intent as a first-class security object. We define Intent Preservation and Intent Drift, and operationalize them through an Intent Profile: an agent-specific representation extracted from organizational, role, and developer intent. We further introduce an Intent-Aware benchmark of 887 validated samples across 35 agents, built by a generation procedure that fixes ground-truth labels before LLM realization, and four Intent Profile-based protections: pre-execution detection, post-execution detection, input alignment, and system-prompt hardening. Across all evaluations, Intent Profile-based protection outperforms all profile-free baselines on the primary metric. On our benchmark, it raises four-class acro-F1 from 45% to 79% (Out-of-Scope F1 from 8% to 76%). On more than 10,000 executed AgentDojo trajectories, where ground truth comes from environment state, profile-based post-execution detection reaches 0.949 AUROC versus AlignmentCheck 0.909, 0.897 with raw agent configuration and 0.843 without context. Profile-based input alignment improves protection success by 7 points over DataFilter with a comparable benign utility. These results suggest that an agent's intended purpose can serve as a useful security reference for detecting and mitigating deviations from its deployed role and operational boundaries.

translation.title: 面向 AI 智能体的意图感知防护
translation.abstract: AI 智能体日益访问企业数据、调用强大工具，并在有限的人类监督下行动。现有安全防御主要检测 prompt injection、有害输出或可疑行为，但无法判断智能体是否仍忠实于其部署时的目的。一个动作可能不含任何攻击模式且在授权权限范围内，却仍然违反了智能体的角色、组织约束或目的。我们提出 Intent-Aware Security 框架，将可信的智能体意图视为一等安全对象。我们定义 Intent Preservation 与 Intent Drift，并通过 Intent Profile 将其可操作化：一种从组织、角色和开发者意图中提取的智能体专属表示。我们进一步构建了覆盖 35 个智能体、887 个经验证样本的 Intent-Aware benchmark，其生成流程在 LLM 具体化之前先固定 ground-truth 标签；并提出四种基于 Intent Profile 的防护：执行前检测、执行后检测、输入对齐和 system prompt 加固。在所有评估中，基于 Intent Profile 的防护在主要指标上优于所有无 profile 的基线。在我们的 benchmark 上，它将四分类 macro-F1 从 45% 提升至 79%（Out-of-Scope F1 从 8% 提升至 76%）。在超过 10,000 条实际执行的 AgentDojo 轨迹上（ground truth 来自环境状态），基于 profile 的执行后检测达到 0.949 AUROC，而 AlignmentCheck 为 0.909，使用原始 agent 配置为 0.897，无上下文为 0.843。基于 profile 的输入对齐在良性效用相当的情况下，将防护成功率比 DataFilter 提高 7 个百分点。这些结果表明，智能体的预期目的可以作为检测和缓解其偏离部署角色与运行边界的有效安全参照。
translation.brief: 该论文针对智能体行为合法但仍偏离部署目的这一防护盲区，提出以组织/角色/开发者意图构建 Intent Profile，并据此实现执行前后检测、输入对齐与 prompt 加固四种防护。

papers.title: SwarmSafe-Delta: Isolating Message Effects on LLM Agent Safety
papers.abstract: When a tool-using LLM agent team violates policy, aggregate outcomes do not reveal whether an upstream message changed the executor's action. We introduce SwarmSafe-Delta, a paired executable protocol that freezes upstream computation, varies real, hidden, and format-matched placebo delivery, and scores a single committed action against deterministic benign and risky policy states under preassigned budgets. Across four models and constructed optional tasks, real delivery at $N=4$ produces 21.4% risky-world violations, versus 5.0% with placebo and 1.0% with hidden delivery (paired differences +16.4 and +20.3 percentage points). Real delivery also improves benign task success, illustrating that suppressing communication sacrifices utility. In a second regime constructed to require an upstream lookup route, real delivery improves safe completion by 74.2 points relative to hidden delivery. These effects quantify message-delivery contrasts under specified information dependencies, not naturally occurring failure rates. Exploratory action-level analyses show that the effect depends strongly on whether the upstream message recommends a prerequisite check or direct execution; model differences also largely track these message compositions. The contribution is a controlled, execution-grounded measurement protocol rather than a general claim that agent communication is harmful or protective.

translation.title: SwarmSafe-Delta：隔离消息对 LLM 智能体安全性的影响
translation.abstract: 当一个使用工具的 LLM 智能体团队违反策略时，总体结果无法揭示某条上游消息是否改变了执行者的行为。我们提出 SwarmSafe-Delta，一种配对的可执行协议：冻结上游计算，分别以真实送达、隐藏送达和格式匹配的安慰剂方式投递消息，并在预设预算下对照确定性的良性/风险策略状态对单个提交动作进行评分。在四个模型和构造的可选任务上，N=4 时的真实送达产生 21.4% 的风险世界违规，而安慰剂为 5.0%、隐藏送达为 1.0%（配对差异分别为 +16.4 和 +20.3 个百分点）。真实送达同时提升了良性任务成功率，说明压制通信会牺牲效用。在第二个被构造为需要上游查询路径的情形中，真实送达相比隐藏送达将安全完成率提升 74.2 个百分点。这些效应量化的是在指定信息依赖下的消息送达对比，而非自然发生的失败率。探索性的动作级分析表明，该效应强烈依赖于上游消息是建议执行前置检查还是直接执行；模型间的差异也基本可由这些消息构成解释。本文的贡献是一个受控的、以实际执行为依据的测量协议，而非关于智能体通信有害或有益的一般性主张。
translation.brief: 该论文针对无法从群体结果中归因单条消息对智能体安全影响的问题，提出冻结上游计算并用真实/隐藏/安慰剂配对投递方式评分单次动作的 SwarmSafe-Delta 测量协议。

papers.title: Does a Self-Learning Migration Agent Learn? An Audited Evaluation of Evidence-Graded Experience Memory for Oracle-to-PostgreSQL Migration
papers.abstract: Do large language model (LLM) migration agents learn from accumulated experience, or do apparent gains reflect retrieval and reference reuse? We evaluate an evidence-graded agent for Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration across four studies. On 1,833 documentation-derived source-reference pairs, persistent memory improved reference conformity (RC) over a no-memory baseline by 0.015 [0.004, 0.025], while policy adaptation added no gain (-0.004 [-0.010, 0.001]). An audit found that 264 of 367 held-out units (72%) shared a PostgreSQL reference with training, and the memory effect on the 103 leak-free units fell to 0.002 [-0.008, 0.011]. A model-free nearest-target copy baseline scored RC 0.222, outperforming all LLM systems (at most 0.163). A reference-grouped split reduced copying to 0.119; a rerun on 374 units in 118 independent target groups found no statistically distinguishable memory effect (0.005 [-0.003, 0.017]) and no policy effect. A separate Oracle-grounded evaluation on 216-224 real PL/SQL units showed that 10-22% of PostgreSQL-accepted units were behaviorally incorrect; a human-gated fix cycle increased demonstrably correct units from 98/216 to 167/224. A write-back study showed a 54% decline in retrieval margin as the knowledge base grew from 12 to 1,200 entries. We derive six evaluation rules that distinguish cross-task learning from reference leakage, copying, metric artifacts, and unstable feedback.

translation.title: 自学习迁移智能体真的在学习吗？面向 Oracle 到 PostgreSQL 迁移的证据分级经验记忆审计式评估
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）迁移智能体是否从积累的经验中学习，还是表面的收益只是检索和参考复用的产物？我们通过四项研究评估了一个用于 Oracle 到 PostgreSQL 迁移的证据分级智能体。在 1,833 个从文档提取的源-参考配对上，持久记忆相对于无记忆基线将参考符合度（RC）提升了 0.015 [0.004, 0.025]，而策略适配没有带来增益（-0.004 [-0.010, 0.001]）。审计发现 367 个留出单元中有 264 个（72%）与训练集共享同一 PostgreSQL 参考，而在 103 个无泄漏单元上记忆效应降至 0.002 [-0.008, 0.011]。一个无需模型的最近目标复制基线得到 RC 0.222，优于所有 LLM 系统（最高 0.163）。按参考分组的切分将复制降低到 0.119；在 118 个独立目标组的 374 个单元上重跑，未发现统计上可区分的记忆效应（0.005 [-0.003, 0.017]），也没有策略效应。另一项基于 Oracle 的评估在 216-224 个真实 PL/SQL 单元上进行，显示 10-22% 被 PostgreSQL 接受的单元在行为上是错误的；一个人工把关的修复循环将可证明正确的单元从 98/216 提升到 167/224。一项回写研究显示，随着知识库从 12 条增长到 1,200 条，检索边际下降了 54%。我们由此得出六条评估规则，用以区分跨任务学习与参考泄漏、复制、度量伪影和不稳定反馈。
translation.brief: 该论文检验 LLM 迁移智能体的记忆收益是否为真实学习，采用审计式评估（泄漏检测、复制基线、分组切分等）构建区分真实学习与泄漏、复制及度量伪影的评估规则。

papers.title: HyperPage: Learned Page Layouts for Disk-Resident Graph Vector Indexes
papers.abstract: Disk-resident graph indexes such as DiskANN store each vector with its graph edges as one record on SSD pages. A search needs the page of every record it expands, so its page reads depend on the page layout, that is, which records share a page. Search agents trained with reinforcement learning query one such index run after run, and every graph traversal can be logged with the records it expands. We therefore use the logs of a finished run to lay out the index for a declared memory budget, so later runs read fewer pages. In contrast, existing layouts such as Starling and MARGO are computed from the graph and vectors and use no logs. Learning a layout from logs is challenging, because the logs must stay valid under every layout, the saving depends on what the budget caches, and the best layout is NP-hard to find. Our key observation is that DiskANN-style search routes on in-memory codes and the records it expands, never on their page-mates. As a result, the logged traversals price every layout by replay, and cached records add no page reads. Accordingly, we propose HyperPage, which first builds layouts for the declared budget on the logged traversals of uncached records. It then selects one layout, together with the budget split between hot records and a page cache, by replaying validation steps. In addition, a Lagrangian lower bound shows how far a layout may be from the optimum. We learn from one Search-R1 agent run and test on a later run with a different reward, over 1M and 21M passages. Across seven cache budgets, HyperPage reads 5.2% to 21.2% fewer pages than MARGO, and no compared layout reads fewer. The advantage is largest when the cache is small. For example, at 1% of the 1M index, MARGO needs nearly 3 times the budget to read as few pages. On the 21M index, HyperPage also cuts search time per step by up to 10.4%. The saving holds for a second agent model and a second corpus.

translation.title: HyperPage：面向磁盘驻留图向量索引的学习式页面布局
translation.abstract: DiskANN 等磁盘驻留图索引将每个向量及其图边作为一条记录存储在 SSD 页面上。一次搜索需要读取它扩展的每条记录所在的页面，因此页面读取次数取决于页面布局，即哪些记录共享同一页面。用强化学习训练的搜索智能体在一次次运行中查询这样的索引，而每次图遍历都可以记录下它扩展的记录。因此，我们利用一次已完成运行的日志，在给定内存预算下为索引布局，使后续运行读取更少的页面。相比之下，Starling 和 MARGO 等现有布局仅从图和向量计算得到，不使用日志。从日志学习布局具有挑战性，因为日志在每种布局下都必须保持有效，节省量取决于预算缓存的内容，而寻找最优布局是 NP 难题。我们的关键观察是：DiskANN 风格的搜索基于内存中的编码和它扩展的记录进行路由，从不依赖其同页记录。因此，日志中的遍历可以通过重放为每种布局定价，且被缓存的记录不会带来额外页面读取。据此，我们提出 HyperPage：它首先在未缓存记录的日志遍历上为给定预算构建布局，然后通过重放验证步骤选择一个布局以及预算在热点记录与页面缓存之间的分配。此外，拉格朗日下界显示了布局与最优解的差距。我们从一个 Search-R1 智能体的运行中学习，并在具有不同奖励的后续运行上测试，语料规模为 1M 和 21M 篇文档。在七个缓存预算下，HyperPage 比 MARGO 少读 5.2% 到 21.2% 的页面，且没有任何对比布局读取更少。缓存越小优势越大：例如在 1M 索引的 1% 缓存下，MARGO 需要近 3 倍的预算才能读到同样少的页面。在 21M 索引上，HyperPage 还将每步搜索时间最多降低 10.4%。该节省在第二个智能体模型和第二个语料库上依然成立。
translation.brief: 针对磁盘图向量索引搜索页面读取过多的问题，提出 HyperPage，通过重放搜索智能体运行日志来学习页面布局并优化缓存预算分配。

papers.title: PolicySniff: Inferring Agent Policy States through Shared-GPU Execution
papers.abstract: LLM agents apply approval settings, such as whether to ask before a consequential tool call, through instructions in their system prompt, and operators keep these settings confidential by restricting access to prompts and responses. Audits check whether an agent obeys its setting, not whether a neighboring process can infer which setting is deployed. PolicySniff infers an agent's approval-policy state through shared-GPU execution. A co-resident attacker that knows the candidate settings and the task first profiles both settings, then times only its own GPU kernels while the agent processes the task. The policy prefix is cached before capture, so the attacker observes processing of a task suffix that is identical under both settings. On an eager sparse mixture-of-experts runtime, where each selected expert runs as separate work, a frozen and blinded study identified the deployed setting at 94.17% balanced accuracy on its primary estimand. Across all authorization conditions, accuracy was 88.82% on tasks for which both settings produce the same decision and 91.98% on tasks where they differ. Hardware replays of expert routing show that its temporal density and layer-and-bucket alignment carry the policy information. Behavioral compliance does not imply configuration confidentiality: deployments that keep their approval setting private should measure its distinguishability on the serving runtime and enforce authorization outside the model.

translation.title: PolicySniff：通过共享 GPU 执行推断智能体策略状态
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体通过系统提示中的指令来应用审批设置，例如在执行有重大影响的工具调用前是否需要询问，而运营者通过限制对提示与响应的访问来对这些设置保密。审计检查的是智能体是否遵守其设置，而不是相邻进程能否推断部署的是哪种设置。PolicySniff 通过共享 GPU 执行推断智能体的审批策略状态。一个共驻的攻击者在已知候选设置和任务的条件下，先对两种设置进行剖析，然后在智能体处理任务时仅对其自身的 GPU 内核计时。策略前缀在捕获前已被缓存，因此攻击者观察到的是两种设置下完全相同的任务后缀的处理过程。在急切稀疏混合专家运行时上（每个被选中的专家作为独立工作运行），一项冻结且致盲的研究在其主要估计量上以 94.17% 的平衡准确率识别出部署的设置。在所有授权条件下，对两种设置产生相同决策的任务准确率为 88.82%，对决策不同的任务为 91.98%。对专家路由的硬件重放表明，其时间密度以及层与桶的对齐携带了策略信息。行为合规并不意味着配置保密：希望保密其审批设置的部署应在服务运行时上测量其可区分性，并在模型之外实施授权。
translation.brief: 该论文解决共享 GPU 上相邻进程可推断 LLM 智能体审批策略的问题，提出 PolicySniff，通过共驻攻击者对其自身 GPU 内核计时来侧信道推断部署的策略状态。

papers.title: JudgeMix: Judge-Guided Mixed-Rollout Data Synthesis for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on expert trajectories is a standard paradigm for training LLM agents. However, it suffers from a well-known training-inference distribution mismatch, calling for target-aware data synthesis strategies that ground the training data in the target model's native state distribution. To bridge this gap, emerging approaches incorporate the expert either to guide mixed rollouts alongside the target model, or to provide dense step-wise supervision. Nonetheless, existing methods apply expert assistance blind to the target model's inherent behavior: they either disrupt the rollout using sub-optimal random intervention heuristics, or they enforce indiscriminate uniform supervision that unnecessarily overwrites the model's already-correct actions. We introduce JudgeMix, a judge-guided data synthesis framework that dynamically interleaves the target model and expert based on step-wise semantic evaluations. JudgeMix queries expert guidance precisely when the target model struggles, ensuring high trajectory success rates while keeping the state distribution aligned with the target model. It additionally uses the judge evaluation to reweight expert supervision on different steps, preserving model's inherent valid behavior while correcting its errors. On two agentic tool-use benchmarks, AppWorld and AutomationBench, JudgeMix demonstrates consistent superior performance to existing methods, with improvements up to 10 pass@1 points.

translation.title: JudgeMix：面向 LLM 智能体的裁判引导混合 rollout 数据合成
translation.abstract: 在专家轨迹上进行监督微调（SFT）是训练 LLM 智能体的标准范式。然而，它存在众所周知的训练-推理分布失配问题，需要以目标模型的原生状态分布为基础的目标感知数据合成策略。为弥合这一差距，新兴方法引入专家，要么引导目标模型参与的混合 rollout，要么提供密集的逐步监督。但现有方法对目标模型的固有行为视而不见地应用专家辅助：要么使用次优的随机干预启发式破坏 rollout，要么实施不加区分的均匀监督，不必要地覆盖模型已经正确的动作。我们提出 JudgeMix，一个由裁判引导的数据合成框架，基于逐步语义评估动态交错目标模型与专家。JudgeMix 精确地在目标模型遇到困难时查询专家指导，确保高轨迹成功率，同时保持状态分布与目标模型对齐。它还利用裁判评估对专家在不同步骤上的监督进行重加权，保留模型固有的正确行为，同时纠正其错误。在 AppWorld 和 AutomationBench 两个智能体工具使用基准上，JudgeMix 表现持续优于现有方法，pass@1 提升最高达 10 个百分点。
translation.brief: 针对 SFT 训练-推理分布失配问题，提出 JudgeMix，用裁判评估在目标模型受困步骤动态引入专家并重加权监督信号来合成训练数据。

papers.title: Stack more levels: how to get general and human-like Mario playing
papers.abstract: Super Mario Bros. is widely used in game AI and procedural content generation (PCG), yet it remains unclear whether a model-free agent can reliably win unseen levels. To address this question, we train Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agents on increasingly large sets of PCG-generated Mario levels and evaluate their generalization on 1000 held-out test levels. We then shape competent PPO policies into three gameplay archetypes---runner, killer, and collector. Finally, we fine-tune these PPO policies using Diffusion-Reward Adversarial Imitation Learning (DRAIL) with human gameplay demonstrations. We find that increasing the number of distinct PCG-generated training levels generally improves unseen-level performance, and that fine-tuning PPO policies with DRAIL increases action-level human-likeness while preserving much of the persona induced by PPO pretraining.

translation.title: 堆叠更多关卡：如何实现通用且类人的马里奥游戏
translation.abstract: 《超级马里奥兄弟》被广泛用于游戏 AI 和程序化内容生成（PCG），但目前仍不清楚无模型智能体能否可靠地通关未见过的关卡。为回答这个问题，我们在规模逐渐增大的 PCG 生成马里奥关卡集合上训练近端策略优化（PPO）智能体，并在 1000 个留出测试关卡上评估其泛化能力。随后，我们将有能力的 PPO 策略塑造成三种玩法原型——奔跑者、歼灭者和收集者。最后，我们使用基于人类游戏演示的扩散奖励对抗模仿学习（DRAIL）对这些 PPO 策略进行微调。我们发现，增加 PCG 生成训练关卡的数量通常能提升未见关卡上的表现，而用 DRAIL 微调 PPO 策略能在保留 PPO 预训练所诱导的大部分角色的同时，提高动作层面的类人程度。
translation.brief: 该论文研究无模型智能体在未见 PCG 生成马里奥关卡上的泛化与类人性，核心方法是用递增规模的训练关卡训练 PPO，再用基于人类演示的 DRAIL 进行微调。

papers.title: Fast Serverless LLM Cold Starts by Sharing and Prewarming Startup Work
papers.abstract: When a serverless LLM platform launches a model worker on demand, the cold start lasts roughly a minute, yet only 5-11% of it is spent loading weights. Most of the remainder goes to compilation, memory profiling and runtime setup, which each server performs again even though the outcome is identical across servers or independent of the model. We present Cairn. The server that is first to start a model publishes the weights and engine artifacts to a CXL memory pool shared across the cluster, and the remaining servers read them in place. Model-independent setup is completed ahead of time inside warm containers, and a template process replaces each container as soon as it is used. With ServerlessLLM on vLLM v0.20, six models from 1B to 14B, and two servers that share an emulated CXL pool, Cairn speeds up cold starts by 4.1-5.2x on servers without a checkpoint of their own and reduces median TTFT on a request stream by 64%.

translation.title: 通过共享与预热启动工作加速无服务器 LLM 冷启动
translation.abstract: 当无服务器 LLM 平台按需启动一个模型 worker 时，冷启动大约持续一分钟，但其中只有 5-11% 的时间用于加载权重。其余大部分时间用于编译、内存分析和运行时设置，而这些工作每个服务器都要重复执行，尽管其结果在各服务器间完全相同或与模型无关。我们提出了 Cairn。第一个启动某模型的服务器将权重和引擎产物发布到集群共享的 CXL 内存池中，其余服务器直接原地读取。与模型无关的设置工作提前在热容器内完成，一旦容器被使用，模板进程便立即替换它。在 vLLM v0.20 上的 ServerlessLLM、1B 到 14B 的六个模型，以及共享模拟 CXL 池的两个服务器的实验中，Cairn 使没有自身 checkpoint 的服务器冷启动提速 4.1-5.2 倍，并将请求流的 median TTFT 降低 64%。
translation.brief: 解决无服务器 LLM 平台冷启动过慢（主要是编译、内存分析等重复性设置）的问题，核心方法是通过 CXL 共享内存池共享启动产物并在热容器中提前预热模型无关的设置工作。

papers.title: Data-Efficient LLM Safety Alignment Guided by Interpretable Features
papers.abstract: Existing large language models typically rely on massive fine-tuning datasets for safety alignment, which results in higher costs for safety alignment and often leads to the problem of over-refusal. We propose Less is Safer (LIS), a compact yet highly effective dataset for safety alignment, constructed through interpretable feature-guided selection and adversarial synthesis. Specifically, we leverage Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) activations to efficiently select prompts that cover diverse and interpretable safety features. Then, we employ a multi-agent adversarial synthesis framework to generate harmless prompts that nevertheless elicit unnecessary refusals. LIS contains only 2.4K samples, yet outperforms much larger datasets, e.g., TRIDENT-Core (26K), TRIDENT-Edge (19K) and WildJailbreak (262K), in overall performance on four safety and five over-refusal benchmarks. Through ablation experiments, we demonstrate that neither safety data nor over-refusal data alone can achieve optimal results. We also used safety features from SAE, annotated by an LLM, for data filtering, but the results were inferior to those obtained using the pipeline proposed in this paper.

translation.title: 由可解释特征引导的数据高效 LLM 安全对齐
translation.abstract: 现有大型语言模型通常依赖海量微调数据集进行安全对齐，这导致安全对齐成本更高，且常常引发过度拒答问题。我们提出 Less is Safer (LIS)，一个紧凑却极为有效的安全对齐数据集，通过可解释特征引导的选择和对抗式合成构建。具体而言，我们利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）激活来高效选择覆盖多样且可解释安全特征的 prompt。然后，我们采用多智能体对抗合成框架生成虽无害但会引发不必要拒绝的 prompt。LIS 仅包含 2.4K 样本，却在四个安全基准和五个过度拒答基准的总体性能上超越规模大得多的数据集，例如 TRIDENT-Core (26K)、TRIDENT-Edge (19K) 和 WildJailbreak (262K)。通过消融实验，我们证明仅靠安全数据或仅靠过度拒答数据都无法达到最优效果。我们还使用由 LLM 标注的 SAE 安全特征进行数据过滤，但结果劣于本文提出的流程。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 安全对齐依赖海量数据且易过度拒答的问题，核心方法是利用 SAE 可解释特征进行数据选择，并结合多智能体对抗合成构建仅 2.4K 样本的高效对齐数据集。

papers.title: SBA: A Practical Memory Performance Denial-of-Service Attack
papers.abstract: Modern cloud platforms use memory bandwidth regulation to isolate co-located workloads, implicitly assuming that high aggregate bandwidth consumption implies high interference. We show that this assumption is fundamentally flawed. We present the Single-Bank Attack (SBA), a practical memory denial-of-service attack that induces extreme cross-core slowdowns---over three orders of magnitude on memory-intensive victims (e.g., LLM decode)---while consuming less than 1 GB/s of memory bandwidth. SBA exploits the gap between peak and worst-case DRAM throughput by concentrating memory write operations on a single bank, forcing persistent row conflicts and frequent write draining, thereby collapsing the memory service rate. Across Intel and AMD systems, including DDR5- and HBM2E-based platforms, SBA consistently causes orders-of-magnitude slowdowns under realistic multi-tenant settings, revealing a fundamental limitation of bandwidth-centric memory isolation. We further show that this localized contention propagates system-wide: single-bank congestion saturates memory controller queues and induces back-pressure into shared cache and coherence structures, ultimately throttling memory request injection across cores. Consequently, severe interference can arise even at low aggregate bandwidth, evading existing bandwidth-based QoS mechanisms such as Intel RDT MBA. To address this limitation, we propose IQ-MemGuard, a lightweight, software-based memory bandwidth regulator that detects sustained contention using microarchitectural signals and selectively throttles pathological request injection. Our implementation on an Intel platform effectively mitigates SBA, whereas Intel's hardware QoS mechanism fails completely.

translation.title: SBA：一种实用的内存性能拒绝服务攻击
translation.abstract: 现代云平台使用内存带宽调节来隔离同驻工作负载，隐含地假设高聚合带宽消耗意味着高干扰。我们证明这一假设存在根本性缺陷。我们提出了 Single-Bank Attack (SBA)，一种实用的内存拒绝服务攻击，可在消耗不到 1 GB/s 内存带宽的情况下，引发极端的跨核减速——对内存密集型受害者（如 LLM decode）可超过三个数量级。SBA 利用 DRAM 峰值吞吐量与最坏情况吞吐量之间的差距，将内存写操作集中到单个 bank 上，强制产生持续的行冲突和频繁的写排空，从而瓦解内存服务速率。在 Intel 和 AMD 系统上，包括基于 DDR5 和 HBM2E 的平台，SBA 在现实的多租户设置下始终造成数量级的减速，揭示了以带宽为中心的内存隔离的根本局限。我们进一步展示这种局部争用会向全系统传播：单 bank 拥塞会使内存控制器队列饱和，并向共享缓存和一致性结构引入背压，最终限制跨核的内存请求注入。因此，即使在低聚合带宽下也可能产生严重干扰，从而绕过基于带宽的 QoS 机制（如 Intel RDT MBA）。为解决这一局限，我们提出 IQ-MemGuard，一个轻量级的基于软件的内存带宽调节器，它利用微架构信号检测持续争用，并选择性地限制病态的请求注入。我们在 Intel 平台上的实现有效缓解了 SBA，而 Intel 的硬件 QoS 机制则完全失效。
translation.brief: 揭示基于带宽的内存隔离假设的缺陷，核心方法是将写操作集中到单个 DRAM bank 引发行冲突从而在低带宽下造成严重干扰，并提出基于微架构信号检测的软件缓解方案 IQ-MemGuard。

papers.title: When can an interpretability claim be trusted? Stability and certification of feature dimensionality, ridge leverage and the feature recovery rate
papers.abstract: Interpretability tools increasingly support safety claims, such as that a sparse dictionary has recovered most of a model's features. Such claims rest on measurements with arbitrary thresholds, and small changes to the model weights, a different training seed or a different threshold can reverse them. We study two widely used measurements in toy models and synthetic dictionaries with known ground truth: the feature dimensionality of Elhage et al. and the feature recovery rate (FRR) with a cosine threshold. We characterize exactly where feature dimensionality is discontinuous and replace it with a regularized (ridge) version with sharp stability bounds: the ridge leverage score changes by at most $3\sqrt{3}/(8\sqrt{\lambda})$ times the operator-norm change of the weights, and this constant cannot be improved; for the regularized dimensionality the stability constant grows like $\rho/4$ in the scale $\rho=R/\sqrt{\lambda}$, with explicit upper and lower bounds. We also prove certificates stating when a claim "feature $i$ is recovered" must survive a given change of the dictionary. The certificates held in every test and are informative for small perturbations, but certify no feature non-trivially across independently trained dictionaries; at the standard threshold, whether a feature counts as recovered changed with the training seed for 55 percent of features. Experiments use toy models only. The proofs, code and text were drafted by AI agents directed by the authors and checked by an independent blind AI reviewer and by numerical tests; the authors take full responsibility for the content.

translation.title: 何时可以信任可解释性声明？特征维数、岭杠杆与特征恢复率的稳定性与认证
translation.abstract: 可解释性工具日益支撑安全声明，例如稀疏字典已恢复模型的大部分特征。此类声明依赖于带有任意阈值的测量，而模型权重的微小变化、不同的训练种子或不同的阈值都可能使其反转。我们在具有已知真值的玩具模型和合成字典中研究两种广泛使用的测量：Elhage 等人的特征维数（feature dimensionality）和使用余弦阈值的特征恢复率（FRR）。我们精确刻画了特征维数的不连续位置，并用具有尖锐稳定性界线的正则化（岭）版本取代它：岭杠杆分数的变化至多为 $3\sqrt{3}/(8\sqrt{\lambda})$ 乘以权重的算子范数变化，且该常数无法改进；对于正则化维数，稳定性常数在尺度 $\rho=R/\sqrt{\lambda}$ 下按 $\rho/4$ 增长，并给出显式的上下界。我们还证明了认证（certificate），说明声明“特征 $i$ 已恢复”何时必须在字典的给定变化下仍然成立。这些认证在每次测试中均成立，且对小扰动具有信息量，但对独立训练的字典无法非平凡地认证任何特征；在标准阈值下，55% 的特征的“是否被恢复”随训练种子而变化。实验仅使用玩具模型。证明、代码和文本由作者指导的 AI 智能体起草，并由独立的盲审 AI 评审员和数值测试核查；作者对内容负全部责任。
translation.brief: 解决可解释性测量（特征维数、特征恢复率）对权重变化和阈值选择敏感、不可靠的问题，核心方法是用具有尖锐稳定性界线的岭正则化版本替代原有度量并证明其认证条件。

papers.title: An Agentic Python Framework for LLM-Driven UVM Testbench Synthesis with Closed-Loop Compiler Feedback
papers.abstract: Protocol bridge verification is a persistent bottleneck in SoC development: for every new bridge instance, engineers hand-craft a full UVM testbench from scratch, consuming 40--100 engineering hours of bring-up effort. We present an agentic Python framework that generates complete, protocol-aware UVM testbenches for arbitrary IP and subsystem configurations from a structured Verification Manifest---a JSON specification encoding interface topology, protocol semantics, and coverage intent. The framework employs a dual closed-loop architecture: an inner compiler feedback loop that injects categorised UVM diagnostics rather than raw tool output, and an outer coverage loop driven by intent-gap analysis against the Manifest. Validated on the AMBA AHB-to-APB bridge---a representative production protocol bridge with a 7-state control FSM, two-phase APB handshake, and non-trivial burst serialisation logic---the framework achieves 96.8% functional coverage, a $4.7\times$ bring-up speedup, and a Protocol Verification Completeness score of 0.87, with only 2.1% of the generated 4,623-line testbench requiring human correction. The generated scoreboard independently identified a critical RTL functional fault that the manual baseline missed entirely. Generalisation across four protocol families confirms that speedup increases with protocol complexity, ranging from $3.1\times$ (APB Subordinate) to $6.1\times$ (CHI Subordinate).

translation.title: 一种用于 LLM 驱动 UVM 测试平台合成的智能体式 Python 框架（带闭环编译器反馈）
translation.abstract: 协议桥验证是 SoC 开发中的持续瓶颈：每出现一个新的桥实例，工程师都需从头手工构建完整的 UVM 测试平台，耗费 40–100 个工程小时的搭建工作。我们提出一个智能体式 Python 框架，可从结构化的 Verification Manifest——一种编码接口拓扑、协议语义和覆盖率意图的 JSON 规范——为任意 IP 和子系统配置生成完整、协议感知的 UVM 测试平台。该框架采用双闭环架构：内环为编译器反馈回路，注入分类后的 UVM 诊断而非原始工具输出；外环为覆盖率回路，由针对 Manifest 的意图差距分析驱动。在 AMBA AHB-to-APB 桥——一个具有 7 状态控制 FSM、两相 APB 握手和非平凡 burst 序列化逻辑的代表性生产级协议桥——上验证，该框架达到 96.8% 的功能覆盖率、4.7 倍的搭建加速和 0.87 的协议验证完整性分数，且生成的 4,623 行测试平台中仅需人工修正 2.1%。生成的 scoreboard 独立发现了一个手工基线完全遗漏的关键 RTL 功能故障。在四个协议族上的泛化验证表明加速比随协议复杂度增加，范围从 3.1 倍（APB Subordinate）到 6.1 倍（CHI Subordinate）。
translation.brief: 解决 SoC 协议桥 UVM 测试平台需大量人工编写的问题，核心方法是基于结构化 Verification Manifest 由 LLM 智能体生成测试平台，并结合内环编译器反馈与外环覆盖率分析的双闭环架构。

papers.title: Turning Multi-Agent Communication into Token-Level Credit with On Policy Self Distillation
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning improves problem solving in large language model multi-agent systems. Existing approaches overlook communication knowledge or compress it into scalar rewards, leaving coarse credit with little guidance on which decisions each agent should reinforce or revise. OPSD4MAS converts future communication into fine-grained token-level credit through On Policy Self Distillation (OPSD). An external model extracts facts and assesses their trajectory relations for coarse-grained filtering, followed by fine-grained leave-one-out filtering of target-token influence against agent-wise outcome advantages. The fact-conditioned policy supplies token-level credit, combined with GRPO through a linearly annealed joint objective. Our method improves mathematical pass@4 over GRPO by up to 20.00 percentage points. Ablations support complete filtering, while frozen-history injection diagnostics support fact utility. Together, these results support combining agent-level outcome guidance with communication-derived token-level credit. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 将多智能体通信转化为词元级信用：基于在线策略自蒸馏
translation.abstract: 强化学习可以提升大语言模型多智能体系统的问题求解能力。现有方法要么忽视通信知识，要么将其压缩为标量奖励，导致信用分配过于粗糙，无法为每个智能体应强化或修改哪些决策提供指导。OPSD4MAS 通过在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）将未来通信转化为细粒度的词元级信用。外部模型首先提取事实并评估其与轨迹的关系进行粗粒度过滤，随后针对智能体级别的结果优势对目标词元影响进行细粒度的留一法过滤。事实条件化的策略提供词元级信用，并通过线性退火的联合目标与 GRPO 相结合。我们的方法将数学任务的 pass@4 相比 GRPO 提升最多 20.00 个百分点。消融实验支持完整过滤流程的有效性，冻结历史注入诊断支持事实的效用。这些结果共同支持将智能体级结果指导与源自通信的词元级信用相结合。代码见 https 链接。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体通信信用分配粗糙的问题，核心方法是用在线策略自蒸馏将通信转化为词元级信用并与 GRPO 联合训练。

papers.title: Guided Generation of Linux Kernel Semantic Patches with Small Local Language Models
papers.abstract: When a Linux kernel API changes, hundreds of drivers are converted by hand over months, and the earlier conversions are reviewed examples for the later ones. We ask whether small open language models running on a laptop can turn such examples into Coccinelle semantic patches, the rules kernel maintainers already use for tree-wide changes. We adapt guided code generation to this task: the training examples are decomposed by script into a tree of change variants, the model writes one small rule per variant under feedback from applying it to the examples, deterministic components repair SmPL syntax and generalise driver-specific names, rules are composed greedily, and a compile critic repairs or rejects a rule whose output does not build. We evaluate on a pre-registered test set of 7 migrations whose new APIs appeared after the training cutoffs of all three models (Qwen2.5-Coder 7B, Llama 3.1 8B, Gemma 3 4B), with 122 held-out driver conversions, counting a conversion as solved only if the rule's output matches the human fix and compiles. With the framework, Qwen2.5-Coder solves 35.3 conversions on average over three seeds (range 32-41), against 1.0 when prompted directly; Spinfer solves 41 and a frontier LLM agent 66. The local model solves fewer conversions than Spinfer but its rules are the most precise on the test set (0.74 of the files they change are solved, against 0.55 for Spinfer and 0.70 for the frontier agent), and the compile critic removes every output that matches the human fix but does not build. The two general-purpose models stay weak even with guidance (at most 12 solved). All code, prompts, model responses and results are released.

translation.title: 利用小型本地语言模型引导生成 Linux 内核语义补丁
translation.abstract: 当 Linux 内核 API 变更时，数百个驱动程序需要耗费数月手工转换，而较早的转换可作为后续转换的评审样例。我们探讨在笔记本电脑上运行的小型开源语言模型能否将此类样例转化为 Coccinelle 语义补丁——内核维护者已用于全树范围变更的规则。我们将引导式代码生成适配到这一任务：脚本将训练样例分解为变更变体树，模型在将规则应用于样例所获反馈的指导下，为每个变体编写一条小规则；确定性组件修复 SmPL 语法并泛化驱动程序特定名称；规则被贪心地组合；编译批评器会修复或拒绝输出无法编译的规则。我们在一个预注册测试集上评估，包含 7 个迁移任务（其新 API 出现在全部三个模型——Qwen2.5-Coder 7B、Llama 3.1 8B、Gemma 3 4B——的训练截止时间之后），共 122 个留出驱动程序转换，只有当规则输出与人工修复一致且能编译时才算解决。借助该框架，Qwen2.5-Coder 在三个种子上的平均解决数为 35.3（范围 32-41），直接提示仅 1.0；Spinfer 解决 41 个，前沿 LLM 智能体解决 66 个。本地模型解决数少于 Spinfer，但其规则在测试集上最为精确（其修改的文件中 0.74 被正确解决，Spinfer 为 0.55，前沿智能体为 0.70），且编译批评器剔除了所有与人工修复一致但无法编译的输出。两个通用模型即使有引导仍然薄弱（最多解决 12 个）。所有代码、提示、模型响应和结果均已发布。
translation.brief: 解决内核 API 迁移中手工编写 Coccinelle 语义补丁的问题，核心方法是将样例分解为变更变体树并结合反馈引导生成、规则组合与编译批评器。

papers.title: WorldDraft: If Code Builds the World, Can Video Models Just Render It?
papers.abstract: Multimodal coding agents decouple 4D world construction from visual generation, repurposing video models from world generators toward generative renderers. This division of labor raises a fundamental question: if code builds the world, can video models just render it? A reliable generative renderer hinges on two complementary criteria: (i) world preservation, retaining prescribed 4D kinematics and camera paths; and (ii) visual realization, persistently binding text-specified target attributes over time. To evaluate this capability, we introduce WorldDraft, a benchmark of $432$ strictly paired test cases across $48$ executable 4D world families spanning six dynamic challenge categories. Under a $3 \times 3$ factorial design, WorldDraft orthogonally crosses draft granularity (abstract proxy to previs) and appearance alignment (neutral to conflicting) under identical dynamics. Extensive evaluations across $12$ representative models reveal that: (I) world preservation and visual realization remain in stark operational tension; (II) richer draft scaffolding anchors structure but paradoxically impairs appearance fidelity; and (III) conflicting source cues trigger severe source leakage (up to $64\%$), exposing fragile cross-modal disentanglement. To mitigate these bottlenecks, we propose WorldDraft-Primer, a plug-and-play visual prompting strategy that consistently improves both objectives across frozen video renderers. Together, WorldDraft and WorldDraft-Primer lay a foundation for bridging programmatic 4D simulation with video generation, advancing physically grounded generative rendering.

translation.title: WorldDraft：如果代码构建世界，视频模型能否只负责渲染？
translation.abstract: 多模态编码智能体将 4D 世界构建与视觉生成解耦，使视频模型从世界生成器转变为生成式渲染器。这种分工提出了一个根本问题：如果代码构建世界，视频模型能否只负责渲染？可靠的生成式渲染器取决于两个互补标准：(i) 世界保持，即保留规定的 4D 运动学与相机路径；(ii) 视觉实现，即随时间持续绑定文本指定的目标属性。为评估这一能力，我们提出 WorldDraft 基准，包含横跨六个动态挑战类别的 48 个可执行 4D 世界族下的 432 个严格配对测试用例。在 3×3 因子设计下，WorldDraft 在相同动态条件下正交交叉草稿粒度（从抽象代理到预演）与外观对齐（从中性到冲突）。对 12 个代表性模型的广泛评估显示：(I) 世界保持与视觉实现处于明显的操作性张力之中；(II) 更丰富的草稿脚手架可锚定结构，却反而损害外观保真度；(III) 冲突的源线索会引发严重的源泄漏（最高达 64%），暴露出脆弱的跨模态解耦。为缓解这些瓶颈，我们提出 WorldDraft-Primer，一种即插即用的视觉提示策略，在冻结的视频渲染器上持续改进上述两个目标。WorldDraft 与 WorldDraft-Primer 共同为连接程序化 4D 仿真与视频生成奠定基础，推动物理扎根的生成式渲染。
translation.brief: 解决评估视频模型作为生成式渲染器能力的问题，核心方法是构建严格配对的 4D 世界基准 WorldDraft 并提出即插即用的视觉提示策略 WorldDraft-Primer。

papers.title: We Are What We Remember: Mental-State-Driven Memory for Long-Term Character Dialogue
papers.abstract: Shared history in human dialogue is not merely a repository of facts, but the foundation of evolving relationships and mutual understanding. However, mainstream conversational memory systems rely on passive semantic similarity over external fact stores, frequently retrieving topically similar records while missing relationally pivotal experiences.
