Inspired by cognitive psychology's Self-Memory System (SMS), we propose MindMem, a mental-state-driven memory framework that asynchronously consolidates shared experiences into source-linked mental states of the character, the user, and their relationship. At each turn, a specialized mental-state reasoner (Mind) contextualizes these persistent states to anticipate latent user needs, form proactive intentions, and recover supporting episodic evidence that surface-level matching overlooks. To evaluate history-sensitive adaptation beyond factual recall, we introduce MemReal-Bench, a longitudinal benchmark grounded in month-long real-user interactions across dyadic and group scenes. By pairing Direct Question Answering (DQA) with Situated Memory Realization (SMR), it tests whether agents bridge the gap between knowing past facts and naturally using shared history, world rules, and relational trajectories. On MemReal-Bench, MindMem reaches 59.03% SMR and 82.58% DQA, exceeding the strongest memory baseline by 24.19 and 9.19 percentage points, respectively, and outperforming oracle target-memory injection on SMR. Code and dataset are available at this https URL.

translation.title: 我们的记忆塑造了我们：面向长期角色对话的心理状态驱动记忆
translation.abstract: 人类对话中的共享历史不仅是事实的存储库，更是不断演进的关系与相互理解的基础。然而，主流对话记忆系统依赖对外部事实库的被动语义相似度检索，常常召回主题相近的记录却遗漏关系上至关重要的经历。受认知心理学自我记忆系统（SMS）启发，我们提出 MindMem，一种心理状态驱动的记忆框架，异步地将共享经历固化为与来源关联的角色、用户及其关系的心理状态。在每一轮对话中，专门的心理状态推理器（Mind）对这些持久状态进行情境化，以预判潜在用户需求、形成主动意图，并找回表层匹配所忽视的支持性情节证据。为评估超越事实回忆的历史敏感适应能力，我们引入 MemReal-Bench，一个基于双人和群组场景中长达一个月真实用户交互的纵向基准。它将直接问答（DQA）与情境化记忆实现（SMR）配对，检验智能体能否跨越“知道过去事实”与“自然运用共享历史、世界规则和关系轨迹”之间的鸿沟。在 MemReal-Bench 上，MindMem 达到 59.03% 的 SMR 和 82.58% 的 DQA，分别超过最强记忆基线 24.19 和 9.19 个百分点，并在 SMR 上超越注入目标记忆的 oracle。代码与数据集见 https 链接。
translation.brief: 解决对话记忆系统遗漏关系上关键经历的问题，核心方法是将共享经历异步固化为心理状态并由推理器驱动主动式记忆检索。

papers.title: Agentic Dashboards: A New Design Paradigm for Visual Analytics
papers.abstract: Visual analytics systems traditionally combine analytical methods and interactive visualizations into a fixed application specified at the design phase. Coding agents offer a flexible approach: experts could conduct analysis through natural-language instructions. We envision an agentic dashboard as a persistent visual analytics workspace where an agent makes decisions about analytical methods, views, and their coordination within a designer-defined decision space. This approach shifts part of the visualization designer's role from engineering a fixed interface to defining the decisions an agent may make at runtime. We illustrate how such a dashboard could operate with current capabilities and propose criteria for evaluating its behavior and potential failures. As analytical workflows become more fluid and agent-mediated, visualization can help experts maintain awareness, coordinate with agents, and exercise judgment.

translation.title: 智能体仪表盘：可视化分析的新设计范式
translation.abstract: 传统的可视化分析系统将分析方法和交互式可视化组合为设计阶段就确定的固定应用。编码智能体提供了一种灵活的方式：专家可以通过自然语言指令开展分析。我们设想一种智能体仪表盘，作为一个持久的可视化分析工作区，智能体在设计者定义的决策空间内对分析方法、视图及其协调方式做出决策。这一方式将可视化设计者的部分角色从构建固定界面转变为定义智能体在运行时可以做出的决策。我们展示了这种仪表盘在现有能力下如何运行，并提出评估其行为与潜在失败的标准。随着分析工作流变得更加流动且由智能体中介，可视化可以帮助专家保持感知、与智能体协作并行使判断力。
translation.brief: 解决固定可视化分析界面灵活性不足的问题，核心方法是提出由设计者界定决策空间、由智能体在运行时决策的智能体仪表盘新范式。

papers.title: What Can a VLA Learn from the Agent That Calls It? Task-Level Experience Distillation for Embodied Navigation
papers.abstract: Navigation agents use a large language model (LLM) planner to call a vision-language-action (VLA) model. Each episode needs the LLM, adding cost and delay. We distill successful agent experience into the VLA instead of distilling the planner. The VLA then navigates alone at test time. Agent sessions are not VLA demonstrations. They include motions driven by planner tools and sub-instructions, along with detours. We present H2E, a task-level experience distillation method that converts these sessions into VLA training data. Every motion becomes a VLA action under the original task instruction, with the resulting poses as targets. H2E masks the loss on steps that move away from the goal. It labels every visited state within 1 m of the goal as a stop. We then update the VLA with low-rank adaptation. The VLA learns to stop at the goal and find goals the base model never reaches. On all 3,189 REVERIE-CE val-unseen episodes, H2E raises the success rate of an 8B VLA from 35.0% to 44.9%.

translation.title: VLA能从调用它的智能体学到什么？面向具身导航的任务级经验蒸馏
translation.abstract: 导航智能体使用大语言模型（LLM）规划器调用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。每个回合都需要LLM，增加了成本和延迟。我们不是蒸馏规划器，而是将智能体的成功经验蒸馏到VLA中，使VLA在测试时能够独立导航。智能体会话并非VLA演示：它们包含由规划器工具和子指令驱动的动作，以及绕路。我们提出H2E，一种任务级经验蒸馏方法，将这些会话转换为VLA训练数据。每个动作在原始任务指令下都成为VLA动作，以 resultant 姿态作为目标。H2E在偏离目标的步骤上掩码损失，并将距目标1米内的所有访问状态标记为停止。然后我们使用低秩适应（LoRA）更新VLA。VLA学会在目标处停止，并能找到基础模型从未到达的目标。在REVERIE-CE全部3,189个val-unseen回合上，H2E将8B VLA的成功率从35.0%提升到44.9%。
translation.brief: 针对VLA导航依赖LLM规划器导致成本高延迟大的问题，提出H2E方法将智能体任务级会话经验（含损失掩码和停止标注）蒸馏进VLA使其独立导航。

papers.title: Label-Efficient Document-Grounded Factuality Detection via Cross-Paraphrastic Invariance Learning
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent claims that are unsupported by a given source document, motivating accurate and efficient document-grounded factuality detection. Existing LLM-based evaluators often require repeated inference and incur high computational cost, whereas compact factuality detectors are efficient at inference time but commonly rely on large labeled or synthetically generated corpora. We propose CPIL (Cross-Paraphrastic Invariance Learning), a two-stage Siamese framework that converts a small labeled set into relational supervision without acquiring additional factuality labels. CPIL constructs positive pairs from distinct label-preserving paraphrastic views of the same document-claim instance and negative pairs from opposite-label examples associated with the same source document. It further introduces quantile-aware semi-hard negative mining, which derives a boundary from the positive-pair similarity distribution and balances informative negatives with broader coverage. In the two-stage training procedure, Stage 1 learns an encoder from these task-aware pairs, and Stage 2 jointly fine-tunes the encoder and a linear classification head for binary factuality prediction. At inference time, CPIL requires no paraphrase generation, pair construction, or Siamese comparison and uses only one encoder-classifier forward pass. On the 11-task LLM-AggreFact benchmark, CPIL-2% and CPIL-3% achieve macro-F1 scores of 81.04 and 81.60 while using only 2-3% of the FactCG-released labeled pool. Both settings outperform all compared compact detectors and two vanilla LLM references. Ablations and sensitivity analyses support the contributions of task-aware pair construction, dynamic negative mining, and multi-pivot paraphrasing.

translation.title: 基于跨复述不变性学习的标签高效文档支撑事实性检测
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可能生成源文档不支持但流畅的陈述，因此需要准确且高效的文档支撑事实性检测。现有基于LLM的评估器通常需要重复推理且计算成本高，而紧凑的事实性检测器推理高效但通常依赖大规模标注或合成语料。我们提出CPIL（Cross-Paraphrastic Invariance Learning），一个两阶段孪生框架，能在不获取额外事实性标签的情况下将小规模标注集转化为关系监督。CPIL从同一文档-陈述实例的不同保标签复述视图构建正样本对，从同一源文档下相反标签的示例构建负样本对。它进一步引入分位数感知的半难负样本挖掘，从正样本对相似度分布中导出边界，并在信息丰富的负样本与更广覆盖之间取得平衡。在两阶段训练中，阶段1从这些任务感知对中学习编码器，阶段2联合微调编码器和线性分类头进行二值事实性预测。推理时，CPIL无需复述生成、样本对构建或孪生比较，只需一次编码器-分类器前向传播。在11任务的LLM-AggreFact基准上，CPIL-2%和CPIL-3%仅使用FactCG发布标注池的2-3%，分别取得81.04和81.60的macro-F1。两种设置均优于所有对比的紧凑检测器和两个朴素LLM基线。消融和敏感性分析支持任务感知对构建、动态负样本挖掘和多轴心复述的贡献。
translation.brief: 针对紧凑事实性检测器依赖大量标注语料的问题，提出CPIL两阶段孪生框架，通过复述不变性构建任务感知正负样本对，从少量标签中学习高效检测器。

papers.title: Eliciting and Mitigating Specification Satisficing in Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents often fail to meet all requirements in the task description. In some of these failures, the agent considers an implementation choice that meets a requirement, but later decides to commit to another one that does not meet the requirement for a reason it finds acceptable. We call this specification satisficing. It is challenging to identify and mitigate specification satisficing because the agent accepts such choices for its own reasons, and existing self-correction methods are biased toward them. We propose SatisFix, which guides a coding agent to report these choices and their reasons, and then check each choice against the task description. We evaluate SatisFix on DeepSWE and SWE-bench Pro with five LLMs as backbones and two different agent frameworks, and compare it with three self-correction methods. SatisFix improves the pass@1 of the base agent by an average of 5.09% on DeepSWE and 7.06% on the hard subset of SWE-bench Pro. On DeepSWE, it outperforms the best baseline by 3.98%. Our ablation study shows that both steps of SatisFix contribute to the improvement.

translation.title: 诱导与缓解编程智能体中的规格满足主义
translation.abstract: 编程智能体常常无法满足任务描述中的所有需求。在这些失败中，有一种情况是智能体考虑过满足某需求的实现选择，但后来因为自认为可接受的理由而选择提交另一种不满足该需求的方案。我们称之为规格满足主义（specification satisficing）。识别和缓解规格满足主义具有挑战性，因为智能体出于自身理由接受这些选择，而现有的自我纠正方法偏向于认可它们。我们提出SatisFix，引导编程智能体报告这些选择及其理由，然后将每个选择与任务描述进行核对。我们在DeepSWE和SWE-bench Pro上用五个LLM作为骨干、两种不同的智能体框架评估SatisFix，并与三种自我纠正方法比较。SatisFix将基础智能体的pass@1平均提升5.09%（DeepSWE）和7.06%（SWE-bench Pro困难子集）。在DeepSWE上，它比最佳基线高出3.98%。消融研究表明SatisFix的两个步骤都促进了改进。
translation.brief: 针对编程智能体出于自身可接受理由放弃满足规格实现的问题，提出SatisFix让智能体报告其实现选择及理由并逐一对照任务描述核查。

papers.title: Rasoi: Visual Diffs for Evaluating Structural Changes Made by Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents let developers modify software rapidly through natural language. However, as agents take on larger changes, developers can lose track of how the codebase is evolving. These edits may look correct on the surface while restructuring the system in unexpected ways: duplicating logic, changing modules outside the requested scope, removing functionality developers meant to keep, or introducing architectural drift. We investigate how visual diffs can help developers understand and evaluate the structural changes that coding agents make. We present Rasoi, a design probe that maps how a codebase's architecture evolves after each agent-made edit, letting developers inspect which architectural elements and relationships were added, modified, or removed across multiple levels of abstraction. We deployed Rasoi in a week-long study with 12 developers working on their own codebases across varied technical domains. We found that visual diffs helped developers see whether changes stayed within scope, notice unexpected restructuring, and understand how modified parts related to the system as a whole. Our findings suggest that the value of oversight tools for coding agents lies less in making developers trust the agent and more in helping developers feel confident in their own evaluation of agent-made changes. We discuss implications for visual tools that support code comprehension and human oversight in AI-assisted software development.

translation.title: Rasoi：用于评估编程智能体结构性改动的可视化差异工具
translation.abstract: 编程智能体让开发者能通过自然语言快速修改软件。然而，随着智能体承担更大的改动，开发者可能无法追踪代码库的演变。这些编辑表面上可能看起来正确，却以意想不到的方式重构系统：复制逻辑、在请求范围之外修改模块、删除开发者想保留的功能，或引入架构漂移。我们研究可视化差异如何帮助开发者理解和评估编程智能体所做的结构性改动。我们提出Rasoi，一个设计探针，映射每次智能体编辑后代码库架构的演变方式，让开发者检查在多个抽象层级上哪些架构元素和关系被添加、修改或删除。我们在为期一周的研究中部署Rasoi，12名开发者在各自不同技术领域的代码库上使用它。我们发现可视化差异帮助开发者查看改动是否在范围内、注意到意外的重构，并理解被修改部分与系统整体的关系。我们的发现表明，编程智能体监督工具的价值不在于让开发者信任智能体，而在于帮助开发者对自己对智能体改动的评估充满信心。我们讨论了对支持代码理解和AI辅助软件开发中人类监督的可视化工具的启示。
translation.brief: 针对开发者难以追踪编程智能体编辑带来的代码库结构性变化的问题，提出Rasoi可视化差异工具，映射每次编辑后的架构演变以辅助人工评估。

papers.title: SAGE-QA: Semantic-Aware, Grounded Evaluation for Closed-Context Question Answering on SQuAD 2.0
papers.abstract: Closed-context question answering (QA) requires a system to generate an answer strictly supported by a supplied passage, or to abstain when the passage lacks adequate evidence. SQuAD 2.0 is a widely used benchmark for this setting, scored by Exact Match (EM) i.e., character-level agreement with human reference spans after lexical normalization. For generative large language models (LLMs), however, an EM failure may reflect a valid paraphrase or an alternative passage-supported answer rather than a hallucination. The best prior leaderboard EM is approximately 91%, but evaluating generative models requires separating lexical divergence from factual error. We introduce SAGE-QA (Semantic-Aware, Grounded Evaluation for Question Answering), a multi-tiered framework combining reference-based Semantic Equivalence Scoring (SES) and passage-based Re-Validation Scoring (RVS). On a fixed set of 10,000 SQuAD 2.0 validation examples, we compute EM and decision-matrix F1 from TP, TN, FP, and FN counts for zero-shot closed-weight frontier models and for open-weight models, untuned and fine-tuned. Zero-shot, Claude Opus 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro reach 85.21 and 86.66 EM, outperforming untuned Llama 3 8B (56.88), gpt-oss-20b (66.28), and Llama 3.3 70B (71.39). Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adds 21.19 to 34.06 EM points, raising these models to 90.94, 87.47, and 94.24 EM, respectively. Auditing the frontier models with SAGE-QA and an external LLM judge yields dataset-wide SES scores of 92.81 for Claude Opus 4.6 and 91.67 for Gemini 3.1 Pro, and hybrid RVS scores, which combine benchmark credit with passage-based judge assessments, of 97.96 and 98.02. Fine-tuned open-weight models perform best, with fine-tuned Llama 3.3 70B surpassing the previous best known EM.

translation.title: SAGE-QA：面向SQuAD 2.0封闭上下文问答的语义感知、有依据的评估
translation.abstract: 封闭上下文问答（QA）要求系统生成严格由给定段落支持的答案，或在段落缺乏足够证据时拒绝回答。SQuAD 2.0是该设置的常用基准，由精确匹配（EM）评分，即经过词法规范化后与人工参考span的字符级一致性。然而对于生成式大语言模型（LLM），EM失败可能反映的是有效的改述或另一种段落支持的答案，而非幻觉。此前排行榜上最佳EM约为91%，但评估生成式模型需要将词汇差异与事实错误区分开来。我们提出SAGE-QA，一个多层框架，结合基于参考的语义等价评分（SES）和基于段落的再验证评分（RVS）。在一组固定的10,000个SQuAD 2.0验证样本上，我们为零样本闭源前沿模型和开源权重模型（未调优与微调）计算EM以及由TP、TN、FP、FN得出的决策矩阵F1。零样本下，Claude Opus 4.6和Gemini 3.1 Pro分别达到85.21和86.66 EM，优于未调优的Llama 3 8B（56.88）、gpt-oss-20b（66.28）和Llama 3.3 70B（71.39）。参数高效微调带来21.19至34.06的EM提升，使这些模型分别达到90.94、87.47和94.24 EM。使用SAGE-QA和外部LLM评判者对前沿模型进行审计，Claude Opus 4.6和Gemini 3.1 Pro的数据集级SES分数分别为92.81和91.67，混合RVS分数（结合基准得分与基于段落的评判评估）分别为97.96和98.02。微调的开源权重模型表现最佳，微调后的Llama 3.3 70B超越了此前已知最佳EM。
translation.brief: 针对EM指标无法区分生成式模型的词汇改述与事实错误的问题，提出SAGE-QA多层评估框架，结合语义等价评分与段落再验证评分评估封闭上下文问答。

papers.title: StateAlign: Internalizing State-Aware Decision-Making for Reliable Multi-Turn Tool Agents via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning has improved the tool-use capabilities of large language models. However, better task performance can coincide with increased tool hallucination. Reliable tool use requires decisions to follow the current task state: available information, tool capabilities, and task progress. Our analysis shows that agents sometimes execute when they should ask for information, retrieve it, or decline an infeasible request, even when reasoning identifies missing information. We introduce StateAlign, combining task-state construction with state-contrastive reinforcement learning. The data cover five task conditions and pair states with different action requirements. Outcome rewards guide task completion; token-level contrasts compare the same generated reasoning and actions under paired states to train outputs that fit the current state. Experiments across five base models from three families show improvements on BFCL v4 multi-turn, ToolSandbox, and When2Call. Ablations show that state construction improves performance and reliability under different reward designs. The complete method further reduces tool hallucination across three Qwen3 sizes. On Qwen3-8B, StateAlign improves BFCL v4 multi-turn accuracy from 45.5% to 55.2% and reduces no-tool hallucination on SimpleToolHalluBench from 62.2% under outcome-only training to 56.1%. Behavioral analyses show more consistent decisions, more complete multi-call execution, and stronger recovery after tool errors.

translation.title: StateAlign：通过强化学习内化状态感知决策以实现可靠的多轮工具智能体
translation.abstract: 强化学习提升了大语言模型的工具使用能力，但更好的任务性能可能伴随工具幻觉的增加。可靠的工具使用要求决策遵循当前任务状态：可用信息、工具能力和任务进度。我们的分析表明，即使推理已识别出缺失信息，智能体有时会在应当请求信息、检索信息或拒绝不可行请求时却执行工具。我们提出 StateAlign，将任务状态构建与状态对比强化学习相结合。数据涵盖五种任务条件，并将具有不同动作要求的状态配对。结果奖励引导任务完成；token 级对比在配对状态下比较相同的推理与动作生成，以训练契合当前状态的输出。在来自三个系列的五个基础模型上的实验显示，BFCL v4 多轮、ToolSandbox 和 When2Call 上均有提升。消融实验表明，状态构建在不同奖励设计下都能提升性能与可靠性。完整方法进一步降低了三种 Qwen3 规模下的工具幻觉。在 Qwen3-8B 上，StateAlign 将 BFCL v4 多轮准确率从 45.5% 提升到 55.2%，并将 SimpleToolHalluBench 上的无工具幻觉从仅结果奖励训练下的 62.2% 降至 56.1%。行为分析显示决策更一致、多轮调用执行更完整、工具出错后的恢复能力更强。
translation.brief: 针对工具智能体决策不符合当前任务状态导致工具幻觉的问题，提出结合任务状态构建与状态对比强化学习的 StateAlign 方法。

papers.title: Shared Item-Level Error Limits the Aggregation of Small Language Models in Fermi Estimation
papers.abstract: Multi-agent systems of language models are often motivated by an averaging argument: if the agents' errors are unbiased and independent, the error of an aggregate of N answers falls as 1/sqrt(N). Fermi estimation, whose continuous answers are aggregated on the logarithmic scale, permits a direct test. We decompose the log10 error of each answer into the mean error of its model on the item, common to all its draws on the item, and a residual, and estimate both from 2.51M answers given before any communication by 15 open-weight models (3B-72B) on realFP, with replication under a single prompt pair on realFP, Science Olympiad Fermi questions and a guesstimation set. Given the item, teammates' errors are uncorrelated and teams behave as independent draws, but the item-level component accounts for a median 0.906 of the error variance over items. Teams of thirty therefore reduce a single agent's error by a median 1.7% (at most 5.4%), whereas draws that were also unbiased on each item would reduce it by 74-79%. All models compress their estimates toward about 10^6; this trend explains a median 17% of the item-level component, and a cross-validated linear recalibration on labelled items removes the overall bias but not that component. Three rounds of debate reduce within-team dispersion by 93% and leave the item-level component unchanged; revision without peers attains the same small gain. Mixing five models of similar accuracy reduces error by 6.6% relative to their own homogeneous teams, but no mixture improves on the most accurate model. Higher sampling temperature changes team error by about 1% at most, and contrastive activation steering not detectably; per-agent scaffold prompts (not significant after multiplicity correction) and skipping one layer in a single-model screen improve it. The results are conditional on the models, benchmarks, prompts and settings tested.

translation.title: 共享的条目级误差限制了小语言模型在 Fermi 估计中的聚合效果
translation.abstract: 多智能体语言模型系统的动机常来自平均论证：若各智能体的误差无偏且独立，N 个答案聚合的误差会按 1/sqrt(N) 下降。Fermi 估计的连续答案在对数尺度上聚合，可直接检验该论证。我们将每个答案的 log10 误差分解为该模型在该条目上的平均误差（对该条目上所有采样共有）和残差，并基于 15 个开源权重模型（3B-72B）在任何通信前给出的 251 万个答案进行估计，涵盖 realFP、Science Olympiad Fermi 题目和一个 guesstimation 数据集，并在单一提示对下重复采样。给定条目后，队友间误差不相关，团队表现为独立采样，但条目级成分占条目间误差方差的中位数 0.906。因此三十个成员的团队只能将单个智能体的误差中位数降低 1.7%（最多 5.4%），而若在各条目上同样无偏，本可降低 74-79%。所有模型都将估计值压缩向约 10^6；这一趋势解释了条目级成分中位数 17% 的部分，而在带标签条目上的交叉验证线性再校准消除了总体偏差却无法消除该成分。三轮辩论将团队内离散度降低 93% 且条目级成分不变；无同伴的自行修订也能获得同样的小幅收益。混合五个准确率相近的模型比同质团队降低误差 6.6%，但没有混合能超过最准确的单一模型。提高采样温度最多改变团队误差约 1%，对比激活引导无可检测影响；每智能体的脚手架提示（多重性校正后不显著）和单模型筛选中跳过一层略有改善。这些结果依赖于所测试的模型、基准、提示和设置。
translation.brief: 针对多模型聚合误差假设，通过分解 Fermi 估计误差发现条目级共享偏差主导误差方差，从而严重限制小模型聚合的降噪收益。

papers.title: Benchmarking AI risk behaviors
papers.abstract: We evaluate LLM risk propensities across a range of contexts and task demands. We evaluate models for how risk averse or risk tolerant they are in various conditions, as well as how stable and consistent their behavior is across conditions. We present a toolkit for developing model risk profiles that can be used to predict model behavior and which can be adapted to include new evaluations of risk propensities. We also examine how these properties have changed across model generations and families. We observe that 2026 state-of-the-art models tend to be more stable, more consistent, and more risk neutral than older models. These trends appear to be related; newer models are more stable and consistent because they are more likely to use expected value maximization as a decision procedure.

translation.title: AI 风险行为基准测试
translation.abstract: 我们在多种情境和任务需求下评估 LLM 的风险倾向。我们评估模型在各种条件下的风险规避或风险容忍程度，以及其行为在各条件间的稳定性和一致性。我们提供一个用于构建模型风险画像的工具包，可用于预测模型行为并可适配新的风险倾向评估。我们还考察了这些特性在模型世代和系列间的变化。我们观察到 2026 年的最先进模型往往比旧模型更稳定、更一致且更接近风险中性。这些趋势似乎相关：新模型更稳定、更一致，因为它们更倾向于以期望值最大化作为决策程序。
translation.brief: 针对缺乏系统性 AI 风险倾向评估的问题，构建了跨情境评估 LLM 风险行为稳定性与一致性的基准工具包。

papers.title: From Large Language Models to Efficient System One Models via Adaptive Computation
papers.abstract: Transferring LLMs into System One decision models typically replaces the language modeling head with a decision head while retaining the full backbone, making every decision pay for all layers. Yet it remains unclear how much depth such decisions require. We find that decision information is concentrated in intermediate layers, with early layers building essential features and the final six layers removable without loss, while independently trained smaller models largely mimic the full model rather than developing specialized decision capabilities. These findings suggest that efficiency requires not simply smaller backbones, but shared computation across different depths. Building on this, we propose \method{}, which jointly trains a full model with prefix sub-models that share its final layers and decision head through self-distillation. A lightweight gate reads the hidden state at each exit to determine whether additional computation is needed, allowing one model to operate at multiple layers. Across seven decision benchmarks, our approach matches or outperforms independently trained models at every depth, while achieving better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs through adaptive computation.

translation.title: 从大语言模型到高效的 System One 决策模型：基于自适应计算
translation.abstract: 将 LLM 转化为 System One 决策模型通常是用决策头替换语言建模头，同时保留完整骨干网络，使每次决策都要付出所有层的代价。然而此类决策究竟需要多深的网络尚不清楚。我们发现决策信息集中于中间层，早期层构建必要特征，最后六层可以无损移除，而独立训练的较小模型大多只是模仿完整模型而非发展专门的决策能力。这些发现表明，高效性需要的不仅是更小的骨干网络，而是跨不同深度的共享计算。基于此，我们提出 \method{}，通过自蒸馏联合训练一个完整模型和共享其最后层与决策头的前缀子模型。一个轻量门控读取每个出口的隐藏状态，判断是否需要额外计算，使一个模型可在多层运行。在七个决策基准上，我们的方法在每个深度上都匹敌或超越独立训练的模型，并通过自适应计算实现更好的准确率-效率权衡。
translation.brief: 针对决策模型每步计算需付出全部层数代价的低效问题，提出通过自蒸馏训练带出口门控的前缀子模型实现自适应深度计算的方法。

papers.title: CURATOR: Scalable Fine-grained Evidence Selection for Retrieval-Augmented Generation using Decision Models
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) provides entire retrieved passages to the LLM, even though only a handful of spans within them contain the evidence pertaining to the question. While precise selection of these spans can improve context utilization, identifying them in isolation is challenging. A span may appear irrelevant by itself, and deciding whether to retain it may require examining other retrieved information. One can evaluate each span's candidacy with the full retrieved context, but this is computationally inefficient as the same text must be processed repeatedly. Pretrained decision model can be used to efficiently evaluate multiple spans simultaneously, allowing each decision to consider the surrounding spans as well. However, our experiments show that their ability to identify relevant evidence deteriorates as the number of simultaneous decisions increases. To address this, we introduce CURATOR, a fine-tuned decision model trained to make reliable evidence-selection decisions over large candidate sets. By training a decision model to select varying numbers of supporting spans from large candidate pools, CURATOR develops the capability to select evidence for RAG while retaining the computational efficiency of joint decision-making. We observe that CURATOR maintains a strong evidence discrimination capability as the number of candidates increases, generalizes across different tasks and document domains, and improves downstream RAG performance, particularly when the available context is limited.

translation.title: CURATOR：基于决策模型的可扩展细粒度证据选择用于检索增强生成
translation.abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）将整段检索文本提供给 LLM，尽管其中只有少数片段包含与问题相关的证据。精确选择这些片段可以改善上下文利用，但孤立地识别它们很困难。一个片段单独看可能显得无关，是否保留可能需要检查其他检索信息。可以在完整检索上下文中评估每个片段的候选性，但这计算效率低下，因为同样的文本必须被反复处理。预训练决策模型可用于同时高效评估多个片段，使每个决策能考虑周围的片段。然而我们的实验表明，随着同时决策数量的增加，其识别相关证据的能力会下降。为此，我们提出 CURATOR，一个经过微调的决策模型，被训练用于在大型候选集上做出可靠的证据选择决策。通过训练决策模型从大型候选池中选择数量不等的支持片段，CURATOR 发展出为 RAG 选择证据的能力，同时保留联合决策的计算效率。我们观察到，随着候选数量增加，CURATOR 仍保持强大的证据判别能力，可在不同任务和文档领域间泛化，并提升下游 RAG 性能，尤其是在可用上下文有限时。
translation.brief: 针对 RAG 中细粒度证据选择在联合决策候选数增多时性能退化的问题，提出通过在大候选池上微调决策模型实现可扩展、可靠的证据选择方法 CURATOR。

papers.title: Bait: Mitigating Harmful Agentic Reinforcement Learning via Probing Reward Function
papers.abstract: We expose a safety vulnerability on nascent agentic reinforcement-learning-as-a-service. Specifically, with a cost as low as \$20, we show that safety alignment of a large language model (e.g., Inkling) can be completely subverted through rounds of harmful agentic reinforcement learning (agentic RL) with a toxic environment from its users. We also demonstrate that upon a successful harmful agentic RL attack via the service API, the attackers can potentially use the safety-degraded model to assist with real-world harmful activities, e.g., exploit software vulnerabilities and launch code re-use attacks. To mitigate harmful agentic RL, we propose Bait, a defense that mitigates the attack via proactively probing the reward function. Experimental results show that such a simple defense can sufficiently mitigate learning from a harmful reward function and can still learn from a benign reward function that promotes benign agentic tasks. Further analysis on both empirical and theoretical aspects shows that an adaptive attacker who assumes the knowledge of Bait defense cannot perfectly subvert it due to a systematic challenge. Source code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: Bait：通过探测奖励函数缓解有害的智能体强化学习
translation.abstract: 我们揭示了新兴的强化学习即服务在智能体应用中的安全漏洞。具体而言，仅需约20美元的成本，我们证明大型语言模型（例如 Inkling）的安全对齐可以通过用户提供的多轮有害智能体强化学习在有毒环境中被完全颠覆。我们还展示了通过服务 API 成功实施有害智能体 RL 攻击后，攻击者可能利用安全性退化的模型协助现实世界的有害活动，例如利用软件漏洞和发起代码重用攻击。为缓解有害智能体 RL，我们提出 Bait，一种通过主动探测奖励函数来缓解攻击的防御方法。实验结果表明，这种简单的防御足以阻止从有害奖励函数中学习，同时仍能从促进良性智能体任务的良性奖励函数中学习。对经验与理论两方面的进一步分析表明，假设知晓 Bait 防御的自适应攻击者由于系统性挑战而无法完美颠覆它。源代码可在该 https 链接获取。
translation.brief: 针对强化学习即服务可被用户用有毒奖励破坏模型安全对齐的问题，提出通过主动探测奖励函数来识别并抵御有害智能体强化学习的 Bait 防御方法。

papers.title: Evidence-Governed Adoption of Self-Generated Updates in Autonomous AI Agents
papers.abstract: Autonomous agents modify prompts, memories, tools, workflows, and policies using interaction histories. Yet a plausible modification is not necessarily suitable for persistent adoption: candidate selection is adaptive, evaluators may be imperfect, and local gains can hide degradation against an earlier baseline. We introduce Evidence-Governed Evolution (EGE), a framework for governing adoption of self-generated agent modifications. EGE separates candidate generation from confirmatory adoption, evaluates frozen candidates on fresh paired audits, requires meaningful improvement on a prespecified primary objective, protects declared capabilities through reference-relative non-inferiority tests, and applies governance constraints before bounded canary deployment. We establish an evaluator-calibrated simultaneous lower-bound construction for a countable sequence of adaptively generated candidates. It combines candidate-wise Hoeffding bounds with independent calibration samples comparing the operational evaluator with a prespecified reference procedure. We also formalise reference replacement through bridge tests, derive a cumulative degradation bound along a versioned reference lineage, and provide an audit-planning condition relating effect-size margin, sample sizes, and acceptance probability. A Monte Carlo stress test illustrates calibration under candidate-dependent evaluator optimism; it is a stylised statistical experiment, not an evaluation of a deployed agent. The guarantees are conditional on bounded paired scores, fresh sampling, a valid reference-evaluation construct, and declared evaluation distributions; they do not establish universal agent safety or robustness to arbitrary distribution shift.

translation.title: 自主 AI 智能体中自我生成更新的证据治理采纳机制
translation.abstract: 自主智能体利用交互历史修改提示、记忆、工具、工作流和策略。然而，一个看似合理的修改未必适合持久采纳：候选选择是自适应的，评估器可能不完美，局部收益可能掩盖相对于早期基线的退化。我们提出证据治理演化（Evidence-Governed Evolution, EGE），一个治理自我生成智能体修改采纳的框架。EGE 将候选生成与确认性采纳分离，在新鲜的成对审计上评估冻结的候选，要求在预先指定的主要目标上有显著改进，通过参照相对非劣性测试保护已声明的能力，并在有边界的金丝雀部署前应用治理约束。我们为可数序列的自适应生成候选建立了评估器校准的同步下界构造，将逐候选 Hoeffding 界与比较运行时评估器和预先指定参照流程的独立校准样本相结合。我们还通过桥接测试形式化参照替换，沿版本化参照谱系推导累积退化界，并提供关联效应量边际、样本量与接受概率的审计规划条件。蒙特卡洛压力测试说明了候选依赖的评估器乐观偏差下的校准情况；这是一个风格化的统计实验，而非对部署智能体的评估。这些保证以有界成对分数、新鲜采样、有效的参照评估构造和已声明的评估分布为条件；它们并不确立普适的智能体安全性或对任意分布偏移的鲁棒性。
translation.brief: 针对自主智能体自我生成修改可能劣化性能却仍被采纳的问题，提出 EGE 框架，通过独立成对审计、非劣性测试和治理约束来确认性采纳候选更新，并给出统计下界与退化界等理论保证。

papers.title: Beyond Compressing Everything: Contrastive Memory Learning for Selective Context Compression
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) advance toward increasingly long inputs, soft context compression offers a promising approach to efficient inference by converting long inputs into compact memory slots. Under limited memory budgets, effective context compression remains challenging because task-relevant evidence varies substantially across queries, ranging from localized evidence to multiple distant spans or information dispersed throughout the full document. Instead of compressing everything indiscriminately, we propose CoMem, a query-guided selective context compression framework that learns memory representations conditioned on both the document and the query. CoMem develops Contrastive Compressor Learning to achieve query-sensitive yet context-preserving memory representations. To inject a strong prior over query-dependent evidence distributions, we devise a same-context hard negative mining strategy by pairing a single document with multiple queries, requiring the compressor to selectively retain information according to each query's distinct evidence needs. To address the restricted information flow imposed by causal masking, we further enable bidirectional attention among memory slots. Experiments demonstrate that CoMem consistently outperforms existing context compression methods across compression ratios on question answering and RULER-NIAH benchmarks. Our code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 超越压缩一切：面向选择性上下文压缩的对比记忆学习
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）处理越来越长的输入，软上下文压缩通过将长输入转换为紧凑的记忆槽，为高效推理提供了有前景的方法。在有限记忆预算下，有效的上下文压缩仍具挑战性，因为任务相关证据在不同查询间差异巨大，从局部证据到多个远距离片段或散布于全文档的信息。与其不加区分地压缩一切，我们提出 CoMem，一个查询引导的选择性上下文压缩框架，学习以文档和查询为条件的记忆表示。CoMem 开发了对比压缩器学习以实现查询敏感且保留上下文的记忆表示。为注入关于查询依赖证据分布的强先验，我们设计了同上下文难负样本挖掘策略，将单个文档与多个查询配对，要求压缩器根据每个查询不同的证据需求选择性地保留信息。为解决因果掩码带来的信息流受限问题，我们进一步在记忆槽之间启用双向注意力。实验表明，CoMem 在问答和 RULER-NIAH 基准上的各种压缩比下始终优于现有上下文压缩方法。我们的代码可在该 https 链接获取。
translation.brief: 针对软上下文压缩对所有内容不加区分压缩而忽略查询相关证据差异的问题，提出查询引导的 CoMem 框架，通过同上下文难负样本对比学习和记忆槽间双向注意力实现选择性压缩。

papers.title: TransXplainRRG: A Radiologist-Evaluated LVLM for Chest Radiograph Report Generation
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLM) enhance X-ray report generation, but often neglect clinical context, overlook workflow integration, and lack explainability, which hinders clinical adoption due to interpretability and reliability concerns. This paper addresses the dual challenges of performance and expert explainability in automated X-ray report generation for clinical AI applications. Our proposed approach, TransXplainRRG, utilises an off-the-shelf Swin Transformer model along with a transformer-based text encoder that incorporates patient medical history to generate a radiology report. Further, we explore an expert-guided `inside-out' approach and extract only abnormal findings for radiology report refinement. Thus, this study bridges the gap between high-performance automation and interpretability critical for clinical practice by combining state-of-the-art transformer-based vision encoders, text encoders, and LLMs. TransXplainRRG is trained and tested on the large-scale MIMIC-CXR dataset and further evaluated on the unseen IU X-Ray dataset to demonstrate its generalizability and robustness. We employed the GREEN metric as a complementary measure of clinical consistency, achieving scores of 0.327 on MIMIC-CXR and 0.605 on IU X-Ray, both higher than those achieved by MAIRA-2 under the same evaluation setting. It also performed competitively across standard evaluation metrics, frequently matching or surpassing state-of-the-art models. Additionally, we introduce qualitative evaluation metrics developed from radiologists' viewpoints and conduct a preliminary radiologist evaluation on 100 generated reports to assess their clinical relevance. Quantitative and qualitative analyses further demonstrate the potential of our TransXplainRRG framework for reliable and explainable radiology report generation.

translation.title: TransXplainRRG：一种经放射科医师评估的胸片报告生成大型视觉语言模型
translation.abstract: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的最新进展提升了 X 射线报告生成能力，但常忽略临床背景、忽视工作流集成且缺乏可解释性，这由于可解释性和可靠性顾虑阻碍了临床采纳。本文解决临床 AI 应用中自动化 X 射线报告生成的性能与专家可解释性双重挑战。我们提出的方法 TransXplainRRG 利用现成的 Swin Transformer 模型和融合患者病史的基于 transformer 的文本编码器来生成放射学报告。此外，我们探索专家引导的'由内而外'方法，仅提取异常发现用于放射学报告的精炼。因此，本研究通过结合最先进的基于 transformer 的视觉编码器、文本编码器和 LLM，弥合了高性能自动化与临床实践关键的可解释性之间的差距。TransXplainRRG 在大规模 MIMIC-CXR 数据集上训练和测试，并在未见过的 IU X-Ray 数据集上进一步评估以证明其泛化性和鲁棒性。我们采用 GREEN 指标作为临床一致性的补充度量，在 MIMIC-CXR 上取得 0.327 分，在 IU X-Ray 上取得 0.605 分，均高于相同评估设置下 MAIRA-2 的得分。它在标准评估指标上也表现具竞争力，经常达到或超越最先进模型。此外，我们引入从放射科医师视角开发的定性评估指标，并对 100 份生成的报告进行初步放射科医师评估以衡量其临床相关性。定量与定性分析进一步证明了我们的 TransXplainRRG 框架在可靠且可解释的放射学报告生成方面的潜力。
translation.brief: 针对胸片报告生成缺乏临床背景、工作流集成与可解释性的问题，提出融合患者病史与专家引导异常发现提取的 LVLM 框架 TransXplainRRG，并结合放射科医师视角的定性评估提升临床可用性。

papers.title: Experience-Handoff Reinforcement Learning for Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract: It is common to train Large Language Models (LLMs) for agentic tasks with Reinforcement Learning (RL) from scalar rewards. However, this throws away the fine-grained information about the environment that the agent experienced during the trial (e.g., error logs). To utilize this rich information, recent works wrap the agent in a harness that refines its own inputs through reflection or compaction and hands past experience to future rollouts, but the construction of the handed-off artifacts (e.g., a playbook) is itself not learned. We want the best of both worlds: gradient updates from a scalar reward, while also utilizing environment information to hand off experience. As a concrete testbed, we fix the Agentic Context Engineering (\ace{}) harness and train one model to act, reflect, and curate task-local playbooks. Our method, \acerl{}, evaluates candidate experience-handoff artifacts by their downstream effect on future actor rollouts, and co-optimizes the role-specific behaviors (action generator, insight reflector, and playbook curator) under a fixed scaffold. Across agentic benchmarks, \acerl{} achieves higher held-out performance than baseline methods. The results suggest that agent training should optimize not only the actions in the current rollout, but also the model-written experience that future rollouts inherit.

translation.title: 面向递归自我改进的经验交接强化学习
translation.abstract: 用基于标量奖励的强化学习（RL）训练大型语言模型（LLM）执行智能体任务很常见，但这丢弃了智能体在试验中经历的关于环境的细粒度信息（例如错误日志）。为利用这些丰富信息，近期工作将智能体包装在一个框架中，通过反思或压缩精炼自身输入，并将过去经验交给未来的 rollout，但被交接产物（例如 playbook）的构建本身并未被学习。我们希望兼得两者：来自标量奖励的梯度更新，同时利用环境信息来交接经验。作为一个具体的测试平台，我们固定 Agentic Context Engineering（ACE）框架，训练一个模型来执行行动、反思和整理任务局部 playbook。我们的方法 ACERL 根据候选经验交接产物对未来 actor rollout 的下游影响来评估它们，并在固定脚手架下协同优化各角色的特定行为（动作生成器、洞察反思器和 playbook 整理者）。在多个智能体基准上，ACERL 取得了高于基线方法的保留集性能。结果表明，智能体训练不仅应优化当前 rollout 中的动作，还应优化未来 rollout 将继承的模型书写的经验。
translation.brief: 针对标量奖励 RL 丢弃环境细节信息且经验交接产物构建未被学习的问题，提出 ACERL 方法，以候选经验交接产物对未来 rollout 的下游影响为信号协同优化行动、反思与 playbook 整理行为。

papers.title: RMIT-ADM+S at TREC RAG 2026: Research Agents, Retriever Ablations, and Open-Weight Replication
papers.abstract: We describe the RMIT-ADM+S team's participation in the TREC 2026 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) track using the ClimbMix corpus. We submitted seven research-agent runs using proprietary OpenAI and open-weight models, exploring different retrieval strategies, writer models, and agent workflows. Pre-submission ablations identified writer selection and adjacent-chunk expansion as the main factors affecting answer quality. In the official NIST evaluation, six of seven runs exceeded the track median across all three rubric/nugget collections. Our best-performing run, brief-hybrid, achieved the highest all-item coverage among our submissions and tied the track maximum (0.892) for Batch-1 vital coverage. Human side-by-side preferences differed across evaluation batches: the open-weight owa-glm5 led Batch 1 despite lower automated coverage, while sol-research-first led Batch 2. These findings highlight differences between automated coverage measures and human preferences, as well as the potential of lower-cost open-weight models for research-agent systems.

translation.title: RMIT-ADM+S 参加 TREC RAG 2026：研究型智能体、检索器消融与开放权重模型复现
translation.abstract: 我们描述了 RMIT-ADM+S 团队使用 ClimbMix 语料库参加 TREC 2026 检索增强生成（RAG）赛道的情况。我们提交了七个基于专有 OpenAI 模型和开放权重模型的研究型智能体运行结果，探索了不同的检索策略、写作模型和智能体工作流。提交前的消融实验发现，写作模型选择和相邻分块扩展是影响答案质量的主要因素。在 NIST 官方评测中，七个运行结果中有六个在全部三个 rubric/nugget 集合上超过了赛道中位数。我们表现最佳的运行 brief-hybrid 在所有提交中获得了最高的全项目覆盖率，并在 Batch-1 vital 覆盖率上追平了赛道最高分（0.892）。人工并排偏好评估在不同批次间存在差异：开放权重的 owa-glm5 尽管自动覆盖率较低，却在 Batch 1 中领先，而 sol-research-first 在 Batch 2 中领先。这些发现凸显了自动覆盖率指标与人工偏好之间的差异，以及低成本开放权重模型在研究型智能体系统中的潜力。
translation.brief: 针对研究型智能体问答任务，探索不同检索策略、写作模型与智能体工作流的组合并提交多个系统参与 TREC RAG 评测。

papers.title: SoScale: Second-Order Scale Search for FP4 Quantization
papers.abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the memory footprint and inference cost of large language models (LLMs), yet accurate FP4 quantization remains challenging. Practical formats such as MXFP4, NVFP4, and HiF4 pair a 4-bit floating-point payload with block-wise or hierarchical scale codes, making accuracy highly sensitive to how each local distribution is scaled. Default maximum-absolute-value scaling preserves dynamic range, but can spend scarce FP4 levels on rarely occupied outlier regions and leave dense tensor values poorly resolved. Existing scale-search methods minimize local element-wise reconstruction error, optimizing tensor fidelity rather than layer-output fidelity. We propose SoScale, a second-order weight scale-code search method for hierarchical FP4 quantization. SoScale searches hardware-valid scale codes under a Hessian-aware layer reconstruction objective and couples this search with GPTQ-style error recovery, selecting scales by their impact on layer outputs. Across Qwen3 models, SoScale consistently reduces downstream quantization degradation under MXFP4, NVFP4, and HiF4.

translation.title: SoScale：面向 FP4 量化的二阶尺度搜索
translation.abstract: 低比特量化可以降低大语言模型（LLM）的内存占用和推理成本，但精确的 FP4 量化仍然充满挑战。MXFP4、NVFP4 和 HiF4 等实用格式将 4 比特浮点负载与逐块或分层的 scale code 相结合，使精度对每个局部分布的缩放方式高度敏感。默认的最大绝对值缩放保留了动态范围，但可能把稀缺的 FP4 量化级别浪费在很少被占用的离群值区域，导致密集张量值的分辨率不足。现有的 scale search 方法最小化局部逐元素重建误差，优化的是张量保真度而非层输出保真度。我们提出 SoScale，一种用于分层 FP4 量化的二阶权重 scale code 搜索方法。SoScale 在 Hessian 感知的层重建目标下搜索硬件有效的 scale code，并将该搜索与 GPTQ 风格的误差恢复相结合，根据 scale 对层输出的影响来选择 scale。在 Qwen3 系列模型上，SoScale 在 MXFP4、NVFP4 和 HiF4 下均持续降低了下游量化性能损失。
translation.brief: 针对 FP4 量化精度对缩放因子敏感的问题，提出在 Hessian 感知的层重建目标下结合 GPTQ 式误差恢复来搜索 scale code。

papers.title: daVinci-Prover: Agent-Native Mid-Training for Formal Theorem Proving
papers.abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) are rapidly transforming formal theorem proving. Yet further progress remains constrained by the lack of a transparent and effective data recipe for systematically improving theorem-proving models. In this work, we argue that effective agentic provers require strong mathematical skill priors to ground theorem proving and agentic trajectories to enable long-horizon, interactive proof construction. To this end, we synthesize an agent-native 33.7B-token mid-training corpus covering decomposition, search, self-verification, and revision, together with verifier-grounded agentic trajectories. We further introduce the daVinci-Prover harness, which enables models to construct proofs and interact with a Lean verifier in an isolated workspace, and use it to collect approximately 36K high-quality agent trajectories for supervised fine-tuning. Our mid-training recipe yields an average improvement of 13.7 points over the matched Qwen3-8B SFT-only baseline across MiniF2F, FATE-M, and ProofNet. When applied to the Qwen3.5 series, our approach also yields strong performance across theorem-proving benchmarks and achieves near-saturating MiniF2F performance with memory compaction. The results highlight agent-native mid-training as an effective foundation for developing stronger interactive theorem-proving agents.

translation.title: daVinci-Prover：面向形式化定理证明的智能体原生中期训练
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的进展正在迅速改变形式化定理证明。然而，缺乏透明且有效的数据配方来系统性提升定理证明模型，仍然制约着进一步的发展。在本工作中，我们认为有效的智能体证明器需要强大的数学技能先验来支撑定理证明，并需要智能体轨迹来实现长程交互式证明构造。为此，我们合成了一个智能体原生的 33.7B token 中期训练语料，涵盖分解、搜索、自我验证和修订，并附带经验证器校验的智能体轨迹。我们进一步引入 daVinci-Prover 框架，使模型能够在隔离工作区中构造证明并与 Lean 验证器交互，并用它收集了约 36K 条高质量智能体轨迹用于监督微调。我们的中期训练配方在 MiniF2F、FATE-M 和 ProofNet 上相比匹配的 Qwen3-8B 纯 SFT 基线平均提升了 13.7 分。应用于 Qwen3.5 系列时，我们的方法在多个定理证明基准上也取得了强劲表现，并借助内存压缩在 MiniF2F 上接近饱和。结果凸显了智能体原生中期训练是开发更强交互式定理证明智能体的有效基础。
translation.brief: 针对定理证明模型缺乏有效数据配方的问题，合成包含分解、搜索、自验证等能力的中期训练语料和与 Lean 验证器交互的智能体轨迹用于训练。

papers.title: Rational Alignments of Superintelligences via Debates
papers.abstract: Artificial superintelligences (ASI) is artificial intelligences with greater capability. However, as human principal has to use it, we have to ensure that the agent will perform in the interest of the human. We investigate the framework of ASI-assisted question answering where ASI agents know the correct answer but the human does not. We provide some example of mechanism for rational alignment, where the agent utility is unchanged, but the interaction between the agent and the human principal is controlled to be in a certain fashion. We show specifically that a debate framework where the agents can further reason and behave in a subgame perfect equilibrium manner will lead to a more predictable result, and in some case will be favorable.

translation.title: 通过辩论实现超级智能的理性对齐
translation.abstract: 人工超级智能（ASI）是能力更强的人工智能。然而，由于人类委托方必须使用它，我们必须确保该智能体按照人类的利益行事。我们研究了 ASI 辅助问答的框架，其中 ASI 智能体知道正确答案而人类不知道。我们给出了若干理性对齐机制的示例：智能体的效用保持不变，但智能体与人类委托方之间的交互被约束为某种特定方式。我们特别表明，智能体可以进一步推理并按子博弈完美均衡方式行事的辩论框架将带来更可预测的结果，在某些情况下对人类有利。
translation.brief: 针对人类无法验证 ASI 回答正确性的问题，提出通过约束辩论交互使其形成子博弈完美均衡来实现理性对齐的机制。

papers.title: The Tiglath Pileser principle and models of persuasion
papers.abstract: This paper develops a formal framework for analysing how agents extract reliable information from narratives and communicative interactions involving strategic deception. Building on Rubinstein and Glazer's models of persuasion, we introduce Tiglath-Pileser relations, a generalization of codex-based guidance relations, to formalize Baruch Halpern's Tiglath-Pileser principle: despite systematic bias, reported claims must retain a connection to the truth. We analyse these relations set-theoretically and axiomatically, identifying conditions for their successful application in persuasion. Our dynamic approach examines how such relations are formed, revised, and strategically manipulated, extending existing models beyond one-shot interactions. Two case studies, including a formal reconstruction of Halpern's interpretation of the biblical account of King David, illustrate the framework's application to historiographical reasoning. Combining logic, epistemic reasoning, and game theory, the paper provides an account of belief formation and truth approximation under partial information and strategic manipulation.

translation.title: 提格拉·帕拉萨原则与说服模型
translation.abstract: 本文提出了一个形式化框架，用于分析智能体如何从包含策略性欺骗的叙事和交际互动中提取可靠信息。基于 Rubinstein 和 Glazer 的说服模型，我们引入 Tiglath-Pileser 关系——基于 codex 的引导关系的一种推广——来形式化 Baruch Halpern 的提格拉·帕拉萨原则：尽管存在系统性偏见，报告的陈述必须与真相保持联系。我们对这些关系进行集合论和公理化分析，识别其在说服中成功应用的条件。我们的动态方法考察这些关系如何被形成、修订和策略性操纵，将现有模型扩展到超越一次性交互的情形。两个案例研究，包括对 Halpern 关于圣经中大卫王叙述之解读的形式化重构，展示了该框架在史学推理中的应用。本文结合逻辑、认知推理和博弈论，为部分信息和策略性操纵下的信念形成与真相逼近提供了一种解释。
translation.brief: 针对在策略性欺骗下如何从叙事中提取可靠信息的问题，推广说服模型引入 Tiglath-Pileser 关系来形式化'陈述必与真相相关'原则并动态分析其操纵。

papers.title: Fine-Tuned Small Language Model for Synthetic Clinical Data Generation and Predictive Healthcare Analytics
papers.abstract: The reduced availability of medical datasets represents an important challenge in the development of predictive models for remote healthcare solutions, especially when the available data are imbalanced or difficult to extend through traditional methods. Small Language Models (SLMs) have become a promising alternative to Large Language Models (LLMs) for addressing these limitations due to their lower computational requirements and adaptability to specialized tasks. However, their performance remains highly dependent on the quality and representativeness of the available training data. In this paper, we propose a method for clinical data augmentation based on a fine-tuned Microsoft Phi-2 model that is used to generate synthetic instances, with the purpose of improving deep learning-based model for predicting remotely monitored vital signs. The Phi-2 model was adapted to the medical domain through supervised fine-tuning on the MedQuad dataset, through a Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA)-based method and by applying few-shot prompting techniques. The resulting model was used afterwards in the augmentation of a small-sized dataset, composed of vital sign values and labels associated with pathological and physiological states. The experimental results demonstrate that fine-tuned SLMs improved the performance on medical domain, achieving higher scores for both lexical (ROUGE) and semantic (BERTScore) evaluation metrics compared to the pretrained model. Moreover, the fine-tuned SLM is effective for generating structured synthetic clinical data. When used for data augmentation, the generated dataset improved the performance of a LSTM predictive model, increasing the classification accuracy from 89.0% to 93.7% and showing consistent improvements in precision, recall, and F1-score.

translation.title: 面向合成临床数据生成与预测性医疗分析的微调小语言模型
translation.abstract: 医疗数据集的匮乏是远程医疗预测模型开发中的一大挑战，尤其是当可用数据不平衡或难以通过传统方法扩充时。小语言模型（SLM）因其较低的计算需求和对特定任务的适应性，已成为解决这些局限的大语言模型（LLM）的有前景替代方案。然而，其性能在很大程度上取决于可用训练数据的质量和代表性。本文提出一种基于微调 Microsoft Phi-2 模型的临床数据增强方法，用于生成合成实例，以改进基于深度学习的远程生命体征监测预测模型。通过在 MedQuad 数据集上进行监督微调、采用基于量化低秩适应（QLoRA）的方法以及少样本提示技术，将 Phi-2 模型适配到医疗领域。随后将所得模型用于扩充一个由生命体征数值和病理与生理状态标签组成的小规模数据集。实验结果表明，微调后的 SLM 提升了医疗领域的表现，在词汇（ROUGE）和语义（BERTScore）评估指标上均优于预训练模型。此外，微调后的 SLM 能有效生成结构化的合成临床数据。在数据增强应用中，生成的数据集提升了 LSTM 预测模型的性能，将分类准确率从 89.0% 提高到 93.7%，并在精确率、召回率和 F1 分数上取得一致提升。
translation.brief: 通过 QLoRA 微调 Phi-2 小语言模型生成合成临床数据以增强小样本生命体征数据集，提升 LSTM 远程健康预测模型的分类性能。

papers.title: How Should Planning Agents ReSHAPE Their Search Space?
papers.abstract: Planning agents and benchmarks treat a user's initial specification as fixed. Yet the requests users write exclude plans they would gladly take, since they rarely discover the possible trade-offs they would accept until seeing the options. Agents already revise requests through interaction, but whether this helps planning is unknown. We formalize this step as the ReSHAPE task, which judges a revision by whether its search space matches the acceptable plans and a planner finds one there. Using ReSHAPE Planter, which builds instances from planning benchmarks with a human-validated simulated user, we analyze 5,800 agent-revised specifications in travel and shopping. We find that reshaping matters: one correct trade-off makes the same planner reach an acceptable plan up to 4.6x as often, and search space quality predicts what the planner finds. Current agents, however, admit at most 32% of the acceptable plans, where that trade-off alone admits over 52%, because they ask about preferences instead of showing plans; in travel, showing plans raises F1 by 9.7 points over asking, with two model families. Planning agents should thus treat a request as a hypothesis to test against the user's reactions to concrete plans to recognize user trade-offs.

translation.title: 规划智能体应如何 ReSHAPE 其搜索空间？
translation.abstract: 规划智能体和基准测试通常将用户的初始需求视为固定。然而用户写下的请求会排除他们其实愿意接受的方案，因为用户往往只有在看到可选方案后才发现自己愿意接受的权衡。智能体已经会通过交互修改请求，但这种做法是否有助于规划尚不清楚。我们将这一步骤形式化为 ReSHAPE 任务，通过修改后的搜索空间是否匹配可接受的方案、以及规划器能否在其中找到方案来评判一次修改。利用 ReSHAPE Planter（基于规划基准构建实例，并采用经人工验证的模拟用户），我们分析了旅行和购物场景中 5,800 份由智能体修改的需求。我们发现重塑搜索空间至关重要：一次正确的权衡可使同一规划器找到可接受方案的概率提升至原来的 4.6 倍，且搜索空间质量可预测规划器的结果。然而，当前智能体最多只能涵盖 32% 的可接受方案，而仅一次权衡即可涵盖超过 52%，原因在于它们询问用户偏好而非展示方案；在旅行场景中，展示方案比询问方式在两个模型家族上均使 F1 提高 9.7 分。因此，规划智能体应将请求视为一个假设，通过用户对具体方案的反应来检验，从而识别用户的权衡。
translation.brief: 将用户请求修改形式化为 ReSHAPE 任务，提出 ReSHAPE Planter 评测框架，发现规划智能体应通过向用户展示具体方案而非询问偏好来识别用户权衡并重塑搜索空间。

papers.title: Accuracy Is Not Welfare: Evaluating AI Buyers under Strategic Price Complexity in a Synthetic Duopoly
papers.abstract: AI buying agents may alter sellers' incentives as well as consumers' decisions. In a synthetic duopoly, we evaluate price-comparison pipelines on a fixed menu and in empirical correlated-equilibrium games. Calculator assistance selects an optimal offer 84.00% of the time, versus 68.57% under verified-total disclosure, yet disclosure has a 20.14-unit higher consumer-worst equilibrium surplus. A frozen-strategy holdout comparison favors disclosure, while re-solving equilibria under scenario resampling produces a range spanning zero. These model-based results show why accuracy, loss severity, seller incentives, and welfare incidence require separate measurement.

translation.title: 准确率不等于福利：合成双寡头市场中战略价格复杂性下的 AI 买方评估
translation.abstract: AI 购买智能体可能改变卖方的激励以及消费者的决策。在一个合成双寡头市场中，我们在固定菜单和经验相关均衡博弈上评估价格比较流水线。计算器辅助方式有 84.00% 的时间选择最优报价，而经验证总额披露方式为 68.57%，但披露方式下的消费者最差均衡剩余高出 20.14 个单位。冻结策略的留出比较支持披露方式，而在场景重采样下重新求解均衡则产生跨越零点的区间。这些基于模型的结果表明，准确率、损失严重性、卖方激励和福利分配需要分别测量。
translation.brief: 在合成双寡头市场博弈中评估不同价格比较机制的 AI 购买智能体，揭示报价选择准确率与消费者福利并非一致、需分开测量。

papers.title: Where in the Input Does a One-Pass Decision Encoder Look?
papers.abstract: Laya is a small model that answers a multiple-choice question about a text in one pass: the question, the options (each with a name and a description) and the text form one sequence of at most 512 tokens, the window, in the English release. A longer text is silently cut at the end, and we measure what that costs. Test documents place a held-out row's text, the evidence, at a chosen token offset among distractor text; 177 items, five tasks, three checkpoints (released, short-row fine-tune, long-document fine-tune), four window sizes and 93,275 scored requests. When the evidence lies beyond the window, accuracy falls to 26.4% for the released checkpoint (27.2% for both fine-tunes), near the 27.0% of guessing and below the 35.6% of always giving the commonest label. Confidence gives no warning (AUROC 0.50 to 0.55 for telling cut from read requests; 0.5 = chance), and the runtime's truncation flag also fires on requests whose evidence was visible. The released checkpoint reads visible evidence badly once text precedes it: 38.5% pooled against 60% when the evidence comes first, so a larger window alone gains +6.2 points. Fine-tuning on long documents adds +27.6 points on visible evidence over the short-row fine-tune (95% interval +22.3 to +33.1) and nothing on cut evidence. That is an in-family result: training rows and test documents share generator and question types, and the main filler is of the training kind. With encyclopedic filler never seen in training the gain is +13.2 (+9.9 to +16.6), with rows of other tasks as filler -2.0. Among training-free rearrangements a 312-token window scan helps most (+11.9 points over the default for the released checkpoint) at six to eleven forward passes. Documents are synthetic, labels are LLM-made and one backbone is studied, so these diagnose this model, not long documents in general.

translation.title: 单遍决策编码器在输入中看向哪里？
translation.abstract: Laya 是一个小型模型，可在单遍处理中回答关于文本的多选题：问题、选项（每个选项含名称和描述）和文本组成一个最长 512 token 的窗口，英文版本即如此。更长的文本会在末尾被静默截断，我们测量了这一代价。测试文档将被留出行的文本（证据）放置在干扰文本中的指定 token 偏移处；共 177 个条目、五个任务、三个检查点（发布版、短行微调版、长文档微调版）、四种窗口大小，共 93,275 次评分请求。当证据位于窗口之外时，发布版检查点的准确率降至 26.4%（两个微调版均为 27.2%），接近 27.0% 的随机猜测水平，低于总是输出最常见标签的 35.6%。置信度无法给出警告（区分截断与已读请求的 AUROC 为 0.50 至 0.55；0.5 为随机水平），且运行时的截断标志对证据可见的请求也会触发。发布版检查点在证据前有文本时读取可见证据表现很差：汇总为 38.5%，而证据在开头时为 60%，因此仅扩大窗口可提升 6.2 分。在长文档上微调使可见证据比短行微调版提升 27.6 分（95% 区间为 +22.3 至 +33.1），但对被截断证据无帮助。这是一个同族结果：训练行与测试文档共享生成器和问题类型，主要填充内容属于训练类型。当使用训练中从未见过的百科全书式填充内容时，增益为 +13.2（+9.9 至 +16.6），而使用其他任务的行作为填充时为 -2.0。在无需训练的重排方法中，312-token 窗口扫描最有帮助（发布版检查点比默认方式高 +11.9 分），但需要六到十一次前向传播。文档为合成、标签由 LLM 生成且仅研究了一个骨干模型，因此这些结果用于诊断该模型，而非一般的长文档。
translation.brief: 通过控制证据在窗口内位置的系统评测，诊断单遍多选决策编码器 Laya 对窗口外证据的截断失效及其置信度不可靠问题，并比较窗口扫描与长文档微调等缓解方法。

papers.title: Contain, Conform, Compare (Extended Version): A Red-Teamed Evaluation Kit for Small Coding Agents and the Full Record of Its Experiments
papers.abstract: A hosted score in the Gemma 4 Developer Agent competition is one noisy number, so development needs a local evaluator that is fast, safe for agent-written code, and matching the hosted scorer's prompts. drydock-eval evaluates a small coding agent (Gemma 4 E4B) at about 250 runs per hour on one RTX 5090. Contain runs each job in a fresh container without network and passed 200 scripted escape tests; conform provides eight checks that compare a local stack's requests with the scorer's configuration, down to rendered tokens; compare provides paired statistics that respect repository clusters. AI agents built and attacked the kit; a human owner approved machine use and release. This extended version repeats the short paper and adds the full record of the experiments made with and around the kit: 9,660 rows of agent runs, 2,494 grading controls and 72 serving measurements, all released. On four L4 GPUs the 31B model decodes 38.1 tokens per second in one stream and E4B 105.8. Six configurations of a 31B agent solved between 37 and 44 of 70 development tasks, and no pairwise difference was detected. A pre-registered five-arm experiment (231 tasks, 4,620 jobs) measured four prompt divergences: no E4B solve-rate change was detected (largest estimate -2.1 points, 95% interval -4.4 to +0.4). Three changes of the E4B agent led their screens by +1.0 to +6.2 points; each was then tested once on new tasks under a frozen pass rule, and none was confirmed (gains -0.35, -0.39 and +4.10 points). The unchanged baseline, run again on the same 128 tasks, moved by 1.17 points, and 65% of these tasks were solved in none of eight runs. Prompts and agent bundles are withheld; every run-level result is public.

translation.title: Contain, Conform, Compare（扩展版）：面向小型编码智能体的红队评测套件及其实验完整记录
translation.abstract: Gemma 4 Developer Agent 竞赛中的托管评分只是一个含噪声的数字，因此开发需要一个快速、对智能体编写的代码安全、且与托管评分器提示一致的本地评测器。drydock-eval 在一块 RTX 5090 上以每小时约 250 次运行的速度评测小型编码智能体（Gemma 4 E4B）。Contain 在无网络的新容器中运行每个任务，并通过了 200 项脚本化逃逸测试；conform 提供八项检查，将本地技术栈的请求与评分器配置进行比较，精确到渲染后的 token；compare 提供尊重仓库聚类的配对统计。AI 智能体构建并攻击了该套件；由人类所有者批准机器使用和发布。本扩展版重复了短论文内容，并增加了使用该套件及围绕其开展的全部实验记录：9,660 行智能体运行记录、2,494 项评分对照和 72 次服务测量，均已发布。在四块 L4 GPU 上，31B 模型单流解码速度为每秒 38.1 token，E4B 为 105.8。31B 智能体的六种配置在 70 个开发任务中解决了 37 至 44 个，且未检测到任何成对差异。一项预注册的五臂实验（231 个任务，4,620 个作业）测量了四种提示差异：未检测到 E4B 求解率变化（最大估计为 -2.1 分，95% 区间为 -4.4 至 +0.4）。E4B 智能体的三项改动在其筛选中领先 +1.0 至 +6.2 分；随后每项都在冻结通过规则下于新任务上测试一次，均未得到确认（增益分别为 -0.35、-0.39 和 +4.10 分）。未改动的基线在相同 128 个任务上重跑时变化 1.17 分，且其中 65% 的任务在八次运行中一次也未被解决。提示和智能体包不予公开；所有运行级结果均公开。
translation.brief: 构建一个包含容器隔离（Contain）、评分配置一致性检查（conform）和配对统计比较（compare）的本地红队评测套件，用于安全快速地评估小型编码智能体并公开全部实验记录。

papers.title: Active Learning of Approximate LLM Ranking for Energy-Efficient Retrieval of Long Queries
papers.abstract: Search engines and Large Language Models (LLMs) offer complementary strengths for document retrieval: lexical retrievers which rely on keyword matching are fast and energy-efficient, whereas LLMs capture semantic meaning and excel at interpreting long, context-rich queries. However, this comes at a cost that is computationally and energetically prohibitive. We propose the LLM Active Approximation Model (LAAM), a hybrid retrieval framework that introduces a lightweight learned predictor which serves as an intermediary between semantic retrieval and LLM retrieval. LAAM is refined through an active learning loop where an LLM labels a small number of documents. By concentrating LLM evaluations on the most informative documents, the framework substantially reduces inference cost while preserving retrieval effectiveness. We evaluate the proposed framework on TREC Robust 2004 using Lucene with BM25 retrieval and DeepSeek v3 as the LLM, under three levels of query verbosity. For verbose queries, LAAM achieves 87% of average P@10 achieved by DeepSeek's reranking (0.459 vs. 0.526), while requiring only 3.3% of the per-query energy consumption. LAAM is statistically significantly better than BM25 and is indistinguishable from DeepSeek on average precision, though not on MAP (Friedman test, P<0.05 with post-hoc testing). Overall, our results demonstrate that selectively approximating LLM relevance judgments through active learning enables retrieval accuracy to be controlled directly through the evaluation (and consequently energy) budget. Rather than committing to either inexpensive (and less accurate) lexical retrieval or exhaustive (and expensive) LLM reranking, our framework exposes a continuous spectrum of operating points along the energy--accuracy curve, allowing practitioners to select how to trade retrieval quality with computational budget.

translation.title: 面向长查询高能效检索的LLM近似排序主动学习
translation.abstract: 搜索引擎与大语言模型（LLM）在文档检索中各具互补优势：依赖关键词匹配的词法检索器快速且节能，而LLM能捕捉语义并擅长理解长而富有上下文的查询，但其计算与能耗代价过高。我们提出LLM Active Approximation Model（LAAM），一种混合检索框架，引入一个轻量的学习型预测器作为语义检索与LLM检索之间的中介。LAAM通过主动学习循环进行精化，由LLM标注少量文档。通过将LLM评估集中于最具信息量的文档，该框架在保持检索效果的同时大幅降低推理成本。我们在TREC Robust 2004上评估该框架，使用Lucene与BM25检索、DeepSeek v3作为LLM，并设置三个查询冗长度级别。对于冗长查询，LAAM达到DeepSeek重排平均P@10的87%（0.459 vs. 0.526），而每查询能耗仅需其3.3%。LAAM显著优于BM25，在平均精度上与DeepSeek无显著差异，但在MAP上存在差异（Friedman检验，P<0.05并做事后检验）。总体而言，结果表明通过主动学习有选择地近似LLM相关性判断，可使检索精度直接由评估（从而能耗）预算控制。我们的框架不必在廉价（但较不准确）的词法检索与穷尽式（且昂贵）的LLM重排之间二选一，而是在能耗—精度曲线上提供连续的操作点谱系，让实践者自行决定检索质量与计算预算之间的权衡。
translation.brief: 针对长查询用LLM重排能耗过高的问题，提出LAAM框架，通过主动学习让轻量预测器有选择地近似LLM相关性判断以权衡能耗与精度。

papers.title: Time and Space: A Dual-Axis, Evidence-Grounded Context Substrate for Personal Agents
papers.abstract: We argue that a binding constraint for personal agents is not model capacity but the form in which context is represented: the agent does not know which entity a phrase denotes, when a fact held, or which source record licenses a claim. We call the missing representation spatio-temporal context (STC) and define it on two axes. The temporal axis carries event time, validity intervals and ingestion time. The spatial axis is a relational space in which entities are points, typed relations are edges, and distance is semantic rather than geographic; physical places are one entity type among many. Every relation is anchored to immutable source records, and every answer must be closed over those records. We formalise the substrate and six invariants, a context operator that composes temporal intersection with relational expansion, an ambiguity-preserving resolution state machine, a conflict detector that converts mutually exclusive facts into user adjudication rather than silent overwrite, and a four-regime consumption taxonomy spanning query, insight, triage and proactive reminder. We describe a local-first prototype of the retrieval layer built on SQLite with on-device embeddings and hybrid lexical-dense recall, report measurements from a deployed store of 341 documents, 340,079 chunks and 190,271 embedded vectors, and specify, but do not yet implement, the analytic layer on which the framework depends. We close with an evaluation protocol with per-invariant metrics for evidence coverage, temporal correctness, conflict precision and interruption cost. The proposal targets the representation of context rather than the volume of it.

translation.title: 时间与空间：面向个人代理的双轴、证据锚定的上下文基底
translation.abstract: 我们认为个人代理的限制性约束不是模型容量，而是上下文的表示形式：代理不知道一个短语指代哪个实体、一个事实何时成立、或哪条源记录支撑某个论断。我们将缺失的表示称为时空上下文（STC），并在两个轴上定义它。时间轴承载事件时间、有效期区间与摄取时间。空间轴是一个关系空间，其中实体是点、带类型的关系是边、距离是语义的而非地理的；物理场所只是众多实体类型之一。每个关系都锚定到不可变的源记录，每个答案必须在这些记录上闭合。我们形式化了该基底及六个不变量、一个将时间求交与关系扩展组合起来的上下文算子、一个保持歧义的消解状态机、一个将互斥事实转化为用户裁决而非静默覆盖的冲突检测器，以及涵盖查询、洞察、分诊与主动提醒的四种消费模式分类。我们描述了一个基于SQLite、设备端嵌入与词法—稠密混合召回的本地优先检索层原型，报告了一个已部署存储（341个文档、340,079个块、190,271个嵌入向量）的测量数据，并 specifies（但尚未实现）框架所依赖的分析层。最后我们给出带按不变量度量的评估协议，涵盖证据覆盖、时间正确性、冲突精确度与打断成本。该方案针对的是上下文的表示而非上下文的体量。
translation.brief: 针对个人代理缺乏实体、时间与证据来源等上下文表示的问题，提出以时间和关系空间两轴定义、锚定不可变源记录的时空上下文基底及形式化不变量与原型实现。

papers.title: ReA-Bench: Benchmarking Responsible Agent Auditing
papers.abstract: As agents perform tasks autonomously in local and cloud environments, auditing their execution trajectories can help service providers identify risks and improve agent harnesses and foundation models. Our analysis of production and red-team trajectories shows that some risks are repeatedly missed across auditing configurations. Overall recall obscures which risks are missed and whether higher recall comes with more false positives on legitimate behavior. Existing benchmarks offer limited insight into these failures. Generated trajectories can contain inconsistent tool calls and responses, conspicuous risky actions, or repetitive attack patterns. Grouping results by risk type also makes it difficult to tell whether auditors overlooked evidence, accepted an unsupported conclusion, or lacked information needed to make a judgment. We introduce ReA-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for auditing responsible agent behavior. It organizes auditing challenges into six tiers: internal safety knowledge, contradictions within trajectories, evidence retrieval in long contexts, verification of sources and reasoning, indirect steering, and missing information. It includes challenging benign cases in which actions resemble risky ones but are consistent with the task and its authorization. It also provides paired trajectory versions to test whether auditors detect the same risks more reliably when the trajectory is shortened or missing information is supplied. Most samples are drawn from real production trajectories, with scenarios manually selected and adapted to preserve realistic tasks and risks that could plausibly arise during execution.

translation.title: ReA-Bench：负责任代理审计的基准测试
translation.abstract: 当代理在本地和云环境中自主执行任务时，审计其执行轨迹可以帮助服务提供商识别风险并改进代理框架和基础模型。我们对生产和红队轨迹的分析表明，某些风险在各种审计配置下被反复遗漏。总体召回率掩盖了哪些风险被遗漏，以及更高的召回率是否伴随着对合法行为更多的误报。现有基准对这类失效提供的洞察有限。生成的轨迹可能包含不一致的工具调用与响应、显眼的风险动作或重复的攻击模式。按风险类型对结果分组也难以判断审计者是忽略了证据、接受了无依据的结论，还是缺乏做出判断所需的信息。我们提出ReA-Bench，一个用于审计负责任代理行为的诊断性基准。它将审计挑战组织为六个层级：内部安全知识、轨迹内部矛盾、长上下文中的证据检索、来源与推理验证、间接操纵以及信息缺失。它包含具有挑战性的良性案例，其中动作看似有风险但与任务及其授权一致。它还提供成对的轨迹版本，以测试当轨迹被缩短或补齐缺失信息时，审计者是否能更可靠地检测相同风险。大多数样本取自真实生产轨迹，场景经人工挑选与改编，以保留执行过程中可能真实出现的任务与风险。
translation.brief: 针对现有代理审计基准无法定位风险遗漏原因的问题，构建六层级、含良性陷阱与配对轨迹的诊断性审计基准ReA-Bench。

papers.title: How many LLM-labelled rows does a decision encoder need, and how wrong can the labels be?
papers.abstract: A decision encoder such as Laya reads a question with named options (for example, which department should handle a ticket) and a text, and picks an option. It reads both in one forward pass and returns a probability for every option, without writing any text. We ask how many LLM-written training rows such an encoder needs and how wrong those labels may be. We ran 19 fine-tunes of Laya (ModernBERT-large) on nested subsets of a 2,818-row pool and scored them on 1,065 held-out items from the same generator, so every test item is in-distribution and no out-of-family test was run. Accuracy rises from 69.4% before fine-tuning to 74.3% with 5% of the rows, 84.8% with 50% and 86.9% with all rows. The curve flattens, and a saturating fit with bootstrap intervals cannot pin down its plateau. Seed spread at 20% of the rows (s.d. 1.6 points) exceeds some of the steps between sizes. Giving small subsets as many updates as the full pool gains 1.9 points at 5% and 1.9 points at 20% of the rows (one seed; p=0.14 and 0.13), and at 20% that is below the 2.3-point difference between two ordinary seeds. A single run with 10% symmetric label noise shows no detectable change (-0.2 points, 95% interval -1.7 to +1.4); 20% costs 3.4 points and 40% costs 8.7 points. Confusable-pair noise at 20% costs 7.4 points, and under noise the model moves from over-confident to under-confident. An independent labeller disagrees with the gold labels on 3.5% of held-out items, and about half of its choice disagreements (16 of 33, leaving each item out of the partner map) name the partner option that the confusable-pair noise uses. Laya is +0.9 points ahead of a TF-IDF classifier trained on the same rows at full size (the interval includes zero) and +21.1 points ahead at 5% of the rows. Everything is synthetic, LLM-labelled and from one backbone, one trainer and mostly one seed.

translation.title: 决策编码器需要多少LLM标注行，标签可以错到什么程度？
translation.abstract: 像Laya这样的决策编码器读取带命名选项的问题（例如哪个部门应处理工单）和一段文本，并选择一个选项。它在一次前向传播中同时读取两者，为每个选项返回一个概率，而不写任何文本。我们探究这样的编码器需要多少LLM撰写的训练行，以及这些标签可以错到什么程度。我们在2,818行的池的嵌套子集上对Laya（ModernBERT-large）进行了19次微调，并在来自同一生成器的1,065个保留项上评分，因此每个测试项都在分布内，未做跨族测试。准确率从微调前的69.4%升至使用5%行的74.3%、50%行的84.8%和全部行的86.9%。曲线趋于平缓，带bootstrap区间的饱和拟合无法确定其平台。使用20%行时种子间波动（标准差1.6点）超过某些规模间的步长。给小子集与全池相同的更新次数，在5%和20%行时分别获得1.9点（单种子；p=0.14和0.13），且在20%时低于两个普通种子之间2.3点的差异。一次10%对称标签噪声的运行未显示可检测的变化（-0.2点，95%区间-1.7至+1.4）；20%损失3.4点，40%损失8.7点。20%易混淆对噪声损失7.4点，且在噪声下模型从过度自信变为自信不足。一个独立标注器在3.5%的保留项上与金标签不一致，其选择分歧中约一半（33中的16，将每个项排除出伙伴映射）指向易混淆对噪声所用的伙伴选项。在全规模同行训练下，Laya比TF-IDF分类器高0.9点（区间包含零），在5%行时高21.1点。所有数据均为合成的、LLM标注的，且来自单一骨干、单一训练器和基本单一种子。
translation.brief: 针对决策编码器训练数据需求与标签噪声容忍度未知的问题，通过19次Laya微调实验系统量化LLM标注行数量与标签错误率对准确率的影响。

papers.title: Recalibrating a Typed-Decision Model in an Afternoon: A Hands-On Recipe for Laya's Confidence Scores
papers.abstract: A typed-decision model such as Laya reads a text and a list of options that the caller defines, for example ticket categories, and returns a probability for each option. Code around it compares the top probability with a threshold to answer, abstain or escalate to a person. Earlier work reports, for a Turkish model, that temperature scaling can raise held-out calibration error (ECE). This tutorial gives a five-step recipe (measure, diagnose, fit, validate, deploy) in 130 lines of numpy with standard methods, none new. On 1,065 synthetic, LLM-labelled items the released Laya checkpoint has a pooled ECE of 0.073 but a bucket-macro ECE of 0.143 (0.127-0.184), the mean over buckets (questions grouped by type and option count): the 12-option bucket is over-confident by +0.22, the three-to-five-option bucket under-confident by 0.05, and they cancel. One global temperature makes pooled ECE worse (0.173); a cross-fitted temperature per bucket brings macro-ECE to 0.073 (0.078 over 10 fold assignments) and reaches 0.089 with 10 labelled items per bucket, but holding out one of seven evaluation sets gives 0.099. After the refit, a gate aimed at 10% error answers 46.3% of items (10.5% wrong) against 6.9% on the published confidences, but one cut-off per bucket on the published confidences answers 45.4%, so most of the gain comes from separating buckets. Confidence-only maps (Platt, histogram, isotonic) need 20 or more labelled items per bucket to approach the temperature; with 320 per bucket the lowest macro-ECE belongs to Platt. In these files the retrained checkpoints store no per-bucket table and the stored 12-option value 0.1006 is clamped to 0.5 at runtime; the refit helps 31 of 33 checkpoints on random folds and 21 with a set held out. Fit and test share one generator and LLM labels, so these are findings about these checkpoints and this data.

translation.title: 一个下午完成类型化决策模型的再校准：Laya置信度分数的实用配方
translation.abstract: 像Laya这样的类型化决策模型读取一段文本和调用方定义的选项列表（例如工单类别），并为每个选项返回一个概率。其外围代码将最高概率与阈值比较，以决定回答、弃权或升级给人工。先前工作报告，对于一个土耳其语模型，温度缩放可能反而提高保留集校准误差（ECE）。本教程给出一个五步配方（测量、诊断、拟合、验证、部署），用标准方法以130行numpy实现，无任何新方法。在1,065个合成的LLM标注项上，已发布的Laya检查点的合并ECE为0.073，但按桶宏平均的ECE为0.143（0.127-0.184），即按类型和选项数分组的问题桶上的均值：12选项桶过度自信+0.22，三至五选项桶自信不足0.05，二者相互抵消。单一全局温度使合并ECE变差（0.173）；每桶交叉拟合的温度将宏ECE降至0.073（10个折分配上为0.078），每桶仅10个标注项时达到0.089，但留出一个评估集时为0.099。再校准后，目标10%错误的门控回答46.3%的项（10.5%错误），而已发布置信度下仅为6.9%，但基于已发布置信度的每桶一个截断可回答45.4%，因此大部分收益来自桶的分离。仅用置信度的映射（Platt、直方图、保序回归）需要每桶20个或更多标注项才能接近温度法；每桶320个时最低宏ECE属于Platt。在这些文件中，重新训练的检查点不存储每桶表，且存储的12选项值0.1006在运行时被钳制到0.5；再校准在随机折上改善33个检查点中的31个，留出一集时改善21个。拟合与测试共用一个生成器和LLM标签，因此这些发现仅针对这些检查点和这份数据。
translation.brief: 针对Laya按桶校准不良及温度缩放失效的问题，给出测量—诊断—拟合—验证—部署的五步再校准配方，用逐桶温度与阈值分离显著降低宏ECE。

papers.title: SignRot: LLM Quantization with Massive Outlier-Aware Sign-Adjusted Rotation
papers.abstract: While quantization compresses LLMs and accelerates inference, outlier activations impede efficient low-bit representation. In particular, massive outliers cause substantial performance degradation. Although rotation-based methods that rely on randomized Hadamard transforms for online inference aim to mitigate this, they can produce fragmented distributions with empty bins when a massive outlier dominates a token's activation. This fragmentation severely undermines uniform quantization performance. Moreover, massive outliers concentrate in the down-projection input, where the preceding nonlinearity requires the rotation to be applied at inference time. This constraint prevents training-based approaches such as SpinQuant from learning the online rotation at this position, as a learned dense matrix cannot use the Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform and would require a full matrix multiplication during inference. To address this, we propose SignRot (Sign-adjusted Rotation), which identifies massive outlier channels and constructs a sign adjustment vector that unifies the signs of the corresponding Hadamard row, collapsing the bimodal distribution into a unimodal profile amenable to quantization. Since the aligned outlier shifts the activation mean away from zero, we pair SignRot with asymmetric activation quantization, whose zero-point absorbs this shift. As a lightweight, drop-in improvement compatible with any Hadamard-based quantization method, SignRot requires only a single calibration forward pass and adds only element-wise sign flips at inference, without an additional matrix multiplication. Applying SignRot to QuaRot achieves a WikiText2 perplexity of 5.88 and an average zero-shot reasoning accuracy of 72.73, surpassing SpinQuant on the LLaMA3-70B model. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: SignRot：基于符号调整旋转的大离群值感知LLM量化方法
translation.abstract: 量化可以压缩LLM并加速推理，但离群值激活会阻碍高效的低比特表示，其中大离群值会导致严重的性能下降。尽管依赖随机化Hadamard变换进行在线推理的旋转类方法旨在缓解该问题，但当一个大离群值主导某个token的激活时，它们会产生带有空桶的碎片化分布。这种碎片化严重削弱了均匀量化的性能。此外，大离群值集中在下投影层的输入处，此处的非线性前序层要求旋转必须在推理时应用。这一约束使得SpinQuant等基于训练的方法无法在该位置学习在线旋转，因为学习到的稠密矩阵无法使用快速Walsh-Hadamard变换，并且需要在推理时进行完整的矩阵乘法。为解决该问题，我们提出SignRot（符号调整旋转），它识别大离群值通道，并构造一个符号调整向量来统一对应Hadamard行的符号，将双峰分布塌缩为适合量化的单峰分布。由于对齐后的离群值会将激活均值偏离零，我们将SignRot与非对称激活量化配对，其零点可以吸收该偏移。作为一种与任何基于Hadamard的量化方法兼容的轻量级即插即用改进，SignRot仅需一次校准前向传播，推理时仅增加逐元素的符号翻转，无需额外的矩阵乘法。将SignRot应用于QuaRot，在LLaMA3-70B模型上取得WikiText2困惑度5.88和平均零样本推理准确率72.73，超越了SpinQuant。代码可在该https URL获取。
translation.brief: 针对Hadamard旋转量化中因大离群值导致的分布碎片化问题，提出SignRot方法，通过符号调整向量统一离群值通道符号并结合非对称激活量化。

papers.title: A Joint LLM and Optimization Agent Solution for Drone Scheduling in Victim Search Missions
papers.abstract: Victim search in wilderness areas is time-critical. Drones enable rapid area search, but scheduling them is challenging because victims may continue moving, detection results are uncertain, and effective decisions must combine structured mission information with unstructured contextual clues and domain knowledge. To address this, we propose an agent-aided drone scheduling system. The system employs an agent at the ground control station (GCS) to coordinate multiple drones over successive search cycles. In each cycle, the agent applies a scheduling policy that combines a large language model (LLM) for reasoning about where to search with an optimizer for determining how to dispatch the drones under energy constraints. Simulation results show that the proposed system consistently completes the victim-search mission, whereas none of the six non-LLM baselines does so and direct LLM scheduling is considerably less reliable. The source code is publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: 用于受害者搜寻任务中无人机调度的LLM与优化联合智能体方案
translation.abstract: 在荒野地区搜寻受害者是时间敏感的任务。无人机可以实现快速区域搜索，但其调度极具挑战性，因为受害者可能持续移动，检测结果具有不确定性，且有效决策必须将结构化的任务信息与非结构化的上下文线索和领域知识相结合。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种智能体辅助的无人机调度系统。该系统在地面控制站（GCS）部署一个智能体，在连续的搜索周期中协调多架无人机。在每个周期中，该智能体应用一种调度策略，将用于推理搜索位置的大语言模型（LLM）与用于在能量约束下确定无人机派遣方式的优化器相结合。仿真结果表明，所提出的系统能够持续完成受害者搜寻任务，而六个非LLM基线均无法做到，且直接使用LLM进行调度的可靠性显著较低。源代码在该https URL公开。
translation.brief: 针对荒野受害者搜寻中的无人机调度难题，提出在地面控制站用智能体结合LLM推理搜索位置与优化器派遣无人机。

papers.title: Lost in Delegation: Studying the Effectiveness of Task Orchestration in Generative Search
papers.abstract: LLMs have quickly evolved from models used in isolation to agentic systems that delegate tasks to external tools and other LLMs to solve complex assignments. This agentic augmentation has led to impressive capability gains. However, when and how delegation improves performance remains poorly understood. For example, it is unclear whether delegation helps when tasks involve post-cutoff information that the orchestrating LLM cannot reliably resolve from its own knowledge. In this work, we use purpose-built datasets with pre- and post-cutoff splits to compare various delegation modes. We find that delegation provides no consistent accuracy improvement over non-delegated setups, with effects varying across models and tasks. When tasks involve knowledge unavailable to the orchestrator, delegation can substantially degrade accuracy, while direct tool use with the same LLM performs much better. Our analysis identifies distorted delegated queries, inefficient tool use, and failures to preserve and use information between agents as recurring failure modes. These findings suggest that effective orchestration requires both well-calibrated delegation decisions and effective exchange of information between agents.

translation.title: 迷失于委托：研究生成式搜索中任务编排的有效性
translation.abstract: LLM已经从单独使用的模型迅速演变为将任务委托给外部工具和其他LLM以解决复杂任务的智能体系统。这种智能体化增强带来了显著的能力提升。然而，委托在何时以及如何提升性能仍然知之甚少。例如，当任务涉及截止时间之后的信息、编排LLM无法依靠自身知识可靠解决时，委托是否有帮助尚不清楚。在本工作中，我们使用专门构建的、带有截止前/截止后划分的数据集来比较各种委托模式。我们发现，与非委托设置相比，委托并未带来一致的准确率提升，其效果因模型和任务而异。当任务涉及编排者不具备的知识时，委托可能显著降低准确率，而使用相同LLM直接调用工具的效果要好得多。我们的分析识别出失真的委托查询、低效的工具使用，以及在智能体之间未能保存和使用信息等反复出现的失败模式。这些发现表明，有效的编排既需要校准良好的委托决策，也需要智能体之间有效的信息交换。
translation.brief: 通过截止前/截止后数据集对比各种LLM委托模式，发现委托在知识不可得时反而损害准确率，并识别出查询失真等失败模式。

papers.title: Game-Theoretic Analysis of RIS-Assisted Challenge-Response PLA - Part I: Perfect Channel Knowledge
papers.abstract: We consider a physical layer authentication scenario in which a legitimate user (Alice) communicates with an authen- ticator (Bob) through a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS), controlled by Bob. An attacker (Trudy) aims to impersonate Alice by suitably precoding her messages and still transmitting them through the RIS. This two-part study analyzes this attack-defense interaction between Bob and Trudy under perfect (Part I) and partial (Part II) channel knowledge by all the agents. Part I formulates the joint RIS selection and precoder design under perfect channel knowledge as a finite zero-sum game, establishing exact channel subspace conditions for attack indistinguishability alongside equilibrium mixed strategies. Part II extends the defense to incomplete channel information, where each agent observes only its own channel, by formulating a finite-action Bayesian game and characterizing the resulting Bayesian Nash equilibrium. Simulations in geometric and 3GPP TR 38.901 UMi-NLOS channels reveal that authentication performance is governed by available spatial degrees of freedom, channel correlation, and operating signal-to-noise ratio. The proposed equilibrium strategies effectively balance communication rate and security, outperforming conventional benchmark policies.

translation.title: RIS辅助挑战-应答物理层认证的博弈论分析——第一部分：完美信道知识
translation.abstract: 我们考虑一个物理层认证场景：合法用户（Alice）通过由Bob控制的可重构智能表面（RIS）与认证者（Bob）通信。攻击者（Trudy）试图通过对消息进行适当预编码并仍通过RIS发送来冒充Alice。本研究分为两部分，在所有参与方具备完美信道知识（第一部分）和部分信道知识（第二部分）的情况下分析Bob与Trudy之间的攻防交互。第一部分将完美信道知识下的RIS选择与预编码器联合设计形式化为有限零和博弈，建立了攻击不可区分性的精确信道子空间条件以及均衡混合策略。第二部分将防御扩展到不完全信道信息的情形——每个参与方仅观测到自己的信道——通过形式化为有限动作贝叶斯博弈并刻画由此得到的贝叶斯纳什均衡。在几何信道和3GPP TR 38.901 UMi-NLOS信道上的仿真表明，认证性能由可用的空间自由度、信道相关性和工作信噪比决定。所提出的均衡策略能够有效平衡通信速率与安全性，优于传统基准策略。
translation.brief: 针对RIS辅助物理层认证中Trudy的冒充攻击，在完美信道知识下将RIS选择与预编码设计形式化为有限零和博弈并求解均衡策略。

papers.title: HALight: Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Traffic Signal Control under Lane-Level Missing Observations
papers.abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning has shown great promise for traffic signal control. However, most existing methods rely on two key assumptions: (i) agents are assumed to be homogeneous with unified observation/action spaces; (ii) full and reliable lane-level traffic observations are available to all agents. In practice, urban road networks exhibit substantial structural heterogeneity (e.g., lane configurations and phase designs), while sensor failures and incomplete detector coverage often result in missing incoming lane measurements. Such issues can severely impair coordination and destabilize learning. To address these challenges, we propose HALight, a communication-enhanced heterogeneous multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for traffic signal control under lane-level missing observations. HALight supports intersection-specific observation and action modeling to accommodate heterogeneous intersections, and incorporates a lightweight one-hop neighborhood communication module to enrich spatial context when lane-level observations are partially unavailable. Moreover, HALight adopts a sequential policy update scheme to improve coordination among heterogeneous agents. Experimental results on two real-world road networks demonstrate that HALight outperforms representative homogeneous and heterogeneous baselines in terms of traffic efficiency and convergence behavior. The code and datasets used in this work are available at this https URL.

translation.title: HALight：面向车道级缺失观测下交通信号控制的异构多智能体强化学习
translation.abstract: 多智能体强化学习在交通信号控制中展现出巨大潜力。然而，大多数现有方法依赖两个关键假设：（i）假设智能体是同构的，具有统一的观测/动作空间；（ii）所有智能体都能获得完整可靠的车道级交通观测。在实践中，城市路网表现出显著的结构异构性（例如车道配置和相位设计），而传感器故障和检测器覆盖不完整常常导致进口车道测量数据缺失。这些问题会严重削弱协作并导致学习不稳定。为应对这些挑战，我们提出HALight，一个面向车道级缺失观测下交通信号控制的通信增强异构多智能体强化学习框架。HALight支持针对特定交叉路口的观测与动作建模以适应异构路口，并引入轻量级一跳邻居通信模块，在车道级观测部分不可用时丰富空间上下文。此外，HALight采用顺序策略更新方案以改善异构智能体之间的协作。在两个真实路网上的实验结果表明，HALight在交通效率和收敛行为方面优于代表性的同构和异构基线。本工作使用的代码和数据集可在该https URL获取。
translation.brief: 针对交通信号控制中路网异构与车道级观测缺失问题，提出HALight框架，结合路口特定建模、邻居通信与顺序策略更新。

papers.title: Large Language Models as Digital Twins: a Distribution-Aware Questionnaire-Based Evaluation
papers.abstract: This paper investigates whether Large Language Models can answer a personality questionnaire as a specific individual would. Given a user's social-media posts, the model completes the BFI-2-60 Big Five questionnaire as that user. The predicted responses are converted into trait scores and compared with the user's actual scores. We evaluate GPT-4, Gemma, Llama 3.1, and Mistral on the MyPersonality dataset.
