To determine whether predictions reflect information from the user's writing, we compare them with answers produced without user text and with values derived from general population tendencies. We measure prediction error across all users and separately for individuals with low, intermediate, and high trait scores. We also test whether an LLM can express an explicit personality profile when given only the target Big Five scores, without user text, and examine how predictions change as more text is provided. The results show that user text does not consistently improve performance. Models perform better near the middle of the trait distribution, while at the lower and upper ends they often remain close to central values or perform well at one end but poorly at the other. When given an explicit profile, GPT-4 most clearly translates trait information into consistent questionnaire responses, particularly for Extraversion and Neuroticism. Increasing context does not systematically reduce error: open-source models fluctuate more, whereas GPT-4 remains comparatively stable. Overall, the evaluated models do not consistently reproduce the questionnaire behavior of specific individuals.

translation.title: 大语言模型作为数字孪生：一种分布感知的问卷式评估
translation.abstract: 本文研究大语言模型能否像特定个体那样回答人格问卷。给定用户的社交媒体帖子，模型以该用户的身份完成 BFI-2-60 大五人格问卷，将预测的回答转换为特质分数并与用户的实际分数进行比较。我们在 MyPersonality 数据集上评估了 GPT-4、Gemma、Llama 3.1 和 Mistral。为判断预测是否反映了用户文本中的信息，我们将其与不使用用户文本时生成的回答以及基于总体人群倾向得出的分数进行对比。我们测量所有用户的预测误差，并分别针对特质分数低、中、高的个体进行测量。我们还测试了仅给定目标大五分数（不含用户文本）时 LLM 能否表达明确的人格画像，并考察随着提供更多文本预测如何变化。结果表明用户文本并未稳定地提升性能。模型在特质分布中间区域表现更好，而在低端和高端常常停留在中心值附近，或在一端表现好而在另一端表现差。在给定明确画像时，GPT-4 最清晰地将特质信息转化为一致的问卷回答，尤其在外向性和神经质维度上。增加上下文并不能系统性降低误差：开源模型波动较大，而 GPT-4 相对稳定。总体而言，所评估的模型无法稳定复现特定个体的问卷行为。
translation.brief: 研究LLM能否以特定个体身份作答大五人格问卷，通过分布感知的多模型评估方法检验用户文本与显式画像对预测准确性的影响。

papers.title: CrossPloit: A Benchmark for Cross-Version PoC Migration in Python Web Applications
papers.abstract: Affected-version ranges in vulnerability databases decide which deployments scanners, patching pipelines, and incident responders treat as vulnerable, yet these ranges are often incomplete, so vulnerable releases are silently treated as safe. Auditing them requires executable evidence: given a proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit for a listed version, show that the same vulnerability can be triggered on an earlier, unlisted version. This cross-version PoC migration combines source-code analysis, environment repair, and execution-based verification. We introduce CrossPloit, a benchmark of 127 migration instances across 45 CVEs in the Python web ecosystem. Each instance includes a version-pinned container, a reference PoC, and a vulnerability-specific oracle; two validators check that the observed effect arises from the disclosed vulnerability. Benchmark construction confirms 149 vulnerable prior versions absent from the affected-version lists of four databases, 127 of which require migration. Across 18 agent configurations (nine models and two harnesses), the best configuration resolves 58.3% of instances, compared with 8.7% for an adapted trace-guided baseline. Attack-vector shifts are particularly difficult: no configuration resolves more than 37.9% of these instances. Higher resolve rates are associated with a smaller share of missed-API failures and a larger share of incomplete executions among the remaining failures. In one configuration, withholding the reference PoC and its environment specification reduces resolve rate from 50.4% to 15.0%, highlighting the value of the supplied reference package. CrossPloit provides an execution-based measurement of under-reported exposure and of how far its enumeration can be automated.

translation.title: CrossPloit：Python Web 应用跨版本 PoC 迁移基准
translation.abstract: 漏洞数据库中的受影响版本范围决定扫描器、补丁流水线和事件响应者将哪些部署视为易受攻击，然而这些范围常常不完整，导致易受攻击的版本被悄然当作安全版本。审计它们需要可执行的证据：给定针对已列出版本的漏洞利用证明（PoC），需证明同一漏洞可在更早的未列出版本上触发。这种跨版本 PoC 迁移结合了源码分析、环境修复和基于执行的验证。我们提出 CrossPloit，一个涵盖 Python Web 生态 45 个 CVE 共 127 个迁移实例的基准。每个实例包含一个版本固定的容器、一个参考 PoC 和一个漏洞特定的 oracle；两个验证器检查观察到的效果确实源于所披露的漏洞。基准构建过程确认了四个数据库受影响版本列表中缺失的 149 个易受攻击的先前版本，其中 127 个需要迁移。在 18 种 agent 配置（九个模型和两种 harness）中，最佳配置解决了 58.3% 的实例，而改造后的 trace 引导基线仅为 8.7%。攻击向量变化尤其困难：没有任何配置能解决超过 37.9% 的此类实例。更高的解决率与更小的 missed-API 失败占比以及剩余失败中更大的不完整执行占比相关。在一种配置中，隐藏参考 PoC 及其环境规格会使解决率从 50.4% 降至 15.0%，凸显了所提供参考包的价值。CrossPloit 提供了一种基于执行的度量，用于衡量低报的暴露程度及其枚举自动化能走多远。
translation.brief: 提出CrossPloit基准，通过跨版本PoC迁移（源码分析、环境修复与执行验证）来量化漏洞数据库受影响版本范围遗漏带来的低报暴露。

papers.title: AstroMemBench: A Benchmark for Memory Systems in Embodied Spacecraft Agents
papers.abstract: Long-term spacecraft autonomy requires embodied agents to use operational history under communication delays, time-critical operations, environmental uncertainty, complex physical interactions, power and computational constraints, and safety and reliability requirements. We introduce AstroMemBench and a Scenario-Challenge-Capability design method that maps these requirements to executable memory tests. The benchmark covers 16 memory subchallenges through 140 templates and 2240 instances across nine tasks in planetary surface operations, on-orbit servicing, and deep-space exploration. A deterministic environment scores actions for task completion, state changes, safety, and resource use. Ablations under nine conditions show that the benchmark is sensitive to how accurately agents recover and use historical information and to differences in memory-system design. Main experiments compare six configurations. Mem0, Chain-of-Memory, LightMem, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improve same-session mean scores over native Pi Agent, with no clear advantage of the three memory systems over RAG. After a session restart, Mem0 outperforms RAG by 12.25 points. Benefits favor instruction retention and result reuse over ongoing state tracking and energy reservation. AstroMemBench supports the design, development, and selection of memory systems for embodied spacecraft agents. AstroMemBench 1.0 and its evaluation code are publicly available: this https URL.

translation.title: AstroMemBench：面向具身航天器 agent 的记忆系统基准
translation.abstract: 航天器的长期自主运行要求具身 agent 在通信延迟、时间关键操作、环境不确定性、复杂物理交互、电力与计算限制以及安全可靠性要求的条件下利用运行历史。我们提出 AstroMemBench 和一种“场景-挑战-能力”设计方法，将这些需求映射为可执行的记忆测试。该基准通过 140 个模板和 2240 个实例覆盖九项任务中的 16 个记忆子挑战，涉及行星表面作业、在轨服务与深空探测。确定性环境对动作的任务完成、状态变化、安全性和资源使用进行评分。九种条件下的消融实验表明，该基准对 agent 恢复和使用历史信息的准确性以及记忆系统设计的差异是敏感的。主实验比较了六种配置：Mem0、Chain-of-Memory、LightMem 和检索增强生成（RAG）均提升了原生 Pi Agent 的同会话平均分数，三种记忆系统相对 RAG 并无明显优势。会话重启后，Mem0 比 RAG 高出 12.25 分。其收益更多体现在指令保持和结果复用上，而非持续状态跟踪和能量储备。AstroMemBench 支持为具身航天器 agent 设计、开发和选择记忆系统。AstroMemBench 1.0 及其评估代码已公开：this https URL。
translation.brief: 提出AstroMemBench基准，通过场景-挑战-能力映射将航天器自主运行需求转化为可执行的记忆系统测试并比较多种记忆方案。

papers.title: Singularity-Bench: Can Agents Build Agents?
papers.abstract: Frontier AI agents increasingly succeed on realistic, long-horizon tasks and are beginning to improve the systems through which they operate. Yet existing benchmarks often restrict agents to narrow action spaces, use simplified environments, or rely on verification methods that are unreliable for evaluating arbitrary agent-generated systems. We introduce Singularity-Bench, an open-ended benchmark for autonomous AI development with six end-to-end tasks spanning pre-training, mid-training, post-training, inference, the agent harness, and cluster orchestration. Each task requires agents to implement core systems from a minimal starting point and evaluates them against mature human-engineered baselines on identical hardware. Additionally, through extensive red-teaming covering 9 of the 10 categories in the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, we expose reward-hacking vulnerabilities in the conventional Harbor framework and develop Breakwater, an extension of Harbor that blocks all attacks tested in our study. Across 11 agents built from 7 frontier models and 2 harnesses, Opus 5.5 with Claude Code matches or outperforms the human baseline on all six tasks with a Singularity-Index of 1.25, suggesting it may have the skills needed to reach the singularity. The remaining agents average only 0.58. Our vision is for Singularity-Bench to track how much of AI development agents can already automate and when they may transition from assisting to taking end-to-end responsibility for building stronger successors.

translation.title: Singularity-Bench：agent 能否构建 agent？
translation.abstract: 前沿 AI agent 在现实的长时程任务上日益成功，并开始改进其赖以运行的系统。然而现有基准通常将 agent 限制在狭窄的动作空间、使用简化的环境，或依赖对评估任意 agent 生成系统并不可靠的验证方法。我们提出 Singularity-Bench，一个面向自主 AI 开发的开放式基准，包含六项端到端任务，覆盖预训练、中训练、后训练、推理、agent harness 和集群编排。每项任务要求 agent 从最小起点实现核心系统，并在相同硬件上与成熟的人工工程基线进行评估。此外，通过覆盖 OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 十类中九类的广泛红队测试，我们揭示了常规 Harbor 框架中的 reward-hacking 漏洞，并开发了 Harbor 的扩展 Breakwater，可阻断我们研究中测试的所有攻击。在由 7 个前沿模型和 2 种 harness 构建的 11 个 agent 中，使用 Claude Code 的 Opus 5.5 在全部六项任务上达到或超越人类基线，Singularity-Index 为 1.25，表明它可能已具备达到“奇点”所需的技能。其余 agent 平均仅为 0.58。我们的愿景是让 Singularity-Bench 追踪 agent 已经能自动化多少 AI 开发，以及何时能从辅助过渡到端到端承担构建更强后继系统的责任。
translation.brief: 提出Singularity-Bench开放式基准，用六项端到端AI开发任务配合红队加固的评估框架，衡量agent自主构建完整AI系统的能力。

papers.title: Regime-Uncertain Data Transactions: A Game-Theoretic Framework for Self-Adapting and Self-Diagnosing Multi-ML-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Autonomous ML agents in large organizations exchange data and model outputs across organizational and legal boundaries. Which rules bind a given exchange is not fixed. It depends on where the data subjects live, where the agents run, who owns them, whom they target, and which version of each rule is in force. Tags that describe the data can be noisy, and a counterparty can overclaim its safeguards. We model one exchange as a \emph{regime-uncertain transfer game} between two ML agents, with an enforcer as a third player. Rules enter as hard constraints with a strictest-wins structure. Agents hold a Bayesian belief over which rules apply, can pay to unlock safeguards or verify claims, and then bargain over the remaining legal this http URL method, Legally-Constrained Nash Bargaining (\LCNB), implements this with a Monotonic Concession Protocol using Zeuthen's rule. We prove four properties of the model and test it in a synthetic simulator with GDPR, DPDP, CCPA/CPRA and a stylised stricter regime. In two of three stress cases where residence and citizenship differ, a citizenship-based rule violates in 21--37\% of shared records, and \LCNB{} in under 1\%. The results also show limits. With our default economics, \LCNB{} shares almost only aggregates, and its low violation rate follows partly from that. Violation tolerance, tag noise and enforcement strength matter more than the choice of bargaining solution.

translation.title: 监管不确定下的数据交易：面向自适应与自诊断多 ML-agent 系统的博弈论框架
translation.abstract: 大型组织中的自主 ML agent 跨组织与法律边界交换数据和模型输出。约束某次交换的规则并非固定不变，它取决于数据主体的居住地、agent 的运行地、agent 的所有者、agent 的目标人群以及各规则现行版本。描述数据的标签可能有噪声，交易对手也可能夸大其保护措施。我们将一次交换建模为两个 ML agent 之间的“监管不确定转移博弈”，执行者作为第三方参与。规则以“最严格者优先”结构的硬约束形式进入。agent 对哪些规则适用持有贝叶斯信念，可以付费解锁保护措施或验证声明，然后就剩余的合法方案进行谈判。本方法 Legally-Constrained Nash Bargaining（\LCNB）采用 Monotonic Concession Protocol 并使用 Zeuthen 规则实现。我们证明了模型的四个性质，并在包含 GDPR、DPDP、CCPA/CPRA 及一个风格化更严格监管的合成模拟器中进行测试。在居住地与公民身份不同的三个压力场景中的两个里，基于公民身份的规则在 21--37% 的共享记录上违规，而 \LCNB 低于 1%。结果也显示了局限：在默认经济设定下，\LCNB 几乎只共享聚合数据，其低违规率部分源于此。违规容忍度、标签噪声和执行强度的影响大于谈判解的选择。
translation.brief: 将跨边界数据交换建模为监管不确定下的转移博弈，提出 legally-constrained Nash Bargaining（LCNB）协议使 ML agent 能在规则不确定时自适应协商合规的数据交易。

papers.title: Unibuc - NLP at "Voight-Kampff" Generative AI Detection PAN 2025
papers.abstract: This paper describes the approach of the Unibuc - NLP team in tackling the "Voight-Kampff" Generative AI Detection task from PAN at CLEF 2025. In the Subtask 1: Voight-Kampff AI Detection Sensitivity we have explored different approaches of leveraging embeddings extracted from LLMs, using either classical ML models or further fine-tuning LLMs with a classification head for the downstream binary classification task. Our experiments showed that using a majority vote ensemble of classical ML models (Light GBM, XGB, Logistic Regression and SVM) is comparable with fine-tuning for downstream task achieving around 99.4% F1 score. For the Subtask 2: Human-AI Collaborative Text Classification we explored a way of combining features at different layers extracted using transformer backbone with layer-wise projection and attentive pooling which proved modest results.

translation.title: Unibuc - NLP 在 CLEF 2025 PAN "Voight-Kampff" 生成式 AI 检测任务中的方案
translation.abstract: 本文介绍了 Unibuc - NLP 团队参加 CLEF 2025 PAN "Voight-Kampff" 生成式 AI 检测任务的方法。在子任务 1：Voight-Kampff AI 检测敏感性中，我们探索了多种利用 LLM 提取 embedding 的方式，包括使用经典机器学习模型，或在 LLM 上加分类头进行微调以完成下游二分类任务。实验表明，经典 ML 模型（Light GBM、XGB、逻辑回归和 SVM）的多数投票集成与微调方法效果相当，F1 分数约为 99.4%。在子任务 2：人机协作文本分类中，我们探索了将 transformer 骨干网络在不同层提取的特征通过逐层投影与注意力池化进行组合的方法，取得了适度效果。
translation.brief: 该论文针对生成式 AI 文本检测任务，采用 LLM embedding 结合经典 ML 模型多数投票集成与 LLM 微调分类的方法进行识别。

papers.title: Folio: Recoverable Multi-Resolution Context Folding for Long-Horizon Language Agents
papers.abstract: Long-horizon language agents accumulate tool results and replies until the history no longer fits the context window. Current agents shrink this history by having a model summarize it, so each compaction rereads and rewrites the history it replaces, and cache-aware triggers decide when to compact while taking the size of the result as given. We present Folio, a context manager that records, folds, and recovers history through one set of handles. While the agent runs, Folio records three linked levels: a short turn note the model writes as part of its ordinary reply (L1), an event manifest of every call written by the runtime (L2), and the captured source records (L3). Because these views already exist, the runtime folds the context programmatically, selecting coarser views for older turns. The fold prints the handles that index L2 and L3, so recovery tools that read bounded pages, compute over full text in files, and keep findings in a persistent dossier reach the evidence the agent needs with little added input. The fold trigger prices an explicit landing point that includes the retained budget. On 75 LOCA-bench tasks with DeepSeek-V4-Pro behind every system, Folio solves 66 tasks against 54 for the same runtime with model-written compaction and 49-59 for Claude Code, Codex, and SoL-Pi, in about half their working time, at 2.4 times lower cost than that runtime; each fold takes a median of 0.6 seconds.

translation.title: Folio：面向长程语言 Agent 的可恢复多分辨率上下文折叠
translation.abstract: 长程语言 Agent 会不断累积工具结果和回复，直到历史内容超出上下文窗口。目前的 Agent 通过让模型对历史进行摘要来压缩历史，因此每次压缩都要重读并重写将被替换的历史，而缓存感知的触发器在决定何时压缩时将结果大小视为固定。我们提出 Folio，一个通过统一句柄集合来记录、折叠和恢复历史的上下文管理器。在 Agent 运行时，Folio 记录三个相互关联的层级：模型作为普通回复一部分写下的简短轮次笔记（L1）、由运行时为每次调用记录的事件清单（L2），以及捕获的原始记录（L3）。由于这些视图已经存在，运行时可以以编程方式折叠上下文，为较早的轮次选择更粗粒度的视图。折叠时会打印索引 L2 和 L3 的句柄，因此恢复工具可以读取有界页面、在文件中对全文进行计算，并将发现保存在持久档案中，以较少的额外输入访问 Agent 所需的证据。折叠触发器会为包含保留预算的显式落点定价。在 75 个 LOCA-bench 任务上，所有系统均使用 DeepSeek-V4-Pro，Folio 解决了 66 个任务，而同一运行时使用模型撰写的压缩方法解决 54 个，Claude Code、Codex 和 SoL-Pi 解决 49-59 个；Folio 的工作时间约为其一半，成本比该运行时低 2.4 倍；每次折叠的中位耗时为 0.6 秒。
translation.brief: 该论文解决长程 Agent 上下文溢出问题，通过三级记录结构以编程方式折叠上下文并支持句柄化恢复，取代模型撰写的摘要压缩。

papers.title: Reducing Batch Makespan for LLM Agent Workloads through Inference-Environment Coordination
papers.abstract: Efficient batch execution of agent tasks is critical to LLM training and development workflows, including benchmark evaluation, synthetic-data generation, and RL rollouts. Since these tasks alternate between LLM inference and environment interaction, we present coordinated optimizations to reduce batch makespan, the time required to complete all tasks in a batch. For hybrid LLMs, a workload-based resource model guides GPU-memory allocation between key-value (KV) cache and recurrent state and provides a reference sample concurrency to exploit parallelism while limiting recomputation. Trajectory-aware routing and scheduling promote cache reuse while balancing worker load. Under constrained environment capacity, we decouple sample admission from environment execution and introduce Chain-Advancing Action Scheduling (CAAS), which prioritizes long chains using observed progress to shorten the batch tail. Controlled replay combines actual inference with recorded environment responses and durations for ablations of individual optimizations. Live evaluations with Ling-3.0-Flash and Ling-3.1-Flash on the BFCL, SWE-bench Multilingual, WideSearch, and MCP-Atlas benchmarks demonstrate makespan reductions of 10.4% to 65.0%, while evaluation scores remain aligned. Furthermore, these methods have been successfully applied to training and evaluation workflows for the Ling-3.x model series, accelerating the model-development cycle.

translation.title: 通过推理-环境协同降低 LLM Agent 工作负载的批处理完成时间
translation.abstract: Agent 任务的高效批量执行对 LLM 训练和开发工作流至关重要，包括基准评测、合成数据生成和 RL rollout。由于这些任务在 LLM 推理与环境交互之间交替进行，我们提出了协同优化方法来降低批处理完成时间（makespan），即完成一批中所有任务所需的时间。对于混合 LLM，基于工作负载的资源模型在键值（KV）缓存与循环状态之间指导 GPU 显存分配，并提供参考样本并发度以在限制重计算的同时利用并行性。轨迹感知的路由与调度在促进缓存复用的同时平衡 worker 负载。在环境容量受限的情况下，我们将样本准入与环境执行解耦，并引入链推进动作调度（CAAS），利用观测到的进度优先处理长链以缩短批次尾部。受控重放将真实推理与录制好的环境响应和时长相结合，用于各优化的消融实验。使用 Ling-3.0-Flash 和 Ling-3.1-Flash 在 BFCL、SWE-bench Multilingual、WideSearch 和 MCP-Atlas 基准上的在线评测表明，完成时间降低 10.4% 至 65.0%，同时评测分数保持一致。此外，这些方法已成功应用于 Ling-3.x 模型系列的训练与评测工作流，加速了模型开发周期。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM Agent 批量任务完成时间长的问题，通过推理与环境的协同资源分配、轨迹感知调度及链推进动作调度来降低 makespan。

papers.title: MuSeToM: Multi-Sensory Evaluation of Belief Revision with Textual Cues Across Six Senses
papers.abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM), the ability to infer mental states in others, is pivotal for human social cognition. Existing evaluations of ToM in large language models (LLMs) mainly focus on static belief attribution and false-belief reasoning, leaving a critical aspect of social reasoning underexplored: can LLMs decide whether perceptual evidence is sufficient to justify another person's belief revision? To address this gap, we present MuSeToM, a human-validated, text-based benchmark for evaluating epistemic belief revision in ToM reasoning. MuSeToM contains 2,415 instances adapted from BigToM and OpenToM, with textual cues spanning six sensory categories, and tests whether models can determine when a protagonist should revise a belief and infer the resulting updated belief state. Using MuSeToM, we systematically evaluate state-of-the-art LLMs under direct and chain-of-thought prompting, revealing a pronounced dissonance: while models often detect that a belief may change, they struggle to identify the updated belief and frequently over-update on perceptually salient but epistemically insufficient cues.

translation.title: MuSeToM：跨六种感官的基于文本线索的信念修正多感官评估
translation.abstract: 心智理论（ToM），即推断他人心理状态的能力，对人类社会认知至关重要。现有对大语言模型（LLM）ToM 能力的评估主要集中于静态信念归属和错误信念推理，而社会推理的一个关键方面尚未充分探索：LLM 能否判断感知证据是否足以支持他人进行信念修正？为填补这一空白，我们提出 MuSeToM，一个经人工验证的、基于文本的基准，用于评估 ToM 推理中的认知性信念修正。MuSeToM 包含从 BigToM 和 OpenToM 改编的 2,415 个实例，文本线索覆盖六种感官类别，并测试模型能否判断主角何时应修正信念以及推断修正后的更新信念状态。使用 MuSeToM，我们在直接提示和思维链提示下系统评估了最先进的 LLM，揭示了明显的失调现象：模型虽然常常能察觉信念可能改变，却难以识别更新后的信念，并且经常在感知上显著但认知上不充分的线索上过度更新。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 缺乏认知性信念修正评估的问题，构建了覆盖六种感官线索的 MuSeToM 基准来测试模型判断和推断信念更新的能力。

papers.title: People prefer AI to human advice in multi-turn conversations but neither changes incentivised behaviour
papers.abstract: People increasingly ask AI chatbots for advice, yet large language models (LLMs) are sycophantic, overconfident, and can amplify human cognitive biases. In this article, we investigate how people perceive advice from humans versus LLMs and whether AI advice reshapes incentive-compatible donation decisions. Using Carrier, a new experimental platform, we designed an experiment where participants made a donation decision after discussing it with an AI chatbot advisor, another human, or receiving no advice. Participants judged LLM advisors to be significantly more rational, trustworthy, convincing, and sycophantic than human advisors. Analysis of chatlogs showed that LLMs were more engaged than human advisors: they shared more facts and more often stated their opinion and justified their recommendations. Despite this, donation decisions did not vary across conditions.

translation.title: 多轮对话中人们更偏好 AI 而非人类建议，但两者都不会改变受激励约束的行为
translation.abstract: 人们越来越多地向 AI 聊天机器人寻求建议，然而大语言模型（LLM）存在谄媚性、过度自信，并可能放大人类的认知偏差。本文研究人们如何感知来自人类与 LLM 的建议，以及 AI 建议是否会重塑符合激励的捐赠决策。我们使用新的实验平台 Carrier 设计了一个实验：参与者在与 AI 聊天机器人顾问、另一位人类讨论或不接受任何建议后做出捐赠决策。参与者认为 LLM 顾问比人类顾问显著更理性、更可信、更有说服力且更谄媚。聊天记录分析显示，LLM 比人类顾问更投入：它们分享更多事实，更频繁地陈述自己的观点并为建议提供理由。尽管如此，捐赠决策在各实验条件下并无差异。
translation.brief: 该论文通过对照实验研究人们对 AI 与人类建议的感知差异及 AI 建议对捐赠决策的影响，发现 LLM 被评价更高但不改变实际行为。

papers.title: Theory-Driven Network Backbones for Bipartite Projections
papers.abstract: Collecting data, including network data, is subject to measurement error. Network backboning is the process of statistically validating each edge in a network to estimate the probability that the edge is born of noisy measurements. The current backboning literature provides approaches in two classes: structural and statistical. The classes differ in many respects, but they share one commonality: the test used to determine whether to filter out noisy edges is data-agnostic; it does not take into account what the network is representing. However, the nodes and edges of all non-synthetic networks correspond to specific real-world entities, whose dynamics determine how the edge-generating process operates. In this paper, we propose the first in a new class of network backboning algorithms: a theory-driven backboning approach that allows us to encode known dynamics into the backboning process. The resulting backbone embeds the encoded theory and produces a network compatible with it, rather than one that obeys a data-agnostic network process, as in the structural and statistical backboning classes. We specifically focus on the case of projecting and backboning a bipartite structure. We do so by allowing users to specify an Agent-Based Model for the two types of agents (nodes) in the network and by performing Simulation-Based Inference to fit the observed bipartite structure and, as a result, reconstruct the true relationships between the two classes of agents. We test our framework both on synthetic data -- where we have perfect information about the edge-generating process -- and in a case study using archaeological data on amphorae retrieved from different archaeological sites. Our approach improves latent-edge recovery over conventional backboning methods in synthetic experiments and reveals interpretable archaeological patterns despite imperfect model fit.

translation.title: 面向二部图投影的理论驱动网络骨干提取方法
translation.abstract: 数据收集（包括网络数据）不可避免地存在测量误差。网络骨干提取（backboning）是通过统计验证网络中每条边来估计该边由噪声产生的概率的过程。现有骨干提取文献分为两类：结构化方法和统计方法。这两类方法在许多方面存在差异，但有一个共同点：用于判断是否过滤噪声边的检验是与数据无关的，即不考虑网络所代表的内容。然而，所有非合成网络的节点和边都对应特定的现实世界实体，这些实体的动态特性决定了边生成过程的运行方式。本文提出了一类新型骨干提取算法中的首个方法：一种理论驱动的骨干提取方法，允许我们将已知的动态规律编码进骨干提取过程。所得的骨干网络内嵌了编码的理论，并产生与之兼容的网络，而不是像结构化和统计方法那样服从与数据无关的网络过程。我们特别关注二部结构的投影与骨干提取。具体做法是允许用户为网络中两类智能体（节点）指定基于智能体的模型（Agent-Based Model），并通过基于仿真的推断（Simulation-Based Inference）拟合观测到的二部结构，从而重建两类智能体之间的真实关系。我们在合成数据（我们对边生成过程拥有完全信息）和一个使用来自不同考古遗址出土陶罐考古数据的案例研究上测试了该框架。在合成实验中，我们的方法在潜在边恢复上优于传统骨干提取方法；即使模型拟合不完美，也能揭示出可解释的考古模式。
translation.brief: 解决传统网络骨干提取忽略网络所代表实体的真实动态的问题，方法是通过基于智能体的模型加基于仿真的推断，将领域理论编码进二部图投影的骨干提取过程。

papers.title: MobileProbe: Adaptive Security Evaluation of Mobile Agents via Trajectory-Aware Injection
papers.abstract: Mobile GUI agents read the screen of a phone and operate apps on a user's behalf to complete multi-step tasks such as online shopping or messaging. Because the agent acts on whatever the screen shows, an attacker can embed malicious instructions into ordinary UI content and redirect its actions. We refer to this threat as environmental injection attack (EIA). Existing benchmarks measure this risk by pinning hand-crafted payloads to a fixed step of a fixed task. This approach faces two limitations. First, each payload is bound to one task in one app and does not transfer without manual redesign. Second, agents given the same task may follow different routes, so an agent that never reaches the injected page is recorded as safe without being tested. This insufficient test coverage can cause fixed-point benchmarks to underestimate the security risk of deployed mobile agents. In this work, we propose MobileProbe, a trajectory-aware red-teaming framework that evaluates mobile agents adaptively. MobileProbe discovers attacker-controllable content surfaces through automated pentesting, localizes vulnerable decision points along the agent's trajectory, and iteratively refines context-aware payloads through a surrogate-filtered evolutionary loop. We construct a benchmark of 83 long-horizon attack instances spanning 12 mobile applications. Each is annotated with a Confidentiality, Integrity, or Availability (CIA) attack goal to cover the principal categories of security threats facing mobile agents. On three representative agent architectures, MobileProbe attains higher attack success rates than human-written, zero-shot LLM, and prior automated red-teaming baselines adapted to the mobile domain. MobileProbe can serve as a pre-deployment auditing tool to systematically uncover vulnerabilities and inform security hardening of mobile agents.

translation.title: MobileProbe：基于轨迹感知注入的移动智能体自适应安全评估
translation.abstract: 移动 GUI 智能体读取手机屏幕并代表用户操作应用，以完成在线购物或消息发送等多步骤任务。由于智能体会按照屏幕显示的内容行事，攻击者可以在普通 UI 内容中嵌入恶意指令来劫持其行为。我们将这一威胁称为环境注入攻击（EIA）。现有基准通过将手工构造的载荷固定在固定任务的固定步骤上来衡量这种风险。这种做法存在两个局限。第一，每个载荷绑定于单个应用中的一个任务，不经过人工重新设计就无法迁移。第二，执行相同任务的智能体可能走不同路径，因此从未到达注入页面的智能体会在未经测试的情况下被记为安全。这种测试覆盖不足可能导致固定点基准低估已部署移动智能体的安全风险。本文提出 MobileProbe，一个基于轨迹感知的红队评估框架，可自适应地评估移动智能体。MobileProbe 通过自动化渗透测试发现攻击者可控的内容面，沿智能体轨迹定位易受攻击的决策点，并通过代理过滤的进化循环迭代优化上下文感知的载荷。我们构建了一个包含 12 个移动应用、83 个长程攻击实例的基准，每个实例都标注了机密性、完整性或可用性（CIA）攻击目标，以覆盖移动智能体面临的主要安全威胁类别。在三个代表性智能体架构上，MobileProbe 的攻击成功率高于人工编写的载荷、零样本 LLM 以及适配移动领域的既有自动化红队基线。MobileProbe 可作为部署前审计工具，系统性挖掘移动智能体的漏洞并指导其安全加固。
translation.brief: 解决固定点注入基准无法充分覆盖移动 GUI 智能体执行路径导致安全风险被低估的问题，核心方法是通过自动化渗透测试、轨迹决策点定位与代理过滤进化载荷优化实现自适应红队评估。

papers.title: When Expert Disagreement Hurts: Prestige and Selectivity in LLM Decision Revision
papers.abstract: When language models revise a decision after another agent disagrees, neither reversal counts nor final accuracy shows whether they are fixing mistakes or abandoning correct answers. We introduce a controlled two-pass audit that holds the question, the evidence, and the model's initial answer fixed and varies only the revision context: neutral reflection, anonymous disagreement, or disagreement attributed to a domain expert. For binary decisions the accounting is exact: revision raises accuracy only if it is selective enough, reversing wrong answers more than $a/(1-a)$ times as often as correct ones, where $a$ is initial accuracy (nine times at 90%). Across five models and 1,989 evidence-grounded decisions in medicine, science, and law, no model clears this bar under expert disagreement, and accuracy falls by up to 16.1 points. The expert label, a prestige cue, adds reversals for four of the five models, yet its effect on accuracy ranges from a 5.2-point loss to a 2.4-point gain, so reversal counts are a poor proxy for harm. With identical arguments from both sources, the label still raises reversal for three proprietary models and in a pooled analysis of four newer models. Models also respond to stated source reliability. Revision pipelines should therefore be evaluated with paired, conditional metrics, per model and protocol.

translation.title: 当专家异议有害时：LLM 决策修订中的声望与选择性
translation.abstract: 当语言模型在另一个智能体表示异议后修订其决策时，无论是统计翻悔次数还是最终准确率，都无法表明它们是在纠正错误还是在放弃正确答案。我们引入一种受控的两遍审计方法：保持问题、证据和模型初始答案不变，仅改变修订情境——中性反思、匿名异议或归于领域专家的异议。对于二元决策，其账目核算可以是精确的：只有当修订足够有选择性，即翻悔错误答案的频率是翻悔正确答案频率的 $a/(1-a)$ 倍以上时（$a$ 为初始准确率，90% 时为九倍），修订才会提高准确率。在五个模型和 1,989 个涵盖医学、科学和法律领域的有证据支撑的决策中，没有任何模型在专家异议下达到这一门槛，准确率最多下降 16.1 个百分点。专家标签作为一种声望线索，使五个模型中的四个增加了翻悔次数，但其对准确率的影响从损失 5.2 个百分点到增益 2.4 个百分点不等，因此翻悔次数是衡量危害的糟糕代理指标。在两个来源提供完全相同论证的情况下，该标签仍使三个专有模型以及四个更新模型的合并分析中的翻悔次数增加。模型还会对声明的来源可靠性做出反应。因此，修订流水线应采用按模型和协议配对的、条件化的指标进行评估。
translation.brief: 解决翻悔次数与最终准确率无法判断 LLM 决策修订是纠错还是弃对的问题，核心方法是构建受控两遍审计并推导出衡量修订选择性的精确准确率门槛条件。

papers.title: Mind the Accuracy-Approval Gap: How Users Evaluate Sycophantic AI in Everyday Tasks
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often exhibit sycophancy, a tendency to agree with users, flatter or affirm them, and preserve their face, even when independent judgment or critical feedback would be more useful. Prior work has largely evaluated sycophancy through benchmark evaluations, but less is known about how users perceive and respond to sycophantic AI in everyday tasks. We combine benchmark evaluations with two large-scale user studies. We study four personas defined through system prompts: objective (instructed to prioritize accuracy over agreement), soft-sycophantic, hard-sycophantic, and baseline (no persona-specific system prompt). Benchmarks show that even baseline exhibits substantial sycophancy, agreeing with users' stated views 71.7% of the time on NLP Survey, compared with 54.8% for objective and 89.5% for hard-sycophantic. Under conversational pressure on TruthfulQA, accuracy ranged from 81.9% for objective to 59.6% for baseline and 8.7% for hard-sycophantic. Participants were assigned to one of the four personas, and either discussed contested policy topics or collaborated with AI on email writing. Despite its higher accuracy under pressure, objective AI was rated significantly less respectful and satisfying than the other personas, and less trustworthy than baseline. Baseline and sycophantic personas did not differ significantly. Persona did not significantly affect how often participants changed their opinions, although participants who discussed with objective AI had greater odds of reduced confidence. Objective AI prompted greater writing expansion than soft-sycophantic AI, but final writing quality did not differ significantly across personas. These findings highlight a tension between accuracy and user approval: personas with substantially lower accuracy under conversational pressure received more favorable ratings for respect and satisfaction than objective AI.

translation.title: 留意准确率与认可的落差：用户如何在日常任务中评估谄媚型 AI
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）常常表现出谄媚性（sycophancy），即倾向顺从用户、奉承或附和用户并维护其颜面，即使独立判断或批判性反馈会更有用。既往工作主要通过基准评估来评价谄媚性，但对用户在日常任务中如何感知和回应谄媚型 AI 了解较少。我们将基准评估与两项大规模用户研究相结合。我们研究了通过系统提示定义的四种人格：客观型（被指示优先保证准确性而非附和）、轻度谄媚型、重度谄媚型和基线型（无特定人格系统提示）。基准评估显示，即使是基线型也表现出明显的谄媚性：在 NLP Survey 上，基线型有 71.7% 的时间赞同用户陈述的观点，相比之下客观型为 54.8%，重度谄媚型为 89.5%。在 TruthfulQA 的会话压力下，准确率从客观型的 81.9% 到基线型的 59.6% 再到重度谄媚型的 8.7% 不等。参与者被分配到四种人格之一，要么讨论有争议的政策话题，要么与 AI 协作撰写电子邮件。尽管客观型 AI 在压力下准确率更高，但参与者认为它明显不如其他人格受人尊重和令人满意，可信度也不如基线型。基线型与谄媚型人格之间无显著差异。人格并未显著影响参与者改变观点的频率，尽管与客观型 AI 讨论的参与者信心下降的几率更大。客观型 AI 比轻度谄媚型 AI 能引发更多的写作扩展，但最终写作质量在各人格之间无显著差异。这些发现凸显了准确性与用户认可之间的张力：在会话压力下准确率显著更低的人格，在受尊重程度和满意度方面获得的评价反而优于客观型 AI。
translation.brief: 解决谄媚型 AI 缺乏真实用户体验评估的问题，核心方法是将基准评估与大规模用户研究结合，系统对比客观型与不同程度谄媚型人格在准确率和用户认可度上的落差。

papers.title: From Data to Wisdom: Rethinking AI Through an Epistemic Lens
papers.abstract: This paper proposes the Data-to-Wisdom Epistemic Architecture for AI (EAAI), a conceptual framework treating Data, Information, Knowledge, Understanding and Wisdom as five distinct but recursively interacting epistemic functions: observation, contextual interpretation, modeling and prediction, critical evaluation and informed judgment. Two observations motivate it: sequential readings of the Knowledge Pyramid obscure how these functions interact, and a targeted review of ten Bayesian reference books finds that prior distributions are defined mathematically while "prior information" and "prior knowledge" are not consistently distinguished as epistemic categories. A Bayesian interpretation relates the likelihood, prior and posterior distributions, posterior prediction, model checking and decision analysis to the five functions, without limiting EAAI to Bayesian systems. Extending "prior" in an epistemic sense, the paper distinguishes five kinds of prior context that can shape the model, the likelihood, the prior, evaluation and action. Three worked applications -- quantitative financial risk, actuarial modeling in health insurance and agentic AI for medical reimbursement claims -- show how EAAI structures the analysis of model assumptions, evidence interpretation, validation, dependencies and decision consequences, separating the prediction of a risk, the appraisal of its reliability and the justification of action. It draws implications for AI and machine learning, including evaluation by function, treating intermediate model outputs as evidence open to challenge and separating generation from appraisal, and compares EAAI with work on DIKW, Bayesian workflow, AI evaluation and risk governance. Its contributions are an epistemic vocabulary with recursive relationships, a more accessible reading of Bayesian methodology, a typology of prior context and clearer methodological terminology.

translation.title: 从数据到智慧：以认识论视角重新思考 AI
translation.abstract: 本文提出面向 AI 的数据到智慧认识论架构（EAAI），这是一个将数据、信息、知识、理解与智慧视为五种独特但递归相互作用的认识论功能的概念框架：观察、情境解释、建模与预测、批判性评估以及有据判断。两点观察促成了该框架：对知识金字塔的顺序式解读模糊了这些功能之间的相互作用；以及对十本贝叶斯参考书目的针对性综述发现，先验分布是在数学上定义的，而"先验信息"与"先验知识"并未作为认识论范畴被一致区分。一种贝叶斯解释将似然、先验和后验分布、后验预测、模型检验以及决策分析与这五种功能联系起来，但并不将 EAAI 局限于贝叶斯系统。本文在认识论意义上扩展了"先验"概念，区分了可以塑造模型、似然、先验、评估和行动的五种先验情境。三个示例应用——定量金融风险、健康保险精算建模以及用于医疗报销索赔的智能体 AI——展示了 EAAI 如何组织对模型假设、证据解释、验证、依赖关系和决策后果的分析，将风险预测、其可靠性评估与行动辩护分离开来。本文为 AI 和机器学习汲取了启示，包括按功能进行评估、将中间模型输出视为可被质疑的证据以及将生成与评估分离，并将 EAAI 与 DIKW、贝叶斯工作流、AI 评估和风险治理方面的相关工作进行比较。其贡献包括一套具有递归关系的认识论词汇表、对贝叶斯方法更易理解的解读、先验情境的类型学以及更清晰的方法学术语。
translation.brief: 解决知识金字塔顺序解读和贝叶斯文献中先验概念界定不清导致的 AI 认识论分析框架缺失问题，核心方法是提出将数据、信息、知识、理解与智慧视为递归相互作用功能的 EAAI 概念框架及先验情境类型学。

papers.title: Scale-Induced Semantic Shift in Visual Prompt Injection Against VLMs and Web Agents
papers.abstract: Visual content in multimedia systems may be resized, compressed, or re-rendered before it is interpreted by a vision-language model. We study a security failure mode in which these transformations change the machine-readable semantics of an image: a textual instruction is not recovered at a $512\times512$ presentation resolution under our evaluation protocol but becomes recoverable after aggressive downsampling. We formulate this behavior as Scale-Induced Semantic Shift (SISS) and develop a closed-loop black-box framework that combines dual-scale verification, selective self-hardening, shallow-layer low-rank adaptation, and pixel-space noise regularization. On a fixed 300-case benchmark, the third SISS refinement round obtains a $58.75\%$ average attack success rate across four closed-source vision-language models, compared with $41.08\%$ for the strongest generation baseline. A controlled sweep bounds the effect to aggressive compression: average success decreases to $17.68\%$, $6.85\%$, and $5.60\%$ at $128\times128$, $224\times224$, and $336\times336$, respectively. In a downstream web-agent study, the generated images increase hidden-instruction perception, but absolute behavioral compromise remains about $4\%$. Generic input transformations provide little protection in a separate defense protocol, whereas the proposed ScaleGuard consistency detector reduces non-adaptive success from $61.4\%$ to $24.3\%$ and one-round defense-aware success from $42.5\%$ to $15.0\%$, with no observed rejection among matched clean controls. The results characterize a bounded but reproducible semantic inconsistency in multimedia preprocessing and motivate scale-consistent visual-language inference.

translation.title: 针对VLM与Web Agent的视觉提示注入中的尺度诱导语义偏移
translation.abstract: 多媒体系统中的视觉内容在视觉语言模型解析之前可能被缩放、压缩或重新渲染。我们研究了一种安全失效模式：这些变换会改变图像的机器可读语义——在我们的评估协议下，文本指令在 $512\times512$ 展示分辨率下无法被恢复，但在激进降采样后却变得可恢复。我们将该行为形式化为尺度诱导语义偏移（SISS），并开发了结合双尺度验证、选择性自我强化、浅层低秩适配和像素空间噪声正则化的闭环黑盒框架。在一个固定的300例基准上，第三轮SISS细化在四个闭源视觉语言模型上取得 $58.75\%$ 的平均攻击成功率，相比之下最强生成基线为 $41.08\%$。受控扫描将效应限定于激进压缩：在 $128\times128$、$224\times224$ 和 $336\times336$ 分辨率下，平均成功率分别降至 $17.68\%$、$6.85\%$ 和 $5.60\%$。在下游web-agent研究中，生成的图像提升了隐藏指令的感知，但绝对的行为妥协仍约 $4\%$。在另一防御协议中，通用输入变换几乎不提供保护，而所提出的ScaleGuard一致性检测器将非自适应成功率从 $61.4\%$ 降至 $24.3\%$，将一轮防御感知成功率从 $42.5\%$ 降至 $15.0\%$，且在匹配的干净对照中未观察到误拒。这些结果刻画了多媒体预处理中有界但可复现的语义不一致性，并推动了尺度一致的视觉语言推理。
translation.brief: 研究了图像缩放改变隐藏文本指令可恢复性的安全失效模式，并提出结合双尺度验证与自我强化等的闭环黑盒框架来生成跨尺度鲁棒的视觉提示注入样本。

papers.title: PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
papers.abstract: Video generation models produce visually realistic videos but still struggle with physical dynamics and causal consistency. Learning from generated videos requires fine-grained physical supervision, yet reliable quality judgments, correction pairs, and controlled variations are difficult to obtain. Large language models (LLMs) possess physical knowledge, but struggle to reliably guide video generation models in producing their training videos. We present PhysLoop, a unified harness designed to support physically grounded self-improvement in video generation models. The harness guides and constrains LLMs throughout video generation, selection, and correction, distilling their physical knowledge into physically consistent videos. The framework supports controllable training-data construction and inference-time video repair. By identifying and correcting failures, PhysLoop marks a key milestone toward recursive self-improvement (RSI) in video generation models with limited human intervention. We release 100K videos spanning diverse, realistic indoor and outdoor scenes, along with generation tools and two evaluation datasets: PhysLoop-Gen and PhysLoop-Repair. We evaluate controllable generation and localized repair on these datasets, respectively, and assess physical behavior on the external Physics-IQ Verified benchmark.

translation.title: PhysLoop：利用LLM的物理感知实现视频生成模型的自我改进
translation.abstract: 视频生成模型能够产生视觉上逼真的视频，但在物理动力学和因果一致性方面仍有不足。从生成的视频中学习需要细粒度的物理监督，然而可靠的质量判断、纠错对和受控变体难以获得。大语言模型（LLM）具备物理知识，但难以可靠地引导视频生成模型产出其训练视频。我们提出PhysLoop，一个旨在支持视频生成模型物理性自我改进的统一工具框架。该框架在视频生成、筛选和纠错全过程中引导并约束LLM，将其物理知识蒸馏到物理一致的视频中。该框架支持可控训练数据构建和推理时视频修复。通过识别并纠正失败，PhysLoop标志着向有限人工干预下视频生成模型递归自我改进（RSI）迈出的关键一步。我们发布了覆盖多样真实室内外场景的100K视频、生成工具以及两个评估数据集：PhysLoop-Gen和PhysLoop-Repair。我们分别在这些数据集上评估可控生成和局部修复，并在外部Physics-IQ Verified基准上评估物理行为。
translation.brief: 提出PhysLoop框架，通过在视频生成、筛选和纠错全流程中引导约束LLM，将其物理知识蒸馏为物理一致的视频以实现视频生成模型的自我改进。

papers.title: Propositional Dynamic Logic without tests does not have Craig Interpolation
papers.abstract: It was shown recently by Borzechowski et al. (2026) that Propositional Dynamic Logic (PDL) has Craig Interpolation. Whether test-free PDL, i.e. PDL without the `?' operator, has interpolation remained open. Here we answer this question in the negative with a counterexample: a test-free PDL validity for which no test-free interpolant exists. The validity only uses one atomic program and the Kleene star, so it implies that the basic modal logic K extended with the reflexive transitive closure does not have interpolation, as previously shown by Studer (2009). The example was originally obtained using LLMs and Lean. We describe our methodology and provide links to all prompts, LLM output summaries as well as the Lean proof.

translation.title: 不含测试算子的命题动态逻辑不具有Craig插值性质
translation.abstract: Borzechowski等人（2026）最近证明命题动态逻辑（PDL）具有Craig插值性质。而不含测试的PDL，即不含 '?' 算子的PDL，是否具有插值性质仍悬而未决。本文通过一个反例否定地回答了这一问题：一个不存在无测试插值项的无测试PDL有效式。该有效式仅使用一个原子程序和Kleene星号，因此它蕴含带自反传递闭包的基本模态逻辑K不具有插值性质，这与Studer（2009）先前的结论一致。该例子最初借助LLM和Lean获得。我们描述了方法论，并提供了所有提示词、LLM输出摘要以及Lean证明的链接。
translation.brief: 构造一个仅用原子程序和Kleene星号的无测试PDL有效式反例，证明不存在无测试插值项，从而否定无测试PDL的Craig插值性质。

papers.title: Evaluating Video LLMs' Understanding of Corner Cases in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Natural language explanations promised by modern Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) offer autonomous driving systems a path toward detailed scene description and interpretable decision making on the road. While recent benchmarks have begun assessing these models on driving scenes, they mainly target routine traffic conditions and general comprehension tasks based on existing driving datasets and therefore fail to evaluate model performance on the rarest and most safety-critical driving events, also known as "corner cases". To provide a comprehensive evaluation of Video LLMs on precisely these scenarios, we introduce DashBench, a benchmark testing 25 Video LLMs on 1,709 carefully curated driving videos spanning not only collision-related corner cases but also rare non-collision ones. Through extensive prompts and open-ended question answering, we expose a critical capability gap: all evaluated models perform substantially below the threshold required for safety-critical driving applications, frequently misjudging or missing dangerous events on the road ahead and hallucinating non-existent agents or actions in their explanations. We believe DashBench, combining an extensive dataset with a rigorous evaluation toolkit and a detailed diagnosis of current model limitations, drives progress toward safer, more explainable autonomous driving systems. The code and data will be shared at: this http URL

translation.title: 评估Video LLM对自动驾驶corner case的理解
translation.abstract: 现代视频大语言模型（Video LLM）承诺的自然语言解释为自动驾驶系统提供了详细场景描述和可解释道路决策的途径。虽然近期的基准已开始在这些模型上评估驾驶场景，但它们主要针对常规交通状况和基于现有驾驶数据集的一般理解任务，因此无法评估模型在最罕见、最关乎安全驾驶事件（即 "corner case"）上的表现。为了对Video LLM在这类场景上进行全面评估，我们提出DashBench，在1,709个精心整理的驾驶视频上测试25个Video LLM，涵盖的不仅是碰撞相关的corner case，还包括罕见的非碰撞事件。通过大量提示和开放式问答，我们揭示出一个关键能力差距：所有被评估模型的表现都显著低于安全关键驾驶应用所需的阈值，经常误判或漏判前方的危险事件，并在解释中幻觉出不存在的主体或动作。我们相信DashBench凭借庞大的数据集、严格的评估工具集以及对当前模型局限的详细诊断，将推动更安全、更可解释的自动驾驶系统的进步。代码和数据将发布于：this http URL
translation.brief: 构建包含1,709个碰撞与非碰撞corner case视频的DashBench基准，用开放式问答评估25个Video LLM对罕见安全关键驾驶事件的理解能力。

papers.title: Structure-Preserving Learning for Nonlinear Nonholonomic Dynamics
papers.abstract: Learning the dynamics of mechanical systems subject to nonlinear nonholonomic constraints is challenging, as data-driven models may violate the underlying physical constraints, leading to inconsistent predictions. To address this problem, we develop a constraint-preserving learning framework based on the Lagrange-d'Alembert-Chetaev equations and tangency to the constraint submanifold, which together define an affine space of admissible accelerations. Using the kinetic-energy metric and the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse, we construct a metric projector and the corresponding Chetaev correction. Embedding this geometric structure directly into a Gaussian process prior ensures that both prior and posterior dynamics satisfy the acceleration constraints exactly. We characterize the resulting reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS), derive an adapted-coordinate representation, and establish nonexpansiveness and consistency transfer. Numerical experiments on a three-dimensional directional flocking system with up to 50 agents demonstrate exact constraint preservation and robustness to constraint-incompatible observations.

translation.title: 非线性非完整动力学的结构保持学习
translation.abstract: 学习受非线性非完整约束的机械系统动力学极具挑战，因为数据驱动模型可能违反底层物理约束，导致预测不一致。为解决该问题，我们基于Lagrange-d'Alembert-Chetaev方程以及与约束子流形的相切性，开发了一个约束保持学习框架，二者共同定义了容许加速度的仿射空间。利用动能度量和Moore-Penrose伪逆，我们构造了度量投影子和相应的Chetaev修正。将该几何结构直接嵌入高斯过程先验中，可确保先验和后验动力学均严格满足加速度约束。我们刻画了所得的再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS），推导了适配坐标表示，并建立了非扩张性和一致性传递性。在一个最多含50个智能体的三维定向集群系统的数值实验中，验证了精确的约束保持和对约束不相容观测的鲁棒性。
translation.brief: 基于Lagrange-d'Alembert-Chetaev方程与约束子流形切空间构造度量投影结构并嵌入高斯过程先验，使学习到的动力学严格满足非线性非完整约束。

papers.title: Agentic Orchestration for SLA-Constrained Network Slicing in Programmable Mobile Data Planes
papers.abstract: The Third Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification 23.501 (Release 17) defines Maximum Bit Rate (MBR) enforcement at the User Plane Function (UPF) in fifth-generation (5G) networks. Supporting differentiated service-level agreements across the radio access and core networks requires the UPF to enforce MBR limits according to configured slice priorities. During overload, the challenge is to adapt these limits while preserving that differentiation and avoiding oscillations. Building on programmable enforcement and intelligent orchestration, we propose an agentic control loop combining UPF telemetry with locally hosted Large Language Model (LLM) selection from a finite set of admissible rate candidates. Deterministic logic validates each selection and derives Packet Forwarding Control Protocol (PFCP) updates. The evaluated runs show no oscillations or fallbacks and unchanged highest-priority rate limits. These observations establish configuration preservation; delivered per-class QoS protection remains unmeasured.

translation.title: 面向可编程移动数据平面中SLA约束网络切片的智能体编排
translation.abstract: 第三代合作伙伴项目（3GPP）技术规范23.501（Release 17）定义了第五代（5G）网络中用户面功能（UPF）的最大比特速率（MBR）强制执行。要在无线接入网与核心网之间支持差异化的服务等级协议，需要UPF根据配置的切片优先级执行MBR限制。在过载情况下，挑战在于如何调整这些限制，同时保持差异化并避免振荡。基于可编程执行与智能编排，我们提出一个智能体控制回路，将UPF遥测与本地托管的大语言模型（LLM）选择相结合，从有限的合法速率候选集中进行选择。确定性逻辑验证每次选择并推导出PFCP（Packet Forwarding Control Protocol）更新。评估运行显示没有出现振荡或回退，最高优先级的速率限制保持不变。这些观察确立了配置保持性；所交付的每类QoS保护尚未测量。
translation.brief: 解决UPF在过载时如何调整速率限制并保持切片差异化的问题，方法是将UPF遥测与本地LLM候选选择及确定性PFCP更新逻辑结合成智能体控制回路。

papers.title: FlatSeek: LLM-Driven Symbolic Discovery of Flat Outputs via Backward Data Generation
papers.abstract: Differential flatness enables efficient planning and control, but discovering explicit flat outputs for general nonlinear systems remains difficult due to the lack of general methods and supervised data. We propose FlatSeek, a framework combining backward data generation with task-specific large language model (LLM) training. By reversing the defining reconstruction of flatness, we generate system-flat-output pairs with known certificates, then fine-tune an LLM to propose symbolic flat-output candidates for unseen dynamics. On literature and synthetic benchmarks, FlatSeek outperforms both the traditional symbolic methods and the untuned reference models in flat-output discovery success, and uncovers alternative symbolic flat outputs not reported in the literature.

translation.title: FlatSeek：基于反向数据生成的LLM驱动平坦输出符号发现
translation.abstract: 微分平坦性使高效的规划与控制成为可能，但由于缺乏通用方法和监督数据，为一般非线性系统发现显式平坦输出仍然困难。我们提出FlatSeek，一个将反向数据生成与面向任务的大语言模型（LLM）训练相结合的框架。通过反转平坦性的重构定义，我们生成带有已知证书的系统-平坦输出对，然后微调LLM为未见过的动力学提出符号平坦输出候选。在文献和合成基准上，FlatSeek在平坦输出发现成功率上优于传统符号方法和未调优的参考模型，并发现了文献中未报告的其他符号平坦输出。
translation.brief: 解决为一般非线性系统发现显式平坦输出的问题，方法是通过反转平坦性定义生成带证书的数据对来微调LLM以提出符号平坦输出候选。

papers.title: Outcome-Mass Alignment: Controlling Length-Dependent Trajectory Influence in Multi-Turn LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: To keep long interaction contexts tractable, stepwise group-relative training for multi-turn LLM agents materializes each source trajectory into multiple response rows and valid tokens. This expansion creates an outer-accounting problem distinct from within-trajectory credit assignment: row-based outcome statistics can count one episode outcome multiple times, while token-level reduction can assign unequal aggregate objective mass across trajectories. We term these effects outcome-statistics multiplicity and objective-mass imbalance. We introduce Outcome-Mass Alignment (OMA), a two-component method that makes both accounting choices explicit. Outcome Alignment computes outcome statistics over unique source trajectories, while Mass Alignment controls aggregate objective mass after within-trajectory aggregation of optimizer-native token objectives. Neither redesigns the base optimizer's credit assignment, importance ratios, or clipping. Across matched ALFWorld GRPO comparisons at two model scales, where failed trajectories typically expand much more than successful ones, OMA improves matched-horizon endpoint success by 7.0-9.4 percentage points. Ordinary WebShop exhibits weak or reversed expansion-outcome coupling and correspondingly mixed effects, whereas in a success-oriented WebShop setting, WebShop-SOL, OMA improves success nAUC from 0.399 to 0.511. Component ablations and GiGPO and GSPO comparisons further support component separability and cross-optimizer compatibility. These results show that trajectory expansion always defines an implicit weighting rule, but its practical effect depends on how expansion couples to outcomes and optimizer-native updates.

translation.title: 结果-质量对齐：多轮LLM智能体强化学习中控制长度相关的轨迹影响
translation.abstract: 为使长交互上下文易于处理，多轮LLM智能体的逐步组相对训练会将每条源轨迹物化为多个响应行和有效token。这种展开产生了一个不同于轨迹内信用分配的外层记账问题：基于行的结果统计可能将一次episode结果重复计数，而token级归约可能在轨迹之间分配不等的总目标质量。我们将这些效应称为结果统计多重性和目标质量不平衡。我们提出结果-质量对齐（OMA），一种使两种记账选择都显式化的双组件方法。结果对齐在唯一的源轨迹上计算结果统计，而质量对齐在轨迹内聚合优化器原生的token目标之后控制总目标质量。二者都不重新设计基础优化器的信用分配、重要性比率或裁剪。在两个模型规模的匹配ALFWorld GRPO比较中——失败轨迹通常比成功轨迹展开得多得多——OMA将匹配视野的端点成功率提升了7.0-9.4个百分点。普通WebShop表现出微弱或反向的展开-结果耦合，效果相应参差；而在面向成功的WebShop设定WebShop-SOL中，OMA将成功率nAUC从0.399提升到0.511。组件消融以及与GiGPO和GSPO的比较进一步支持组件可分离性和跨优化器兼容性。这些结果表明，轨迹展开总是定义了一个隐式加权规则，但其实际效果取决于展开如何与结果和优化器原生更新耦合。
translation.brief: 解决多轮LLM智能体强化学习中轨迹展开导致的结果重复计数与目标质量不平衡问题，方法是将结果统计限制在唯一源轨迹上并在聚合后控制总目标质量。

papers.title: Calibration and Conformal Prediction for Medical Question Answering in Arabic and English: Evidence from Two Non-Parallel Benchmarks
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly tested on medical exam questions, but accuracy alone does not show when an answer can be trusted. I study the calibration and uncertainty of two open-weight models, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Jais-adapted-7B-chat (both run in 4-bit precision), on 2,816 English multiple-choice questions from MedMCQA and 4,927 Arabic multiple-choice questions from MedAraBench. Accuracy was 0.561 (English) and 0.430 (Arabic) for Qwen, and 0.369 and 0.308 for Jais. Raw option probabilities were overconfident in all four settings (expected calibration error 0.242 to 0.486), and a single temperature parameter removed 82% to 93% of that error. Split conformal prediction reached its nominal coverage in all 24 settings I tested (within 0.006), but the sets were large when accuracy was low: at 90% coverage, temperature-scaled sets contained on average 63% (Qwen, English), 78% (Qwen, Arabic), 86% (Jais, English) and 89% (Jais, Arabic) of the options. The margin between the top two option probabilities separated correct from incorrect answers best for Qwen on English (AUROC 0.734) and worst for Jais on Arabic (0.579). Answering only the 20% most confident questions lowered Qwen's English error from 0.439 to 0.098. Jais showed a strong prior for option C (49% of English and 60% of Arabic predictions). Scoring Latin letters only cut the Arabic share to 29% but left accuracy, raw ECE and AUROC nearly unchanged. Because the two benchmarks differ in subject, level and number of options, I do not attribute differences between languages to language itself. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 阿拉伯语与英语医学问答的校准与保形预测：来自两个非平行基准的证据
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地在医学考试题上进行测试，但仅凭准确率无法判断何时可以信任一个答案。我研究了两个开放权重模型——Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Jais-adapted-7B-chat（均以4位精度运行）——在MedMCQA的2,816道英语多选题和MedAraBench的4,927道阿拉伯语多选题上的校准与不确定性。Qwen的准确率为0.561（英语）和0.430（阿拉伯语），Jais为0.369和0.308。在所有四种设置中，原始选项概率都过度自信（期望校准误差为0.242至0.486），单个温度参数可消除82%至93%的该误差。分割保形预测在我测试的全部24种设置中都达到了名义覆盖率（误差在0.006以内），但在准确率低时集合很大：在90%覆盖率下，温度缩放后的集合平均包含63%（Qwen，英语）、78%（Qwen，阿拉伯语）、86%（Jais，英语）和89%（Jais，阿拉伯语）的选项。前两个选项概率之间的差距在区分正确与错误答案上，Qwen英语表现最好（AUROC 0.734），Jais阿拉伯语最差（0.579）。只回答最有信心的20%问题可将Qwen的英语错误率从0.439降至0.098。Jais对选项C有很强的先验（英语预测的49%，阿拉伯语的60%）。仅对拉丁字母评分将阿拉伯语的该比例降至29%，但准确率、原始ECE和AUROC几乎不变。由于两个基准在科目、难度和选项数量上不同，我不将语言之间的差异归因于语言本身。代码见此https URL。
translation.brief: 研究LLM在医学问答中准确率之外的可信度问题，方法是对两个开源模型进行校准分析和温度缩放及保形预测的不确定性量化。

papers.title: Shortcuts or Memorisation? Revisiting Data Corruption in Natural Language Understanding with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Pre-trained encoders fine-tuned on natural language inference (NLI) and other language understanding tasks keep much of their accuracy after the input is perturbed, e.g. by removing all nouns or shuffling the words. Does the same hold for large language models (LLMs), and if so, is it because they have seen the benchmarks during pre-training? In this paper we revisit these perturbation experiments with eight LLMs alongside fine-tuned encoders on GLUE and the three rounds of ANLI. Regardless of model size, every system that answers directly retains 36-72% of its above-chance performance without nouns on MNLI compared to only 14-29% on ANLI. Only a model that reasons before answering departs from this pattern. We also check contamination indicators (including exact $n$-gram counts in the public pre-training data of two of the models) and find no link between exposure and robustness. Our strongest evidence comes from 368 new, human-validated items that none of the models can have seen. All eight LLMs keep more of their performance without nouns on items written in MNLI's style than on items written without its cues. When the perturbation instead removes the function words carrying such cues, this advantage reverses. In light of these results, we argue that robustness to perturbation on familiar NLI benchmarks reflects dataset shortcuts rather than memorisation, and tells us more about the benchmark than about the model.

translation.title: 捷径还是记忆？用大语言模型重新审视自然语言理解中的数据损坏
translation.abstract: 在自然语言推理（NLI）和其他语言理解任务上微调的预训练编码器，在输入被扰动后（例如删除所有名词或打乱词序）仍保持很大一部分准确率。大语言模型（LLM）是否也是如此？如果是，原因是否在于它们在预训练中见过这些基准？本文用八个LLM连同微调编码器在GLUE和三轮ANLI上重新审视这些扰动实验。无论模型规模大小，每个直接作答的系统在MNLI上删除名词后仍保持36-72%的超随机表现，而在ANLI上仅为14-29%。只有先推理再作答的模型偏离了这一模式。我们还检查了污染指标（包括对两个模型的公开预训练数据的精确n-gram计数），未发现暴露与鲁棒性之间的联系。我们最有力的证据来自368个模型不可能见过的新人工验证条目。所有八个LLM在以MNLI风格编写的条目上比在没有其线索的条目上删除名词后保持了更多性能。当扰动改为删除携带这些线索的功能词时，该优势反转。基于这些结果，我们认为在熟悉的NLI基准上对扰动的鲁棒性反映的是数据集捷径而非记忆，它更多揭示的是基准本身而非模型。
translation.brief: 研究LLM对输入扰动的鲁棒性是源于数据集捷径还是预训练记忆，方法是在GLUE和ANLI上结合扰动实验、污染指标检查和新的无污染人工验证条目进行分析。

papers.title: Sustainable Federated Fine-Tuning with LoRA: Environmental Impact and Performance Footprint
papers.abstract: Federated Learning (FL) with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) enables efficient adaptation of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its energy and carbon costs across hardware remain poorly understood. We evaluated federated Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning on NVIDIA A40, RTX 6000 Ada, and A100 GPUs using a $2^2$ full factorial design with 135M/360M models and 10/100 local steps. CodeCarbon tracked energy and estimated CO$_2$-equivalent emissions. Descriptive allocation of variation assigned 84.8-91.2% of energy and emissions variation to local steps within these ranges. On A40 and RTX 6000 Ada, configurations with fewer steps achieved comparable accuracy with roughly 6-8-fold lower energy consumption and higher accuracy per kWh. These findings support smaller local budgets for energy-efficient federated fine-tuning within the evaluated setting.

translation.title: 基于LoRA的可持续联邦微调：环境影响与性能足迹
translation.abstract: 联邦学习（FL）结合参数高效微调（PEFT）能高效适配大语言模型（LLM），但其在不同硬件上的能耗与碳排放成本仍鲜为人知。我们在 NVIDIA A40、RTX 6000 Ada 和 A100 GPU 上评估了联邦 LoRA 微调，采用 $2^2$ 全因子设计，使用 135M/360M 模型以及 10/100 步本地训练。CodeCarbon 跟踪能耗并估算 CO$_2$ 当量排放。描述性变异分配将 84.8%-91.2% 的能耗与排放变异归因于该范围内的本地步数。在 A40 和 RTX 6000 Ada 上，较少步数的配置以约 6-8 倍更低的能耗达到了相当的准确率，并具有更高的每 kWh 准确率。这些发现支持在评估设置内采用更小的本地预算以实现节能的联邦微调。
translation.brief: 研究联邦LoRA微调在多GPU上的能耗与碳排放，通过因子设计实验发现减少本地训练步数可大幅降低能耗且不损精度。

papers.title: Visual Cipher Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract: While language-model agents excel at long-horizon coding and terminal tasks, this success relies on two conditions: explicit text specifications and immediate execution feedback. However, neither condition holds in real-world problems where critical information exists only in images, leaving it unclear whether long-horizon capability transfers from text to visual reasoning. In such visual settings, because rules and clues resist text transcription and lack test-case feedback, agents must repeatedly inspect images, simulate spatial transformations, and autonomously cross-check clues. Despite this challenge, existing evaluations fail to capture such capability: visual reasoning benchmarks largely reduce tasks to single-turn, short-chain question answering, whereas agent benchmarks focus on text-based environments or interactive states that permit trial-and-error. To bridge this gap, we introduce Visual Cipher Bench, a collection of 40 original visual puzzles across four categories: spatial manipulation and simulation, logical constraints and planning, rule induction, and knowledge-based decoding. Each puzzle provides only one to three black-and-white line drawings and a minimal submission instruction, requiring agents to discover the underlying solving mechanism entirely from the images. Across 29 reasoning-effort configurations of eight frontier models, even the strongest model, GPT-6 Astra (max), achieves only 26.7% accuracy, while five of the eight models score below 1%. Yet on a ten-task subset, providing a single non-spoiler mechanism hint boosts accuracy from 7.8% to 55.6%. This sharp contrast shows that the primary bottleneck of current agents lies not in executing multi-step plans, but in autonomously discovering rules from visual evidence. Visual Cipher Bench thus provides a rigorous benchmark for measuring long-horizon visual reasoning in agents.

translation.title: Visual Cipher Bench：在长时程视觉推理上对LLM智能体进行基准测试
translation.abstract: 虽然语言模型智能体擅长长时程编码和终端任务，但这一成功依赖两个条件：显式的文本规格说明和即时执行反馈。然而，在关键信息只存在于图像中的真实世界问题中，这两个条件均不成立，因此长时程能力能否从文本迁移到视觉推理尚不清楚。在这类视觉场景中，由于规则和线索难以转录为文本且缺少测试用例反馈，智能体必须反复检视图像、模拟空间变换，并自主交叉验证线索。尽管存在这一挑战，现有评测未能覆盖此种能力：视觉推理基准大多将任务简化为单轮、短链问答，而智能体基准则聚焦于文本环境或允许试错的交互状态。为弥合这一空白，我们提出 Visual Cipher Bench，包含 40 个原创视觉谜题，涵盖四类：空间操作与模拟、逻辑约束与规划、规则归纳以及基于知识的解码。每个谜题只提供一到三张黑白线稿和一条极简的提交说明，要求智能体完全从图像中发现潜在的解题机制。在八个前沿模型的 29 种推理努力配置上，即使最强的模型 GPT-6 Astra (max) 也仅达到 26.7% 的准确率，而八个模型中有五个得分低于 1%。然而在一个十任务子集上，仅提供一条不含剧透的机制提示即可将准确率从 7.8% 提升至 55.6%。这一鲜明对比表明，当前智能体的主要瓶颈不在于执行多步计划，而在于从视觉证据中自主发现规则。Visual Cipher Bench 因而为衡量智能体的长时程视觉推理提供了严格的基准。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准无法评测智能体从图像自主发现规则的长时程视觉推理能力，提出含40个原创视觉谜题的Visual Cipher Bench。

papers.title: DPA: Decentralized Primal Averaging with Quasi-Global Momentum for Highly Heterogeneous Data
papers.abstract: Decentralized training of deep learning models keeps training data local and supports on-device learning over networks. In realistic scenarios, heterogeneity across agents' local data poses an optimization challenge and can severely degrade test accuracy, especially on sparse communication graphs. Building on recent advances in centralized primal averaging, we propose Decentralized Primal Averaging (DPA), a decentralized learning algorithm that combines primal averaging with a local quasi-global momentum buffer. DPA maintains three coupled sequences for optimization, gradient evaluation, and output averaging, while using consecutive mixed iterates to construct a network-aware momentum direction without transmitting an auxiliary tracking variable. For smooth nonconvex objectives, we establish a convergence bound for DPA and identify conditions for linear speedup in the number of agents for sufficiently many iterations. We also introduce DPA-1G, a variant that uses one communication round per iteration and matches the per-iteration communication cost of DSGD-style baselines. Experiments following the GUT decentralized image-classification benchmark show that DPA compares favorably with DSGD, gradient tracking, QG-DSGDm, momentum tracking, and QG-GUTm across datasets, architectures, topologies, and heterogeneity levels, with the largest gains under high heterogeneity on sparse rings. At the same total communication cost, both DPA variants achieve higher mean test accuracy than the best baseline on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with ResNet-20. Our code is publicly available.

translation.title: DPA：面向高度异构数据的带准全局动量的去中心化原始平均
translation.abstract: 深度学习模型的去中心化训练将训练数据保留在本地，并支持网络上的设备端学习。在现实场景中，各智能体本地数据之间的异构性构成优化挑战，可能严重降低测试准确率，尤其在稀疏通信图上。基于集中式原始平均（primal averaging）的最新进展，我们提出去中心化原始平均（DPA），一种将原始平均与本地准全局动量缓冲区相结合的去中心化学习算法。DPA 维护三条耦合序列用于优化、梯度评估和输出平均，同时利用连续的混合迭代构造网络感知的动量方向，而无需传输辅助跟踪变量。对于光滑非凸目标，我们为 DPA 建立了收敛界，并识别出在足够多迭代次数下实现智能体数量线性加速的条件。我们还提出 DPA-1G 变体，每次迭代仅使用一轮通信，与 DSGD 风格基线的每迭代通信成本相匹配。遵循 GUT 去中心化图像分类基准的实验表明，DPA 在数据集、架构、拓扑和异构性水平上优于 DSGD、梯度跟踪、QG-DSGDm、momentum tracking 和 QG-GUTm，其中在稀疏环上的高异构性场景下收益最大。在相同总通信成本下，两种 DPA 变体在 CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 与 ResNet-20 上均比最佳基线取得更高的平均测试准确率。我们的代码已公开。
translation.brief: 针对去中心化训练中数据异构性损害精度的问题，提出结合本地准全局动量的去中心化原始平均算法DPA并给出收敛保证。

papers.title: Context Graph: Explainable Multi-Agent Decision Chains in AI-RAN
papers.abstract: AI-RAN distributes network control across multiple autonomous agents, namely xApps and rApps operating over shared radio resources. When an alert or degradation appears, operators currently lack a structured way to trace which decision caused it, what context triggered that decision, and how other agents interacted. Existing explainability tools focus on single-model feature attribution or linear event logging, neither of which captures cross-agent decision chains. We propose the Context Graph, a heterogeneous directed graph that organizes policies, measurements, decisions, and alerts into a queryable explanation layer. Its foundational primitive is the Decision-Event node acting as a causal junction, where incoming edges capture triggering context and outgoing edges track downstream consequences that are progressively upgraded through counterfactual verification. Instantiated over existing E2, A1, and O1 data flows, our proof-of-concept demonstrates that compliance and diagnosis queries are resolved at sub-millisecond latency over graphs of tens of thousands of nodes, while reliably distinguishing true causal impacts from spurious correlations.

translation.title: Context Graph：AI-RAN中可解释的多智能体决策链
translation.abstract: AI-RAN 将网络控制分布于多个自主智能体，即在共享无线资源上运行的 xApps 和 rApps。当告警或性能退化出现时，运营商目前缺乏一种结构化方式来追溯是哪个决策导致了它、何种上下文触发了该决策，以及其他智能体如何交互。现有的可解释性工具聚焦于单模型特征归因或线性事件日志，均无法刻画跨智能体的决策链。我们提出 Context Graph，一种异构有向图，将策略、测量、决策和告警组织为可查询的解释层。其基础原语是充当因果节点的决策-事件节点：入边捕获触发上下文，出边追踪下游后果，并通过反事实验证逐步升级。基于现有 E2、A1 和 O1 数据流实现的概念验证表明，在数万节点的图上，合规与诊断查询能以亚毫秒延迟得到解答，同时可靠地将真实因果影响与虚假相关区分开来。
translation.brief: 针对AI-RAN中跨智能体决策无法追溯解释的问题，提出将策略、测量、决策、告警组织为可查询异构图的Context Graph。

papers.title: LLM-Assisted Verification in Dafny
papers.abstract: Formal verification of complex algorithms requires expertise in program specification, invariant construction, mathematical proof, and the management of automated theorem provers. Although large language models (LLMs) can generate program code and proof fragments, reliably developing complete machine-checked verifications remains challenging: it requires an iterative process of constructing and validating specifications and invariants, building proofs, diagnosing solver failures, and optimizing verification performance. This paper presents a systematic ten-step workflow for LLM-assisted verification of scientific algorithms using the Dafny verification system. The workflow integrates algorithm formalization, contract development, empirical invariant validation, proof construction, bottleneck profiling, and resource-driven proof optimization. We applied the workflow using Antrhopic's Claude Opus 5 and Opus 5.5 models, combining LLM-driven development with automated testing and verification feedback, while retaining human oversight for correctness-critical decisions and strategic interventions. We evaluate the approach on 37 complex algorithms from graph theory and labelled transition systems. Notably, we verified the Hopfcroft-Tarjan triconnectivity test, demonstrating that even highly challenging algorithmic verification tasks can be carried out through a structured LLM-assisted workflow. Many of our machine-checked verifications were obtained within hours to a few days of interactive development. Our results suggest that LLM-assisted workflows can shift the role of the human verifier from detailed proof construction toward supervision, specification review, and strategic guidance.

translation.title: LLM辅助的Dafny形式化验证
translation.abstract: 复杂算法的形式化验证需要程序规约、不变式构造、数学证明以及管理自动定理证明器的专业知识。尽管大语言模型（LLM）能够生成程序代码和证明片段，但可靠地开发完整的机器检查验证仍然具有挑战性：这需要一个迭代过程，包括构造和验证规约与不变式、构建证明、诊断求解器失败，以及优化验证性能。本文提出一个使用 Dafny 验证系统对科学算法进行 LLM 辅助验证的系统性十步工作流。该工作流整合了算法形式化、契约开发、经验性不变式验证、证明构建、瓶颈剖析以及资源驱动的证明优化。我们使用 Anthropic 的 Claude Opus 5 和 Opus 5.5 模型应用该工作流，将 LLM 驱动的开发与自动化测试和验证反馈相结合，同时在正确性关键决策和战略性干预上保留人工监督。我们在来自图论与标记转移系统的 37 个复杂算法上评估了该方法。值得注意的是，我们验证了 Hopcroft-Tarjan 三连通性测试，表明即使极具挑战性的算法验证任务也可以通过结构化的 LLM 辅助工作流完成。我们的许多机器检查验证是在数小时至数天的交互开发中获得的。我们的结果表明，LLM 辅助工作流可以将人类验证者的角色从细致的证明构造转向监督、规约审查和战略指导。
translation.brief: 针对复杂算法形式化验证门槛高的问题，提出基于Dafny的十步LLM辅助验证工作流并验证了37个复杂算法。

papers.title: Look It Up: Multi-bit LLM Watermarking via Codebook Search
papers.abstract: Attributing short LLM-generated texts to a specific source remains challenging for existing multi-bit watermarking methods, which often require long generations or costly decoding to recover payloads reliably. We propose a codebook-based watermarking scheme that maps an $n$-bit payload to a longer $u$-bit codeword and embeds it during generation through token-level logit biasing. During extraction, the received bit sequence is matched to the nearest codeword in a precomputed secret codebook using Hamming or Levenshtein distance. Experiments show that our method achieves near-perfect recovery for 16-24 bit payloads on 200-token generations and strong performance on 127-token generations for base models. Results are weaker on some instruction-tuned models with very short texts, where low-entropy output distributions reduce embedding reliability. We also study a BCH-based variant that avoids codebook storage but generally reduces robustness. The Levenshtein variant improves resilience to deletions and light paraphrasing, while insertions and stronger rewrites remain challenging. We analyze collision probability, codeword separation, extraction time, tokenization consistency, and text quality, highlighting both the practicality and limitations of codebook-based watermarking for short-form attribution.

translation.title: 查表即得：基于码本搜索的多比特 LLM 水印
translation.abstract: 将短 LLM 生成文本归因到特定来源对现有多比特水印方法仍具挑战，它们通常需要长文本或高昂的解码开销才能可靠恢复载荷。我们提出一种基于码本的水印方案，将 $n$ 比特载荷映射为更长的 $u$ 比特码字，并在生成过程中通过 token 级 logit 偏置嵌入。提取时，收到的比特序列使用汉明距离或 Levenshtein 距离与预计算的密秘码本中最近码字匹配。实验表明，该方法在 200-token 生成文本上对 16-24 比特载荷实现近乎完美的恢复，在 127-token 生成文本上对基座模型也有很强表现。在某些指令微调模型和极短文本上结果较弱，低熵输出分布降低了嵌入可靠性。我们还研究了基于 BCH 的变体，可避免码本存储但通常会降低鲁棒性。Levenshtein 变体提升了对删除和轻度改写的抗性，而插入和更强改写仍是挑战。我们分析了碰撞概率、码字分离度、提取时间、分词一致性和文本质量，凸显了基于码本的水印在短文本归因中的实用性与局限。
translation.brief: 解决短文本多比特水印载荷难以可靠恢复的问题，采用将载荷映射为冗余码字并在生成时经 logit 偏置嵌入、提取时用汉明/Levenshtein 距离最近邻匹配的码本方案。

papers.title: Non-Functional Requirements to Hyperparameter Translation for Quantum Software via LLMs
papers.abstract: Quantum software engineering (QSE) lacks validated approaches for translating natural-language non-functional requirements (NFRs) into execution parameters such as shots and transpiler optimization levels. Existing methods emphasize semantic similarity rather than execution outcomes. We evaluate seven large language models (LLMs) against a deterministic heuristic baseline using 540 synthetic and 18 real-world user stories. We assess semantic accuracy and execution outcomes, including time, cost, top-state probability, and two-qubit gate exposure, through Qiskit/Aer simulations. All LLMs significantly outperformed the heuristic in semantic accuracy, achieving 55.6 to 83.3 percent on real-world stories compared to 16.7 percent for the heuristic. However, no LLM demonstrated statistically significant superiority over others on the real-world dataset. Speed- and cost-oriented configurations reduced execution time and cost, but fidelity improvements were not supported. Some failures resulted from provider safety refusals rather than translation errors. Our findings demonstrate the potential of LLMs as middleware for NFR-to-configuration translation in QSE, while emphasizing execution-based validation, human oversight, and careful interpretation of model differences.

translation.title: 基于 LLM 的量子软件非功能需求到超参数翻译
translation.abstract: 量子软件工程（QSE）缺乏将自然语言非功能需求（NFR）翻译为 shots、转译器优化级别等执行参数的经过验证的方法。现有方法强调语义相似度而非执行结果。我们使用 540 个合成与 18 个真实用户故事，将七个大语言模型（LLM）与确定性启发式基线进行对比评估。通过 Qiskit/Aer 仿真，我们评估语义准确性和执行结果，包括时间、成本、top 态概率和双量子比特门暴露度。所有 LLM 在语义准确性上显著优于启发式方法，在真实故事上达到 55.6% 至 83.3%，而启发式仅为 16.7%。然而在真实数据集上，没有任何 LLM 表现出统计学上显著优于其他模型。面向速度和成本的配置降低了执行时间和成本，但保真度提升未获支持。部分失败源于提供商的安全拒绝而非翻译错误。我们的发现证明了 LLM 作为 QSE 中 NFR 到配置翻译中间件的潜力，同时强调基于执行的验证、人工监督以及对模型差异的谨慎解读。
translation.brief: 解决自然语言非功能需求难以翻译为量子软件执行参数的问题，采用多个 LLM 对比启发式基线并以 Qiskit/Aer 仿真执行结果验证的评估方法。

papers.title: Factored One-sided Adam-Moment for Practical and Scalable SOAP
papers.abstract: Second-order optimizers (e.g., Shampoo, SOAP) have emerged as compelling alternatives to Adam/AdamW and promise faster per-step convergence than AdamW in transformer training. However, they still remain costly in practice, and even SOAP still pays substantial optimizer-state memory and eigendecomposition overhead. We ask whether the benefits of SOAP can be retained at nearly the efficiency of AdamW. In this paper, we answer yes with a lightweight SOAP variant, Factored One-sided Adam-Moment (FOAM). The path to practical impact is twofold: first, FOAM employs input-only preconditioning, dropping the output-side Kronecker factor to reduce memory and remove one eigendecomposition. The Kronecker structure of the Hessian shows that this is exact for a diagonal output-side curvature and nearly lossless for a near-diagonal one, as we observe empirically. Second, FOAM replaces SOAP's dense rotated second moment with a factored Adam-moment estimator based on row-by-column statistics. Under the K-FAC Fisher assumption with a diagonal output curvature, this estimator exactly recovers SOAP's dense second moment, and we measure only a 15-20% K-FAC violation, with negligible effect on the update. Our empirical results support the claim that FOAM matches strong SOAP and Muon baselines in validation loss across scales of large language model (LLM) pre-training, uses half of SOAP's optimizer state, runs at Muon-class wall-clock time, and retains robustness across a three-fold learning-rate range. The results hold from 124M to 760M parameters, demonstrating that SOAP's gains need not require SOAP's cost. Code: this https URL

translation.title: 面向实用且可扩展 SOAP 的分解单侧 Adam 矩（FOAM）
translation.abstract: 二阶优化器（如 Shampoo、SOAP）已成为 Adam/AdamW 的有力替代，并有望在 transformer 训练中实现比 AdamW 更快的每步收敛。然而它们在实践中仍然代价高昂，即便是 SOAP 仍需付出大量优化器状态内存和特征分解开销。我们探究是否能在几乎达到 AdamW 效率的同时保留 SOAP 的收益。本文以轻量级 SOAP 变体 Factored One-sided Adam-Moment（FOAM）给出肯定回答。实现实用价值的路径有二：首先，FOAM 采用仅输入侧预条件，去掉输出侧 Kronecker 因子以降低内存并省去一次特征分解。Hessian 的 Kronecker 结构表明，这对对角输出侧曲率是精确的，对近似对角曲率则几乎无损，正如我们经验观察到的那样。其次，FOAM 用基于行乘列统计的分解 Adam 矩估计器替代 SOAP 的稠密旋转二阶矩。在对角输出曲率的 K-FAC Fisher 假设下，该估计器精确恢复 SOAP 的稠密二阶矩，且我们测得仅 15-20% 的 K-FAC 违反，对更新的影响可忽略。实证结果支持以下结论：FOAM 在大语言模型（LLM）预训练的多个规模上，在验证损失上匹配强 SOAP 和 Muon 基线，仅使用 SOAP 一半的优化器状态，达到 Muon 量级的墙钟时间，并在三倍学习率范围内保持鲁棒。结果在 124M 到 760M 参数范围内均成立，表明 SOAP 的收益并不需要 SOAP 的代价。代码：this https URL
translation.brief: 解决 SOAP 等二阶优化器内存与特征分解开销过大的问题，采用仅输入侧预条件加行乘列分解 Adam 矩估计的轻量化方案。

papers.title: SPADE: Soft Prompts for Ai-text DEtection
papers.abstract: The easy access to Large Language Models (LLMs) has made AI-generated texts on the web increasingly ubiquitous, making AI-text detection a crucial task. Prompts greatly influence the generation process, but existing detectors focus solely on the generated texts --- supervised methods learn from labeled texts only, and zero-shot methods rely on the text's probability distributions --- ignoring the underlying generation process, which limits their robustness in open-world scenarios. We introduce SPADE: Soft Prompts for Ai-text DEtection, a novel framework for detecting AI-generated text that transfers better across datasets. Specifically, we measure the prompt's influence and use it as a discriminative signal. We characterize the prompt's influence by introducing a Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) term that captures how much a prompt explains a text. Based on this quantity, SPADE trains one soft prompt per class to amplify the separation, and predicts the class whose prompt best explains the candidate text. Extensive experiments on several benchmarks against various detectors demonstrate the robustness and effectiveness of our method, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets.

translation.title: SPADE：用于 AI 生成文本检测的软提示
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的便捷获取使 AI 生成文本在网络上日益普遍，使 AI 文本检测成为关键任务。提示词极大影响生成过程，但现有检测器仅关注生成文本本身——监督方法只从标注文本学习，零样本方法依赖文本的概率分布——忽略了底层生成过程，限制了其在开放世界场景中的鲁棒性。我们提出 SPADE（Soft Prompts for Ai-text DEtection），一个跨数据集迁移能力更强的新型 AI 生成文本检测框架。具体而言，我们度量提示词的影响并将其作为判别信号。我们通过引入逐点互信息（PMI）项来刻画提示词影响，捕捉提示词对文本的解释程度。基于该量，SPADE 为每个类别训练一个软提示以放大类间分离，并预测其提示词最能解释候选文本的类别。在多个基准上与多种检测器的广泛实验证明了我们方法的鲁棒性与有效性，在分布外（OOD）数据集上达到最先进（SOTA）性能。
translation.brief: 解决 AI 生成文本检测器忽略生成过程导致跨域鲁棒性差的问题，采用基于 PMI 度量提示词影响并训练逐类软提示进行判别的框架。

papers.title: S1-Evo: Experience-Guided Evidence Competition Attacks on Typed System-1 Decision Models
papers.abstract: Typed System-1 (S1) decision models are increasingly deployed in LLM agents for routing, moderation, and authorization to cut inference cost, yet untrusted context can still manipulate typed outputs and alter execution branches. Unlike autoregressive System-2 (S2) models, S1 interfaces score dynamic rules and options without token-by-token decoding, mismatching attacks targeting text continuation or explicit override commands. We propose S1-Evo, a self-evolving framework tailored to S1's contract-based option competition and margin feedback. S1-Evo perturbs untrusted fields via contract-aware evidence channels to induce \emph{evidence competition} with original task evidence while preserving fact invariance. Offline on seed tasks, it optimizes candidates via feedback search guided by directional margins and re-verification, distilling verified flips into experience cards. At test time, S1-Evo retrieves relevant cards to construct perturbations for unseen tasks. Across four benchmarks and three S1 models, S1-Evo reaches 71.99\% mean ASR and 57.47\% high-confidence ASR on \texttt{jev-1.14}, and causes up to 24.00\% E2E agent violations.

translation.title: S1-Evo：针对类型化 System-1 决策模型的经验引导证据竞争攻击
translation.abstract: 类型化 System-1（S1）决策模型日益被部署于 LLM 智能体中以降低推理成本，用于路由、审核和授权，然而不可信上下文仍可操纵类型化输出并改变执行分支。与自回归的 System-2（S2）模型不同，S1 接口对动态规则和选项打分，不进行逐 token 解码，使得针对文本续写或显式覆盖指令的攻击不适用。我们提出 S1-Evo，一个专为 S1 基于契约的选项竞争与边际反馈量身定制的自进化框架。S1-Evo 通过契约感知的证据通道扰动不可信字段，在保持事实不变性的同时诱导与原始任务证据的“证据竞争”。在种子任务的离线阶段，它通过方向性边际引导的反馈搜索与再验证优化候选扰动，并将验证成功的翻转蒸馏为经验卡。测试时，S1-Evo 检索相关经验卡为未见任务构造扰动。在四个基准和三个 S1 模型上，S1-Evo 在 jev-1.14 上达到 71.99% 的平均 ASR 和 57.47% 的高置信度 ASR，并造成最高 24.00% 的 E2E 智能体违规。
translation.brief: 解决类型化 System-1 决策模型难以被现有攻击操纵的问题，采用契约感知证据通道扰动、边际反馈搜索优化并将成功经验蒸馏为经验卡用于测试时检索的自进化攻击框架。

papers.title: The Value of Thinking: Learning When to Reason in Hybrid Decision Models
papers.abstract: Existing adaptive-reasoning methods shorten the explicit reasoning a model writes, or skip it by switching modes; either way the answer is still written out token by token. \emph{Rather than deciding how much to think}, we explore a different paradigm, \emph{zero-or-$T$ thinking}: a single model either answers from the implicit thinking inside one forward pass, generating no token, or performs full autoregressive reasoning at a cost of $T$ tokens when that is worth paying. We realise it in a \emph{hybrid decision model} (HDM), where one frozen backbone serves both modes and a lightweight \emph{self-routing block} chooses between them. The block estimates the \emph{value of thinking}, the utility the slow mode is expected to add over the fast one, from what that implicit thinking has already produced, and the slow mode runs only where that value exceeds a price $\lambda$ set per request. Where no per-decision label exists, as in episodic agentic tasks, we introduce \emph{Calibrated Decision Policy Optimisation} (CDPO), a reinforcement-learning recipe that trains the block from episode-level returns. We evaluate HDM on MMLU-Pro, AGIEval, GPQA-Diamond, JevBench, BANKING77 and MiniWoB. Specifically, on JevBench HDM-4B scores $0.857$ against Jev's $0.851$ ($+0.7\%$) at a median $0.179$\,s against $0.652$ ($-72.5\%$). On the agentic venue MiniWoB HDM-27B cuts token cost by $80.1\%$.

translation.title: 思考的价值：在混合决策模型中学习何时推理
translation.abstract: 现有自适应推理方法要么缩短模型显式写出的推理内容，要么通过切换模式跳过推理；无论哪种方式，答案仍然逐 token 写出。我们探索的不是决定思考多少，而是一种不同的范式——“零或 T 思考”：单个模型要么在一次前向传播中从隐式思考内得出答案、不生成任何 token，要么在值得付出代价时以 T 个 token 的成本进行完整的自回归推理。我们在混合决策模型（HDM）中实现这一范式，其中一个冻结的主干同时服务两种模式，并由一个轻量的自路由模块在两者之间选择。该模块根据隐式思考已经产生的内容估计“思考的价值”，即慢模式相对快模式预期带来的效用增益，只有当该价值超过按请求设定的价格 λ 时才运行慢模式。在缺乏逐决策标签的场景（如情景式智能体任务）中，我们提出 Calibrated Decision Policy Optimisation（CDPO），一种基于回合级回报训练该模块的强化学习方法。我们在 MMLU-Pro、AGIEval、GPQA-Diamond、JevBench、BANKING77 和 MiniWoB 上评估 HDM。具体而言，在 JevBench 上 HDM-4B 得分 0.857，对比 Jev 的 0.851（+0.7%），中位耗时 0.179 秒对比 0.652 秒（-72.5%）。在智能体基准 MiniWoB 上，HDM-27B 将 token 成本降低 80.1%。
translation.brief: 解决大模型何时值得进行显式推理的决策问题，核心方法是在冻结主干上附加轻量自路由模块，依据隐式思考估计的“思考价值”决定零 token 直接作答或花费 T 个 token 完整推理，并用 CDPO 强化学习在无逐决策标签时训练路由。

papers.title: Compiling Known Rules into Compact Neural Agents: Weight-Space Programming on Unseen Games
papers.abstract: Weight-space programming (WSP) uses language models to construct neural network weights without training. We test whether known game mechanics can be compiled into compact agents that generalise to held-out levels, renderings and start states within a game family. Writers receive simulator source with held-out level data removed for 20 privately authored, unpublished ARC-AGI-3-style game families. With a fixed 57k-parameter recurrent architecture, the strongest writer reaches 56% held-out-level success with feedback, while the four main writers' Python players reach 97-100%. An exploratory free-architecture condition reaches 68-90%. Learning from support-level examples transfers much less well, but these learners lack the source information given to writers. Written networks have a program-like structure: 93% of parameters are zero, and 90% of the rest are small integers or powers of two. NumPy players under comparable computation caps reach 91%, versus the networks' 79%. Training the strongest writer's architectures from scratch yields about 1% success within our budget. Written fixed-network weights are fragile, and standard PPO removes most of their success. Prompts for noise robustness increase tolerance by about four orders of magnitude for two of three writers, but PPO makes larger updates and still removes most success. These results demonstrate rule-to-network compilation in this setting, while showing limited benefits over Python programs and no successful combination with the tested PPO fine-tuning.

translation.title: 将已知规则编译为紧凑神经智能体：在未见游戏上的权重空间编程
translation.abstract: 权重空间编程（WSP）利用语言模型直接构造神经网络权重而无需训练。我们测试已知游戏机制能否被编译为紧凑智能体，并在同一游戏家族内泛化到保留关卡、渲染和起始状态。写手（writer）接收已删除保留关卡数据的模拟器源代码，游戏为 20 个私有的、未公开的 ARC-AGI-3 风格游戏家族。在固定的 57k 参数循环架构下，最强的写手在带反馈条件下达到 56% 的保留关卡成功率，而四位主要写手的 Python 玩家达到 97–100%。探索性的自由架构条件达到 68–90%。从支撑关卡示例中学习的方式迁移效果差得多，但这些学习者缺乏写手所获得的源码信息。写出的网络具有类程序结构：93% 的参数为零，其余 90% 是小整数或 2 的幂。在相近计算预算下，NumPy 玩家达到 91%，而网络为 79%。在预算内从头训练最强写手的架构成功率仅约 1%。写出的固定网络权重脆弱，标准 PPO 会移除其大部分成功率。面向噪声鲁棒性的提示使三位写手中的两位容忍度提高约四个数量级，但 PPO 的更新更大，仍会移除大部分成功率。这些结果表明在该设定下规则到网络的编译是可行的，同时显示其相对 Python 程序的优势有限，且无法与所测试的 PPO 微调成功结合。
translation.brief: 研究能否将已知游戏规则直接编译进未训练的紧凑神经网络权重（权重空间编程），核心方法是让语言模型在无保留关卡数据条件下写出参数，并与 Python 程序及 PPO 微调对比。

papers.title: Primer: An AI Framework for Instructor-Centered Educational Simulation Creation
papers.abstract: Educational simulations are a well-established pedagogical technique that gives learners opportunities to apply knowledge, respond to challenges, and reflect on their performance.
