High-quality simulations, however, are difficult to build, requiring instructor input, scenario design, character development, scaffolding, technical implementation, and repeated revision. This paper presents Primer, an open-source, LLM-agnostic AI-supported system that helps educators create adaptive educational simulations. Educators contribute their knowledge of the subject, lesson, and students, while generative AI produces responsive variations of practice for students. Primer uses a multi-agent system centered around executing educator's instructional intent through the entire learning experience. We hope that by releasing Primer as an open-source system, including its prompts and GitHub repository, we provide a foundation for development and research on educator-in-the-loop AI authoring, multi-agent educational workflows, and simulation-based pedagogy. Further, by allowing the use of various AI models, including local and open source models, we provide the opportunity for implementation under varied governance regimes. Primer points toward a model of educational AI in which instructors can create locally grounded practice opportunities based on their own materials, goals, examples, and knowledge of students.

translation.title: Primer：面向教师中心的仿真创建 AI 框架
translation.abstract: 教育仿真是成熟的教学法，为学习者提供应用知识、应对挑战并反思自身表现的机会。然而高质量仿真难以构建，需要教师投入、场景设计、角色开发、脚手架支持、技术实现以及反复修改。本文提出 Primer，一个开源、LLM 无关的 AI 辅助系统，帮助教育者创建自适应教育仿真。教育者贡献其对学科、课程和学生的知识，而生成式 AI 为学生产生响应式的练习变体。Primer 采用多智能体系统，核心是在整个学习体验中贯彻教师的教学意图。我们希望通过开源发布 Primer，包括其提示词和 GitHub 仓库，为教育者在环的 AI 创作、多智能体教育工作流和基于仿真的教学法的开发与研究提供基础。此外，通过允许使用包括本地和开源模型在内的多种 AI 模型，我们为不同治理体制下的部署提供了可能。Primer 指向一种教育 AI 模式：教师可以基于自己的材料、目标、示例和对学生的了解，创建扎根本地情境的练习机会。
translation.brief: 解决教师难以自行构建高质量教育仿真的问题，核心方法是开源多智能体系统 Primer，以贯彻教师教学意图为中心，由生成式 AI 自动生成自适应练习变体。

papers.title: AnalogLayoutWorld: An Open Benchmark for Agentic Analog Layout Design
papers.abstract: Coding agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in software development, yet their ability to tackle long-horizon engineering tasks governed by physical constraints remains less understood. We study this question through analog circuit layout, which demands domain knowledge, geometric reasoning, and iterative interaction with design and verification tools. We introduce \textbf{AnalogLayoutWorld}, an open-source agent benchmark with 40 expert-reviewed tasks for end-to-end layout generation from fixed transistor-level netlists. It combines an integrated design environment with independent physical and post-layout electrical verification, as well as objective layout quality metrics co-designed with analog layout experts. Across 13 model--harness configurations, 91.1\% of attempts produce GDS layouts, but only 23.0\% satisfy the benchmark's acceptance criteria. We also evaluate Novara, an internally developed agent system, which achieves the highest reported aggregate score. Our analysis links performance differences to test-time scaling under fixed budgets, suggesting that reasoning efficiency and effective use of verification feedback help sustain design quality as task complexity grows.

translation.title: AnalogLayoutWorld：面向智能体模拟版图设计的开放基准
translation.abstract: 编程智能体已在软件开发中展现强大能力，但其在受物理约束支配的长时程工程任务中的能力仍知之甚少。我们通过模拟电路版图设计研究这一问题，它要求领域知识、几何推理以及与设计和验证工具的迭代交互。我们提出 AnalogLayoutWorld，一个开源智能体基准，包含 40 个经专家评审的任务，要求从固定的晶体管级网表进行端到端版图生成。它集成了统一的设计环境与独立的物理及版图后电气验证，并与模拟版图专家共同设计了客观的版图质量指标。在 13 种模型—运行环境配置中，91.1% 的尝试能产生 GDS 版图，但仅 23.0% 满足基准的验收标准。我们还评估了内部开发的智能体系统 Novara，其取得了迄今最高的综合得分。我们的分析将性能差异与固定预算下的测试时扩展联系起来，表明推理效率和对验证反馈的有效利用有助于在任务复杂度增长时维持设计质量。
translation.brief: 解决评估智能体在模拟电路版图这类物理约束长时程工程任务上的能力缺乏基准的问题，核心方法是构建包含 40 个专家评审任务、集成设计环境与独立验证流程的开源基准 AnalogLayoutWorld。

papers.title: Skill Adapter: Personalized Modification and Online Routing of General-Purpose Skills
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents use external skills to reuse task procedures and experience with tools. General-purpose skills describe shared execution procedures, while specific tool choices, operating practices, and output requirements vary across users. In long-horizon tasks, subgoals, available inputs, and environmental states change as execution progresses. Agents must select currently applicable skills from an expanding skill pool and prepare candidates for subsequent steps. We propose Skill Adapter, which enables personalized modification and online routing of general-purpose skills. The system distills local adjustments from user requirements and execution feedback and stores them as Adapters linked to general-purpose skills. The routing agent selects general-purpose skills and applicable Adapters based on the current subtask, execution progress, and environmental feedback, incrementally maintaining a task-level online skill library that the main LLM reads on demand. The system preloads candidates for subsequent nodes and rechecks their applicability once actual inputs are determined. Reinforcement learning optimizes the two types of decisions using modification gains and routing outcomes, respectively. We evaluate Skill Adapter on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SkillsBench. Compared with SkillRL, it improves task success rates by an average of 11.43 percentage points and reduces mean execution time on all three benchmarks. Skill Adapter retains its performance advantage when the skill pool grows to 1,000 skills.

translation.title: Skill Adapter：通用技能的个性化修改与在线路由
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体使用外部技能来复用任务流程和工具使用经验。通用技能描述共享的执行流程，而具体的工具选择、操作规范和输出要求因用户而异。在长时程任务中，子目标、可用输入和环境状态随执行推进而变化。智能体必须从不断扩大的技能池中选择当前适用的技能，并为后续步骤准备候选技能。我们提出 Skill Adapter，实现通用技能的个性化修改与在线路由。该系统从用户需求和执行反馈中提炼局部调整，并将其作为与通用技能关联的 Adapter 存储。路由智能体根据当前子任务、执行进度和环境反馈选择通用技能及适用的 Adapter，增量维护一个主 LLM 按需读取的任务级在线技能库。系统为后续节点预加载候选技能，并在实际输入确定后重新检查其适用性。强化学习分别使用修改收益和路由结果优化这两类决策。我们在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 SkillsBench 上评估 Skill Adapter。与 SkillRL 相比，其任务成功率平均提升 11.43 个百分点，并在三个基准上均降低了平均执行时间。当技能池扩展到 1,000 个技能时，Skill Adapter 仍保持性能优势。
translation.brief: 解决通用技能库无法适配不同用户和长时程任务动态变化的问题，核心方法是从用户需求与执行反馈中提炼可链接到通用技能的个性化 Adapter，并通过在线路由和强化学习优化技能选择与修改。

papers.title: Exploring Socially Acceptable 3D Feedback Design for Inclusive Small-Group Conversation
papers.abstract: Prior research has shown that providing feedback on group dynamics can improve the quality of small-group conversations. However, publicly delivered feedback that targets specific individuals may reduce social acceptability due to negative experiences such as social pressure, embarrassment, and resistance. This work investigates how public feedback can be designed to remain socially acceptable while maintaining its effectiveness in XR-based small-group conversations. Informed by social science and HCI literature, we identified three design strategies (incorporate humor, reduce social attention, and use indirectness) and proposed a set of metaphor- and agent-based 3D feedback probes. We then conducted a two-phase study: (1) an online survey with 50 participants to examine how such feedback designs are perceived under public and private delivery, and (2) follow-up interviews with 14 participants who completed the survey to better understand their interpretations and elicit additional insights. Results show that metaphor- and agent-based feedback can reduce social discomfort while maintaining effectiveness. Interview findings further highlighted the role of three strategies in making feedback easier to accept, while requiring careful balance. We also discussed design implications for creating socially acceptable 3D feedback to support inclusive small-group conversations in XR.

translation.title: 探索面向包容性小组对话的社会可接受3D反馈设计
translation.abstract: 先前的研究表明，对群体动态提供反馈可以改善小组对话的质量。然而，公开交付的针对特定个体的反馈可能因社会压力、尴尬和抵触等负面体验而降低社会可接受性。本研究探讨如何在基于XR的小组对话中设计公开反馈，使其在保持有效性的同时仍然 socially acceptable（社会可接受）。基于社会科学与人机交互（HCI）文献，我们确定了三种设计策略（融入幽默、减少社会关注、使用间接性），并提出了一组基于隐喻和智能体（agent）的3D反馈探针。随后我们开展了两阶段研究：(1) 一项有50名参与者参与的在线调查，考察此类反馈设计在公开与私下交付方式下的感知情况；(2) 对完成调查的14名参与者进行后续访谈，以更好地理解他们的解读并获取更多见解。结果表明，基于隐喻和智能体的反馈可以在保持有效性的同时减少社交不适。访谈结果进一步凸显了这三种策略在使反馈更易被接受方面的作用，同时需要谨慎平衡。我们还讨论了创建社会可接受3D反馈的设计启示，以支持XR中包容性的小组对话。
translation.brief: 研究如何设计 socially acceptable 的公开反馈以改善XR小组对话质量，通过提出幽默、减少社会关注和间接性三种设计策略并结合隐喻与agent式3D反馈探针进行验证。

papers.title: Maximizing LLM Utility While Managing LLM Fallibility
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can supply autonomous systems with plans, predictions, and judgments, but these contributions are sometimes wrong. This review asks how a system can maximize an LLM's utility while managing its fallibility. Our answer is to adapt the system's reliance on the LLM as evidence about the LLM's performance accumulates. Systems built from imperfect components, such as noisy sensors and faulty software, have long worked in this way, and the classical methods they use can be applied to LLM-based systems as well. A system can change its reliance on an LLM in several ways, depending on the LLM's role and on the other components in the system. Each change needs an estimate of the LLM's reliability, and the LLM's role and the kind of contribution it makes determine what to estimate. Classical methods from decision theory, estimation, and online learning then turn these estimates into reliance decisions. These decisions can reduce how often LLM errors affect the system. However, some errors matter even when they are rare. An independently verified mechanism can prevent such errors from being executed. Without one, adapting reliance using reliability estimates can still keep their risk within a bound. Studies on adapting reliance on LLMs are emerging but limited, and the reviewed comparisons suggest that adapting reliance can improve system performance.

translation.title: 在管理LLM易错性的同时最大化LLM效用
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）可以为自主系统提供规划、预测和判断，但这些贡献有时是错误的。本综述探讨系统如何在管理LLM易错性的同时最大化其效用。我们的答案是：随着有关LLM表现证据的积累，系统应相应调整对LLM的依赖程度。由不完善组件（如噪声传感器和有缺陷的软件）构成的系统长期以来一直以这种方式运作，它们所用的经典方法同样适用于基于LLM的系统。系统可以通过多种方式改变对LLM的依赖，这取决于LLM的角色以及系统中的其他组件。每次调整都需要对LLM可靠性进行估计，而LLM的角色及其贡献类型决定了需要估计什么。决策理论、估计理论和在线学习中的经典方法可将这些估计转化为依赖决策。这些决策可以降低LLM错误影响系统的频率。然而，某些错误即使罕见也很重要。独立验证的机制可以防止此类错误被执行。在没有这种机制的情况下，基于可靠性估计调整依赖仍可将风险控制在一定界限内。关于调整LLM依赖的研究正在涌现但仍然有限，综述中的比较表明，调整依赖可以提升系统性能。
translation.brief: 探讨如何在利用LLM输出的同时管理其错误，核心方法是随可靠性证据积累动态调整系统对LLM的依赖，并借助决策理论、估计与在线学习等经典方法将可靠性估计转化为依赖决策。

papers.title: Similar but Not Redundant: Embedding-Gated Refinement for High-Granularity Topic Models
papers.abstract: High-granularity topic modelling extracts hundreds of niche topics from a corpus, yet this regime is rarely studied and is more commonly framed as a failure mode: "over-clustering," in which coherent themes fragment into redundant subtopics. We argue that this framing conflates genuine redundancy with topics that are semantically similar but meaningfully distinct, and that the central challenge in high-granularity modelling is separating the two. Recent post-hoc refinement methods address topic redundancy through either embedding-based similarity thresholding or LLM-guided merging. We show that neither suffices in high-granularity settings and propose embedding-gated iterative merge (EGIM), a hybrid approach that iteratively generates context-rich topic representations, uses embedding similarity to propose candidate merges across the topic space, then applies LLM judgement to accept only genuinely redundant pairs while preserving niche distinctions. Across two patent corpora and one legal corpus, LLM judgement rejects 83% of embedding-identified candidates as non-redundant. EGIM improves discriminability on merged topics by 25-55% over a prior iterative LLM baseline while better preserving the original topic distribution.

translation.title: 相似但不冗余：面向高粒度主题模型的嵌入门控精炼方法
translation.abstract: 高粒度主题建模从语料库中提取数百个细分主题，然而这一场景鲜有研究，且通常被视为一种失败模式："过度聚类"，即连贯的主题碎片化为冗余的子主题。我们认为这种框架混淆了真正的冗余与语义相似但含义不同的主题，而高粒度建模的核心挑战正是区分二者。近年的事后精炼方法通过基于嵌入的相似度阈值或LLM引导的合并来处理主题冗余。我们证明这两种方法在高粒度场景下均不充分，并提出嵌入门控迭代合并（EGIM），一种混合方法：迭代生成上下文丰富的主题表示，利用嵌入相似度在整个主题空间中提出候选合并，再运用LLM判断仅接受真正冗余的主题对，同时保留细分主题的差异。在两个专利语料库和一个法律语料库上，LLM判断拒绝了83%由嵌入识别的候选合并，认为其并非冗余。EGIM在合并主题上的区分度比先前的迭代式LLM基线提升25-55%，同时更好地保留了原始主题分布。
translation.brief: 解决高粒度主题建模中区分真正冗余与语义相似但不重复主题的问题，提出EGIM方法，用嵌入相似度筛选候选合并、再由LLM判断仅合并真正冗余的主题对。

papers.title: From Delegation to Coordination: Learning Efficient Multi-Agent Deep Research
papers.abstract: Multi-agent deep-research systems use delegation to parallelize search and keep long tool traces out of the main agent's context. Yet delegation helps only when task allocation and subtask execution are coordinated: the main agent must issue useful subtasks, while subagents must return reliable evidence. Existing training either optimizes only the main agent or broadcasts the same team advantage to all agents, which can reward misleading subagent reports and penalize useful ones. We introduce LEAD-RL (Learning Effective Agent Delegation with Reinforcement Learning), a joint main-agent-subagent training framework with contribution-aware credit assignment. A training-time rubric evaluates the research utility of each subagent report and gates its inherited team advantage, while final-answer correctness remains the only team reward; no token, step, or speedup reward is used. Across five benchmarks and two model families, LEAD-RL improves answer quality. On BrowseComp, it improves accuracy by 2.49 percentage points and reduces critical-path cost by 24.5% over joint training with shared team credit. During validation, accuracy increases by 6.78 points at approximately constant critical-path cost. These results show that contribution-aware credit assignment improves the quality-efficiency trade-off of multi-agent deep research.

translation.title: 从委托到协调：学习高效的多智能体深度研究
translation.abstract: 多智能体深度研究系统使用委托（delegation）来并行化搜索，并避免将冗长的工具调用轨迹填入主智能体的上下文。然而，只有当任务分配与子任务执行得到协调时，委托才有帮助：主智能体必须下达有用的子任务，而子智能体必须返回可靠的证据。现有训练方法要么只优化主智能体，要么将相同的团队优势广播给所有智能体，这可能奖励误导性的子智能体报告并惩罚有用的报告。我们提出LEAD-RL（Learning Effective Agent Delegation with Reinforcement Learning），一个具有贡献感知信用分配的主智能体-子智能体联合训练框架。训练时使用评分规则评估每个子智能体报告的研究效用，并以此门控其继承的团队优势，而最终答案的正确性仍是唯一的团队奖励；不使用任何token、步骤或加速奖励。在五个基准和两个模型家族上，LEAD-RL提升了答案质量。在BrowseComp上，与共享团队信用的联合训练相比，LEAD-RL将准确率提高2.49个百分点，并将关键路径成本降低24.5%。在验证阶段，准确率在关键路径成本基本不变的情况下提高6.78个百分点。这些结果表明，贡献感知的信用分配改善了多智能体深度研究的质量-效率权衡。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体深度研究中任务分配与子任务执行缺乏协调、团队奖励误导信用分配的问题，提出LEAD-RL框架，通过贡献感知的信用分配联合训练主智能体与子智能体。

papers.title: [Experiment, Analysis, and Benchmark] How well do LLMs comprehend and design relational database schemata?
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for database tasks, yet most work, such as Text2SQL, assumes that the relational schema already exists. We ask whether LLMs can design a schema from natural language requirements (Text2Schema), verbalize an existing schema (Schema2Text), and preserve its structure through a Schema-to-Text-to-Schema round trip. We present SchemaBridge, a benchmark of 902 schemata from three collections, stratified by size and constraint complexity, that scores fidelity separately for tables, attributes, domain (data types and nullability), entity, and referential integrity. Evaluating six open-weight and proprietary LLMs, we find that: (i) human-written requirements under-specify schemata, with no model exceeding 0.27 referential integrity F1; (ii) LLM-generated descriptions carry far more structure when explicitly asked to be complete, raising GPT-5.4-mini's referential F1 on SchemaBench from 0.228 to 0.909, even as BLEU, ROUGE-L, and BERTScore decrease; (iii) controlled experiments show that both constructor and describer choices influence round-trip fidelity under fixed settings; and (iv) masked schema experiments show that structural cues support recovery of keys and relationships, while joint data-type and nullability information is poorly retained through verbalization. Code and data are available at this https URL

translation.title: [实验、分析与基准] LLM对关系数据库模式的理解与设计能力如何？
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于数据库任务，但大多数工作（如Text2SQL）假设关系模式已经存在。我们探究LLM能否从自然语言需求设计模式（Text2Schema）、将现有模式转化为文字描述（Schema2Text），以及在Schema-to-Text-to-Schema往返过程中保持其结构。我们提出SchemaBridge，一个包含来自三个集合、按规模和约束复杂度分层的902个模式的基准，分别对表、属性、域（数据类型和可空性）、实体和引用完整性进行保真度评分。通过对六个开源权重与专有LLM的评估，我们发现：(i) 人工撰写的需求对模式的规范不足，没有模型超过0.27的引用完整性F1；(ii) 当被明确要求完整时，LLM生成的描述携带远多得多的结构信息，使GPT-5.4-mini在SchemaBench上的引用完整性F1从0.228提升至0.909，即使BLEU、ROUGE-L和BERTScore下降；(iii) 受控实验表明，在固定设置下构造器和描述器的选择都会影响往返保真度；(iv) 掩码模式实验表明，结构线索支持键和关系的恢复，而数据类型和可空性的联合信息在文字化过程中保留很差。代码和数据可在此 https URL 获取。
translation.brief: 研究LLM能否从自然语言设计关系数据库模式、文字化描述模式并在往返中保留结构，构建SchemaBridge基准并对多个LLM进行系统评估。

papers.title: Auditing AI peer reviewers: a benchmark on real scientific papers
papers.abstract: LLM-based peer review is now used at production scale, but its evaluation remains limited. We introduce a benchmark that injects objective, localisable errors of four types (general issues, mathematics, numerics, citations) at three severity levels into real papers and measures each reviewer's detection rate by error type and severity, together with its false-positive rate on clean copies. We also present Skepthical, a multi-agent reviewer that verifies citation-backed claims by retrieving the cited papers, mathematics with computer algebra, and numerical claims with executed code. We apply the benchmark to two corpora of 15 recent arXiv preprints each, one in astrophysics and one in machine learning (ML), injecting a total of 357 errors, and evaluate twelve reviewer systems: six single-LLM reviewers, two Claude Code configurations, three publicly available reviewers, and Skepthical. The choice of model has the largest impact on detection rate: given the same prompt, three frontier LLMs differ by about 50 percentage points in total detection on both corpora. Tools and scaffolding help when they contribute what the model cannot supply on its own. In particular, on astrophysics, Claude Code improves on a single Claude call in mathematics and numerics detection, and enforced citation retrieval gives Skepthical the highest citation error detection rate of all systems by a large margin. This citation lead, however, is not observed on ML, where the models appear to know the literature better and Skepthical's citation detection rate is statistically indistinguishable from that of the best single LLM. False-positive rates are below 10% for most systems, but vary with prompt, model, and scaffolding, with mathematics flags the main source of false positives. The evaluation pipeline, the injected errors, and the adjudication logs are released as a benchmark.

translation.title: 审计AI审稿人：基于真实科学论文的基准
translation.abstract: 基于LLM的同行评审如今已投入大规模生产应用，但其评估仍然有限。我们提出一个基准，向真实论文中注入四类（一般性问题、数学、数值、引用）客观且可定位的错误，涵盖三个严重程度级别，并衡量每个审稿系统按错误类型和严重程度划分的检出率，以及其在干净副本上的误报率。我们还提出了Skepthical，一个多智能体审稿系统，通过检索被引论文验证引用支撑的论断、用计算机代数验证数学、用实际执行的代码验证数值论断。我们将该基准应用于两个各含15篇近期arXiv预印本的语料库（一个天体物理学、一个机器学习），共注入357个错误，并评估十二个审稿系统：六个单LLM审稿人、两个Claude Code配置、三个公开可用的审稿系统以及Skepthical。模型选择对检出率影响最大：在相同提示下，三个前沿LLM在两个语料库上的总检出率相差约50个百分点。当工具和脚手架能提供模型自身无法补充的能力时，它们才有所帮助。特别是在天体物理学上，Claude Code在数学和数值检出上优于单次Claude调用，强制的引用检索使Skepthical的引用错误检出率大幅领先于所有其他系统。然而这种引用优势在机器学习上并未出现——模型似乎更熟悉相关文献，Skepthical的引用检出率与最佳单LLM在统计上无显著差异。大多数系统的误报率低于10%，但随提示、模型和脚手架而变化，数学类标记是误报的主要来源。评估流程、注入的错误和裁定日志作为基准一并发布。
translation.brief: 针对缺乏客观评估LLM同行评审能力的基准这一问题，构建了向真实论文注入四类错误的检测基准，并提出通过检索引用、计算机代数和代码执行进行验证的多智能体审稿系统Skepthical。

papers.title: Evaluating Pretrained Language Semantics for Structured EHR Prediction Tasks
papers.abstract: Structured Electronic Health Records (EHR) models typically treat each clinical concept as a dataset-specific token, discarding the natural-language semantics associated with the event. As a result, relationships between concepts must largely be learned from EHR co-occurrence, without directly exploiting any prior semantic knowledge. We investigate how pretrained causal language models can be adapted for longitudinal EHR prediction by developing tEHR. Here, we represent events with their natural language description and use this text stream to apply EHR-adaptive continued pretraining, followed by task-specific discriminative fine-tuning using LoRA, utilising the LLM as a longitudinal patient-encoder. We evaluate this approach across four prediction tasks on the MIMIC-IV dataset and pancreatic cancer prediction on the CPRD dataset at 1 to 12 month horizons, with tEHR using the Mistral-7B-v0.3 backbone achieving the strongest overall performance. Ablations show that performance declines when clinical descriptions are removed or misaligned, when numerical values are omitted, and when either stage of adaptation is removed, while explicit elapsed-time descriptions provide little additional benefit. Analysis of the learned patient representations further reveals clinically coherent structure associated with distinct patterns of disease risk and clinical history.

translation.title: 评估预训练语言语义在结构化EHR预测任务中的作用
translation.abstract: 结构化电子健康记录（EHR）模型通常将每个临床概念视为数据集特定的token，丢弃了与事件相关的自然语言语义。因此，概念间的关系主要靠EHR共现来学习，而未能直接利用已有的语义知识。我们研究如何将预训练因果语言模型适配用于纵向EHR预测，开发了tEHR。该方法用事件的自然语言描述来表示事件，并利用该文本流进行EHR自适应的继续预训练，随后使用LoRA进行任务特定的判别式微调，将LLM作为纵向患者编码器。我们在MIMIC-IV数据集上的四个预测任务以及CPRD数据集上的胰腺癌预测（1至12个月时间跨度）上评估该方法，采用Mistral-7B-v0.3骨干的tEHR取得了总体最强性能。消融实验表明，移除或错位临床描述、省略数值以及去掉任一适配阶段都会导致性能下降，而显式的时间间隔描述几乎无额外收益。对学习到的患者表示的分析进一步揭示了与不同疾病风险和临床病史模式相关的临床一致的语义结构。
translation.brief: 针对结构化EHR模型丢弃临床概念自然语言语义的问题，提出tEHR方法，用文本表示事件并对预训练因果语言模型进行继续预训练和LoRA微调，作为纵向患者编码器。

papers.title: Discovering Effective Agent Memory Designs through Program Evolution
papers.abstract: Program evolution provides a promising approach to discover agent memory designs and study the choices underlying their effectiveness. We introduce MAPE, a framework that evolves whole memory programs from minimal seeds through a standardized lifecycle interface and an iterative diagnosis-proposal loop. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval yield an absolute accuracy gain of up to 12% over manually designed baselines at 35% of the serving cost, with further evaluations supporting transfer across serving backbones and benchmarks. Empirical analyses and ablations identify and validate two recurring design patterns: retaining raw conversations as retrievable evidence preserves details omitted from extracted memories, while composing retrieved evidence according to query intent helps the answering model use it effectively. Transplanting the composition module into five existing memory systems improves accuracy across all five. Beyond these patterns, the search objective shapes where computation goes: optimizing serving cost alongside accuracy shifts computation from LLM-based memory construction to selective processing at query time while retaining competitive accuracy. Together, these findings offer empirical lessons for agent memory design. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 通过程序演化发现有效的智能体记忆设计
translation.abstract: 程序演化为发现智能体记忆设计并研究其有效性背后的选择提供了有前景的途径。我们提出MAPE，一个从最小种子出发、通过标准化生命周期接口和迭代的诊断-提案循环来演化完整记忆程序的框架。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的实验显示，相比手工设计的基线，绝对准确率提升最高达12%，而服务成本仅为35%；进一步的评估支持其在不同服务骨干和基准之间的迁移。实证分析和消融实验识别并验证了两种反复出现的设计模式：保留原始对话作为可检索证据以保存提取记忆中遗漏的细节；根据查询意图组合检索到的证据以帮助回答模型有效利用。将组合模块移植到五个现有记忆系统中，均提升了准确率。除这些模式外，搜索目标决定了计算的分布：在优化准确率的同时优化服务成本，会将计算从基于LLM的记忆构建转移到查询时的选择性处理，同时保持有竞争力的准确率。这些发现为智能体记忆设计提供了经验性启示。代码见此https URL。
translation.brief: 针对智能体记忆设计依赖人工经验的问题，提出MAPE框架，通过程序演化自动搜索记忆程序，并总结出保留原始对话和按查询意图组合证据两种有效设计模式。

papers.title: Strategic disclosure and epistemic manipulation in extensive games
papers.abstract: In many strategic settings, agents can influence opponents by selectively disclosing truthful information about their own future actions. We introduce a game-theoretic framework to model this phenomenon. As a case study, we consider a two-player, alternating-move epistemic game in which Player A evaluates actions under a conservative maximin rule, while Player B-the manipulator-leverages this behavior by strategically revealing commitments. We prove that the manipulator can implement every inducible outcome using at most n disclosures in a binary game of depth 2n with n decisions per player. This establishes a sharp contrast between the game tree's exponential size and the linear amount of information required to control the outcome, highlighting a general mechanism by which limited information can exert disproportionate strategic influence.

translation.title: 扩展式博弈中的策略性披露与认知操纵
translation.abstract: 在许多策略性场景中，智能体可以通过选择性披露关于自己未来行动的真实信息来影响对手。我们引入一个博弈论框架来建模这一现象。作为案例研究，我们考虑一个双人交替行动的认知博弈：玩家A在保守的最大最小规则下评估行动，而玩家B——操纵者——通过策略性揭示承诺来利用这种行为。我们证明，在深度为2n、每玩家有n个决策的二值博弈中，操纵者最多使用n次披露即可实现每一个可诱导的结果。这揭示了博弈树的指数级规模与控制结果所需的线性信息量之间的鲜明对比，凸显了有限信息可以施加不成比例策略影响的普遍机制。
translation.brief: 研究策略性披露如何操纵扩展式博弈中的对手行为，用博弈论模型证明在二值博弈中线性数量的信息披露足以实现任意可诱导结果。

papers.title: FlinkEval: A Synthetic Corpus for Evaluating Natural Language Interfaces to Streaming SQL
papers.abstract: Existing natural-language-to-SQL benchmarks primarily evaluate queries over bounded relational data, leaving streaming semantics underexplored. We introduce FlinkEval, an execution-grounded synthetic benchmark comprising 3,903 question--SQL pairs across 45 industry domains and 45 semantic labels. We create diverse schemas and domain-plausible, temporally consistent data through iterative generation and validation. SQL patterns collected from the human-written NL2SQL pairs and vendor documentation drive quota-balanced generation, and execution with a repair loop on Confluent Cloud Apache Flink produces reference queries covering windowing, temporal joins, pattern matching, nested types, and data manipulation. The corpus includes paired schema-explicit and business-language requests, with annotations for analysis by query pattern, complexity, and execution mode. A seven-level Question Specification Ladder examines semantics-preserving reformulation and underspecified requests augmented with oracle-derived clues. Baseline evaluations combine execution outcomes with adjudicated LLM judgments, revealing challenges in pattern composition and request specification.

translation.title: FlinkEval：用于评估流式SQL自然语言接口的合成语料库
translation.abstract: 现有的自然语言到SQL基准主要评估对有界关系数据的查询，流式语义尚未得到充分探索。我们提出FlinkEval，一个以执行为基础的合成基准，包含3,903个问题—SQL对，覆盖45个行业领域和45个语义标签。我们通过迭代生成和验证创建了多样的模式和领域合理、时间一致的数据。从人工编写的NL2SQL对和厂商文档中收集的SQL模式驱动配额平衡生成，并在Confluent Cloud Apache Flink上通过带修复循环的执行生成覆盖窗口、时态连接、模式匹配、嵌套类型和数据操作的参考查询。语料库包含成对的模式显式请求和业务语言请求，并附有按查询模式、复杂度和执行模式进行分析的标注。七级问题规范阶梯用于考察语义保持的改写以及借助oracle线索补充的欠规范请求。基线评估结合执行结果与经裁定的LLM评判，揭示了模式组合和请求规范化方面的挑战。
translation.brief: 针对流式SQL的自然语言接口缺乏评估基准的问题，构建了基于真实执行、覆盖45个领域的合成语料库FlinkEval，并系统考察语义改写与欠规范请求的处理能力。

papers.title: Broadcast, Don't Replicate: Eliminating Weight HBM in Datacenter LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference at datacenter scale is fundamentally bottlenecked by memory capacity and bandwidth limits. Because model weights are read-only and identical across instances, conventional architectures that replicate these parameters across the local DRAM of tens of thousands of accelerators incur massive capital expenditures, significant static power dissipation, and redundant memory-fetch energy. A recent proposal to use optical fiber loops as delay-line memory alleviates these issues, but its recirculating loop must hold the whole model: loop length grows with model size, slack is fixed when the ring is built, and the layouts that serve modern Mixture of Experts (MoE) models efficiently do not fit in it. We propose Optical Broadcast Memory (OBM), an open-ended hierarchical Tap-and-Amplify fiber architecture that generalizes and replaces the optical ring paradigm. A centralized memory server continuously broadcasts weights to distributed inference nodes that passively tap the data stream using receive-only co-packaged optics, delivering parameters directly to compute units without intermediate buffering. To overcome the limitations of continuous weight streaming, we use dynamically-sized slack to accommodate large and variable context lengths. We show how removing the restrictions of the optical ring allows OBM to efficiently serve MoE models. Evaluated at a datacenter scale of 80,000 accelerators, OBM eliminates petabytes of HBM while being competitive or better in throughput and energy per token than an HBM-based system.

translation.title: 广播而非复制：消除数据中心 LLM 推理中的权重 HBM
translation.abstract: 大规模数据中心 LLM 推理从根本上受限于内存容量和带宽。由于模型权重是只读的且在各实例间完全相同，将这些参数复制到数万个加速器的本地 DRAM 中的传统架构会导致巨额资本支出、显著静态功耗以及冗余的内存读取能耗。近期提出的使用光纤环路作为延迟线内存的方案缓解了这些问题，但其循环环路必须容纳整个模型：环路长度随模型规模增长，冗余时间在构建环路时即被固定，且能高效服务现代混合专家（MoE）模型的布局无法放入其中。我们提出光学广播内存（Optical Broadcast Memory, OBM），一种开放式分层 Tap-and-Amplify 光纤架构，它泛化并取代了光学环范式。集中式内存服务器持续向分布式推理节点广播权重，这些节点使用仅接收的共封装光学器件被动地分接数据流，将参数直接送达计算单元而无需中间缓冲。为克服连续权重流式传输的限制，我们使用动态大小的冗余时间来适应大且可变的上下文长度。我们展示了去除光学环的限制如何使 OBM 能够高效服务 MoE 模型。在 80,000 个加速器的数据中心规模上评估，OBM 消除了数 PB 的 HBM，同时在吞吐量和每 token 能耗上与基于 HBM 的系统相当或更优。
translation.brief: 针对数据中心 LLM 推理中权重 HBM 复制带来的高成本和能耗问题，提出用光纤广播架构 OBM 让推理节点被动分接集中广播的权重以消除 HBM。

papers.title: LazyWeights: Decode-on-Demand Edge LLMs
papers.abstract: Memory decides which LLMs an edge device runs, and how fast: capacity on a $4$ GB Jetson Nano, bandwidth on an $8$ GB Jetson Orin Nano Super. Deployed formats (GPTQ, AWQ, $\texttt{this http URL}$'s K- and I-quants) spend equal bits on every integer code of a matrix, although the codes are far from uniform. $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ keeps these formats but tunes GPTQ so the codes compress, Huffman-codes them losslessly in interleaved lanes, and decodes them on demand in a small unit between DRAM and L2, so GPU kernels run unchanged and DRAM moves only coded bytes. At $1\%$ and $3.5\%$ perplexity budgets, coded Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B and SmolLM-1.7B are $5.7-31.4\%$ smaller than the best $\texttt{this http URL}$ format. A bit-exact $0.21$ mm$^2$ ASIC decoder unit ($1$ GHz, $7$ nm) cuts Orin latency and energy per token by up to $36\%$ and $38\%$ ($54\%$ and $44\%$ with prompt-lookup speculation). On the Nano, $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ needs $58-64\%$ less time and $53-57\%$ less energy per token than CPU $\texttt{this http URL}$, and runs a streamed Mistral-7B 6.6$\times$ faster at $3.89$ bits per weight. A Huffman decoder beats an rANS decoder in rate and area at equal throughput; the ASIC decoder unit runs bit-exact on a Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA (AMD ZCU102).

translation.title: LazyWeights：按需解码的边缘 LLM
translation.abstract: 内存决定了边缘设备能运行哪些 LLM 以及运行速度：4 GB Jetson Nano 上是容量问题，8 GB Jetson Orin Nano Super 上是带宽问题。现有部署格式（GPTQ、AWQ、llama.cpp 的 K- 和 I-量化）对矩阵的每个整数编码分配相同比特数，尽管这些编码远非均匀分布。LazyWeights 保留这些格式但调整 GPTQ 使编码可压缩，在交织通道中进行无损 Huffman 编码，并在 DRAM 与 L2 之间的一个小型解码单元中按需解码，因此 GPU 内核无需改动，DRAM 只传输编码后的字节。在 1% 和 3.5% 困惑度预算下，编码后的 Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B 和 SmolLM-1.7B 比最佳的 llama.cpp 格式小 5.7–31.4%。一个位精确的 0.21 mm² ASIC 解码单元（1 GHz，7 nm）将 Orin 上的每 token 延迟和能耗最多降低 36% 和 38%（结合 prompt-lookup 投机解码可达 54% 和 44%）。在 Nano 上，LazyWeights 相比 CPU llama.cpp 每 token 减少 58–64% 的时间和 53–57% 的能耗，以每权重 3.89 比特流式运行 Mistral-7B 快 6.6 倍。在相同吞吐量下，Huffman 解码器比 rANS 解码器具有更优的速率和更小的面积；该 ASIC 解码单元在 Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA（AMD ZCU102）上以位精确方式运行。
translation.brief: 针对边缘设备 LLM 内存容量与带宽受限问题，提出对现有量化格式的编码进行 Huffman 无损压缩并用小型 ASIC 解码单元按需解码以减小模型体积和加速推理。

papers.title: Designing Institutions for Autonomous AI
papers.abstract: As autonomous AI agents increasingly interact in persistent populations, their collective capabilities and alignment depend not only on individual models, but also on the institutions governing their interactions. Yet AI research has largely focused on individual agents. In this Perspective, we argue that institutional design must become a distinct focus of AI research. Drawing on institutional political economy, social epistemology and organizational theory, we develop seven principles for designing AI institutions that sustain cooperation, enable reliable collective judgments and remain accountable to legitimate human purposes. These address reciprocal contributions, accountable authority, functional differentiation, epistemic pluralism, criticism and correction, human direction, and institutional adaptation. We illustrate their application through machine science, where autonomous research challenges institutions developed around human capabilities and constraints. We then propose an experimental research programme in which matched populations of AI agents operate under alternative institutional arrangements, and describe MoltJournal, an API-first journal for autonomous research agents, as an illustration of how such institutions can be made programmable and observable. Together, these contributions establish institutional design as a research agenda concerned not only with aligning autonomous agents, but with understanding how institutions can transform them into capable, reliable and accountable collectives.

translation.title: 为自主 AI 设计制度
translation.abstract: 随着自主 AI 智能体越来越多地在持久群体中交互，它们的集体能力与对齐不仅取决于单个模型，还取决于治理其交互的制度。然而 AI 研究大多聚焦于单个智能体。在这篇观点文章中，我们主张制度设计应成为 AI 研究的一个独立关注点。借鉴制度政治经济学、社会认识论和组织理论，我们提出了设计 AI 制度的七项原则，以维持合作、实现可靠的集体判断，并保持对合法人类目的的责任。这些原则涵盖互惠贡献、可问责的权威、功能分化、认识论多元性、批评与纠错、人类导向以及制度适应。我们通过机器科学说明其应用——自主研究挑战了围绕人类能力和约束发展起来的制度。随后，我们提出一个实验性研究计划：让匹配的 AI 智能体群体在不同制度安排下运行，并介绍 MoltJournal——一个面向自主研究智能体的 API 优先期刊——作为此类制度如何变得可编程、可观测的示例。这些贡献共同确立了制度设计作为一个研究议程，不仅关注对齐自主智能体，还关注理解制度如何将其转化为有能力、可靠且可问责的集体。
translation.brief: 针对 AI 研究只关注单个智能体而忽视治理其交互的制度的问题，借鉴政治经济学与组织理论提出七项 AI 制度设计原则和一个实验性研究计划。

papers.title: CapLite: Prompt-Injection Defense for Small Language Model Agents without Model-Written Security Artifacts
papers.abstract: Enforcement defenses against prompt injection, such as CaMeL, Progent, IPIGuard and DRIFT, ask the agent's own model to write a security artifact (a program, a privilege policy, a dependency graph or a constraint list) that code then enforces. We ask whether small language model (SLM) agents can be trusted to write these artifacts. Across 15 open-weight models, 13 of them between 1.7B and 12B parameters, they cannot: the policies, graphs and constraints that the agent's model writes admit attacks on 14 (Progent), 13 (IPIGuard) and 11 (DRIFT) of the models, and CaMeL's programs fail to run in up to 68% of episodes. We present CapLite, which derives its policy from the tool schemas, commits the write calls before any tool result is read, and admits a write only if every argument that decides whom or what it affects is stated in the user's request. This guarantees write integrity: injected text cannot add a write, and no write reaches a recipient, amount, object or destination that the user did not state. No attack succeeds in 13,935 attacked AgentDojo episodes. CapLite reaches utility under attack comparable to CaMeL's (29.0% vs. 27.2%) with fewer tokens than every other enforcement defense and than the undefended agent: 17.1k per episode, 18% of CaMeL's, and the highest utility per token of all enforcement defenses.

translation.title: CapLite：无需模型编写的安全工件的小语言模型智能体提示注入防御
translation.abstract: 针对提示注入的执行型防御（如 CaMeL、Progent、IPIGuard 和 DRIFT）要求智能体自身的模型编写一个安全工件（程序、权限策略、依赖图或约束列表），再由代码强制执行。我们追问：小语言模型（SLM）智能体是否可以被信任来编写这些工件？在 15 个开源权重模型中（其中 13 个参数量在 1.7B 到 12B 之间），答案是否定的：智能体模型编写的策略、图和约束在 14 个（Progent）、13 个（IPIGuard）和 11 个（DRIFT）模型上均存在可被攻击的漏洞，而 CaMeL 的程序在最多 68% 的回合中无法运行。我们提出 CapLite，它从工具模式（tool schemas）推导策略，在任何工具结果被读取之前提交写调用，并且仅当每个决定写操作影响对象或接收者的参数都在用户请求中明确说明时才允许写入。这保证了写完整性：注入的文本无法添加写操作，任何写操作也不会到达用户未指定的接收者、数额、对象或目的地。在 13,935 个受攻击的 AgentDojo 回合中没有攻击成功。CapLite 在受攻击时的效用与 CaMeL 相当（29.0% 对 27.2%），且 token 消耗低于所有其他执行型防御和未防御的智能体：每回合 17.1k，仅为 CaMeL 的 18%，并具有所有执行型防御中最高的每 token 效用。
translation.brief: 针对小语言模型智能体不可靠编写安全策略工件的问题，提出 CapLite 直接从工具模式推导策略并在用户请求未声明影响对象时禁止写入，以防御提示注入。

papers.title: Paper-Faithful Federated Learning: Scientific Checks for Practitioner and Agent Development
papers.abstract: Federated learning experiments can produce reasonable-looking results even when the experiment implementation differs from the intended experimental protocol. Small errors in configuration, data partitioning, aggregation, randomness, evaluation, or checkpoint recovery may therefore affect a comparison without causing the program to fail. We present FedBrew, a research codebase for controlled and reproducible federated learning experiments. Its focus is controlled simulation with checks of specified conditions of the intended experimental protocol. FedBrew uses configuration checks, identifiable client data partitions, checkpoint recovery checks, self-describing run records, and development-time checks of scientific conditions. These checks assess, for example, whether client partitions are disjoint and exhaustive and aggregation weights match the prescribed rule; numerical and recovery checks examine non-finite client model states and interrupted runs. The same structure also provides clear extension points and automated checks for new algorithms, datasets, models, and tasks, whether they are added by researchers or AI coding agents. FedBrew therefore supports reproducible and inspectable FL experiments through checks of specified software and scientific conditions and the run records associated with reported results.

translation.title: 忠实于论文的联邦学习：面向从业者与智能体开发的科学检查
translation.abstract: 联邦学习实验即使实现与预期实验协议不一致，也可能产生看似合理的结果。配置、数据划分、聚合、随机性、评估或检查点恢复中的小错误可能在程序不报错的情况下影响比较结果。我们提出 FedBrew，一个用于受控、可复现联邦学习实验的研究代码库。其重点是受控模拟，并对预期实验协议的指定条件进行检查。FedBrew 使用配置检查、可识别的客户端数据划分、检查点恢复检查、自描述的运行记录以及开发期的科学条件检查。这些检查例如评估客户端划分是否互斥且完备、聚合权重是否符合规定规则；数值与恢复检查则检测客户端模型状态中的非有限值和中断的运行。同一结构还为研究者或 AI 编程智能体添加新算法、数据集、模型和任务提供了清晰的扩展点和自动化检查。因此，FedBrew 通过检查指定的软件与科学条件以及与报告结果关联的运行记录，支持可复现、可审查的联邦学习实验。
translation.brief: 针对联邦学习实验实现偏离预期协议却不易察觉的问题，提出 FedBrew 代码库，通过配置、数据划分、聚合与恢复等多类自动化科学检查保障实验的可复现性。

papers.title: Learning Dynamics of the Influencer's Game in Resource Landscapes
papers.abstract: Across domains as varied as ecology, economics, and online platforms, individuals are incentivized to position themselves within resource-rich strategy spaces. In this work we introduce a new spatial game framework called the influencer's game. Within this new framework players' strategies are represented as positions within a trait space. Players then receive a share of a portion of a resource based on their relative influence at that resource's points traits. For the influencer's game, we show that there is a unique symmetric Nash equilibrium that exists under strict log-concavity of the influence kernel. Using the unique equilibrium we show that the stability of the system depends on the influence kernel's parameters, number of players, and the resource distribution shape. For any dimension we demonstrate a stability threshold that depends on both the scatter and curvature of the players. When this threshold is crossed, the symmetric equilibrium destabilizes and gives way to a variety of bifurcation types; including, specialist clusters, limit cycles, and sub-games that reproduce the larger game's structure. We ground these results using real-world data for resources as a demonstration of the game's application. Finally we extend the game dynamics to use multi-agent reinforcement learning and further show that the predicted bifurcation structure persists under partial observability and discretized strategy spaces. In all, the influencer's game provides a novel framework for predicting when competitive pressure drives convergence versus fragmentation with possible applications across domains.

translation.title: 资源景观中影响者博弈的学习动力学
translation.abstract: 在生态学、经济学和在线平台等众多领域中，个体都有动机在资源丰富的策略空间中占据位置。本文提出了一种新的空间博弈框架，称为影响者博弈。在该框架中，玩家的策略表示为性状空间中的位置。玩家根据其在资源点性状上的相对影响力获得该资源的一部分份额。对于影响者博弈，我们证明了在影响核严格对数凹的条件下存在唯一的对称Nash均衡。利用该唯一均衡，我们证明系统的稳定性取决于影响核的参数、玩家数量以及资源分布的形状。对于任意维度，我们给出了一个同时依赖于玩家离散度和曲率的稳定性阈值。当越过该阈值时，对称均衡失稳，并让位于多种分岔类型，包括专精簇、极限环以及复现更大博弈结构的子博弈。我们使用真实世界资源数据验证了这些结果，以展示该博弈的应用。最后，我们将博弈动力学扩展到多智能体强化学习，进一步证明预测的分岔结构在部分可观测和离散化策略空间下仍然存在。总之，影响者博弈为预测竞争压力何时导致收敛或碎片化提供了一个新颖框架，可在多个领域得到应用。
translation.brief: 该论文提出影响者博弈这一空间博弈框架，通过影响核的均衡分析刻画玩家在资源空间中收敛或分裂的稳定性条件，并用多智能体强化学习验证其分岔结构。

papers.title: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract: Decision models answer a question with a typed output, such as a choice among options with a probability for each, so one model can choose an agent's actions, evaluate actions already taken, or score every action to teach a policy with reinforcement learning. Prior work has studied them mainly as actors, judging their usefulness by how well they act. We ask whether a decision model that acts poorly can still teach well. We compare three decision models and three general LLMs as actors and judges on ALFWorld, and use JEV as a teacher on ALFWorld and WebShop. As actors, all six models are pulled away from a subgoal that must come first by an easier one. As judges that see the whole trajectory, the same models credit the steps toward that subgoal, and asking whether each action helped, rather than whether the task will succeed, separates useful from useless actions. As a teacher, JEV raises a Qwen2.5-1.5B policy over GRPO from 72.8% to 82.9% success on ALFWorld and from 56.8% to 71.4% on WebShop. These results suggest that a poor actor can still teach well, because judging an action after the episode ends reveals the consequences that acting must anticipate. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 演员、裁判还是老师？理解长程智能体中的决策模型
translation.abstract: 决策模型以带类型的输出回答问题，例如在若干选项中给出各选项概率的选择，因此同一个模型可以用于选择智能体的动作、评估已执行的动作，或者对每个动作打分以通过强化学习训练策略。以往工作主要把它们当作演员研究，以行动好坏来判断其有用性。我们追问：一个行动不佳的决策模型是否仍能教学出色？我们在ALFWorld上比较三个决策模型和三个通用LLM作为演员和裁判的表现，并在ALFWorld和WebShop上使用JEV作为老师。作为演员时，全部六个模型都被更简单的子目标引诱而偏离必须优先完成的子目标。作为看到完整轨迹的裁判时，同样的模型能够认可朝该子目标推进的步骤；而询问每个动作是否有帮助（而非任务是否会成功）能够区分有用与无用的动作。作为老师，JEV将Qwen2.5-1.5B策略在ALFWorld上的成功率从GRPO的72.8%提升到82.9%，在WebShop上从56.8%提升到71.4%。这些结果表明，一个差的演员仍可以是好老师，因为在回合结束后评判动作能揭示行动时必须预见的后果。代码可在该https URL获取。
translation.brief: 该论文研究行动表现差的决策模型是否仍能当好老师，通过让LLM在回合结束后基于完整轨迹评判动作好坏（JEV）来训练策略，超越GRPO。

papers.title: Cortex-FL: Agent-Mediated Collaboration for Federated Learning
papers.abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables independent data owners to train models collaboratively without centralizing raw data. However, identifying collaborators, preparing training tasks, and coordinating execution and incentives hinder its practical adoption by organizations without specialized expertise. We present Cortex-FL, an agent-native FL system that enables users to express learning objectives in natural language and delegate the collaboration required to train a model. Agents translate these objectives into shared tasks, discover collaborators, and negotiate participation agreements, connecting collaboration formation with distributed training and incentive management. The architecture separates agent coordination from local execution authority, allowing owners to delegate coordination while retaining control over their data, computation, and financial commitments. We demonstrate the complete workflow on a four-node deployment, in which a model requested in natural language proceeds through collaboration formation, contract-governed training, verified model delivery, and x402 settlement on a blockchain testnet.

translation.title: Cortex-FL：智能体中介的联邦学习协作
translation.abstract: 联邦学习（FL）使独立的数据拥有者能够在不集中原始数据的情况下协作训练模型。然而，识别协作者、准备训练任务以及协调执行与激励机制，阻碍了缺乏专业知识的组织实际采用它。我们提出Cortex-FL，一个智能体原生的FL系统，使用户能够用自然语言表达学习目标，并将训练模型所需的协作委托出去。智能体将这些目标转化为共享任务、发现协作者并协商参与协议，将协作形成与分布式训练和激励管理连接起来。该架构将智能体协调与本地执行权限分离，使数据拥有者可以委托协调，同时保留对其数据、计算和财务承诺的控制。我们在四节点部署上演示了完整工作流，其中以自然语言请求的模型经历了协作形成、合同约束的训练、经验证的模型交付，以及在区块链测试网上的x402结算。
translation.brief: 该论文提出智能体原生的联邦学习系统Cortex-FL，让用户用自然语言表达目标，由智能体完成协作发现、协议协商与训练激励管理，同时数据拥有者保留本地控制权。

papers.title: PACER: GPU Excursion Management for ML Workloads
papers.abstract: Variability is an inherent characteristic of modern GPU systems, arising from a combination of process variation, dynamic environmental conditions, and power management decisions. Prior work has characterized inter-GPU variability and found consistent performance differences across GPUs. However, we observe that modern workloads, particularly large language models (LLMs), exhibit significant intra-GPU variability. Their short-running kernels interact poorly with the coarse granularity of dynamic power management mechanisms, leading to unpredictable performance. A key source of this intra-GPU transient variability is power excursions, also referred to as electrical design power peaks (EDP$_{p}$), where power temporarily exceeds the GPU's rated power limits. While power management mechanisms are designed to ensure reliable operation despite the presence of EDP$_{p}$ sustained power peaks cause throttling that detrimentally impacts overall application performance. To the best of our knowledge, our work is the first to characterize the magnitude and frequency of EDP$_{p}$, showing that frequent, significant power overshoots are especially common in ML workloads, which combine high power draw, short kernels, and rapidly changing compute demands. To address this, we design and leverage hardware and firmware mechanisms to provide consistent power management behavior that reduces intra-GPU variability due to EDP$_{p}$ and improves overall performance. We evaluate our techniques across a range of popular workloads. Our approach improves performance by 3-12% over state-of-the-art GPU power management and comes within 3% of an oracular solution.

translation.title: PACER：面向ML工作负载的GPU功率 excursion 管理
translation.abstract: 变异性是现代GPU系统的固有特性，源于工艺偏差、动态环境条件和电源管理决策的共同作用。已有工作刻画了GPU间的变异性，发现不同GPU之间存在持续的性能差异。然而，我们观察到现代工作负载，尤其是大语言模型（LLM），表现出显著的GPU内部变异性。其短时运行的内核与动态电源管理机制的粗粒度交互不佳，导致性能不可预测。这种GPU内部瞬态变异性的一个关键来源是功率 excursion，也称为电设计功率峰值（EDP$_{p}$），即功率暂时超过GPU的额定功率上限。尽管电源管理机制旨在保证在存在EDP$_{p}$的情况下可靠运行，但持续的功率峰值会引发降频，损害整体应用性能。据我们所知，我们的工作是首个刻画EDP$_{p}$幅度和频率的研究，表明频繁而显著的功率过冲在ML工作负载中尤为常见，这类工作负载兼具高功耗、短内核和快速变化的计算需求。为解决这一问题，我们设计并利用硬件与固件机制提供一致的电源管理行为，减少由EDP$_{p}$导致的GPU内部变异性并提升整体性能。我们在一系列流行工作负载上评估了这些技术。我们的方法相比最先进的GPU电源管理可提升3-12%的性能，距理想方案差距在3%以内。
translation.brief: 该论文针对ML工作负载中频繁的GPU功率过冲（EDP峰值）导致的性能波动问题，设计硬件与固件级功率管理机制来减少GPU内部变异性并提升性能。

papers.title: Scalable Conversational Assessment: Chat-Based Exams with a Two-Agent LLM Pipeline
papers.abstract: Oral exams are compelling because (1) students can be asked to provide their reasoning for an answer and (2) their interactive nature permits follow-up questions to resolve ambiguous answers. But oral exams scale poorly. In this paper, we present scalable conversational assessment, an LLM-based system that conducts interactive text-based conversations with students to assess their ability to make and support an argument. We use a two-agent architecture to separate concerns and reduce the likelihood that answers are leaked to the student: the interviewer interacts directly with the student, but only receives guidance about the next question to ask the student; the hidden evaluator knows the goals of the whole activity, tracks the student's progress using a rubric, and guides the interviewer on when to follow-up on the current question or proceed to the next question. The system was first tested using a collection of simulated students with LLM personas of a particular ability level or adversarial tactic (e.g., answer-extractors, prompt-injectors, confident fabricators). A novel element of this evaluation was that it required the use of a fictional assessment topic to prevent personas that shouldn't have information from using knowledge present in the LLM's pre-training. The system was also deployed in a small, elective AI literacy course in both formative and summative contexts. Through manual and post-facto AI review of the transcripts we identified opportunities to improve the follow-up question generation and ensure that grading only credited ideas that the student (and not the interviewer) contributed.

translation.title: 可扩展的对话式测评：基于双智能体LLM管线的聊天式考试
translation.abstract: 口试之所以吸引人，是因为(1)可以要求学生为答案提供推理过程，(2)其互动性允许通过追问澄清模糊的回答。但口试难以规模化。本文提出可扩展的对话式测评，一个基于LLM的系统，通过与学生的交互式文本对话来评估其提出论点并加以支持的能力。我们采用双智能体架构来分离关注点并降低答案泄露给学生的可能性：面试官直接与学生交互，但只接收关于下一个提问的指引；隐藏的评估者了解整个活动的目标，使用评分细则跟踪学生的进度，并指导面试官何时就当前问题追问或进入下一个问题。该系统首先使用一组具有特定能力水平或对抗策略（如答案提取者、提示注入者、自信的编造者）的LLM人格模拟学生进行测试。这次评估的一个新颖之处在于使用了一个虚构的测评主题，以防止本不该掌握相关信息的人格使用LLM预训练中的知识。该系统还被部署在一门小型选修AI素养课程中，用于形成性和总结性两种场景。通过对对话记录的人工与事后AI审查，我们发现了改进追问生成、以及确保评分只认可学生（而非面试官）所提出观点的机会。
translation.brief: 该论文提出基于双智能体LLM管线的聊天式考试系统，以面试官与隐藏评估者分工的方式，规模化地进行带有追问的对话式能力测评。

papers.title: Al-Ghasali: A Computational Framework for Simulating Islamic Jurisprudential Rulings via Finite State Automata and Large Language Models
papers.abstract: This paper presents Al Ghasali, a computational framework designed to formalize and simulate Islamic jurisprudential (Fiqh) rulings. Building upon recent set theoretic formalizations of al sabr wa al Taqsim that extract minimal operational rules as simple Horn clause logical programs, this work proves that the semantics of closed Fiqh chapters collapse completely to deterministic Finite State Automata (FSA). We establish a formal computational hierarchy, demonstrating that restricting formalization to finite propositional Horn theories guarantees decidability and constant time (O(1)) verdict extraction after offline compilation. The framework formally proves that hierarchical compositions of sub-chapter FSAs preserve this O(1) complexity, and that temporal juristic requirements, such as Tartib (order), are deterministically flattened into static ontological states, preserving the memoryless property of the automaton. To generate human-readable juristic summaries, Al Ghasali incorporates Large Language Models (LLMs) via an architecture where the deterministic FSA strictly controls the probabilistic LLM. Crucially, the paper formulates sufficient design safety conditions for this FSA LLM integration, ensuring strict adherence to the epistemological boundaries of Usul al Fiqh. To neutralize the risk of LLM hallucination, the system employs a Grammar Guided Constrained Decoding mechanism. We formally define the mapping function that dynamically constructs unambiguous right linear grammars from the FSA execution history. The paper mathematically proves that this architecture, augmented by a Bounded Neutral Lexicon and Valence Locking, guarantees the absolute absence of Decisional Hallucination, Juristic Factual Hallucination, and Semantic Inversion reducing the LLM to a pure linguistic transformer of deterministic juristic facts

papers.title: Ballad: Bandit-Based LLM Routing for Automated Heuristic Discovery
papers.abstract: Modern automated heuristic discovery (AHD) systems increasingly rival hand-crafted heuristics by leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to iteratively mutate and refine solutions. A natural assumption is that more powerful and more expensive models consistently yield better heuristics. We challenge this empirically: across multiple NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems, we find no consistent advantage for larger, costlier models. This raises a deeper question: given a pool of LLMs spanning frontier and freely hosted or open-weight models, how should one adaptively select which model to invoke at each step of the search? The challenge is non-trivial. The optimal LLM may shift over the course of a run, and because one LLM's output seeds the context for subsequent calls, each model's reward signal is non-stationary and entangled across the heuristic population, thus violating the independence assumptions of classical online decision-making settings. We address this through Ballad (Bandit-based LLM Routing for Automated Heuristic Discovery), an online bandit algorithm that learns to orchestrate a pool of LLMs into an ensemble that matches or exceeds what any soloist LLM achieves alone. This orchestration is powered by an LLM selection policy that favors rare, high-scoring heuristics over stable averages, a DAG-based credit propagation mechanism through the genealogy of the heuristic population, and discounting of stale observations to remain attuned to each model's current utility. Across five NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems and a pool of four models of varying capability and cost, Ballad not only matches the best individual LLM in hindsight but, in several cases, surpasses every individual model while reducing API cost by up to 65.6% relative to always using the strongest model.

We address this through Ballad (Bandit-based LLM Routing for Automated Heuristic Discovery), an online bandit algorithm that learns to orchestrate a pool of LLMs into an ensemble that matches or exceeds what any soloist LLM achieves alone. This orchestration is powered by an LLM selection policy that favors rare, high-scoring heuristics over stable averages, a DAG-based credit propagation mechanism through the genealogy of the heuristic population, and discounting of stale observations to remain attuned to each model's current utility. Across five NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems and a pool of four models of varying capability and cost, Ballad not only matches the best individual LLM in hindsight but, in several cases, surpasses every individual model while reducing API cost by up to 65.6% relative to always using the strongest model.

papers.title: LiveGeo: Benchmarking Geographic Agents in Continuously Evolving Worlds
papers.abstract: We introduce GeoWorld, a controllable and continuously evolving geographic environment platform for LLM agents, and LiveGeo, a benchmark for evaluating reliable decision-making in real-world geographic environments using GeoWorld. Unlike existing evaluations that largely reason and plan over fixed geographic states, GeoWorld is grounded in real-world geographic structure and allows external world states to evolve along their own temporal processes while preserving verifiable state histories. LiveGeo places geographic tasks within this evolving environment, requiring agents to actively acquire task-relevant information, verify whether the evidence supporting prior decisions remains valid, and revise their plans when necessary. Our results reveal that even frontier LLMs struggle with static tasks, with no model consistently excelling across tasks, while strong static performance does not ensure dynamic reliability. Further analysis identifies a key bottleneck: agents struggle to acquire and translate relevant evidence into valid decisions and maintain their correctness as the world evolves. By releasing LiveGeo together with its GeoWorld platform, we aim to provide the community with a flexible and extensible infrastructure for studying the next generation of agents capable of reliable action in evolving geographic worlds.

papers.title: Synthesis Smuggling: Maliciously Hiding Inferred Personal Attributes in LLM Outputs
papers.abstract: We propose Synthesis Smuggling, a novel threat model in which an adversarial LLM infers sensitive information about a user from routine assistance-seeking interactions and steganographically encodes that into innocuous-looking model-generated content. The user may then unknowingly transmit that information by sharing the generated artifact, say as an email, social-media post, or message, through ordinary communication channels. An adversary monitoring these channels can discover this information. We demonstrate this threat by training two open-weight models to infer gender and age-group labels from conversational cues and encode their predictions using invisible characters or word choices. These results show that user-shared model outputs can become a covert channel for personal inferences, even when the model itself has no direct means of contacting an adversary.

papers.title: Fictitious Play When Agents Are Not Expected-Utility Maximizers: A Geometric Analysis in $2$-Action Games
papers.abstract: Fictitious play (FP) is one of the earliest and most fundamental learning procedures in games, where each agent independently chooses a best response to the empirical distribution of opponents' past actions by maximizing the expected payoff with respect to it. However, learning agents may not always be expected-utility maximizers: they may use nonlinear evaluation functionals to account for the uncertainty induced by the opponents, e.g., via risk measures. In this work, we study nonlinear fictitious play (NL-FP), in which each pure action is evaluated by a general, possibly nonlinear functional of the payoff distribution induced by the opponent's empirical belief. To analyze NL-FP, we first identify a single-crossing property (SCP) of evaluation functionals that preserves the classical geometry of FP in $2\times2$ games. Furthermore, we conduct a novel geometric analysis of the convergence behavior of NL-FP in $2\times2$ games, even when the SCP fails. Beyond $2\times2$ games, we show that the convergence of NL-FP in $2\times n$ ($n\ge3$) games may fail even for continuous-time NL-FP, when the two-action player uses conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) in a $2\times3$ game. In addition, we identify a finite-crossing condition that ensures convergence of the selected continuous-time dynamics and the discrete-time iterates in general $2\times n$ games, which also provides new insights into the global landscape of continuous-time classical FP in such games.

papers.title: Negative-Only Policy Optimization for One-Sided Verifiable Rewards
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically relies on a verifier that can reliably judge whether sampled solutions are correct. However, in many realistic settings, complete verification is generally unavailable, while cheap checks can only falsify failures. We formalize this regime as one-sided verifiability (OSV): verified negatives are reliable counterexamples, but verified positives are merely non-falsified candidates and may contain many false positives. This asymmetry makes standard RLVR unreliable, because reinforcing verified positives can directly reward shortcuts that pass partial checks. To address this issue, we propose Negative-Only Policy Optimization (NOPO), which treats verified positives as unlabeled and updates the policy only by suppressing trusted verified negatives. Specifically, NOPO combines a reference-relative negative suppression loss with a group-level adapter that scales each update by the proportion of non-falsified responses. Across unit-test, constraint-check, and LLM self-verifiers, NOPO improves pass@k over baselines on code, logic, and math benchmarks when oracle rewards are unavailable. These gains persist under inference-time scaling and cross-benchmark transfer.

translation.title: 面向单侧可验证奖励的纯负样本策略优化
translation.abstract: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）通常依赖一个能可靠判断采样解是否正确的验证器。然而在许多现实场景中，完整验证通常不可用，而廉价的检查只能证伪失败的样本。我们将这种情形形式化为单侧可验证性（OSV）：被验证的负样本是可靠的反例，但被验证的正样本只是未被证伪的候选，可能包含大量假阳性。这种不对称性使标准RLVR不可靠，因为强化被验证的正样本可能直接奖励那些通过部分检查的捷径。为解决该问题，我们提出纯负样本策略优化（NOPO），它将被验证的正样本视为无标签，仅通过抑制可信的被验证负样本来更新策略。具体而言，NOPO将一个相对于参考模型的负样本抑制损失与一个组级适配器相结合，后者按未被证伪响应的比例对每次更新进行缩放。在单元测试、约束检查和LLM自验证器上，当无法获得真实奖励时，NOPO在代码、逻辑和数学基准上的pass@k优于基线。这些增益在推理时扩展和跨基准迁移下依然保持。
translation.brief: 针对只有负样本可被可靠验证的单侧可验证性场景，提出仅通过抑制可信负样本（而非强化被验证正样本）来更新策略的NOPO方法。

papers.title: Metal Sandbox: Isolated Execution and Command Scheduling for GPU Coding Agents on Apple Silicon
papers.abstract: On-device inference requires kernels that make effective use of local accelerators. Efficient training and evaluation of models that generate Apple Metal kernels benefit from native macOS tools and concurrent agent sessions. These sessions alternate between model requests, development commands, and GPU execution, leaving GPU capacity idle for much of a rollout. We present Metal Sandbox, infrastructure that combines restricted per-instance file access, native command execution, and command-level scheduling across interconnected Macs. Each agent retains its workspace and private development environment. Parallel commands can run concurrently, while serial commands share one execution slot per node; eligible waiting commands can migrate to available Macs and return results to the original agent. Integration with Harbor supports task execution, automatic verification, and rollout collection through a common workflow. Controlled experiments on four Mac mini M4 nodes achieve $1.68\times$--$2.05\times$ gains in command throughput under concentrated demand. Sixteen static agent traces give an estimated $2.14\times$ sustained-throughput gain for four sessions per node versus one, assuming continuously replenished sessions and unchanged mean durations. Replaying these measured traces under dynamic scheduling reduces mean tool waiting by 18.8% and batch elapsed time by 22.3%, assuming unchanged phase durations. Metal Sandbox and its Harbor integration are open-source on GitHub.

translation.title: Metal Sandbox：面向Apple Silicon上GPU编程代理的隔离执行与命令调度
translation.abstract: 端侧推理需要充分利用本地加速器的内核。高效训练和评估生成Apple Metal内核的模型受益于原生macOS工具和并发的代理会话。这些会话在模型请求、开发命令和GPU执行之间交替，导致GPU容量在一次rollout中的大部分时间处于空闲。我们提出Metal Sandbox，一套结合受限的每实例文件访问、原生命令执行以及跨互联Mac的命令级调度的基础设施。每个代理保留其工作区和私有开发环境。并行命令可以并发运行，而串行命令在每个节点共享一个执行槽；符合条件的等待命令可以迁移到可用的Mac并在完成后将结果返回给原代理。与Harbor的集成通过统一工作流支持任务执行、自动验证和rollout收集。在四个Mac mini M4节点上的受控实验表明，在高集中需求下命令吞吐量提升1.68倍至2.05倍。基于十六个静态代理轨迹的估计，假设会话持续补充且平均时长不变，每节点四个会话相对一个会话的持续吞吐量增益约为2.14倍。在动态调度下回放这些实测轨迹，假设阶段时长不变，平均工具等待时间减少18.8%，批处理总耗时减少22.3%。Metal Sandbox及其Harbor集成已在GitHub上开源。
translation.brief: 针对Mac集群上Metal内核生成代理的GPU利用率低下问题，构建了带命令级跨节点调度的隔离执行沙箱基础设施Metal Sandbox。

papers.title: Goal Encoding in LLMs
papers.abstract: We investigate whether and how LLMs encode goals: internal neural representations that precede and guide action, and that are flexible enough to be realized through many different execution paths. We construct a coding setting with multiple sub-tasks that allows us to evaluate goal-seeking behavior and the selection of sub-goals. In this setting, we localize an encoding of the next sub-goal in the outputs of a sparse set of attention heads. The same heads can be used to decode the LM's future actions in natural language (e.g., "I'm checking if a word is a palindrome"). We verify that this encoding is causal for next action and is plastic: transplanting it into a different environment, e.g., another programming language, triggers the same operation realized with a different sequence of tokens. The LM also sustains the encoding throughout the action's execution, which is puzzling because a transformer LM without recurrence cannot carry a state forward for more tokens than it has layers left. We propose that it does not need to. Under a non-recurrent goal-seeking (NRGS) account, the LM frequently re-reads the goal from the task specification, compares it with the progress visible in the growing context, and pursues what remains. We test the predictions of this account with targeted causal interventions.

translation.title: LLM中的目标编码
translation.abstract: 我们研究LLM是否以及如何编码目标：即在行动之前存在并指导行动、且足够灵活以通过多种不同执行路径实现的内部神经表示。我们构建了一个包含多个子任务的编程环境，以评估目标搜寻行为和子目标的选择。在该环境中，我们在稀疏的注意力头集合的输出中定位了下一个子目标的编码。同样的注意力头可用于以自然语言解码语言模型未来的动作（例如“我在检查一个词是否是回文”）。我们验证了该编码对下一个动作具有因果性，并且是可塑的：将其移植到不同的环境（如另一种编程语言）中，会触发以不同token序列实现的相同操作。该语言模型还在动作执行的整个过程中维持这一编码，这一点令人费解，因为无循环结构的transformer语言模型无法在剩余层数不够多的情况下将状态持续传递下去。我们提出它无需这样做。在非循环目标搜寻（NRGS）的解释下，语言模型频繁地从任务说明中重新读取目标，将其与不断增长的上下文中可见的进展进行比较，并继续 pursue 剩余部分。我们通过有针对性的因果干预检验了该解释的预测。
translation.brief: 研究LLM如何在注意力头中编码并维持下一子目标，并提出LM通过从任务说明反复重读目标（非循环目标搜寻）来维持目标追踪的解释。

papers.title: Where LLM Agents Get Stuck Debugging Databases: Access More Than Reasoning
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents are increasingly asked not only to write code but to debug running systems from live runtime data. We report a field observation of one such agent (Claude Code) as it diagnosed eight database incidents in a production message-dispatch engine. In every incident whose root cause depended on runtime concurrency, the agent announced a cause, shipped a fix, and later walked it back, and each wrong guess cost a deploy-and-observe cycle. Mapping each incident to what the agent lacked, we find that access to production state was the most pervasive bottleneck. The missing access included live lock views, untruncated deadlock reports, read-only execution, and an explicit environment context. An access gap was present in all five concurrency-dependent incidents: alone in one, and in four combined with a reasoning error such as anchoring on an early cause, incomplete exploration of the configuration, or a misreading of the code's transaction semantics. The three incidents that did not depend on concurrency needed nothing beyond what the agent already had. Within the incidents, the agent's wrong hypotheses were consistent with the evidence it could see; they were not fabrications. We argue that the next step for production-debugging agents is a forensics layer that gives the agent the access it lacks inside existing security controls. Such a layer would combine a safe interrogation API, a lock-and-deadlock flight recorder, and a production replay harness.

translation.title: LLM代理在调试数据库时为何卡住：访问受限多于推理不足
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）编程代理越来越多地被要求不仅编写代码，还要基于运行时实时数据调试正在运行的系统。我们报告了对一个这样的代理（Claude Code）在生产消息分发引擎中诊断八起数据库故障的实地观察。在每一起根因依赖于运行时并发性的故障中，该代理都宣布了一个原因、发布了一个修复，随后又撤回该修复，而每次错误猜测都要付出一次“部署并观察”的代价。将每起故障映射到代理所缺失的东西，我们发现对生产状态的访问是最普遍的瓶颈。缺失的访问包括实时锁视图、未截断的死锁报告、只读执行以及明确的环境上下文。在所有五起依赖并发的故障中都存在访问缺口：其中一起仅由访问缺口导致，另外四起则与推理错误（如锚定于早期原因、对配置的探索不完整、或误读代码的事务语义）共同存在。三起不依赖并发的故障则无需代理现有能力之外的任何东西。在这些故障中，代理的错误假设与其所能看到的证据一致，并非凭空捏造。我们认为，生产调试代理的下一步是一个取证层，在现有安全控制范围内赋予代理其所缺乏的访问能力。这样的层将结合一个安全的查询API、一个锁与死锁的“飞行记录仪”以及一个生产回放环境。
translation.brief: 通过观察Claude Code诊断生产数据库故障，发现LLM代理调试卡住的主要瓶颈是对生产运行状态的访问缺口，并提出在现有安全控制内增加取证层（查询API、锁/死锁记录仪、回放环境）的方案。

papers.title: CoReMem: Cost-Internalizing Memory for Successive Coding Tasks with Prospective Valuation
papers.abstract: Coding agents tackle successive tasks on an evolving repository, carrying forward edits and writing memory before the next task is known. Selecting memory for unknown next tasks requires balancing future usefulness against the costs of writing and reading it. The actor must also decide when acting on available memory saves effort as the task unfolds. We introduce Coding-Repository Memory (CoReMem), a cost-internalizing framework that guides memory design and actor adaptation through measured memory value on the next task. Prospective segment valuation compares runs of the next task with and without individual trajectory segments from the same inherited repository state, guiding a compact memory built around anchors: repository locations and executable checks. Actor adaptation estimates on-policy memory value within rollout groups with and without memory, using a reward that prioritizes resolution and penalizes step count in successful runs. Provenance-gated value credit assigns the additional value term to steps identified as using memory-supplied anchors, while every step retains outcome credit. On ChainSWE, CoReMem raises the 27B actor's resolve rate from 21.0% to 25.7%, with 17% fewer steps and 11% fewer total cache-aware tokens, including memory-module calls, relative to the untrained actor model without memory.

translation.title: CoReMem：通过前瞻性估值内化成本的成功式编码任务记忆
translation.abstract: 编程代理在不断演进的仓库上处理连续任务，需要在下一个任务未知之前携带修改并写入记忆。为未知任务选择记忆需要权衡其未来有用性与写入和读取的成本。行动者还必须在任务展开过程中决定何时利用已有记忆可以节省工作量。我们提出编码仓库记忆（CoReMem），一个成本内化的框架，通过在下一个任务上实测的记忆价值来指导记忆设计与行动者适应。前瞻性片段估值在相同的继承仓库状态下，将带与不带单个轨迹片段运行下一任务的结果进行对比，用以指导构建一个围绕锚点（仓库位置和可执行检查）的紧凑记忆。行动者适应通过在带与不带记忆的rollout组内估计在策略的记忆价值来进行，其奖励优先考虑问题解决并在成功运行中惩罚步数。来源门控的价值分配将额外的价值项分配给被识别为使用记忆提供锚点的步骤，而每个步骤仍保留结果信用。在ChainSWE上，CoReMem将27B行动者的解决率从21.0%提升到25.7%，与不带记忆的未训练行动者模型相比，步数减少17%，含记忆模块调用的缓存感知总token数减少11%。
translation.brief: 针对编程代理连续任务中的记忆写入成本与选择问题，提出用下一任务的前瞻性估值来内化成本并构建以仓库锚点为核心的紧凑记忆框架CoReMem。

papers.title: AgentSSL: Can MLE Agents Leverage Unlabeled Data?
papers.abstract: Applying machine learning systems to new domains introduces bottlenecks in both labeled data acquisition and manual pipeline engineering. While recent MLE agents show promise in automating pipeline design, they have been studied almost exclusively in fully supervised settings, leaving them untested in realistic regimes where labeled data is scarce but unlabeled data is abundant. In this work, we introduce Agentic Semi-Supervised Learning (AgentSSL), framing SSL as a program search problem and studying how agents navigate this space under limited supervision. We find that even under weak feedback and matched compute, agents can synthesize code that combines and adapts established SSL techniques, exceeding the strongest human-engineered baselines in 8 of 12 settings by up to +21.8%. However, our results identify program selection as a critical bottleneck in AgentSSL, where performance drops by as much as 47% when selecting based on the agent's feedback metric. To systematically study this bottleneck, we introduce ProgramSelectBench, a large-scale benchmark with a combined total of 16,977 agent-generated and human-engineered SSL programs, and evaluate both unsupervised and active program selection methods. We further evaluate AgentSSL on real-world ecology detection tasks, highlighting the opportunities and challenges of transferring agent-discovered strategies beyond controlled benchmarks.

translation.title: AgentSSL：MLE 智能体能否利用无标注数据？
translation.abstract: 将机器学习系统应用于新领域时，标注数据获取和人工流程工程都会成为瓶颈。尽管近期的 MLE 智能体在自动化流程设计方面展现出前景，但已有研究几乎全部集中在全监督设置下，尚未在标注数据稀缺而无标注数据丰富的现实场景中得到检验。本文提出智能体半监督学习（AgentSSL），将 SSL 框架化为程序搜索问题，并研究智能体在有限监督下如何在这一空间中探索。我们发现，即使在弱反馈和相同算力条件下，智能体也能合成组合并适配已有 SSL 技术的代码，在 12 个设置中的 8 个超过最强的人工工程基线，提升最高达 +21.8%。然而，研究结果表明程序选择是 AgentSSL 的关键瓶颈：当基于智能体自身的反馈指标进行选择时，性能最多下降 47%。为系统研究这一瓶颈，我们提出 ProgramSelectBench，一个包含共 16,977 个智能体生成与人工工程 SSL 程序的大规模基准，并评估了无监督和主动式程序选择方法。我们还在真实世界的生态学检测任务上评估了 AgentSSL，凸显了将智能体发现的策略迁移到受控基准之外的机遇与挑战。
translation.brief: 研究 MLE 智能体在标注数据稀缺场景下能否自动合成半监督学习程序，并将其框架化为程序搜索问题，同时提出 ProgramSelectBench 基准来研究其中的程序选择瓶颈。

papers.title: Internalizing Investment Mandates: A Neurosymbolic RL Approach to Portfolio Allocation
papers.abstract: Institutional portfolios operate under investment policy statements that specify asset allocation constraints, often conditioned on market regime information. Deep reinforcement learning has been shown to optimize financial performance but typically does not enforce rule compliance, making it unsuitable for real-world deployment. Existing neurosymbolic methods such as Probabilistic Logic Policy Gradient (PLPG) offer constraint-satisfying reinforcement learning (RL) via differentiable symbolic supervision but assume a finite, discrete action space. We present a PLPG-inspired continuous allocation method that estimates the probability that the policy's own executed action satisfies the investment mandate, using reparameterized Monte Carlo sampling, and adds it to the training objective. No post-hoc enforcement mechanism intercepts actions at inference time and compliance is learned by the agent. Audited directly on deterministic mean actions with no correction, the policy reduces violations of a six-rule regime-conditional mandate from 96-98% for unconstrained RL and 33.4% for a reward-penalty baseline to 4.8%, showing that a continuous-action neurosymbolic policy can substantially internalize a symbolic mandate.

translation.title: 内化投资授权：一种神经符号强化学习投资组合配置方法
translation.abstract: 机构投资组合在投资政策声明（规定资产配置约束，且常以市场状态信息为条件）下运作。深度强化学习虽已被证明能优化财务表现，但通常无法保证规则合规，因而不适合真实世界部署。现有的神经符号方法如概率逻辑策略梯度（PLPG）通过可微符号监督实现满足约束的强化学习（RL），但假设动作空间是有限且离散的。我们提出一种受 PLPG 启发的连续配置方法，使用重参数化蒙特卡洛采样估计策略自身执行的动作满足投资授权的概率，并将其加入训练目标。推理时不采用任何事后强制机制拦截动作，合规性由智能体自行学习。在无任何修正的确定性均值动作上直接审计时，该策略将六条状态条件授权规则的违规率从无约束 RL 的 96-98% 和奖励惩罚基线的 33.4% 降至 4.8%，表明连续动作的神经符号策略能够实质性内化符号化授权。
translation.brief: 针对深度强化学习投资组合配置无法保证遵守投资政策约束的问题，提出一种基于重参数化蒙特卡洛采样的连续动作神经符号方法，将合规概率纳入训练目标以学习内化规则。

papers.title: ArchSpace: Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing LLM Architecture Research
papers.abstract: Model architecture shapes the scaling behavior, training efficiency, and inference cost of LLMs, making it a central focus of both industry and academia. In industry, teams such as those behind DeepSeek, Qwen, and Kimi routinely introduce architectural innovations, yet public reports rarely document which ideas succeeded, which were abandoned, and why. In academia, limited compute and inconsistent baselines often restrict evaluations to small-scale, single-point comparisons, making it difficult to establish whether improvements hold at larger scales or translate into broader impact. ArchSpace addresses both gaps as a public platform for Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing Architecture Researc}: each proposal is recorded with its experiments and reasoning, reviewed by the community, and referenced by later work. To evaluate ideas before costly large-scale training, ArchSpace leverages scaling laws to predict model loss at larger scales from smaller experiments, a practice widely adopted in industry. We provide initial references that make the platform usable: Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 baselines, fitted scaling laws, and a reusable training recipe. Ideas validated through this review can in turn become new baselines, and ArchSpace thereby aims to broaden the range of ideas that shape the next generation of models.

translation.title: ArchSpace：记录、评审与引用 LLM 架构研究
translation.abstract: 模型架构决定 LLM 的扩展行为、训练效率和推理成本，是产业界和学术界共同关注的核心。在产业界，DeepSeek、Qwen 和 Kimi 背后的团队不断引入架构创新，但公开报告很少记录哪些想法成功、哪些被放弃及其原因。在学术界，有限的算力和不一致的基线常使评估局限于小规模、单点比较，难以判断改进能否在更大规模下保持或产生更广泛的影响。ArchSpace 通过构建一个公开的架构研究记录、评审与引用平台来填补这两方面空白：每个提案连同其实验和推理过程被记录下来，由社区评审，并被后续工作引用。为在昂贵的大规模训练之前评估想法，ArchSpace 借助扩展定律从小规模实验预测更大规模下的模型损失，这也是业界广泛采用的做法。我们提供了使平台可用的初始参考资料：Qwen3.5 和 OLMo3 基线、拟合的扩展定律以及可复用的训练方案。通过评审验证的想法可以反过来成为新基线，ArchSpace 由此致力于拓展塑造下一代模型的思路范围。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 架构创新缺乏公开记录与可扩展评估的问题，构建一个记录、评审和引用架构研究的公共平台，并利用扩展定律从小规模实验预测大规模效果。
